studio:prompts3:ours-1032.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean daily vlog 4-panel square post, showing one person across four time blocks with clear lifestyle progression.
Social-media-friendly 2x2 grid collage that reads instantly at thumbnail size while feeling like a real captured day, with lived-in props, Korean captions, and subtle Instagram-style interface details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The same person should occupy the visual focus in all four panels, with consistent face shape, hairstyle, skin tone, accessories, and outfit continuity cues, while each panel clearly reflects a different time of day.
- Use {레이아웃} with equal panel sizes, thin gutters, and a polished square framing system; keep the subject centered or slightly off-center depending on each scene, allowing natural objects around them to describe the activity.
- Backgrounds should feel like everyday Korean indoor-outdoor spaces with realistic surfaces: apartment window, wooden table, lunch counter or office corner, café glass reflection, sofa and small living-room items; include believable lifestyle details without overwhelming the subject.
- Place {타임라인} as a compact caption system near the top or within each panel, and use {각 컷} as the activity logic for each frame.
- Add small social-post details: a tiny handle label, date/location tag, short caption strip, sticker-like tags, and micro save/share icons integrated tastefully into the collage.
- Keep color transitions readable across the grid, following {컬러} without making any one panel visually dominate.
- Preserve square format harmony with {비율} and avoid cropping important facial features, hands, key food/drink objects, or the home-cinema context.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top-left panel: morning scene based on {타임라인}, with {각 컷} interpreted as a coffee moment; bright natural light, ceramic mug with steam, small plate, notebook or phone, soft curtain, table surface, and a relaxed start-of-day pose.
2) Top-right panel: midday scene, still the same person, with {각 컷} interpreted as lunch; slightly stronger daylight, casual Korean lunch setting with tray, bowl or sandwich, water cup, tote bag or jacket on chair, and a natural mid-day expression.
3) Bottom-left panel: afternoon scene, with {각 컷} interpreted as a café break; softer interior light, iced drink or dessert plate, receipt, laptop or book, window reflections, street blur outside, and a leisurely pose that still matches the same subject identity.
4) Bottom-right panel: night scene, with {각 컷} interpreted as a home cinema moment; darker indoor setting, TV/projector screen glow, popcorn bowl, remote control, blanket, sofa cushions, warm lamp, and a calm ending mood.
5) Across all four panels, maintain a consistent editorial collage language: aligned gutters, matching rounded corners or sharp grid edges, small readable separation between scenes, and subtle overlay labels that feel like a finished social carousel cover.
6) Include a small footer or corner overlay across the full square: handle, day-log caption, and page indicator, designed to look printed or digitally overlaid rather than floating randomly.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight, 24–32px for panel labels, 18–22px for small subtitles, clean sans-serif with tight tracking.
- Color palette: soft morning beige, lunch daylight cream, café caramel, night navy, muted gray, with transitions guided by {컬러}.
- Border/shadow: thin white or light-gray panel borders, subtle 2–4px shadow, 10–15% opacity, crisp editorial grid separation.
- Graphic overlays: tiny rounded labels, semi-transparent caption pills, small doodle-style sparkle or heart stickers, page indicator dots, and micro UI icons should be realistic and restrained.
- Text hierarchy: each panel needs one time label, one short activity label, and one tiny contextual line; the full collage may include one small top title or bottom caption.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm or 50mm full-frame look, f/2.8–f/4, documentary lifestyle framing with natural perspective and moderate depth of field.
- Lighting: morning soft window light from upper-left, midday brighter diffuse daylight, afternoon side window light with gentle fill, night practical lamp light plus soft screen glow.
- Color grade: warm-to-cool progression from creamy beige in the morning to deeper navy and amber in the night panel, with realistic skin tones preserved.
- Texture realism: visible fabric weave, ceramic highlights, condensation on iced drink, paper receipt, table grain, sofa fabric, and soft reflections in glass should make the collage feel photographed rather than sterile.

[6. MOOD]
Clean Korean lifestyle editorial — like a polished Instagram day-in-the-life carousel with a Kinfolk-meets-Dazed collage feel, realistic and cozy, with small personal details that make the day feel genuinely lived.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문구: "아침 7시", "점심 12시", "오후 4시", "밤 9시", "커피·런치·카페·홈씨네".
- 추가로 자연스럽게 표시할 수 있는 짧은 한국어 문구: "오늘의 데일리 브이로그", "서울의 하루", "@daily.me", "2026.05.01", "저장", "공유", "1/4".
- 각 컷 활동 라벨 예시: "모닝커피", "점심 기록", "카페 쉬는 시간", "홈씨네 나이트".
- 동일 인물 시간대 변화 식별이 가능해야 하며, 4컷 모두 같은 사람으로 인식되어야 한다.
- 2x2 그리드에서 각 컷의 장면 구분이 명확해야 한다.
- 모든 한국어 텍스트는 깨지지 않고 정확한 글자 형태로 렌더링되어야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Mismatched identity across panels or impossible anatomy

studio:prompts3:ours-1031.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Four-panel yoga pose reference sheet featuring the same person from {참고 이미지} in a polished 2x2 grid, suitable for instructional social posts, personal fitness tracking, and a saved routine card.
Pose showcase should feel like a real wellness studio record: clear body alignment visibility, warm lifestyle details, and readable Korean micro-copy for sharing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: each of the 4 panels holds one full-body pose, centered with head-to-toe visibility and consistent scale across panels.
- Background treatment: {장소} as a realistic yoga studio corner with a soft studio floor, visible yoga mat texture, warm cream wall, subtle sage-green accents, daylight window glow, small natural wellness details such as a folded towel, cork yoga block, water bottle, or potted plant placed away from the body silhouette.
- Spacing and framing: equal gutters between panels, designed outer frame with a top title band and bottom social-caption band, clean separation between poses, strong silhouette readability.
- Add a small editorial header: “오늘의 요가 기록” and “자세 체크 4컷”. Include date/location label “2026.05.01 · {장소}”, handle “@my_yoga.log”, and compact hashtag-style text “#호흡 #균형 #유연성”.
- Use {요가 자세 4종}, {레이아웃}, {장소}, {컬러}, {비율} placeholders to control pose set, grid structure, setting, palette, and overall aspect.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Panel 1 (top-left): {참고 이미지} in {요가 자세 4종} first pose, full body upright and aligned, feet planted clearly, hands visible, neutral front-facing angle for easy comparison. Add small Korean label badge “01 시작 자세” near the lower-left of the panel.
2) Panel 2 (top-right): second pose from {요가 자세 4종}, body turned slightly to reveal side profile and spine alignment, mat edge straight and readable. Add small Korean label badge “02 균형 체크”.
3) Panel 3 (bottom-left): third pose from {요가 자세 4종}, lower-body or hinge-focused pose, complete body in frame with even visual breathing room above the head and below the feet. Add small Korean label badge “03 호흡 유지”.
4) Panel 4 (bottom-right): fourth pose from {요가 자세 4종}, backbend or floor-based pose, clean arc lines and stable contact points, wrists and toes fully visible. Add small Korean label badge “04 마무리 스트레칭”.
5) Grid system: {레이아웃} should be balanced with uniform panel size, matching camera distance across all four frames, editorial divider lines, tiny page indicator “1/1”, and a small save/share icon row in the bottom band.
6) Environment continuity: {장소} should look identical across panels, with the same mat color, same floor texture, consistent daylight direction, and repeated studio props in believable positions that do not cover key alignment points.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for Korean labels, 28–36px equivalent for panel labels, larger 46–58px equivalent for the main title “오늘의 요가 기록”, high legibility with editorial spacing.
- Color palette: {컬러} with cream #F6F1E8, sage green #B8C7B0, soft gray #D9D9D9, muted charcoal #2E2E2E, plus warm wood-floor beige and natural cork tones.
- Border/shadow: thin white editorial frames, sage dividers, rounded label badges, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity.
- Graphic details: add subtle sticker-like tags such as “AM ROUTINE”, “10분 루틴”, and “저장하고 따라 하기” in small Korean/English mix, with tiny leaf or circle accent shapes matching {컬러}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 50mm lens at f/5.6, straight-on studio framing, consistent distance for each panel, crisp body edges.
- Lighting: bright natural window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, soft diffuse shadows on the mat, realistic highlights on skin, fabric, mat grain, and wood floor.
- Color grade: warm cream and soft sage with low-contrast editorial tone, lightly desaturated, clean skin tones, natural texture detail in clothing, mat, floor, wall, and props.

[6. MOOD]
Warm wellness reference-sheet aesthetic — similar to a premium Korean yoga studio social post, calm, organized, personal, and realistic.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all visible Korean clearly and naturally, including “오늘의 요가 기록”, “자세 체크 4컷”, “2026.05.01 · {장소}”, “01 시작 자세”, “02 균형 체크”, “03 호흡 유지”, “04 마무리 스트레칭”, “10분 루틴”, “저장하고 따라 하기”, “#호흡 #균형 #유연성”.
- Identity/layout invariants: same person from {참고 이미지} in all 4 panels, consistent face, hair, outfit, body proportions, and skin tone across the entire sheet.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: exactly 5 fingers per hand, feet and hands anatomically correct, no duplicated limbs, each pose must match the requested yoga posture accurately, with full wrists, ankles, fingers, and toes visible when relevant.
- Realism: believable yoga clothing fabric folds, mat compression under hands/feet, soft contact shadows, and consistent studio perspective across panels.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-1030.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
4컷 운동 자세 비교 인포그래픽, 개인 피트니스 체크용 정사각형 SNS 카드.
동일 인물의 기본 4대 운동 자세를 실제 헬스장 트레이닝 기록처럼 {레이아웃}로 정리한 고급 피트니스 코칭 카드.
상단에는 한국어 타이틀, 날짜/장소 라벨, 계정 핸들, 짧은 캡션이 들어가고, 하단에는 저장·공유 마이크로 UI, 해시태그, 운동 체크 메모가 들어간 현실적인 SNS 피드 디자인.
운동 수행 기록, 폼 피드백, 오늘의 오운완 인증샷을 한 장에 정리한 프리미엄 피트니스 프로필 카드처럼 보이게 한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 캔버스는 정사각형 1:1, {레이아웃}을 반영한 2x2 그리드 4컷이 정확히 같은 크기로 배치되도록 구성한다.
- 각 패널 안에서 인물은 중앙에 크게 배치하되, 머리와 발끝이 과도하게 잘리지 않도록 안정적인 스포츠 포트레이트 프레이밍을 유지한다.
- 어두운 헬스장 배경 위에 네온 그린과 시안 포인트를 주고, 각 컷 사이에는 얇은 구분선 또는 8px 내외의 간격을 둔다.
- {참고 이미지}의 얼굴과 체형, 헤어스타일, 피부톤은 4컷 모두 동일하게 유지한다.
- {의상}은 네 컷 모두 동일하게 유지하고, 운동 동작이 잘 보이도록 실루엣이 단정하게 드러나게 한다.
- {운동목록}은 좌상단부터 우상단, 좌하단, 우하단 순으로 자연스럽게 읽히도록 배치한다.
- 카드 상단 얇은 헤더 영역에 Korean title text: “{카드제목}”, small date label: “{날짜시간}”, location label: “{장소}”, handle text: “{핸들}”를 넣는다.
- 헤더 오른쪽에는 작은 프로필 원형 썸네일, “오늘 기록 저장됨”, “체크 완료” 같은 앱 상태 칩을 배치해 실제 피트니스 SNS 카드처럼 보이게 한다.
- 카드 하단에는 작은 진행 표시 “FORM CHECK 04/04”, “{하단CTA}”, “{해시태그}”와 tiny save/share/bookmark icon 느낌의 UI를 배치한다.
- 각 패널에는 짧은 운동명 라벨, 세트/횟수 텍스트, 1줄 코칭 포인트를 포함한다. 예: “01 스쿼트”, “{세트기록}”, “무릎은 발끝 방향”.
- 패널 한쪽에는 작고 선명한 데이터 칩으로 “{운동강도}”, 체크 박스, 난이도 점 표시, 휴식 시간 메모를 넣어 실제 트레이너 피드백 화면처럼 구성한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top-left panel: {운동목록} 중 첫 번째 자세를 정면 또는 3/4 각도로 보여주고, 바벨/덤벨/몸의 축 정렬이 명확하게 보이도록 한다. 패널 라벨은 “01”, 운동명, “체중 중심 확인” 같은 짧은 한국어 코칭 태그를 추가한다. 발 위치 근처에는 얇은 네온 가이드 라인과 작은 원형 관절 포인트를 넣는다.
2) Top-right panel: 두 번째 자세는 시작 위치와 마무리 자세가 한눈에 읽히도록 하고, 무릎·허리·어깨 각도가 분명하게 보이게 한다. 작은 각도 가이드 라인과 “허리 중립”, “호흡 고정” 같은 캡션을 넣어 실제 트레이너 피드백처럼 보이게 한다.
3) Bottom-left panel: 세 번째 자세는 상체와 하체의 균형이 강조되도록 프레임 안에 완전히 들어오게 구성한다. 배경에는 랙, 원판, 케이블 머신, 고무 매트 질감, 물병, 수건, 벽면 운동 시간표 같은 자연스러운 헬스장 디테일이 보이게 한다.
4) Bottom-right panel: 네 번째 자세는 가장 역동적인 구간을 포착하되, 동작이 과장되지 않게 실제 운동 폼처럼 표현한다. “마지막 반복”, “속도 안정” 같은 짧은 메모와 미세한 모션 에너지 라인을 더한다.
5) Panel consistency: 네 컷 모두 같은 인물, 같은 {의상}, 같은 조명 톤, 같은 카메라 거리로 통일해 비교가 쉽게 보이도록 한다.
6) Background detail: 각 패널 뒤에는 어두운 헬스장 장비 실루엣, 금속 바벨 질감, 고무 바닥 텍스처, 흐릿한 LED 사인, 거울 반사, 분필 가루, 형광 느낌의 포인트 라인을 넣고 심도와 대비를 조절한다.
7) Data overlay: 패널 모서리에 작은 체크 박스, 세트 기록, 난이도 점 표시를 넣는다. 예: “난이도 ●●●○○”, “{운동강도}”, “휴식 60초”. 텍스트는 실제 앱 UI처럼 선명하고 작게 배치한다.
8) Social card details: 하단 바에는 저장 아이콘, 공유 아이콘, 댓글 아이콘, 북마크 아이콘을 아주 작게 배치하고, “좋아요 128”, “코치 메모 4개”, “슬라이드 1/1” 같은 마이크로 카피를 포함한다.
9) Caption strip: 중앙 하단 또는 하단 바 위에 “{트레이너메모}”를 짧은 캡션 스트립으로 넣어 개인 운동 기록 카드의 정보성을 강화한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold, 22–28px 느낌의 짧은 캡션 스타일을 사용하고, 숫자 라벨은 Pretendard Bold로 더 두껍게 처리한다.
- Color palette: matte black #111111, charcoal #2A2A2A, neon green #7CFF4E, electric cyan #28D7FF, cool white #F2F5F7, with {컬러톤} accents applied to labels, guide lines, badges, and small UI elements.
- Border/shadow: 각 패널에 2px 내외의 얇은 다크 그레이 라인, 인물에는 8px y-offset / 18px blur / 18% opacity의 소프트 그림자.
- Graphic elements: 얇은 자세 가이드 라인, 작은 원형 관절 포인트, 체크 아이콘, 세트 기록 칩, 하단 페이지 인디케이터, 앱 스타일 토글, 작은 해시태그 스티커를 사용해 실제 피트니스 앱 캡처와 스포츠 매거진 인포그래픽 사이의 질감을 만든다.
- Text hierarchy: 상단 타이틀은 가장 굵게, 각 패널 운동명은 두 번째로 크게, 세트/코칭 메모는 작지만 판독 가능하게 구성한다.
- Ratio handling: {비율}이 드러나도록 인물의 전신 비율과 그리드 패널 비율을 안정적으로 맞추고, 4컷의 크기와 간격을 균일하게 유지한다.
- UI realism: 모든 오버레이는 반투명 다크 칩, 미세한 글로우, 작은 라운드 코너를 사용하고, 실제 모바일 앱에서 캡처한 듯한 정보 밀도를 가진다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 35mm camera with 50mm f/1.8 lens, indoor sports portrait framing, sharp subject separation.
- Lighting: gym-style mixed lighting with overhead cool white practical lights plus subtle neon edge light from the back-right, mild contrast.
- Color grade: deep black shadows, crisp cool highlights, neon green and cyan accents, slightly desaturated skin tones for a clean training-app look.
- Realism: realistic gym textures including rubber flooring, brushed steel equipment, chalk dust on grips, subtle sweat sheen on skin, fabric folds in {의상}, knurled barbell detail, scuffed weight plates, and soft reflections from metal weights.
- Depth: background equipment should be recognizable but slightly out of focus, with the person and posture guide overlays remaining sharp.
- Finish: premium SNS feed card, crisp 1024x1024 export, clean but information-rich editorial composition with realistic exercise documentation.

[6. MOOD]
High-end fitness coaching app editorial — premium training campaign meets clean sports infographic feel.
현실적인 개인 운동 기록, 트레이너가 바로 피드백해 줄 것 같은 전문적인 분위기, SNS에 업로드해도 자연스러운 고급 트레이닝 카드 무드.
운동 후 땀, 형광 조명, 고무 매트 냄새가 느껴지는 실제 헬스장 현장감과 정리된 앱 UI의 세련미를 함께 표현한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 모든 한국어 라벨은 깨끗하고 정확해야 한다. Use short Korean labels such as “{카드제목}”, “스쿼트”, “허리 중립”, “무릎 방향”, “{세트기록}”, “{장소}”.
- 필수 렌더링 텍스트: “{날짜시간}”, “{핸들}”, “{하단CTA}”, “{해시태그}”, “FORM CHECK 04/04”, “좋아요 128”, “코치 메모 4개”.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean financial app advertising poster, vertical mobile-first campaign visual, designed to clearly present an in-app screen with family-friendly trust and optimism.
Premium magazine-style brand ad with a warm everyday-life mood, emphasizing safe child savings, daily interest benefits, and parental reassurance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main in-app screen: centered hero takes about 62% of the frame height, with a front-facing close-up, crisp device edges, and stable vertical composition.
- 주변 연출: parent and child presence should be felt softly around the app screen through warm hands near the phone, a blurred child profile, a parent cardigan sleeve, or gentle lifestyle cues that support the message.
- Realistic everyday details: include a softly blurred wooden table texture, small savings jar with coins, child’s crayon drawing, pencil, calendar corner, and folded school notice in the background to make the savings moment feel lived-in and believable.
- Brand advertising frame: add a compact top brand lockup, a small campaign badge, a lower information band with QR area, app CTA, campaign period, consultation note, and legal fine print, all secondary to the app screen.
- Background treatment: bright white and soft cream base with warm amber haze, faint home-like interior suggestions, and subtle blue/mint graphic accents echoing the app UI.
- Framing direction: symmetrical balance with a strong central axis, using refined editorial spacing and realistic foreground/background layering so the app screen feels premium and easy to read.
- Use {주제}, {스타일·결}, {조명·라이팅}, {구도·앵글}, {컬러 팔레트}, {카메라·렌즈·필름}, {캠페인 배지}, {캠페인 기간}, {CTA 문구}, {QR 안내문}, {상담 안내}, {하단 고지문} as guiding variables while preserving the exact ad layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Center hero area: place the app screen prominently in the middle, large enough that the copy inside it is immediately legible; keep the device/screen edges crisp and clean with no perspective distortion.
2) Supporting family presence: add subtle parent-and-child atmosphere around the hero using soft-focus hands, warm clothing textures, a child’s blurred cheek or hair silhouette, and domestic tabletop items, so the scene feels like a real everyday savings moment.
3) Copy emphasis inside screen: ensure the following Korean lines are arranged clearly within the app screen hierarchy, with the headline strongest and supporting lines smaller but readable.
4) Poster information layer: place a neat top-left or top-center brand line, a rounded campaign badge near the phone, and a bottom strip containing QR code, CTA, campaign period, consultation/contact information, and one-line legal notice.
5) Visual realism: include tactile details such as matte phone glass reflections, soft paper fibers, tiny coin highlights, gentle shadow contact under objects, and warm window-light gradients.
6) Finish and polish: render the whole composition like a high-end financial service campaign, with precise edges, realistic materials, premium editorial color, and a reassuring family-friendly finish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: clean modern Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; headline heavy 700-800 weight, supporting text medium 500-600 weight, size hierarchy clearly separated.
- App UI text: the main headline must be the most prominent text inside the phone screen; supporting benefit lines should be in clear rounded cards or list modules with blue/mint icons.
- Brand and poster text: top brand lockup may use a refined bold sans-serif; bottom information band should use compact but readable Korean typography, 400-600 weight.
- Color palette: 신협 블루, mint, warm amber, white, soft cream, light wood beige, and muted family-lifestyle neutrals; use the palette from {컬러 팔레트} with bright, clean tonal separation.
- Graphic accents: use small rounded badges, soft wave shapes, coin/sprout/heart-line icons, and translucent blue/mint UI highlights that reinforce child savings and growth.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the app screen, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 15% opacity; realistic glass reflection on the device and a gentle contact shadow on the tabletop.
- Layout realism: QR code block, fine print, campaign period, and consultation line must look like real printed/ad-poster information, aligned to a tidy grid and not competing with the app screen.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP look, 105mm f/2.8, ISO 100, polished advertising clarity with precise micro-contrast.
- Lighting: 풍부하고 부드러운 자연광, like soft window light from upper-left at 45° with a faint fill from the right; warm amber ambient bounce throughout the scene.
- Color grade: warm amber + clean white + 신협 블루 and mint accents, with gentle high-key brightness, creamy highlights, natural skin-tone warmth, and refined commercial contrast.
- Material rendering: matte paper, smooth smartphone glass, soft knit fabric, pale wooden tabletop, translucent savings jar, and small metallic coin reflections should all feel physically realistic.
- Depth: shallow editorial depth of field around the lifestyle props and family presence, while the app screen and all required text remain sharply readable.

[6. MOOD]
Premium financial brand campaign — the refined warmth of a Kinfolk-style lifestyle ad combined with the trust-forward polish of a high-end banking poster.
The feeling should be warm, hopeful, safe, and parent-friendly: a quiet morning at home where a child’s future is being prepared with care.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 앱 화면 안에 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함:
  - "우리 아이 첫 재테크 0세부터 19세까지 부모님이 준비하는 아이모아통장"
  - "아이가 매일 이자를 받아요"
  - "부모님이 안전하게 관리해요"
  - "용돈미션으로 돈의가치를 배워요"
- 포스터 상단 또는 브랜드 영역에 아래 문구를 자연스럽게 표시:
  - "신협 아이모아통장"
  - "{캠페인 배지}"
- 하단 정보 영역에 아래 문구를 작지만 읽을 수 있게 표시:
  - "{CTA 문구}"
  - "{QR 안내문}"
  - "{캠페인 기간}"
  - "{상담 안내}"
  - "{하단 고지문}"
- App screen layout must remain centered and dominant, with the copy clearly readable and not cropped.
- Parent and child presence should remain subtle and supportive, not replacing the app screen.
- Vertical composition must stay stable and premium, with no skewed device perspective.
- QR code, badge, campaign period, and fine print must feel like real advertising details, but the exact savings-benefit copy inside the app remains the main focus.

[1. PURPOSE]
Completed modern mid-to-large hospital exterior architectural photo for a wide landscape format, suitable for editorial real-estate/architecture presentation.
A finished, operating hospital at dusk, emphasizing massing, facade materials, illuminated entrance activity, realistic site details, and the quiet isolation of a suburban medical campus.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {주제} placed as the full-frame hero, occupying about 70% of the width and 62% of the height, with the roofline clearly visible and the entrance canopy readable.
- Facade treatment: {외벽 마감} with crisp material transitions, realistic glass reflections, clean construction joints, small variations in panel tone, and believable weathering at edges and base details.
- Site treatment: {주변 환경} with trimmed grass, layered shrubs, young trees, stone edging, bollards, a paved drop-off lane, crosswalk markings, and a few subtle hospital-site details in the foreground.
- View direction: {구도·앵글} with the building centered slightly left or right for balanced asymmetry, and the sky visible as a strong dusk backdrop band.
- Text placement: include physically integrated Korean hospital signage on the facade and entrance only, such as ‘해온종합병원’, ‘응급의료센터’, and a small address plaque near the driveway; no floating graphic overlay.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero massing: show the entire completed hospital volume in one coherent frame, including the main entrance canopy, lobby glazing, upper patient-room levels, lit reception area, and the distinction between lower and upper facade sections.
- Lower facade band: render the terracotta panel base with warm earth tones, fine grout lines, subtle texture variation, tactile seams, shadowed corners, and a few mounted wall lights glowing under dusk light.
- Upper facade band: render the full curtain wall with stale blue glass, slim metal mullions, soft interior room lights in selected windows, and amber sunset reflections that stay soft and believable.
- Entrance zone: include a covered drop-off canopy with warm downlights, glass sliding doors, a wheelchair-accessible ramp, handrails, planters, tactile paving, a small wayfinding sign reading ‘접수 · 로비’, and a restrained ambulance/emergency bay marker reading ‘응급’.
- Ground plane: place trimmed grass, low shrubs, clean site curbs, a paved access lane, crosswalk stripes, drainage grates, a bench, a few bollards, and one or two small staff/visitor figures near the entrance for scale without turning the scene into a street view.
- Horizon and background: keep a distant mountain or field silhouette with a dusk gradient sky; the horizon should feel open and quiet, with no nearby urban buildings competing with the hospital.
- Lighting logic: apply {시간대·조명} so the sun angle creates long soft shadows and a gentle highlight on the terracotta, while the glass catches a warm reflective sheen and interior lights begin to read naturally.
- Camera framing: use {카메라·렌즈} to preserve straight verticals, high detail in facade surfaces, readable signage, and a natural architectural perspective.
- Aspect handling: {비율} with broad lateral context around the hospital, including enough driveway, landscaping, and sky to feel like a finished site documentation shot.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: any visible text must be real physical signage integrated into the architecture, using clean Korean sans-serif lettering; render ‘해온종합병원’, ‘응급의료센터’, ‘외래진료’, and small wayfinding labels accurately and legibly.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with realistic dusk saturation, avoiding oversharpened highlights or neon tones.
- Environmental shadows: use natural environmental shadows from the canopy, trees, bollards, and building massing, with a soft 8–12% contrast falloff in the shadowed facade areas.
- Surface quality: avoid plastic smoothing; preserve concrete, metal, glass, asphalt, stone curb, grass, shrub, and terracotta panel textures with authentic micro-contrast.
- Real-world detail: include subtle operational details such as lit lobby furniture silhouettes, door sensors, security camera domes, small exterior lights, accessible parking markings, and clean hospital wayfinding elements.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: {카메라·렌즈} with a true architectural-photo look, corrected perspective, and a neutral medium-contrast rendering.
- Lighting: dusk golden-hour sidelight from one side, low sun angle, long soft shadows across the site, warm reflections on glass, and early evening interior lights adding depth behind the curtain wall.
- Color grade: amber dusk highlights, terracotta earth midtones, stale blue curtain wall, grass green foreground, asphalt gray driveway, and a soft purple horizon band.

[6. MOOD]
Premium contemporary architecture editorial — the restrained clarity of a hospital portfolio image seen in Dezeen or Architectural Record, but with enough real operating-campus details to feel photographed on location at calm late sunset.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all visible building signage cleanly and correctly, especially ‘해온종합병원’, ‘응급의료센터’, ‘외래진료’, ‘접수 · 로비’, and a small plaque such as ‘서울시 서원구 해온로 247’.
- Must be a completed, fully built, operating hospital exterior with believable entry lighting, accessible entrance details, landscaping, and site circulation.
- Exact framing intent: wide architectural exterior shot, isolated medical campus setting, no construction context, no competing nearby building mass.
- Preserve the dusk amber + terracotta earth + stale blue curtain wall + grass green + soft purple horizon palette.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals/certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Self-care lifestyle editorial square image for a calm home routine magazine cover, combining home spa, yoga, and tea-time objects in one cohesive real-life composition.
Designed for social feed use, moodboard-style sharing, wellness content thumbnails, and a premium Korean lifestyle magazine cover finish with readable editorial text details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero placement: a balanced square editorial cover layout with the main still-life and a natural hand/side-cut moment centered in the frame, occupying about 60% of the canvas.
- Background treatment: off-white to ivory home surface with visible natural paper, linen, ceramic, wood, or stone texture; let the setting feel like a real quiet morning corner at home.
- Framing direction: arrange the spa, yoga, and tea-time elements in a calm editorial flow, with believable overlap, soft shadows, and small lifestyle details that connect them into one daily ritual.
- Use {테마} as the conceptual anchor, expressed through a warm self-care routine rather than a product mockup.
- Use {hero 이미지} for the main visual treatment, with a precise editorial crop, tactile materials, and a realistic home-studio atmosphere.
- Place {소품} as supporting accents around the hero area, allowing natural items such as tea leaves, towel folds, candle wax, book pages, ceramic texture, flower stems, or water droplets to enrich the scene.
- Apply {스타일링} to the arrangement so the objects feel curated but lived-in, like a premium lifestyle magazine shoot captured during an actual slow morning.
- Use {비율} as the final crop ratio, optimized for the 1024x1024 square format.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Central hero zone (middle 60%): show the main self-care scene as an editorial still life with a primary focal point such as a tea cup, folded robe, bath oil bottle, or relaxed hand reaching toward tea; secondary objects form a soft visual triangle.
2. Left or lower-left support area: place yoga-related elements such as a rolled mat edge, folded towel, strap, stretch band, or a small glimpse of a relaxed pose detail so it reads as part of the same routine.
3. Right or upper-right support area: place tea-time objects such as a ceramic teapot, loose tea leaves, cup, saucer, honey spoon, lemon slice, or steam detail in a compact real-life cluster.
4. Home spa accents: add candle, bath salt bowl, wooden brush, essential oil, small flower stem, face towel, or linen pouch near the periphery to imply a spa atmosphere with tactile warmth.
5. Magazine cover system: add a Korean lifestyle cover masthead at the top such as “SLOW HOME”, issue label “VOL.1013”, date label “2026년 5월호”, price “₩7,500”, and a small barcode area near the lower-right or lower-left edge.
6. Feature headline blurbs: include 2–3 short Korean blurbs placed around the composition, for example “10분 요가 루틴”, “허브티 레시피”, “반신욕 준비”, with small section labels and refined editorial hierarchy.
7. Credit details: include tiny spine/credit text such as “Wellness at Home / Photo Essay”, a small model-name or contributor credit like “모델: 지윤”, and a subtle page-style footer mark such as “SELF CARE ISSUE”.
8. Final visual read: the whole frame should feel like one calm self-care day captured as a real Korean lifestyle magazine cover, with tactile props, readable text, soft shadows, and premium editorial polish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR bold for headline-sized Korean text, around 42–56px equivalent, with smaller supporting text in 18–24px equivalent and tight editorial spacing.
- Main cover title: set bold Korean headline text such as “집에서 깊게 쉬는 법” or “오늘은 나를 돌보는 시간”, integrated over the image without hiding the hero object.
- Supporting editorial text: add compact Korean cover lines such as “10분 요가 루틴”, “따뜻한 허브티 한 잔”, “욕실을 스파처럼”, plus issue/date/price details that look printed and intentional.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} translated into concrete tones such as ivory #F5F0E8, dusty pink #D8B7B0, sage #A9B8A2, warm beige #C9B59A, and charcoal #333333.
- Border/shadow: use soft object shadows, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, enough to separate ceramics, fabric, glass, paper, and botanical details from the surface.
- Surface finish: matte editorial finish with subtle paper grain, ceramic speckle, woven towel fibers, candle wax texture, tea steam softness, and gentle organic material variation.
- Barcode and micro text: include a realistic barcode block and tiny magazine metadata, but keep all Korean characters clean and legible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 50mm lens at f/2.8 for a natural editorial still-life look, or 35mm top-down if more flat-lay structure is needed.
- Lighting: use {조명} as the lighting direction; soft window light from upper-left at 45°, with warm amber bounce fill from the opposite side and mild natural shadow falloff.
- Color grade: warm ivory, muted sage, dusty pink, beige, and charcoal with a slightly desaturated Kinfolk-inspired wellness editorial grade.
- Realism cues: preserve natural fabric wrinkles, ceramic irregularities, translucent tea color, soft candle glow, tiny tea-leaf fragments, towel pile texture, and believable hand scale if a hand appears.

[6. MOOD]
Premium self-care editorial — Kinfolk magazine spread meets Aesop-inspired home ritual aesthetic, with the richer visual language of a Korean wellness magazine cover.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all Korean text in the image must render correctly without broken characters.
- Required visible Korean/editorial details may include: “집에서 깊게 쉬는 법”, “10분 요가 루틴”, “허브티 레시피”, “반신욕 준비”, “2026년 5월호”, “모델: 지윤”.
- Keep the overall composition calm, balanced, and magazine-like while allowing realistic lifestyle richness, tactile materials, and natural home details.
- All objects should look real, clean, and intentionally arranged, with natural proportions, believable shadows, and no distortion.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

Preserve the original local street scene and subject identity while upgrading the mood into a real film-still street photograph with lived-in textures, believable neighborhood details, and subtle editorial polish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {원본 사진} stays as the anchor of the frame, with the alley perspective leading inward and giving depth; keep the original camera angle, lens feel, street geometry, and walking direction intact.
- Background treatment: maintain the neighborhood alley environment from {결}, including real-world details such as Korean signboards, bicycles, scooters, mailboxes, delivery boxes, small planters, cats, utility poles, tangled cables, wall stains, pavement seams, storefront edges, apartment entrances, and local shop fronts when they naturally belong to the source.
- Spacing and framing: vertical 1024x1536 composition with natural headroom, visible alley depth, and enough foreground pavement to feel like an actual walking photo; do not crop away important alley context or distort building lines.
- Character handling: apply {인물 옵션} while preserving facial features, body proportion, clothing silhouette, hairstyle, skin texture, and pose if a person is present.
- Atmosphere control: use {조명} to reshape the light mood only, without changing the real location identity; allow realistic highlights on windows, wet asphalt, metal shutters, parked bicycles, and glass doors.
- Local realism: add or clarify small everyday Korean alley cues only where plausible—old stickers on poles, faded shop notices, handwritten menu boards, recycling bags, potted plants, door buzzers, gas meters, delivery crates, drain covers, and lightly weathered walls—so the image feels observed rather than staged.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base scene preservation — Keep the original alley layout from {원본 사진}, including the same street depth, wall rhythm, sidewalk width, storefront positions, entrance spacing, and perspective vanishing point.
2. Subject rendering — If {인물 옵션} includes a person, preserve the exact face, skin texture, hair outline, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and walking posture; if no person, keep the alley as an atmospheric environmental street scene without forcing a new main subject.
3. Environmental details — Retain natural alley props from {소품} such as signs, bikes, scooters, cats, mailboxes, planters, crates, street lamps, cables, drain grates, and shop items in believable local placement; enrich surface detail and age without altering the architecture.
4. Street text and signage — Existing Korean signage must remain readable and natural. If blank or distant signage needs plausible enhancement, use short Korean neighborhood text such as “분식”, “세탁”, “영업중”, “김밥 3,500원”, “배달 가능”, “주차금지”, “오늘의 메뉴”, or “동네슈퍼” only when it fits the visible shop or wall context.
5. Lighting pass — Re-render the scene with {조명} so surface reflections, shadow softness, window glow, alley haze, and highlight direction feel cinematic but still believable in a real Korean alley.
6. Color treatment — Apply {컬러 그레이딩} as a restrained film-toned grade; preserve material realism on concrete, tile, brick, metal, glass, plastic bags, paper posters, plants, pavement, and fabric while shifting only the overall mood.
7. Output framing — Final image must remain a vertical travel-photo feel in {비율}, with stable composition, clean photographic edges, natural lens perspective, and no perspective warping.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: no graphic overlay typography; only environmental text that belongs inside the street scene is allowed. Real Korean signage, stickers, menu boards, posters, and shop labels should look printed, painted, handwritten, or weathered according to their material.
- Color palette: muted concrete gray, moss green, warm beige, charcoal black, faded blue, rust brown, off-white paper, plastic crate red, and soft amber accents; reference the tone of {컬러 그레이딩} without oversaturating.
- Border/shadow: no artificial frame treatment; physical shadows should be realistic with soft edge falloff, roughly 4px offset and 12px blur equivalent in feel, 15%–25% opacity in the darkest areas.
- Texture detail: emphasize authentic Korean alley materials—aged concrete, peeling paint, metal shutters, tiled walls, damp pavement, dusty glass, sun-faded banners, paper notices, rubber mats, plastic stools, and small potted plants.
- Human-scale cues: preserve natural street scale through door heights, window frames, parked bicycle size, curb edges, signs, utility boxes, and everyday objects.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame documentary street photo, 35mm lens at f/2.8 to f/4 look, natural perspective with minimal distortion; if the source feels tighter, mimic a 50mm street portrait framing without widening the alley.
- Lighting: {조명} rendered as real environmental light, such as golden hour side light, blue-hour ambient fill, cloudy afternoon softness, neon spill from a small shop, or post-rain reflected bounce; keep shadow edges physically plausible.
- Color grade: cinematic Korean film palette with subdued saturation, gentle highlight roll-off, slightly lifted blacks, and controlled contrast inspired by Wong Kar-wai, Lee Chang-dong, and Park Chan-wook visual mood.
- Detail rendering: high-resolution street-photo realism with fine grain, realistic skin texture if applicable, subtle lens falloff, believable depth separation, natural bokeh in distant lights, and no plastic-smooth surfaces.
- Environmental atmosphere: allow faint dust, humidity, light rain residue, warm shop interior glow, reflected signage color, or evening streetlamp bloom when consistent with {조명} and {결}.

[6. MOOD]
Korean urban walking scene — intimate film-still atmosphere with a Wong Kar-wai / Lee Chang-dong / Park Chan-wook inspired color sensibility, grounded in everyday neighborhood realism: quiet footsteps, lived-in storefronts, small local signs, weathered surfaces, and a sense of passing through a familiar 골목.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: any visible Korean signage, menu text, handwritten notice, sticker, address label, or printed street text from the source must remain correct and readable exactly as it appears in the reference.
- If adding plausible environmental Korean text to blank or unreadable signs, keep it short, natural, and correctly written, for example “영업중”, “분식”, “세탁”, “김밥 3,500원”, “주차금지”, “배달 가능”, “오늘의 메뉴”, or “동네슈퍼”.
- If a person is present, preserve the exact face, proportions, hairstyle, skin texture, clothing silhouette, and pose from {원본 사진}; do not change age, gender presentation, or identity.
- Keep the original alley’s physical layout, camera viewpoint, and object placement consistent; enrich local textures and believable small details without transforming the scene into another city or a different neighborhood type.
- Maintain realistic anatomy and body structure; hands, feet, shoulders, and reflected body parts, if visible, must be anatomically correct.
- Do not turn the result into a poster, magazine layout, illustration, or synthetic mockup; it must read as a real vertical street photograph.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals/certifications
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean solo-living room tour transformation, i2i interior edit for a realistic home-sharing post.
Editorial apartment tour visual that keeps the original room’s identity while upgrading tidiness, light, styling, and everyday livability.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the full room fills the frame as a wide-angle interior view, with the bed zone, desk zone, storage zone, floor area, and window/light direction all visible in one natural room-tour shot.
- Background treatment: preserve the original room layout and furniture identity from {원본 룸}, while making the room look carefully reset for a Korean 1-person household room tour; keep real wall texture, floor grain, fabric wrinkles, cable traces, shelf shadows, and small signs of daily use.
- Framing direction: straight-on room tour angle with slight depth from a corner perspective, keeping the spatial structure of {평수·구조} easy to read and showing how the occupant actually moves through the room.
- Styling control: apply the degree of tidying described in {정리 결} and {스타일링}; refine the scene with believable lived-in objects such as a mug, notebook, folded clothes, tissue box, charger, small plant, slippers, storage baskets, books, or a fabric tote where they naturally fit the reference room.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Entry view: show the room as a single cohesive lived space, with the main furniture arranged neatly and the walkway readable as part of a real compact Korean apartment.
- Bed area: make the bedding smooth but not artificial, with pillows aligned, blanket edges softened, natural fabric creases, and everyday accents such as a bedside book, phone cable, cushion, sleep mask, or small tray if they suit {스타일링}.
- Desk area: organize the desk surface into a realistic work/study zone with purposeful items: laptop or monitor, keyboard, notebook, pen cup, desk lamp, calendar, small receipt, sticky memo, cup, charger cable, or headphones, scaled to the existing desk and arranged according to {정리 결}.
- Storage area: keep closet, shelving, or wardrobe elements visually ordered, with grouped books, boxes, folded towels, hangers, storage bins, skincare bottles, or household supplies visible in a believable way; preserve the room size in {평수·구조}.
- Floor and daily-life details: include realistic floor contact, slight rug pile or mat texture if present, slippers near the bed or door, a laundry basket, trash bin, extension cord, or small fan/heater only if compatible with the original room identity.
- Surface detailing: preserve the original furniture material, finish, age, scratches, laminate sheen, wood grain, plastic edges, metal legs, and fabric wear patterns from the reference image, while subtly enhancing order, brightness, and surface cleanliness.
- Light transformation: use the lighting described in {조명} to lift shadowed corners, define edges, reveal wall and fabric texture, and make the room feel naturally photographed rather than digitally redrawn.
- Color balance: push the room toward the palette in {컬러 팔레트}, maintaining the original wood, white, and fabric tones while adding small accent color touches through realistic objects such as stationery, a plant, a cushion, a book spine, or a mug.
- Final presentation: keep the image as a believable one-person apartment room tour, with realistic proportions, practical storage, modest styling upgrades, and the honest atmosphere of a room someone actually lives in.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: do not add floating graphic captions or UI overlays; natural printed details may appear on calendars, book spines, delivery boxes, product labels, memos, or postcards if they belong in the room.
- Korean text in objects: any newly visible Korean micro-text should be short and realistic, for example “5월”, “오늘 할 일”, “세탁”, “영수증”, “룸투어”, or “집밥 기록”, and must be cleanly rendered.
- Color palette: beige, wood brown, off-white, soft gray, with small accent touches of green and yellow from {컬러 팔레트}; keep tones warm and neutral like a real Korean home interior editorial.
- Materials and shadows: use subtle natural contact shadows under furniture, bedding, boxes, plants, lamps, cables, and decor, plus soft ambient occlusion in corners; preserve believable texture on walls, flooring, curtains, paper, plastic, glass, and fabric.
- Realism control: add enough ordinary household detail to feel lived-in, but keep all additions subordinate to the original room from {원본 룸} and consistent with the chosen {정리 결}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame interior photograph look, 24mm wide-angle lens at f/5.6, straight horizon, room-tour perspective with realistic depth.
- Lighting: natural light from a single time of day, softened through a window, with a warm amber tint and gentle highlight rolloff; keep it believable and unforced.
- Color grade: warm beige + walnut + soft white with restrained amber highlights and a light green/yellow accent presence; clean home-visit documentary grade.
- Image texture: realistic smartphone-meets-editorial apartment photography, crisp but not over-sharpened, with gentle sensor noise, natural lens falloff, and no plastic CGI finish.

[6. MOOD]
Korean lifestyle magazine apartment tour — low-key editorial home interior with a warm Dwell / Kinfolk / Maison-style calm, but grounded in an ordinary 1인 가구 room with practical routines, small possessions, and real textures.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: if readable Korean appears on newly visible room objects, keep it short, clean, and natural; examples include “5월”, “오늘 할 일”, “세탁”, “룸투어”, “집밥 기록”. Preserve any existing Korean text from the reference image exactly without distortion.
- Preserve the exact room identity from {원본 룸}: same furniture shapes, proportions, textures, colors, printed details, window/door positions, floor material, and storage layout; do not redesign the original room or replace its core objects.
- Keep the original room layout legible for {평수·구조}, and make sure the scene reads as a real one-person home rather than a showroom or a rental listing render.
- Follow {정리 결}, {조명}, {스타일링}, {컬러 팔레트}, and {비율} closely while adding only plausible everyday details that could naturally belong to the existing occupant.
- Do not alter the original subject’s physical structure or printed labels if present; only tidy the room, adjust lighting, refine styling, and enrich realistic daily-life details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean cat adoption 안내 poster, vertical A4-style community flyer for shelter, foster, and adoption inquiry.
Designed to present one or multiple adoptable cats with clear rescue info, emotional appeal, event-style adoption details, and easy contact routes.
The final image should feel like a real printed community poster displayed by a local rescue group: warm paper texture, practical information blocks, small labels, adoption-day details, QR/contact area, and a believable nonprofit visual identity.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero placement: {hero 이미지} occupies the upper 42% of the poster, centered slightly above midline, with strong eye contact emphasis, realistic fur detail, and a gentle editorial portrait presence.
- Title block placement: {헤드라인} sits across the upper third, spanning 70–80% of width, aligned center, with enough contrast to read instantly.
- Organization label placement: {단체·고양이} appears as a smaller brand/source line near the top or under the headline, using a clean supportive hierarchy. Add a small local-rescue style label such as “입양 캠페인 VOL.12” or “2026 봄 입양 안내” nearby.
- Information card zone: {정보 박스} arranged in a mid-lower panel with clear rows, separated from the hero by a subtle divider line or soft box edge. Include realistic adoption details such as “나이”, “성별”, “중성화”, “예방접종”, “성격”, “임보 가능”, using small paw/heart/check icons.
- Contact/footer zone: {연락 방법} anchored in the lower 18% as the final action area, visually distinct and easy to scan. Include a QR-code placeholder box labeled “입양 신청 QR”, a phone/message line, and a short CTA button-style label.
- Background treatment: warm paper-like beige surface with visible fiber grain, faint risograph-like ink variation, soft taped-corner or bulletin-board feeling, and gentle gradient falloff. Add small realistic poster details such as tiny registration text, a subtle paw-pattern divider, and a sponsor/partner strip along the bottom.
- Poster detail enrichment: include event-style information blocks: date/time/venue line, adoption consultation note, preparation checklist, and a small caption under the cat image.
- Spacing: balanced left-right symmetry, modular poster framing, readable hierarchy, and a clear visual path from headline to cat to info box to contact.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- 1) Header zone (top 18%): set {단체·고양이} as a small source line above or near the main title, in a supportive role with thin spacing and neat alignment. Add small metadata text such as “입양 안내 포스터 · NO. 024”, “2026.05”, and “지역 구조묘 캠페인”.
- 2) Main headline zone (upper 20%): place {헤드라인} in large Korean display type, centered, with a calm emotional tone and strong readability against the warm background. Support it with the fixed line “이 작은 가족, 함께 살아주세요.” and category title “반려묘 입양 안내”.
- 3) Hero image zone (middle 42%): feature {hero 이미지} as the visual centerpiece, framed like a warm rescue profile portrait. Use soft natural shadowing, believable paper-print integration, and a small photo caption bar below the portrait such as “오늘도 사람 손길을 기다리는 아이예요”. If multiple cats are present, arrange them as a cohesive adoption-family portrait.
- 4) Information zone (lower middle 16%): place {정보 박스} inside a rounded card or stacked list format with separators, making age/sex/neuter/vaccination/personality easy to scan. Add short Korean labels such as “기본 정보”, “입양 조건”, “성격 메모”, “준비물 체크”.
- 5) Event and sponsor detail zone: add a compact event strip near the lower middle or above the footer with realistic details: “입양 상담일 2026.05.18 토 13:00–17:00”, “장소 성수동 반려문화센터 2층”, “상담 예약 권장”, and a small sponsor area reading “후원 · 동네동물병원 · 캣케어마켓 · 따뜻한임보모임”.
- 6) Contact call-to-action zone (bottom 12%): present {연락 방법} as the final action block with a clear label, concise line breaks, and stronger contrast than the surrounding copy. Include a QR placeholder, “입양 신청하기”, “문의 DM / 카카오채널”, and a short URL-style line such as “adopt-local.kr/cat”.
- 7) Footer balance: make the bottom feel like a real NGO/community adoption notice with microcopy, small page code, and print-style footer text such as “문의 전 입양 안내문을 꼭 읽어주세요 · 책임입양을 부탁드립니다”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for {헤드라인} in medium-to-bold weight, roughly 54–72px feel; use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for {정보 박스}, {연락 방법}, and {단체·고양이} in regular to semibold weight, 20–30px feel. Use smaller 11–16px Korean microtext for date, venue, sponsor, caption, QR label, and footer notes.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} as warm amber, beige, charcoal, and muted green; recommended anchors include #D8A24A, #F4E8D8, #2F2B28, and #7A8B6B. Use muted terracotta or soft cream highlights only as subtle accent tags.
- Border/shadow: subtle paper-card shadows, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12–18% opacity; if boxes are used, keep corners softly rounded and edges clean. Add delicate paper fibers, slight print misregistration, and tactile ink texture for realism.
- Layout styling: thin divider lines, rescue-poster grid, gentle paw/heart/check icons, small label stickers, QR-code area, sponsor strip, and practical adoption checklist elements. Avoid glossy commercial effects; keep it humane, handmade-public-notice, and trustworthy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.4 portrait-style look for the cat hero, with shallow depth of field and crisp eye detail; if multiple cats are present, compose like a controlled studio pet portrait rather than a snapshot.
- Lighting: warm natural window light from upper-left at about 45°, very soft fill from front-right, gentle catchlights in the eyes, realistic shadow softness, no harsh flash.
- Color grade: amber beige base with muted green accents and charcoal text, slightly filmic and paper-warm, similar to a gentle editorial rescue flyer.
- Print realism: visible paper grain, slight ink absorption, tiny alignment imperfections, realistic taped or pinned poster feel, and soft shadows around photo/card elements so the poster reads as a physical nonprofit flyer.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet community rescue editorial — thoughtful, humane, warm, and believable as a real local adoption notice. It should feel caring and practical, with enough information to make the viewer imagine contacting the shelter today.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구:
  - "이 작은 가족, 함께 살아주세요."
  - "반려묘 입양 안내"
  - "입양 상담일 2026.05.18 토 13:00–17:00"
  - "장소 성수동 반려문화센터 2층"
  - "입양 신청 QR"
  - "문의 전 입양 안내문을 꼭 읽어주세요"
  - {단체·고양이}
  - {헤드라인}
  - {hero 이미지}
  - {정보 박스}
  - {연락 방법}
  - {컬러 팔레트}
  - {비율}
- Additional Korean microcopy may include: “기본 정보”, “입양 조건”, “성격 메모”, “준비물 체크”, “후원 · 동네동물병원 · 캣케어마켓”, “책임입양을 부탁드립니다”, “NO. 024”, “2026.05”.
- Layout invariants: maintain a vertical A4 poster composition, with the cat hero as the dominant focal point and the information/contact sections clearly separated into readable blocks.
- All Korean text must render cleanly with no broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
반려묘 사진을 활용한 프리미엄 커스텀 굿즈 목업 이미지.
단독 히어로 또는 4~6종 시트 그리드로 구성된 세로형 제품 소개 비주얼이며, 실제 온라인 편집숍의 신상품 촬영 컷처럼 포장재, 행택, 가격 라벨, 주문 카드, 바코드 스티커, 작은 생활 소품이 함께 놓인 현실적인 장면.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {원본 고양이}의 얼굴·털결·무늬·눈 색·비례를 원본 그대로 유지한 채, {굿즈 종류} 표면에 자연스럽게 적용.
- Layout: {레이아웃}에 맞춰 중앙 히어로 60% 또는 4~6칸 제품 시트로 구성. 각 제품은 실제 샘플 촬영처럼 약간씩 다른 각도, 두께, 소재 반사, 자연스러운 그림자를 갖게 배치.
- Background: {배경}을 기반으로 아이보리, 웜그레이, 라이트 우드 톤의 생활감 있는 표면 처리. 테이블 상판의 은은한 나뭇결, 패브릭 매트, 포장 종이의 접힌 자국, 스티커 비닐의 반짝임이 보이도록 연출.
- Styling accents: {스타일링} 소품을 제품 주변에 자연스럽게 배치. 예: 린넨 천, 엽서, 리본, 작은 꽃 한 송이, 티컵, 포장 봉투, 투명 스티커 시트, 펜, 주문서 일부, 완충지, 클립, 작은 택배 박스.
- Product detail layer: 작은 행택, 케어 카드, 바코드 스티커, SKU 라벨, 가격표, 옵션 체크 라벨, 손글씨 느낌 메모를 더해 실제 판매용 굿즈 샘플 촬영처럼 보이게 구성.
- Brand context: {스튜디오명}의 편집숍 감성을 살리고, {상품명}, {가격}, {제작일}, {핸들}, {옵션문구}가 작은 카드와 라벨에 선명하게 보이도록 배치.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero / grid base: {굿즈 종류}를 화면 중심 또는 시트 칸의 중심에 배치하고, 제품 실루엣과 실제 재질이 또렷하게 읽히도록 정면성과 약간의 입체감을 함께 확보.
2) Cat image application: {원본 고양이}의 주요 특징이 깨지지 않게 전사, 인쇄, 자수 패치, 패턴, 슬리브 프린트, 아크릴 키링 삽입, 스티커 다이컷, 포토카드 인쇄 등 굿즈 유형에 맞는 방식으로 정확히 반영.
3) Surface & props: {배경} 위에 {스타일링}을 제품과 연결되도록 배치하고, 책·꽃·티컵·린넨·우드 트레이·포장 봉투·완충지·클립 같은 소품을 실제 촬영 현장처럼 겹쳐 놓아 깊이를 만든다.
4) Color anchoring: {컬러 팔레트}를 전체 톤으로 유지하되, 고양이 원본 색이 묻히지 않도록 명도 대비를 부드럽게 조절. 제품 소재별로 유광 아크릴, 무광 종이, 코튼 패브릭, 세라믹, 투명 비닐의 색 반사 차이를 살린다.
5) Merchandise information: 제품 주변 라벨과 카드에 짧은 Korean text를 선명하게 배치. 예: “{상품명}”, “반려묘 커스텀”, “모델: 우리 고양이”, “주문제작 샘플”, “{제작일}”, “{가격}”, “SKU CAT-09”, “{핸들}”, “{옵션문구}”.
6) Real retail context: 선물 포장용 스티커, 작은 바코드 영역, 옵션 체크 라벨, 배송 메모 일부, 샘플 넘버, 재질 안내 문구를 포함해 브랜드 촬영 컷과 실제 상품 상세페이지 사이의 현실적인 분위기를 만든다.
7) Label hierarchy: 큰 제품명 카드 1개, 작은 가격 라벨 1~2개, 바코드/SKU 라벨 1개, 케어 카드 또는 주문 카드 1개를 서로 다른 크기로 배치하여 시선 흐름을 만든다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard, SUIT, 또는 Noto Sans KR 계열의 깔끔한 산세리프. 작은 라벨은 18–28px, 제품명 라벨은 30–44px 수준으로 사용. Korean text must be crisp and readable.
- Text examples in image: “{상품명}”, “냥이 굿즈”, “반려묘 커스텀”, “모델: 우리 고양이”, “주문제작”, “선물 포장 가능”, “{제작일}”, “{가격}”, “SKU CAT-09”, “{핸들}”, “{옵션문구}”.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 기준으로 #F4EFE7 아이보리, #D8C7B3 웜 베이지, #4A4541 차콜, #BFA78B 라이트 토프를 보조색으로 사용.
- Edge / shadow: 제품 하단에 soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity로 고정감 부여; 시트형이면 카드 경계는 1px warm gray line. 종이 라벨과 포장 카드에는 미세한 엠보싱, 종이 섬유 질감, 살짝 들뜬 모서리를 표현.
- Product realism: 인쇄면은 굿즈의 굴곡과 소재를 따라 자연스럽게 휘어지고, 머그·아크릴·패브릭·스티커·엽서·폰케이스 등 각 소재의 광택과 가장자리 두께가 실제처럼 보여야 한다.
- Decorative graphics: 작은 발바닥 아이콘, 고양이 실루엣 라인, 점선 커팅 라인, 리본 스티커, 미니 하트 태그를 라벨과 포장지에 가볍게 더해 커스텀 굿즈의 선물감을 강화한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 50mm f/1.8 for single hero mockup, or 35mm lens for multi-product grid, straight-on product photography look.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, controlled specular highlights on acrylic and ceramic, subtle bounce light on white surfaces.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + charcoal editorial product palette, slightly lifted shadows, clean e-commerce finish with magazine-style realism.
- Texture rendering: visible paper grain, ceramic glaze, cotton weave, acrylic edge reflections, sticker vinyl sheen, ribbon fibers, corrugated box texture, and natural tabletop texture.
- Depth: shallow but practical product-photography depth of field; main goods sharp, rear packaging and lifestyle props gently softened while still recognizable.

[6. MOOD]
A premium pet-goods editorial mockup — feels like a warm boutique gift shop product shoot mixed with a polished Korean e-commerce detail page. Cozy, personal, giftable, realistic, and emotionally connected to the owner’s cat.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 원본 고양이, 굿즈 종류, 레이아웃, 배경, 스타일링, 컬러 팔레트, 스튜디오명, 상품명, 가격, 제작일, 핸들, 옵션문구, 비율.
- Render added Korean text accurately and legibly: “{스튜디오명}”, “{상품명}”, “냥이 굿즈”, “반려묘 커스텀”, “모델: 우리 고양이”, “주문제작”, “선물 포장 가능”, “{제작일}”, “{가격}”, “SKU CAT-09”, “{핸들}”, “{옵션문구}”.
- Preserve the original cat’s precise fur texture, face features, markings, eye color, whiskers, ear shape, and color balance exactly as in {원본 고양이}.
- Any printed cat image, pattern, sticker cutline, embroidery, acrylic insert, or label on the merchandise must remain anatomically and visually faithful to the reference.
- If {레이아웃} is a grid, all 4~6 panels must share the same perspective, spacing, lighting direction, and styling rules while showing varied product details, labels, materials, and small packaging elements.
- Ensure {비율} is respected in the composition, with the product set designed for a vertical 1024x1536 catalog image.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized public-figure face swaps

studio:prompts3:ours-1008.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean pet Instagram concept image, centered square composition with a cozy daily-life editorial feel and realistic social-feed details. Designed for an Instagram feed post, story cover, or cute single-image cat diary featuring a relaxed everyday moment.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {hero 이미지} is the clear focal point, occupying about 55–65% of the frame, with a natural cat pose that matches {컨셉}.
- Composition: frame the cat like a candid lifestyle photo, slightly off-center or comfortably centered, with a believable home interior around it: blanket folds, wood floor grain, cardboard box edge, food bowl, toy mouse, curtain shadow, or a sun patch.
- Instagram card layer: include a subtle social post interface treatment with {계정명} near the top, {위치라벨} and {날짜라벨} as small metadata, plus bottom-area micro icons for 좋아요 / 댓글 / 공유 / 저장.
- Text placement: place {헤드라인} as a warm editorial caption near the upper-left, lower-third, or beside the cat depending on the photo crop; add {캡션}, {해시태그}, and {스티커태그} as small feed-style details without covering the cat’s face.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Layer 1 — Base scene: build a square Instagram feed canvas with warm neutral home textures that support {컨셉}: ivory bedding, wood beige flooring, soft curtain fabric, cardboard texture, ceramic bowl, woven rug, or a sunny windowsill.
- Layer 2 — Subject placement: position the cat in a natural pose within {hero 이미지}, such as sleeping with curled paws, basking in sunlight, eating kibble, batting a toy, peeking from a box, or stretching on a blanket.
- Layer 3 — Daily-life details: add believable pet-life objects around the scene, such as a half-visible toy, scattered kibble crumbs, blanket wrinkles, a cushion seam, paw-print dust in the sunbeam, or a small houseplant in the background.
- Layer 4 — Instagram identity overlay: render {계정명}, {위치라벨}, {날짜라벨}, tiny interaction icons, and {마이크로카피} in a refined app-card style, as if this is a polished pet account post.
- Layer 5 — Caption and tags: render {헤드라인} as the main warm Korean phrase, then add {캡션}, {해시태그}, and {스티커태그} as smaller decorative social text labels.
- Layer 6 — Final polish: preserve the cute meme-like or documentary-like tone from {스타일}, with realistic fur texture, warm highlights, and a feed-ready editorial finish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard / Noto Sans KR bold for the headline at roughly 30–52 px, and smaller app UI text at 16–24 px; handwritten Korean accent text may be used for {스티커태그}.
- Color palette: ivory #F5F1E8, wood beige #D7C2A3, warm amber #D99A4E, charcoal #2F2A26, soft cream highlights #FFF8EF from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Instagram UI graphics: use small line icons for heart, comment bubble, paper-plane share, bookmark save, and a tiny carousel dot or story-tag pill; keep them legible in charcoal or warm gray.
- Text effects: use a soft cream label, semi-transparent caption bar, or gentle drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for readability over fur or sunlight.
- Decorative accents: allow small paw-print doodles, rounded tag stickers, date stamp pill, or a tiny emoji-like accent that supports the pet diary mood.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm f/1.8 or 85mm f/1.4 pet lifestyle look, with a shallow depth of field for a natural Instagram portrait feel.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from the right to keep fur detail visible; for sunbathing scenes, use a warm late-afternoon sun patch with soft shadow edges.
- Color grade: warm cream + amber + wood-brown grade, slightly desaturated, with clean highlights and a cozy documentary finish.

[6. MOOD]
Editorial pet-lifestyle Instagram post — a calm Kinfolk-meets-cute-meme aesthetic, like a thoughtfully shot everyday cat diary with real feed-card details and affectionate Korean captions.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: if the main headline is shown, render this Korean string exactly: "오늘도 ○○이는 잘 잤습니다"
- Additional Korean feed text may include: "@momo.catdiary", "서울 성수동 · 오후 3:42", "햇살 충전 완료", "#고양이일상 #집사그램 #냥스타그램", "저장해두고 또 보기".
- Keep the cat anatomically natural: realistic fur, correct paws, no extra limbs, no distorted face, no uncanny body proportions.
- The composition must remain a square 1:1 Instagram-friendly layout with one clear cat subject, readable Korean typography, and believable everyday pet-life details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized famous-person likenesses
- Distorted animal anatomy, extra limbs, or plastic-looking fur

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean pet portrait studio i2i, designed as a polished 1:1 profile-ready cat photo with themed styling and a refined boutique studio proof-card finish.
Use the reference cat as-is and transform only the scene, props, accessory styling, and gentle graphic labels into a realistic professional pet studio concept.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {원본 고양이} occupies the center 65% of the frame, with the head slightly above midpoint and the ears, whiskers, paws, and tail fully readable inside the square crop.
- Background treatment: {배경} becomes a real pet studio set with a cream seamless backdrop, soft floor reflection, small themed props, and boutique details arranged around the lower third.
- Framing direction: square subject-centered composition, full body or 3/4 body depending on {포즈}, with the cat clearly separated through lighting, depth, and realistic fur edges.
- Styling anchors: apply {테마}, {소품}, and {컬러 팔레트} while preserving the original cat’s identity, facial proportions, fur markings, eye color, and natural coat texture.
- Profile-card overlay: add a tasteful studio label area near the bottom or side containing {스튜디오명}, {촬영일}, {촬영장소}, {고양이 이름}, {캡션}, and {장식태그} as printed Korean card text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Main subject area (center 65%): {원본 고양이} rendered with exact facial proportions, fur pattern, eye shape, muzzle shape, ear angle, and whisker placement preserved; keep the coat texture crisp and photographic.
- Theme styling layer: interpret {테마} as a pet-safe studio wardrobe direction, such as a small velvet ribbon, lace collar, tiny crown, Santa accent, kimono-inspired collar, or classic bow tie, sized naturally for a cat.
- Background layer: build {배경} as a seamless pet portrait set with a warm cream wall-to-floor curve, a softly textured rug or fabric runner, seasonal flowers, ribbon strands, a miniature chair, or a low wooden block that fits the chosen theme.
- Pose rendering: {포즈} should feel candid and feline, with stable paws, relaxed shoulders, believable weight distribution, alert ears, and a natural gaze toward camera or slightly off-camera.
- Accessory layer: {소품} must match the theme with realistic materials such as satin ribbon, brushed metal charm, knitted fabric, dried flower sprig, pearl-like bead, or small plush toy placed within reach of the cat.
- Card-detail layer: include small printed studio proof elements such as a date/location label, film-style shot number, tiny heart or paw icon, and tag stickers reading {장식태그}; keep all text cleanly typeset and integrated into the photo set.
- Color coordination: apply {컬러 팔레트} across backdrop accents, props, costume details, card labels, and small decorative graphics, keeping the look airy, premium, and cohesive.
- Finish quality: preserve the cat’s fur detail, facial clarity, and original breed-appropriate anatomy; the result should look like a professional Korean pet studio portrait photographed for a profile image and keepsake card.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold and Pretendard Regular; main pet name 34–42px, caption 22–28px, date/location label 16–20px, charcoal gray #333333 with soft beige or blush accent labels.
- Rendered text layout: bottom card strip or side label may include “{스튜디오명}”, “{촬영일} · {촬영장소}”, “{고양이 이름}”, “{캡션}”, and “{장식태그}” in accurate Korean.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with off-white #F7F4EE, warm beige #DCCBB8, soft blush #E9C9CF, light blue #D9E7F4, and charcoal #333333 for text.
- Border/shadow: use a soft studio-card mat effect, gentle prop shadows, natural contact shadows under paws, and a delicate photographic vignette that keeps the square portrait premium.
- Decorative graphics: add small paw icons, tiny heart marks, film-frame corner ticks, or a sticker-like label, matching the boutique pet studio identity.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 full-frame studio pet portrait look, 85mm f/2.0 equivalent with shallow but readable depth of field, crisp focus on the eyes and nose.
- Lighting: large diffused softbox from upper-left at 45° plus gentle white fill from front-right, creating clean fur separation, natural paw shadows, glossy eye catchlights, and soft texture on props.
- Color grade: airy neutral whites with warm beige undertones and subtle pastel accents, similar to a high-end Korean pet studio editorial and premium profile-card print.

[6. MOOD]
A premium pet portrait studio editorial — warm, polished, gently whimsical, and realistic, like a boutique Korean pet photo studio keepsake prepared for a profile image.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the visible text exactly and legibly, for example “{스튜디오명}”, “{촬영일} · {촬영장소}”, “{고양이 이름}”, “{캡션}”, “{장식태그}”, with correct Korean spacing and no garbled characters.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: preserve the original cat’s exact face shape, fur pattern, eye placement, coat color, body proportion, paw structure, tail shape, and realistic whiskers.
- The scene must clearly read as the same reference cat in a styled Korean studio portrait, with only the background, props, accessory styling, and card-label design changed.
- All costume and prop elements must appear pet-safe, lightweight, physically plausible, and naturally resting on or around the cat.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Human facial features or human-like body proportions on the cat
- Celebrity composites or implying the cat is an official mascot of a real person

studio:prompts3:ours-1006.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean anniversary greeting card for Pepero Day, White Day, and Valentine’s Day. 1. Header area (top 16%): place {헤드라인} in a bold, friendly Korean sans-serif, centered or slightly left-aligned depending on balance, with clean line breaks and high legibility.

4. CTA area (lower 14%): render {CTA} as a button-like label with strong contrast and generous padding, clearly separated from the footer edge for mobile cropping safety.

- Background treatment: dark charcoal-to-deep-indigo gradient backdrop with soft-glow bokeh, matte vinyl or cinema-screen grain, faint waveform arcs, cinematic light streaks, and neon edge accents.
- Framing direction: vertical {비율} ad poster framing, with layered cards, device UI panels, tiny notification chips, progress bars, album/movie thumbnails, and app-install cues floating around the hero for a premium campaign composition.
- Use {앱·콘텐츠}, {헤드라인}, {hero}, {큐레이션 카드}, {CTA}, {컬러 팔레트} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top headline band: place {헤드라인} large and centered near the top, bold Korean display typography with tight leading, slightly condensed tracking, and a crisp high-contrast read against the dark background. Add a small campaign label above it such as “NEW SEASON DROP” or “MUSIC & WATCH NIGHT”, plus a Korean date tag like “2026.05 프로모션”.
2. Hero zone (mid-frame): show {hero} as the dominant visual, with one main smartphone/tablet mockup and secondary floating UI elements behind it; keep the device screen sharp with visible app navigation tabs, playback controls, watch-progress bars, playlist rows, episode thumbnails, and a highlighted featured title tile.
3. Curated content cluster: arrange {큐레이션 카드} as 3–4 small layered cards around the hero, each card distinct in size and depth, suggesting recommended picks, playlists, watch history, trending charts, or “이어보기” content. Include tiny realistic UI text, star ratings, runtime labels, track counts, “NEW” tags, and thumbnail imagery that matches the music or OTT context.
4. Brand/product context: integrate {앱·콘텐츠} as a supporting label or product category cue, placed near the headline or above the CTA, so the poster clearly reads as either music streaming or OTT promotion. Add a small “앱 설치 이벤트” line and a compact benefit row with icons for offline download, no ads, and personalized recommendations.
5. CTA block: place {CTA} in a rounded pill button or bold rectangular badge at the lower center, with strong contrast and generous padding so it feels tappable and app-store ready. Around the CTA, include a small QR-style square, “지금 시작하기”, “APP STORE · GOOGLE PLAY” style download strip, and a fine-print subscription note.
6. Color system: apply {컬러 팔레트} through neon accents on buttons, card edges, waveform lines, subtitles, progress bars, icon glows, and content-card highlights, while keeping the majority of the canvas in deep charcoal and dark gradient tones.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for clean UI-like body text, and a bold condensed Korean display font for the headline; headline weight 800–900, CTA weight 700, card labels weight 500.
- Color palette: dark gradient base with specific accent colors from {컬러 팔레트}; keep text in off-white #F5F5F2, charcoal #1A1A1D, and neon accents such as green, red, or vivid mint depending on the palette.
- Border/shadow: use soft drop shadows with 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 18% opacity on floating cards and device mockups; add thin 1px inner highlights on UI edges for a glossy app-ad finish.
- Realistic campaign details: include tiny legal text, app rating stars, “4.8”, “1천만+ 다운로드”, compact icon labels, duration badges like “EP.03 · 58분” or “PLAYLIST · 42곡”, and small playback/watching indicators that make the layout feel like an actual launched service advertisement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product composite photographed like a premium app campaign, 50mm lens at f/2.8 for the hero device, with a secondary 85mm crop for shallow-depth UI emphasis.
- Lighting: soft key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle neon rim light from right, and subtle fill from below to keep the screen readable; maintain controlled reflections on the mockup glass.
- Color grade: dark cinematic grade with blackened shadows, slightly lifted midtones, and neon accents in emerald, crimson, or lime against deep charcoal and indigo.

[6. MOOD]
Premium digital product advertisement — closer to a Spotify-style campaign meets a Netflix key-art promo, with a sleek modern app-launch editorial feel, energetic enough for a social feed but detailed enough to look like a real paid install campaign.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문구: “오늘 밤, 무엇을 들을까?”, “한 번 보면 멈출 수 없는.”, “첫 30일 무료”, “광고 없이”, “다운로드”.
- Additional realistic Korean on-image microcopy may include: “앱 설치 이벤트”, “지금 시작하기”, “개인 맞춤 추천”, “오프라인 저장”, “이어보기”, “인기 급상승”, “새로운 플레이리스트”, “2026.05 프로모션”, “4.8 평점”, “1천만+ 다운로드”, “월 ₩7,500부터”, “언제든 해지 가능”.
- Layout invariants: the hero mockup must remain the central focal point, the small curated cards must remain 3–4 pieces, and the overall composition must stay a vertical app-ad poster with clear headline, hero, and CTA hierarchy.
- All on-image Korean characters must be clean, properly spaced, and free of distortion or broken glyphs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
