[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header band: place small but legible Korean catalog text: “{브랜드명} / {제품명}”, “{시즌정보}”, and “상품코드 {상품코드}” with clean spacing and a realistic online-catalog feel.
2) Left panel / first display: present {원본 의류} as a flat lay product cut, carefully arranged with fabric edges visible, natural sleeve or hem positioning, realistic wrinkles, and a soft contact shadow.
3) Center panel / second display: show the same garment on a simple hanger or suspended display, matching the exact material, color, label placement, logo position, pattern scale, and fabric weight from the reference image.
4) Right panel / third display: render the garment on a faceless mannequin or invisible-body support shape when appropriate, keeping shoulder line, drape, seams, prints, tags, and textile texture consistent with the other two cuts.
5) Detail consistency: preserve the exact shape, proportion, textile weave, opacity, stitching, buttons, zipper, logo, branding, labels, and any printed text from the reference image; do not redesign the garment.
6) Footer info strip: add compact Korean product information blocks reading “컬러 {색상명}”, “사이즈 {사이즈정보}”, “소재 {소재정보}”, “가격 {가격정보}”, plus three tiny view labels “01 플랫”, “02 행거”, “03 실루엣”.
7) Background and isolation: use a seamless studio cutout treatment with realistic soft contact shadow beneath each garment instance, thin gray panel separators, and subtle catalog-card layering rather than harsh outlines or cut-paste artifacts.
8) Camera and framing: {카메라·렌즈} with a straight, catalog-style viewpoint that keeps product edges sharp, proportions accurate, and fabric texture readable.
9) Output behavior: use {비율} as the final canvas logic so the three variants feel evenly spaced, product-focused, and professionally aligned for a square e-commerce thumbnail.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean catalog text in Pretendard Medium, Noto Sans KR Bold, or Apple SD Gothic Neo; header 30–42px equivalent, info chips 18–24px equivalent, panel labels 16–20px equivalent.
- Color palette: studio white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F7F6F2, soft neutral gray #E7E7E7, detail gray #9A9A9A; preserve the garment’s original colors exactly as in {원본 의류}.
- Layout graphics: fine divider lines, rounded info chips, small SKU text, and discreet catalog markers may appear; keep them secondary to the garment and aligned to a polished Korean shopping-mall product sheet.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, 12–15% opacity; panel cards may have very light gray separation and realistic paper-like layering.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V with 50mm f/8 for flat lay presentations and 85mm f/4 for mannequin-style presentation; high-resolution commercial product framing.
- Lighting: {라이팅}, even diffusion, controlled shadow softness, clean textile highlight rolloff, no harsh hotspot, no specular glare on fabric.
- Color grade: neutral studio white balance with faithful textile color rendering, slightly lifted midtones, true-to-source garment color preservation, accurate black/white point for online retail.
- Render quality: crisp fabric weave, clean edge separation, realistic gravity on folds, believable hanger/mannequin support, and consistent product scale across all three views.

[6. MOOD]
High-end Korean fashion e-commerce product photography — polished studio catalog sheet with practical shopping information, similar in finish to premium smart-store, W컨셉, 무신사 스토어, or department-store online lookbook assets.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Render Korean catalog text exactly and legibly: “{브랜드명} / {제품명}”, “{시즌정보}”, “상품코드 {상품코드}”, “컬러 {색상명}”, “사이즈 {사이즈정보}”, “소재 {소재정보}”, “가격 {가격정보}”, “01 플랫”, “02 행거”, “03 실루엣”.
- Preserve the exact product from the reference image: shape, proportion, texture, color, label, logo, branding, seam placement, and any existing printed garment text must match the original without redesign.
- Added catalog text, SKU, price, and info chips must appear only on the product sheet background or footer/header areas, never printed onto the garment itself.
- If the garment already includes tags, labels, logos, or printed lettering, keep their placement and spelling identical while making them clearer and more realistic.
- All 3 display variations must depict the same garment identity, same material behavior, same color temperature, and same pattern scale across the layout.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Garment redesign, invented garment logos, or altered printed text

studio:prompts3:ours-975.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
제품 6컷 디테일 시트 i2i, 원본 제품의 형태와 표면 정보를 정확히 보존한 상태로 3x2 그리드에 정리한 고급 상품 촬영 시트.
정면/측면/후면/매크로 텍스처/박스·패키징/사용 시연을 한 장에 담고, 실제 커머스 상세페이지와 브랜드 촬영 컨택시트처럼 컷명, 촬영 메모, SKU형 보조 정보까지 포함해 상세 검토와 상품 소개에 바로 쓰는 구성.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 원본 {원본 제품}이 각 컷마다 동일한 제품으로 유지되도록 하고, 정면 hero 컷이 전체 시트에서 가장 먼저 보이도록 배치한다.
- 3x2 그리드 {레이아웃} 기준으로 6개 컷의 비주얼 무게를 균등하게 맞추되, hero 컷은 약간 더 큰 제품 스케일, 선명한 하이라이트, 정돈된 그림자로 강조한다.
- 전체 기본 바탕은 {배경}이며, 제품 단독 컷은 흰 무한대 배경과 실제 스튜디오 바닥 접지감이 함께 느껴지도록 자연스러운 그림자와 미세한 반사광을 둔다.
- 상단에는 작은 상품 시트 헤더를 넣는다: “제품 디테일 시트”, “촬영일 2026.05.01”, “SKU: PRD-247”, “비율 {비율}”. 하단에는 아주 작은 제작 메모처럼 “원본 기준 색상 보정 / 6컷 구성”을 배치한다.
- 각 패널 좌상단 또는 하단에 짧은 한국어 캡션을 넣는다: “01 정면”, “02 측면”, “03 후면”, “04 소재 확대”, “05 패키지”, “06 사용 예시”. 캡션은 제품을 가리지 않고 실제 촬영 시트 라벨처럼 작고 선명하게 배치한다.
- mockup 컷은 책상/테이블 질감, 은은한 생활 소품, 종이 조각, 그림자, 손의 접촉감 등 실제 사용 장면의 맥락을 포함하되, 제품이 가장 중요한 피사체로 보이게 한다.
- 컷 사이 간격은 좁고 일정하게 유지하고, 얇은 분할선과 미세한 패널 번호 체계를 사용해 실제 제품 검수용 시트처럼 읽히게 한다.
- 모든 컷에서 제품의 라벨, 로고, 인쇄 문구, 재질감이 흐트러지지 않도록 {원본 제품}을 중심으로 안정적으로 프레이밍한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero cut (top-left or most prominent panel): {원본 제품} 정면을 가장 크게 보여주고, 제품 실루엣이 깨끗하게 읽히도록 중앙 배치한다. 흰 무한대 배경 위에 소프트 드롭 섀도우와 바닥 반사감을 얹어 실제 스튜디오 촬영처럼 보이게 한다. 작은 캡션 “01 정면 / HERO VIEW”를 추가한다.
2) Side detail cut: {원본 제품}의 좌측 또는 가장 특징적인 측면을 같은 높이로 맞춰 촬영해 두께, 곡선, 접합부를 확인 가능하게 한다. 가장자리 라인이 선명하게 보이도록 림라이트를 살리고, 작은 치수 가이드 라인 또는 “측면 곡선 확인” 같은 짧은 보조 문구를 배치한다.
3) Back view cut: {원본 제품} 후면을 정렬된 상태로 보여주고, 패키징 정보나 후면 그래픽이 있으면 왜곡 없이 평면적으로 보이게 한다. 흰 배경에서 그림자는 짧고 얕게 처리하며, 캡션 “03 후면 / PRINT CHECK”와 작은 페이지 마커를 넣는다.
4) Macro texture cut: {원본 제품}의 핵심 재질, 표면 결, 코팅, 엠보싱, 프린트의 미세 질감을 1:1에 가깝게 확대해 보여준다. 초점은 단단하고 주변부는 자연스럽게 얕은 심도로 흐리며, 작은 확대 표시 “x3.0 소재 확대”와 얇은 포커스 포인트 마커를 넣는다.
5) Box & packaging cut: {원본 제품}과 박스·패키징이 함께 보이도록 구성하되, 포장 구조와 인쇄면이 한눈에 읽히도록 사선 3/4 각도를 사용한다. 제품 본체와 패키징의 색 균형을 유지하고, 포장재의 접힘, 종이 질감, 투명 필름 반사, 개봉부의 실제적인 디테일을 살린다. 캡션은 “05 패키지 구성”.
6) Usage mockup cut: {원본 제품}을 실제 사용 상황처럼 책상 또는 테이블 위에 자연스럽게 두고, 손이 들어가면 해부학적으로 정확한 형태와 손가락 수를 유지한다. 이 컷은 다른 컷보다 약간 더 부드러운 자연광 결을 적용하고, 주변에는 사용 맥락을 보여주는 현실적인 소품을 작게 포함한다. 캡션은 “06 사용 예시 / ON DESK”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 제품 시트에는 실제 브랜드 촬영 보드처럼 작고 정돈된 보조 타이포그래피를 사용한다. Pretendard Medium 또는 Noto Sans KR SemiBold, 18–28px 수준으로 “제품 디테일 시트”, “촬영일 2026.05.01”, “SKU: PRD-247”, “01 정면”, “02 측면”, “03 후면”, “04 소재 확대”, “05 패키지”, “06 사용 예시”를 선명하게 렌더링한다. 원본 제품 라벨/패키지 인쇄가 보인다면 원본 텍스트를 그대로 유지한다.
- Color palette: pure white #FFFFFF, soft off-white #F6F6F2, neutral gray #D9D9D9, deep charcoal #222222, and the product’s original colors preserved exactly from {원본 제품}.
- Border/shadow: panel separation은 8–16px 정도의 얇은 흰 여백과 neutral gray #D9D9D9의 가는 분할선으로 정리하고, 각 제품에는 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity의 매우 부드러운 섀도우를 사용한다.
- Sheet details: 상단 헤더, 패널 번호, 작은 크롭 마크, 페이지 마커 “DETAIL SHEET 01/01”, 하단 촬영 메모 “색상 기준: 원본 참조”를 포함해 실제 제품 촬영 납품 시트처럼 완성도를 높인다.
- Composition texture: {구도 결}을 반영해 정렬은 정교하게 유지하되, 표면 반사, 종이 패키지 질감, 책상 결, 얕은 그림자처럼 실제 촬영에서 보이는 미세한 정보가 살아 있게 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One XT or IQ4 with 120mm macro lens for detail panels, matching studio product photography sharpness; mockup cut can use the same system with a slightly wider 80–90mm equivalent framing. If {카메라} is specified, match that camera character while preserving the same premium product-photography sharpness.
- Lighting: main five panels use controlled studio softbox lighting at 45° from upper-left with gentle fill from right, following {라이팅}; mockup panel uses diffused window light from upper-right with soft shadow falloff and natural tabletop bounce.
- Color grade: clean neutral product grade with accurate whites, restrained contrast, and no artificial saturation shift; preserve the exact product color and label tone from the reference.
- Surface realism: retain crisp edges, real contact shadows, subtle specular highlights, tiny paper or plastic texture in packaging, and macro-level material detail without changing the product design.

[6. MOOD]
High-end studio product catalog sheet — Apple-style precision meets Muji-like cleanliness, with the organized clarity of a premium e-commerce lookbook and the realism of an actual brand shoot contact sheet delivered to a merchandiser.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 이 결과물에는 원본 제품의 라벨/패키지에 있는 모든 한글 문구가 있으면 그대로 정확히 보여야 하며, 보조 캡션은 “제품 디테일 시트”, “촬영일 2026.05.01”, “SKU: PRD-247”, “01 정면”, “02 측면”, “03 후면”, “04 소재 확대”, “05 패키지”, “06 사용 예시”처럼 정확하고 깨지지 않는 한글로 렌더링해야 한다.
- Replicate the exact product from the reference image: shape, proportion, texture, color, label, logo, branding, and any printed text must remain unchanged.
- Only the background, framing, lighting, panel captions, and product-sheet graphic layout may be re-photographed or added; do not redesign, beautify, stylize, or invent product details.
- All 6 panels must show the same product identity with consistent proportions and no accidental duplication of mismatched parts.
- If hands appear in the usage mockup, hands must be anatomically correct with exactly 5 fingers per hand.
- Maintain output_size 1024x1536 and the vertical 3x2 detail-sheet composition implied by {레이아웃} and {비율}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-974.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
1-2 English lines: high-end product photography sheet, 4-cut multi-angle cutout reference grid for e-commerce, catalog QA, and marketplace listing assets.
Show the same physical product from multiple views with studio consistency, realistic catalog metadata, and no product redesign.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 제품} is the main subject in all four panels, occupying about 65-75% of each product frame with clean cutout separation, natural contact shadow, and no compositing artifacts.
- {레이아웃} arranges the product in a structured 2x2 comparison sheet with equal panel sizes, precise gutters, fine light-gray divider lines, and consistent baseline alignment across all views.
- Use {배경} as a professional white-to-soft-gray studio catalog board: #FFFFFF product area, very subtle paper grain, faint registration marks, small measurement ticks, and realistic sheet metadata.
- Add a slim header strip at the top with catalog-style information: Korean title “제품 다각도 누끼 시트”, “CUTOUT REF. 04”, “SKU: PRD-0426”, “촬영일 2026.05.01”, and a small barcode placeholder area at the far right.
- Add small panel labels in Korean under or above each frame: “01 정면”, “02 측면”, “03 후면”, “04 디테일”, plus tiny scale notes such as “동일 비율 기준” and “컬러 기준값 유지”.
- Use {비율} with balanced product sizing and a realistic reference-board composition that feels like a premium studio production deliverable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Panel 1 (front view): place {원본 제품} centered, facing the camera directly, preserving exact shape, proportion, texture, color, label, logo, branding, and printed text from the reference image. Include a small label “01 정면” and a thin baseline guide.
2) Panel 2 (side view): rotate the same product to the left 90° for a clean profile view, keeping height, thickness, surface finish, and all visible construction details consistent. Include a small label “02 측면” and a subtle width marker.
3) Panel 3 (back view): show the product from a 180° rear angle, aligned to match the first panel’s scale and lighting. Include a small label “03 후면”, a faint vertical centerline, and realistic studio shadow continuity.
4) Panel 4 (detail close-up): crop a macro detail that reveals material texture, seams, printed surface, logo area, cap, edge, handle, port, stitching, embossing, or functional detail that actually exists on {원본 제품}; do not invent product features. Include a small label “04 디테일” and a short technical caption “재질·인쇄 디테일”.
5) All four panels must use the same product scale logic, {각도 일관성}, the same white studio background treatment, identical shadow language, and matching product color so the sheet reads as one coherent catalog reference asset.
6) Add realistic production marks around the board: tiny crop ticks, gray measurement dots, a small “QC PASS” text badge without implying official certification, and a bottom footer line reading “PRODUCT CUTOUT SHEET / COLOR CHECK / 1536×1024”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium for sheet labels and metadata, 14-24px, charcoal #111111 and neutral gray #777777; keep product label text exactly as shown in the reference.
- Color palette: pure white #FFFFFF, soft studio gray #F3F4F6, neutral gray #D9D9D9, charcoal #111111, and the product’s original colors only.
- Panel treatment: thin light-gray dividers, soft natural contact shadows, realistic paper-board surface, tiny barcode block, catalog footer, and subtle measurement guides that support the product reference purpose.
- Maintain a premium commercial packshot feel: crisp edges, accurate reflections, readable material texture, and clean separation between product and background.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 with 120mm Macro at f/8 for front/back/detail fidelity, locked studio framing for consistency; honor {카메라·렌즈} if it specifies an equivalent professional product-photography setup.
- Lighting: {라이팅}; identical studio setup across all panels, left main light at 45° with right-side fill, soft diffused shadows, controlled highlights, and realistic surface reflections without harsh specular clipping.
- Color grade: neutral product-catalog grade with clean whites, accurate product color, natural contrast, calibrated midtones, and no warm or cool tint cast.
- Rendering quality: high-resolution commercial studio photography, realistic cutout edges, believable macro texture in the detail panel, and precise alignment like a professional catalog production sheet.

[6. MOOD]
Premium studio catalog sheet — high-end e-commerce packshot reference with a realistic production-board look, precise product QA annotations, and polished commercial photography finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {참고 이미지} should be clearly identifiable and occupy about 45–55% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center for a romantic poster look, with natural posture and an expressive gaze as if captured from an actual film still.
- Background treatment: layered dusk sky in {컬러 톤}, soft gradient haze, subtle city lights or seaside silhouette, distant street lamps, window glow, light bokeh, faint clouds, and gentle film-grain texture to create a believable cinematic environment.
- Spacing and framing: organize the poster into a strong top title zone, a central portrait zone, and a lower information zone containing tagline, release date, venue-style theatrical notice, cast/crew microtext, and a compact billing strip.
- Title block: place {영화 제목} prominently across the upper third in large cinematic Korean typography, with {서브 카피} smaller beneath it or across the lower-middle as the emotional tagline.
- Real poster details: include small readable Korean elements such as “2026.05.14 대개봉”, “올봄, 가장 오래 남을 멜로”, “주연  당신”, “감독  이서윤”, “제작  스튜디오 달”, “예매 오픈”, “극장 동시 개봉”, and a compact bottom billing block with tiny production credits.
- Decorative graphic elements: add tasteful film-poster details such as a faint vertical light leak, small constellation-like dots, thin separator lines, a subtle ticket-stub motif near the lower corner, and a tiny barcode-style poster inventory mark that does not look like an official certification.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer: build a cinematic dusk backdrop in {컬러 톤} with a smooth sky gradient, faint atmospheric haze, soft city or seaside depth, small realistic light sources, and subtle grain for film-poster texture.
2. Subject layer: place {참고 이미지} as a naturally integrated portrait of the user, with recognizable facial features, natural skin detail, soft edge blending, realistic hair separation, and a romantic pose that feels like a captured movie moment rather than a studio cutout.
3. Lighting layer: add directional key light from one side and a soft rim light to separate the subject from the background; keep highlights gentle, emotional, and believable, with a slight sunset reflection on cheeks and hair.
4. Title layer: set {영화 제목} across the upper area in a bold Korean cinematic serif or high-contrast display font, with slight tracking, elegant spacing, and subtle emboss or ink-density variation for theatrical poster authority.
5. Subtitle layer: place {서브 카피} below the title or in the lower third using smaller, lighter-weight Korean typography so it reads like a romantic tagline.
6. Release and credits layer: add “2026.05.14 대개봉” in a clear date label, plus small credit lines such as “주연  당신”, “감독  이서윤”, “각본  한지우”, “음악  서도현”, and a compact billing block at the very bottom using condensed Korean/English-style poster typography.
7. Promotional detail layer: include short Korean poster blurbs like “올봄, 마음에 번지는 단 하나의 이야기” and “사랑이 지나간 자리에서 다시 시작되는 우리”, plus tiny theater notice text “예매 오픈 · 전국 극장 상영” arranged like a real campaign poster.
8. Color balance: push the overall palette toward {컬러 톤} with controlled contrast, natural flattering skin tones, rose-pink highlights, and deep blue charcoal shadows.
9. Format control: preserve the {비율} vertical layout with classic one-sheet hierarchy, cinematic scale, and layered visual depth.

[4. STYLE RULES]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean church / cathedral youth group recruitment poster, vertical A4-style flyer for bulletin board, lobby stand, parish hall, and social sharing.
Create a warm, realistic community announcement that invites young adults to small-group fellowship, worship, Bible study, service, shared meals, and first-visit welcome gatherings.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the main headline in the upper 18% of the page, with the hero image occupying the middle 52% and the schedule/contact block stacked in the lower 30%.
- Use {교회·소그룹} as the core subject label near the title area, supported by a small season/date label such as "2026 봄학기 모집" or "청년 공동체 안내".
- Background treatment: tactile ivory church-bulletin paper with warm cream wash, subtle fiber grain, faint cross-shaped window light, and gentle shadows suggesting a printed poster pinned on a real lobby noticeboard.
- Add realistic poster details: tiny pushpin marks or paper tape corners, a small QR-code placeholder box labeled "신청 QR", a short welcome badge, and discreet footer credit text.
- Place {hero 이미지} as the central visual, framed like a documentary editorial photo collage: young adults gathered around a table with Bibles, notebooks, coffee cups, hymn sheets, soft church interior lights, chapel pews, and a friendly small-group atmosphere.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header area: set {헤드라인} in large elegant Korean serif type, centered, with slightly increased tracking and a quiet devotional tone.
2. Under-title label: place {교회·소그룹} as a smaller supporting line or rounded tag, aligned to center, using a clean sans-serif for contrast. Add a small line nearby: "함께 예배하고, 배우고, 나누는 청년 공동체".
3. Hero area (mid 52%): show {hero 이미지} as the focal composition, softly lit and naturally integrated, with realistic depth separation from the paper background; include candid smiles, open notebooks, a Bible, mugs, a candle-like warm lamp, and church window light without making the scene theatrical.
4. Event detail strip: add compact Korean information blocks around or just below the hero image: "첫 모임 5.10 FRI", "참가비 무료", "처음 오신 분 환영", "소그룹 선택 가능".
5. Information block: list {정기 모임} in a neat stacked layout with clear line breaks, using small line icons for calendar, location, meal, and fellowship. Add a thin divider labeled "REGULAR MEETING" for a realistic flyer feel.
6. Contact block: place {연락 방법} near the lower portion with slightly smaller text; include a visible call-to-action button style reading "문의·신청하기" and a small QR-code placeholder labeled "QR로 바로 신청".
7. Sponsor / footer area: include a small sponsor or host line such as "주관: 청년부 리더팀 · 새가족 환영팀", plus tiny credit text "Photo by Youth Ministry / Printed for lobby notice".
8. Color band accents: use {컬러 팔레트} in small highlights, label chips, divider rules, QR frame, and date badge so the poster remains warm and church-appropriate.
9. Footer area: preserve {비율} as the poster format reference while keeping all essential Korean text comfortably readable in the vertical print composition.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the headline at bold 54–72px, and Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for details at 22–30px, with clean line spacing and careful Korean spacing.
- Use typographic hierarchy like a real Korean church flyer: large headline, medium subtitle, pill-shaped date tags, small all-caps English section labels, and compact Korean body details.
- Color palette: ivory, warm cream, muted gold, sage-beige, and charcoal from {컬러 팔레트}; use #F7F1E6, #E9D8B8, #C9A25D, #8F9A7A, and #2F2A26 as guiding tones.
- Border/shadow: very soft drop shadow under the hero image, 0–6px y-offset, 16px blur, about 12% opacity; thin warm-gray dividers, small gold corner marks, and soft paper-tape details are allowed.
- Decorative graphic elements should feel church-bulletin realistic: subtle cross line art, small leaf or wheat motif, rounded label stickers, understated date stamps, and a modest QR/contact area.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary editorial look, Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/1.2 shot at f/2.8 for the hero scene; use a 35mm documentary perspective only if the composition needs a wider church interior view. Keep perspective natural and undistorted.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from the right, and warm practical glow in the background, resembling a calm Sunday afternoon church or parish hall interior.
- Color grade: warm cream + soft gold + charcoal, with slightly muted saturation, realistic skin tones, visible paper texture, and clean contrast for a printed-poster finish.
- Rendering details: realistic Korean print design, tactile paper grain, believable shadows from layered photo cards and labels, legible text blocks, natural people, and gentle environmental context.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet editorial church community poster — akin to a warm Korean fellowship announcement on a real parish lobby board, reverent but welcoming, sincere, lived-in, and approachable for first-time young adults.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and legibly in the rendered image: "함께 모이는 청년의 시간.", "○○ 교회 청년부 또는 ○○ 성당 청년 모임 / 소그룹 종류 (찬양·성경공부·봉사)", "매주 금요일 19:30 / 청년부실 / 찬양 + 나눔 + 식사 교제", "교회 사무실 또는 카톡 채널 @○○청년부 / 첫 방문 환영".
- Also include realistic poster microcopy in Korean, correctly rendered: "2026 봄학기 모집", "첫 모임 5.10 FRI", "참가비 무료", "QR로 바로 신청", "문의·신청하기", "주관: 청년부 리더팀".
- Maintain a vertical A4 poster composition with centered hierarchy, readable Korean typography, visible event details, contact path, and a welcoming recruitment purpose.
- Keep the hero image respectful, community-oriented, naturally lit, and believable, with realistic young adults participating in fellowship, worship preparation, Bible study, or shared conversation.

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Youth career mentoring recruitment poster, vertical A4-style community program flyer for schools and youth centers.
Designed to communicate mentoring types, schedule, application info, venue cues, and participation benefits at a glance for middle and high school students and parents.
The final image should feel like a real printed recruitment poster pinned on a school bulletin board or shared by a youth center, with believable event information, photographic detail, and civic education design polish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: the hero mentoring scene occupies the upper 48% of the page, centered slightly above midline for an energetic recruitment-poster feel.
- Header zone: the headline sits in the top 14% with strong visual priority, supported by a small recruitment label, date badge, and youth-program tag.
- Information zone: program details are stacked in the lower 38% as clear poster blocks with strong hierarchy, small icons, dividers, and practical application information.
- Background treatment: bright white base with soft blue-to-white airy gradients, accented by yellow highlight shapes, dotted school-notebook graphics, faint grid paper texture, and small career-themed line illustrations.
- Spacing and framing: editorial poster margins, rounded info cards, balanced left-right rhythm, and layered visual accents that make the flyer feel complete and realistic.
- Use {주최·프로그램}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {대상·일정}, {신청 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders naturally in the layout.
- Add realistic poster micro-content: small date label '2026년 봄학기', program badge 'VOL. 04', venue line '청소년센터 2층 꿈마루실', participation line '참가비 무료', QR-code style application box, sponsor/support area, and contact line '문의 02-1234-5678'.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (upper 48%): depict {hero 이미지} as a lively mentoring scene with Korean teenagers and one mentor around a shared table; include notebooks, colorful sticky notes, pens, a laptop with career-planning charts, a tablet, small science model pieces, art swatches, name tags, and printed worksheets. The figures should look friendly, natural, and engaged, with one student asking a question, another writing notes, and the mentor pointing to a career map.
2. Headline band (top 14%): place {헤드라인} in large Korean display type with youthful handwritten energy, using a strong contrasting color and an accent underline, arrow doodle, or yellow marker stroke for emphasis. Add a small top label reading '청소년 멘토링 모집' and a compact badge reading '진로 탐색 · 직업 체험 · 멘토 토크'.
3. Organizer strip (just below headline): set {주최·프로그램} in a smaller but clear label style, preceded by the text '주최' and followed by a thin divider. Include a subtle civic-program line such as '학교 밖 진로 경험을 연결하는 지역 청소년 프로그램'.
4. Poster event details block (between hero and lower cards): add compact event facts with small icons: '일시 2026.05.18 토 10:00–16:00', '장소 청소년센터 2층 꿈마루실', '참가비 무료', '준비물 필기도구 · 개인 텀블러'. These must look like printed flyer information, not placeholder filler.
5. Details cards (lower middle): present {대상·일정} in a compact two- to three-line block with icon-like separators or bullet dots, making the time, duration, and mentoring ratio immediately scannable. Add small section labels such as '대상·일정', '운영 내용', and '멘토링 분야'. Include short Korean blurbs: '1:4 소그룹 멘토링', '진로 흥미 검사', '포트폴리오 미니 코칭'.
6. Application block (lower 20%): show {신청 방법} inside a rounded rectangle or highlighted panel with clear hierarchy for free participation, school/youth center application, and certificate/portfolio note. Include a realistic QR-code area labeled '온라인 신청', a short URL-style text 'youthcareer.kr/apply', a deadline tag '신청 마감 2026.05.10', and a line '선착순 40명'.
7. Palette reinforcement: apply {컬러 팔레트} through blue base fields, yellow accents, white panels, charcoal text, pale sky-blue career cards, and small lemon-yellow stickers.
8. Footer balance (bottom edge): reserve the lowest strip for support and credibility details, including '후원 지역교육협력센터', '문의 02-1234-5678', small social handle '@youth_dream_lab', and the {비율} layout note only if needed as tiny production metadata.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for headers, Pretendard Medium for details, and a hand-drawn Korean display style for the headline accent; headline around 56–72px equivalent, body text around 24–30px equivalent, micro labels around 14–18px equivalent.
- Color palette: bright blue, warm yellow, white, and charcoal, matching {컬러 팔레트}; use deep navy or charcoal for key text, pale sky-blue for large background fields, and warm yellow for badges, highlights, arrows, and deadline tags.
- Border/shadow: soft rounded cards with a subtle drop shadow, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity; thin white separators and light outlines to keep information readable over layered flyer elements.
- Graphic details: include small doodle icons of a compass, lightbulb, checklist, rocket, magnifier, and speech bubble; add notebook-paper tabs, sticker-like labels, and soft geometric circles so the poster feels youth-oriented and print-ready.
- Realistic print finish: slight paper grain, gentle ink texture, crisp vector-like typography, and believable alignment marks or tiny footer credits such as 'Design for Youth Career Week 2026'.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial poster look, 35mm lens at f/4 for the group mentoring scene, slightly elevated angle to keep the composition readable and welcoming.
- Lighting: soft studio daylight from upper-left with gentle fill from front-right, creating bright skin tones, visible tabletop objects, and clear object visibility without harsh contrast.
- Color grade: school-poster fresh grade with sky blue, lemon yellow, white, and charcoal; slightly crisp contrast with bright highlights and warm human skin tones.
- Rendering approach: combine a realistic photographed mentoring scene with polished Korean civic-poster graphic layout; the people and objects should have photographic depth while the surrounding event information is cleanly typeset and print-sharp.

[6. MOOD]
Community youth program recruitment poster — like a modern Korean education flyer with the polished clarity of a civic campaign graphic and the approachable energy of a university open-day poster.
The mood should feel hopeful, practical, and welcoming, showing that students can explore real careers through conversation, hands-on activities, and guided portfolio coaching.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following exact Korean strings must appear clearly and correctly in the rendered image:
  - 청소년 멘토링 모집
  - 주최
  - 헤드라인
  - 대상·일정
  - 신청 방법
  - 한글 정확
- Additional Korean poster text should be short, realistic, and legible, such as '진로 탐색', '직업 체험', '멘토 토크', '참가비 무료', '온라인 신청', '선착순 40명', and '청소년센터 2층 꿈마루실'.
- Layout invariants: maintain a tall vertical recruitment-poster structure, with the hero scene above and the information blocks below in a readable hierarchy.
- The mentoring scene must feel friendly and realistic, with anatomically correct hands, natural eye contact, believable teenage styling, and genuine interaction between mentor and students.
- Ensure all placeholder-driven content remains integrated: {주최·프로그램}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {대상·일정}, {신청 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

[1. PURPOSE]
도서관·문화원 강연 및 작가초청 모집용 세로형 포스터. 공공기관 게시판, 홈페이지 배너, SNS 공지, 문화강좌 접수 안내에 바로 사용할 수 있는 현실적인 문예 행사 홍보 디자인.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 상단 20%에는 {행사명}과 {헤드라인}을 크게 배치하고, 그 아래에 {서브카피}와 {주최기관}을 작은 캡션으로 정렬해 도서관 문화행사 성격을 즉시 인지시키는 구조.
- 중앙 45%는 {hero이미지}가 가장 먼저 시선을 끌도록 배치한다. 서가, 강연 단상, 펼쳐진 책, 마이크, 물컵, 강연자 네임카드, 북마크, 메모지 같은 실제 행사 오브제를 함께 담아 현장감을 만든다.
- 중앙 이미지 한쪽에는 작은 {행사번호} 라벨과 북스탬프 느낌의 날짜 표기를 넣고, 가장자리에는 얇은 책갈피 리본, 연필 드로잉, 페이지 모서리 그래픽 등 {장식요소}를 자연스럽게 배치한다.
- 하단 35%는 {일정}, {장소}, {소요시간}, {신청방법}, {모집인원}, {참가비}, {혜택}, {티켓정보}, {문의처}를 정보 카드와 티켓 스텁 형태로 나누어 읽기 쉽게 정리한다.
- 최하단에는 {후원협력} 영역을 두어 협력기관명, 작은 후원 문구, 홈페이지/QR 접수 박스를 포함한 실제 포스터 같은 마감 구조를 만든다.
- 모든 본문 요소는 {컬러팔레트}를 기준으로 조화롭게 구성하고, 종이 질감, 목재 테이블, 책등의 색, 인쇄 잉크 농담이 보이도록 현실적인 편집 포스터 톤을 유지한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header zone (top 20%): 좌상단에 작은 카테고리 라벨 “도서관 강연 모집”을 넣고, 중앙에는 {헤드라인}을 가장 크게 배치한다. 얇은 구분선 아래에 {행사명}, {강연자정보}, {주최기관}을 소형 정보줄로 넣어 공공 문화행사 포스터 인상을 만든다.
- Hero zone (middle 45%): {hero이미지}를 editorial still-life 방식으로 구성한다. 뒤쪽에는 따뜻한 도서관 서가, 앞쪽에는 강연 단상 일부, 펼쳐진 책, 마이크, 연필, 프로그램 리플릿, 작은 좌석번호 표식을 배치해 실제 강연장 준비 장면처럼 보이게 한다.
- Event detail strip: Hero 아래에는 인디고 컬러의 가로 정보 띠를 넣어 “일정 / 장소 / 신청” 세 항목을 빠르게 확인하게 하며, 각 항목 앞에 작은 라인 아이콘을 배치한다.
- Schedule block: {일정}, {장소}, {소요시간}을 날짜-시간-장소-진행 순서로 줄바꿈해 배치하고, “강연 60분 + Q&A 30분” 같은 실제 안내 문장으로 구성한다.
- Application block: {신청방법}, {모집인원}, {참가비}, {혜택}을 짧은 문장들로 나누고, 선착순·무료·사은품 요소는 작은 배지 또는 체크 리스트로 표시한다.
- Ticket / QR block: {티켓정보}를 티켓 스텁 디자인으로 넣고, QR 접수 박스, 접수 시작일, 입장 안내, 문의번호 {문의처}를 함께 넣어 현실적인 모집 포스터로 완성한다.
- Sponsor footer: 하단에는 {후원협력}을 작은 텍스트와 기관명 나열 방식으로 정리하고, 인쇄물처럼 페이지 하단 고유번호와 웹주소를 아주 작게 배치한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {헤드라인}은 Noto Serif KR 또는 Nanum Myeongjo 계열의 절제된 명조체, 52~68px 굵기; 행사명과 강연자 정보는 Noto Serif KR SemiBold 28~36px; 본문 정보는 Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR 18~28px Regular/Medium.
- Color palette: {컬러팔레트}의 아이보리 #F4F0E6, 따뜻 브라운 #8A6A4F, 인디고 #243B63, 차콜 #2B2B2B를 중심으로 사용하고, 포인트로 오래된 책갈피 레드 #9B3D30 또는 올리브 #6B7255를 소량 사용한다.
- Layout details: 정보 카드는 1px 브라운 라인, 8px blur, 10% opacity의 soft drop shadow를 사용해 인쇄된 카드가 겹쳐진 느낌을 준다. 티켓 스텁에는 미세한 절취선, 작은 번호, QR 접수 박스, 날짜 라벨을 포함한다.
- Graphic accents: {장식요소}는 책갈피, 연필 스케치, 페이지 넘김, 도서 대출카드, 손글씨 메모 느낌을 활용하되 공공기관 안내문답게 차분하고 읽기 쉬운 밀도로 배치한다.
- Text hierarchy: 헤드라인, 행사명, 일정, 신청 방법, 문의처 순으로 명확한 위계를 만들고, 실제 인쇄 포스터처럼 자간과 행간을 안정적으로 조정한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/2.8 editorial still-life look, sharp focus on 책 표면과 강연 관련 오브제.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, subtle fill from right, no harsh specular highlights, paper and wood texture visible.
- Color grade: warm cream + brown + indigo + charcoal, with low saturation and gentle contrast, similar to a Kinfolk editorial layout.
- Material realism: visible paper grain, slightly worn book cloth, matte ink, wood desk texture, linen bookmark ribbon, soft shadow under cards and ticket stub.

[6. MOOD]
Premium library event editorial — calm cultural-poster aesthetic with Kinfolk magazine spread restraint, a quiet literary salon atmosphere, and the realistic warmth of a local public library lecture announcement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: “도서관 강연 모집”, “한 권의 책, 한 시간의 대화.”, “작가초청 북토크”, “주최”, “일정”, “장소”, “신청”, “문의”, “2026.06.15 (토) 14:00”, “○○ 도서관 2층 강당”, “강연 60분 + Q&A 30분”, “도서관 홈페이지 사전 신청”, “선착순 50명”, “참가비 무료”, “참석자 도서 사은품”.
- 포스터 하단에는 실제 안내 요소처럼 “접수기간 2026.05.20–06.10”, “입장권 현장 수령”, “문의 02-000-0000”, “협력 ○○ 문화원 · 지역서점 책마루”가 읽히게 배치되어야 함.
- 모든 한글 문자는 정확한 맞춤법과 자간으로 렌더링되어야 하며, 글자 깨짐이나 오탈자가 없어야 함.
- 포스터는 세로형 {비율}을 유지하고, 상단 헤드라인-중앙 행사 이미지-하단 신청 정보의 3단 구조가 명확해야 함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable real-person impersonation
- 얼굴 왜곡, 실제 인물 변형, 과도한 피부 보정

[1. PURPOSE]
A community-center recruitment poster for local cultural classes, designed as a realistic A4 portrait notice that feels practical, friendly, and easy to read on an apartment lobby or 주민센터 bulletin board.
Use a warm editorial layout with strong hierarchy, believable printed-paper details, and enough civic information for residents scanning program schedules, venue, fee, and application route at a glance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The poster is a vertical A4-style recruitment notice with a strong top header band, a content-rich central hero collage area, and a lower information block; the layout should feel like a real neighborhood bulletin poster produced by a 주민자치센터, not a sterile template.
- Top header occupies about 18% of the frame, centered and bold; the hero area takes the middle 42–48%; the schedule, venue, fee, and application information sits in organized boxed sections near the bottom.
- Background treatment: warm beige paper texture with slight grain, subtle off-white mottling, faint print-ink imperfections, light staple or tape marks near the corners, and mild photocopy registration texture to mimic a real community-center printed notice.
- Add realistic poster metadata and civic details: small date label, 모집기간 line, venue line, 문의 phone placeholder, QR-code-like application box, small sponsor/cooperation strip, and a bottom posting-code/footer line.
- Maintain clear separation between headline, visual, and details with a practical municipal notice feel, using readable spacing and structured boxes rather than a glossy advertisement composition.
- Main placeholders: {주최·프로그램}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {수강 정보}, {신청 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header band (top 18%): Place {주최·프로그램} as the organizing label, centered in a strong Korean headline style. Set {헤드라인} directly below it in a larger warm handwritten or soft display font, with quotation-mark style emphasis and airy line spacing. Include small realistic labels around the header such as “2026 봄·여름 문화강좌”, “접수중”, and “VOL. 04 / 주민참여 프로그램”.
2. Hero collage area (middle 45%): Build a friendly neighborhood-class collage using {hero 이미지} as the main visual cue. Show a community-center classroom scene with residents of mixed ages participating naturally, combined with still-life elements such as a rolled yoga mat, simple 우쿨렐레, calligraphy brushes, ink dish, folded class handout, tea cup, name stickers, and a small schedule clipboard, arranged as a layered printed-photo-and-cut-paper composition.
3. Visual framing: Keep the hero collage centered and slightly tall, with the classroom element carrying the main visual weight and smaller class-related props orbiting around it. Use crisp cut-paper edges, subtle overlaps, soft drop shadows, masking-tape details, and pinned-note accents so the poster feels handmade but professionally organized.
4. Information block (lower 25%): Present {수강 정보} in neatly aligned rows or boxed bullet lines with clear separators. Add practical sublabels in Korean such as “수강 대상”, “운영 기간”, “수강료”, “장소”, “정원”, and “준비물”, using small icons, thin dividers, and a timetable-like arrangement.
5. Application block (bottom strip): Place {신청 방법} in a contrasting but restrained accent area, such as a rounded rectangle or thin-outlined box, so the sign-up route is immediately visible. Include a small QR-code-style square labeled “온라인 신청”, a phone/contact line “문의 02-0000-0000”, and a short note “선착순 마감 / 주민 우선 접수”.
6. Footer accent: Use {컬러 팔레트} in decorative divider lines, small corner motifs, program-category color chips, and a sponsor/cooperation strip reading “주관 주민자치회 · 협력 동네문화공방 · 장소 2층 다목적실” to unify the poster and reinforce a local, welcoming neighborhood identity.
7. Size treatment: Respect {비율} as a portrait poster layout with print-ready proportions, realistic bulletin-board presence, and legible information density suitable for 1024x1536 output.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard Bold for the main program name, Noto Sans KR Medium for information rows, and a hand-drawn or brush-inspired Korean display font for the headline. Keep sizes roughly 64–76px for the main title, 38–48px for the headline, 24–30px for details, and 16–20px for micro labels, footer metadata, and captions.
- Color palette: warm beige, amber, teal, and charcoal based on {컬러 팔레트}; suggested tones include #F3E7D3, #D89B2B, #2D8C8A, and #3B3B3B. Add small coral or sage accent chips only if they harmonize with the given palette.
- Border/shadow: use thin charcoal rules, soft 4px y-offset shadows at 12px blur with about 14% opacity, lightly rounded boxes for application and timetable sections, and small dotted dividers for class categories.
- Print feel: slight ink spread, subtle paper grain, minor toner speckles, believable paper creases, and restrained contrast so it resembles a real printed community-center flyer posted on a public notice board.
- Decorative elements: include modest Korean notice-board details such as tape tabs, tiny check marks, simple calendar icon, location pin icon, phone icon, arrow markers, and small class-category badges like “건강”, “예술”, “취미”, “음악”.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary-style 35mm full-frame look with a 50mm lens at f/4 for the classroom scene, combined with flat-lay object styling for props; keep perspective natural and grounded.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle fill from the lower-right and very mild ambient bounce; no harsh specular highlights.
- Color grade: warm cream, amber, and muted teal with charcoal text; keep saturation moderate and the paper background slightly sunlit but not yellowed.
- Material realism: the hero photo should have mild depth of field and natural skin tones, while the surrounding paper elements should show printed halftone texture, slight edge shadows, and tactile collage layering.

[6. MOOD]
Neighborhood civic-poster editorial with the approachable clarity of a local community newsletter, the warm print tactility of a Kinfolk-style layout, and the believable fullness of a real 주민자치센터 모집 공고 posted for local residents.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear correctly and clearly in the rendered image:
  - 주민자치센터
  - ○○ 주민자치센터 또는 ○○ 동사무소 / 프로그램 (요가·필라테스·서예·우쿨렐레 등)
  - "동네에서 가까이, 매주 한 번." — 따뜻 한글
  - 매주 화·목 19:30 / 12주 과정 / 회비 월 1~2만 (저렴) / 주민 우선
  - 주민자치센터 직접 신청 / 동사무소 게시판 / 카카오 채널
- Additional Korean poster details should appear as small but legible supporting text where appropriate:
  - 2026 봄·여름 문화강좌
  - 모집기간 2026.05.01–05.20
  - 장소 2층 다목적실 / 문의 02-0000-0000
  - 정원 15명 내외 / 선착순 마감
  - 온라인 신청 QR / 현장 접수 가능
  - 주관 주민자치회 · 협력 동네문화공방
- The poster must preserve a clear A4 portrait notice layout with headline on top, hero in the middle, and information/application details below.
- All text must be properly formed Korean with no broken characters, no accidental English substitutions in the rendered Korean strings, and no malformed punctuation.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Public recruitment poster for a city hall / district office lifelong learning course program, A4 vertical layout for community noticeboards, municipal website banners, and mobile sharing.
Friendly civic-service poster with clear enrollment messaging, realistic class photography, and practical course information that residents can read quickly.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main poster follows a vertical civic announcement layout for {비율}: a civic header and recruitment badge at the top, a warm hero image in the upper section, a large headline below, then course schedule, fee, venue, application, and contact details arranged as readable information cards.
- Place {주최기관} and {강좌명} near the top as the organizational/course identifier, aligned like a municipal lifelong-learning announcement rather than a commercial ad.
- Add a small issue-style civic label such as “2026 상반기 평생학습 프로그램” and a rounded badge reading “선착순 접수” beside the header.
- Use {헤드라인} as the primary attention line, large and friendly, followed by {서브카피} in a smaller supportive line.
- Insert {hero이미지} as the central visual focus: real classroom atmosphere with learners, instructor gestures, notebooks, tablets, craft tools, cooking utensils, language flashcards, or calligraphy brushes depending on the course theme.
- Build the lower section with {모집기간}, {운영기간}, {수강안내}, {신청방법}, {장소}, and {문의} as compact information rows with icons, dividers, and colored labels.
- Add a footer sponsor/administration strip with {주관협력}, {웹주소}, a small QR-code placeholder, and a public-service notice line.
- Apply {컬러팔레트} across the entire design with civic blue-green accents, white paper texture, charcoal text, soft panels, and friendly decorative graphics such as learning-themed doodle icons, calendar dots, and small page-corner stickers.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header area (upper 12%): Place {주최기관} as a civic label with the main title “시민 강좌 모집”; add {강좌명}, “2026 상반기”, and a small badge “접수중 · 선착순”.
2. Hero image block (upper 36%): Show {hero이미지} as a realistic municipal brochure photograph with warm classroom depth, visible learning materials, diverse adult learners, and an instructor helping participants.
3. Headline block (mid 13%): Set {헤드라인} in the largest Korean type, with {서브카피} underneath; add a small decorative underline or blue-green ribbon shape.
4. Event details block (mid-lower 18%): Present {모집기간}, {운영기간}, {수강안내}, and {참가비} in four labeled cards using calendar, clock, certificate, and won-symbol icons.
5. Application block (lower 13%): Present {신청방법}, {장소}, and {문의} with clear emphasis on application dates, venue, phone number, and online route.
6. Footer / sponsor area (bottom 8%): Include {주관협력}, {웹주소}, QR-code placeholder, “자세한 내용은 홈페이지 공지사항을 확인하세요”, and small decorative graphics from {장식요소}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR, bold 700–800 for the headline, medium 500–600 for supporting details, size hierarchy with the headline roughly 2.5–3x larger than body text.
- Color palette: {컬러팔레트} with civic blue, muted green, clean white, warm off-white paper, and charcoal black; use pale tinted panels for information grouping.
- Graphic treatment: soft rounded rectangles, 1px blue-gray divider lines, gentle card shadows around 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity, small line icons for date/time/place/phone, and learning-themed decorative stickers.
- Information design: dates and deadlines must be visually highlighted with accent color; phone and website should be placed in the footer where residents can easily find them.
- Poster realism: include small print details such as QR code placeholder, “수강료 감면 대상 별도 문의”, “정원 초과 시 조기 마감”, and a municipal noticeboard-friendly print texture.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary poster photo feel, Canon EOS R5 with RF 35mm f/1.8 at f/5.6 for a balanced classroom scene, or Canon EOS R6 Mark II with RF 50mm f/1.8 for a friendly enrollment brochure look.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left, with gentle fill from front-right; keep the scene bright, warm, and believable like a municipal lifelong-learning center brochure shot.
- Color grade: crisp civic blue + fresh green + neutral white balance, slightly softened contrast, clean public-service print finish with natural skin tones and readable text overlays.

[6. MOOD]
Friendly public-service announcement — trustworthy, welcoming, and useful, like a well-designed municipal brochure posted at a community center, library, subway noticeboard, and city hall website.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함
  - "올해는 새로운 걸 배워볼까요?"
  - "시민 강좌 모집"
  - "모집기간 2026.04.01–04.15"
  - "매주 1회 90분 · 8주 과정"
- Render all key Korean poster text cleanly and legibly: {주최기관}, {강좌명}, {모집기간}, {운영기간}, {수강안내}, {참가비}, {신청방법}, {장소}, {문의}, {웹주소}.
- Layout invariants: vertical A4-style poster, civic header at top, hero classroom image above the headline, details stacked in the lower half, footer with sponsor area and QR-code placeholder.
- People in the hero image must look natural, adult, friendly, and appropriate for a public lifelong-learning class.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Face or body distortion in any people shown

[1. PURPOSE]
사회인 골프 동호회 모집 포스터. A4 세로형 세로 비율의 클럽 모집 공고 느낌으로, 동호회 정체성, 정기 라운딩 일정, 가입 안내, 모임 분위기를 한 장에 담은 현실적인 홍보용 이미지.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 상단 14%: {동호회·로고}를 메인 로고/클럽명처럼 배치하고, 작은 서브 라벨로 “2026 봄 시즌 신규 회원 모집”과 “SINCE 2024 · WEEKEND GOLF CLUB”을 함께 넣어 실제 클럽 포스터처럼 구성.
- 상단 바로 아래: {헤드라인}을 짧고 단정한 명조체 헤드라인으로 배치하고, 보조 카피 “필드의 동반자, 함께해요.”를 골드 포인트 라인과 함께 넣기.
- 중앙 48%: {hero 이미지}를 시선 집중 요소로 크게 두고, 실제 골프장 페어웨이, 그린 잔디, 골프공, 티, 장갑, 스코어카드, 야디지북, 클럽헤드, 카트 도로 일부가 자연스럽게 보이는 잡지 광고형 포스터 비주얼로 구성.
- 중앙 이미지 주변: 작은 라운딩 배지 형태로 “월 1회 정기 라운딩”, “입문 가능”, “핸디캡 무관”을 배치하고, 얇은 야디지 맵 라인, 홀 플래그 아이콘, 골프공 딤플 패턴을 장식 요소로 활용.
- 하단 26%: 정보 박스 2개로 나누어 {정기 라운딩}과 {가입 방법}을 균형 있게 배치하되, 각 박스 안에 아이콘, 짧은 라벨, 시간/장소/문의 정보가 보이도록 현실적인 모집 안내처럼 구성.
- 하단 가장 아래: “일정: 매월 둘째 토요일 07:30”, “장소: 그린힐 CC / 클럽하우스 로비”, “문의: 카톡 오픈채팅 ‘필드메이트’”, “참가비: 코스별 별도 공지” 같은 작은 안내 라인을 넣고, 우측에는 QR 코드처럼 보이는 문의 박스와 작은 바코드형 장식 영역을 배치.
- 배경은 딥 그린 기반에 골프장 잔디 결, 가죽 스코어카드 커버, 은은한 종이 포스터 질감, 골드 라인 그래픽이 함께 느껴지는 프리미엄 클럽 공지 스타일.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone: {동호회·로고}를 상단 중앙에 배치, 골드 포인트와 차콜 보조색으로 안정감 있게 구성. 주변에 작은 클럽 크레스트형 라인 아트, “MEMBER RECRUITMENT” 캡션, “VOL. 03” 같은 포스터 에디션 표기를 추가.
2) Slogan zone: 바로 아래에 {헤드라인}을 크고 우아한 한글 명조체로 배치하고, 보조 문구 “필드의 동반자, 함께해요.”를 작은 산세리프체로 넣어 모집 메시지가 즉시 읽히게 처리.
3) Hero zone: 중앙에는 {hero 이미지}를 고급 골프 잡지 화보처럼 배치. 실제 필드 위에 놓인 골프공과 클럽, 스코어카드에 적힌 “OUT 36 / IN 36”, 작은 연필, 티 꽂이, 거리 표식, 클럽하우스 실루엣을 더해 현장감 있게 구성.
4) Event detail ribbon: hero 이미지 하단 또는 측면에 골드 리본/라벨 형태로 “정기 라운딩 DAY”, “매월 둘째 토요일”, “9홀·18홀 선택”을 넣어 포스터 정보성을 강화.
5) Info card A: 좌측 또는 중앙 하단 박스에 {정기 라운딩}을 3~4줄 내외의 안내문처럼 정리하고, 캘린더 아이콘, 티타임 아이콘, 작은 홀 플래그 그래픽을 포함.
6) Info card B: 반대편 하단 박스에 {가입 방법}을 같은 톤과 같은 박스 스타일로 맞춰 배치하고, 카톡 말풍선 아이콘, 추천 가입 배지, “사전 1회 동행” 체크리스트를 포함.
7) Sponsor / contact strip: 하단 푸터에는 “후원: 로컬 골프샵 · 카페 버디”, “문의 @fieldmate.golf”, “서울·경기권 직장인 환영” 같은 작은 실제 포스터형 문구를 넣고, {컬러 팔레트}의 느낌을 살린 골드 라인과 작은 QR 문의 박스를 함께 배치.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold for body info, Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo Bold for headline, size hierarchy clearly separated with headline 54~68px, body 24~30px, micro labels 14~18px.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 기반으로 deep green #0F3B2E, gold #C8A24A, white #F7F5EF, charcoal #2B2B2B. Add subtle grass green highlights and warm beige paper tones where they support the golf-club atmosphere.
- Border/shadow: very subtle 2px gold rules and soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity on cards; matte premium print finish rather than glossy effects.
- Graphic details: use thin golf-course contour lines, yardage-map curves, small scorecard grid lines, flag icons, tee markers, and club badge accents to make the poster feel like a real club recruitment flyer.
- Layout rhythm: maintain clear reading order from logo to headline to hero image to schedule/joining cards to contact strip, with realistic printed-poster density and polished editorial alignment.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial flat-lay and poster composite feel, like a luxury club brochure photographed on a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 for the hero object, then composed cleanly in layout.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from right, controlled highlights on the golf items, natural sheen on club metal, realistic texture on grass, scorecard paper, glove leather, and golf ball dimples.
- Color grade: deep forest green + muted gold + warm white + charcoal, with restrained contrast and slightly desaturated luxury editorial tone.
- Print realism: slight paper grain, crisp Korean typography, believable shadows under cards and objects, subtle ink texture on gold lines, realistic club-brochure finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium golf club recruitment poster — luxury country-club brochure aesthetic with a calm editorial magazine finish, practical weekend-club information, and an inviting social rounding atmosphere for 직장인 members.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: “사회인 골프 동호회 모집”, “필드의 동반자, 함께해요.”, “월 1회 정기 라운딩 / 9홀·18홀 / 코스 비용 분담 / 입문 가능”, “카톡 또는 추천 가입 / 핸디캡 무관 / 사전 1회 동행”.
- Additional Korean text to render clearly where space allows: “2026 봄 시즌 신규 회원 모집”, “매월 둘째 토요일 07:30”, “그린힐 CC / 클럽하우스 로비”, “참가비 코스별 별도 공지”, “문의 @fieldmate.golf”, “후원: 로컬 골프샵 · 카페 버디”, “서울·경기권 직장인 환영”.
- {동호회·로고}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {정기 라운딩}, {가입 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율}가 서로 충돌하지 않도록 레이아웃을 정돈할 것.
- 한글 자모 분리, 오탈자, 줄바꿈 깨짐 없이 선명하게 렌더링.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Adult dance club recruitment poster in vertical A4 format, designed for ballet, jazz dance, latin, waltz, and salsa communities. Create a polished but realistic studio recruitment flyer for a physical dance-studio notice board, Instagram stories, KakaoTalk sharing, and local community boards, with enough real-world poster information to feel ready to print.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero composition: the frame is a vertical poster with the hero image occupying the central 58% of the canvas, a clear top headline band around 18%, and a structured lower information block around 24%.
- Main subject placement: {hero 이미지} sits slightly above center with a graceful rehearsal-poster presence; the figure is framed by mirror reflections, a ballet barre, studio floor lines, and soft rehearsal objects that naturally belong in an adult dance studio.
- Background treatment: soft studio mirror-room atmosphere with ballet barre, folded tutu fabric, ballet shoes, jazz shoes, a water bottle, rehearsal schedule paper, and polished wooden floor reflections in a pale cream-white interior.
- Text hierarchy: {헤드라인} is placed at the top center as the primary emotional line, while {동호회·종목}, {수업·시간}, and {가입 방법} are arranged in separated information rows beneath the hero with small icons, dividers, and practical recruitment details.
- Poster realism: include a small event/date label, venue line, contact strip, QR-code placeholder box, ticket/trial-class note, and a sponsor/support area near the footer so the design feels like a real community recruitment poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): place {헤드라인} in a delicate serif headline treatment, centered, with thin gold rule lines, a small date label “2026 SPRING CLASS”, and a short supporting line “성인을 위한 저녁 취미 클래스”.
2. Hero area (mid 58%): feature {hero 이미지} as the dominant visual, softly integrated into a ballet-studio setting with mirror, barre, rehearsal props, pinned studio notes, and warm window reflections; keep the figure elegant, natural, and non-sensational.
3. Program title block: show {동호회·종목} in a bold refined subheading, clearly indicating the dance genres offered; add a compact genre chip row reading “Ballet · Jazz · Latin · Waltz · Salsa”.
4. Schedule block: present {수업·시간} in an easy-to-scan layout with small separators and calendar-style details; include Korean microcopy such as “장소: 마포구 연습실 B홀”, “정원: 12명 내외”, and “대상: 성인 입문·취미반”.
5. Membership block: place {가입 방법} near the lower section as a practical callout, visually distinct with a muted blush card shape; add “무료 체험 1회”, “편한 운동복 가능”, and a small QR-code placeholder labeled “신청 QR”.
6. Footer balance: include realistic footer details such as “주최: 무브온 댄스클럽”, “문의 010-2458-0719”, “@moveon_dance”, a tiny sponsor strip “with Studio Room 3F”, and decorative star/dot accents in muted gold and pale blush.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the headline in medium-to-bold weight, with refined high-contrast strokes; use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body text at small poster-readable size.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with soft off-white background #F7F3EF, deep charcoal #2E2B2C, muted gold accents #C9A86A, and pale blush pink highlights #EBC4D3.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow, 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under the hero; thin gold divider lines and elegant blush information cards.
- Layout finish: refined editorial poster surface with crisp printed edges, light paper grain, gentle ink texture, studio-photo depth, readable hierarchy, and realistic local-event flyer details.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm portrait lens look, f/2.0 shallow depth of field for the hero; polished editorial framing reminiscent of a high-end studio portrait.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at 45°, with a gentle fill from front-right and faint rim light to separate the silhouette from the background.
- Color grade: pastel pink, warm ivory, charcoal, and muted gold with a restrained ballet-editorial tone; slight warm highlight roll-off, soft neutral shadows, and realistic printed-poster contrast.
- Material realism: show subtle paper fibers, faint fold-like pressure marks, authentic ink edges on Korean typography, and soft reflections in the studio mirror without reducing readability.

[6. MOOD]
Premium ballet and dance studio recruitment editorial — the refined atmosphere of a Kinfolk spread mixed with a graceful fashion-school poster and a believable neighborhood studio class flyer.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - "성인 댄스 동호회 모집"
  - "무대 위, 다시 빛나요."
  - "발레·재즈·라틴·왈츠·살사"
  - "매주 화·목 19:30 / 1시간 / 입문·중급 분반 / 회비 월 8만"
  - "카톡 채널 / 첫 수업 무료 / 운동복 자율"
- Additional Korean poster details should appear naturally and legibly where space allows: "2026 SPRING CLASS", "장소: 마포구 연습실 B홀", "정원 12명", "신청 QR", "문의 010-2458-0719", "@moveon_dance", "주최: 무브온 댄스클럽".
- Anatomy/layout invariants: any dancer figure must be anatomically correct, elegant, and natural; if visible, limbs and hands must look realistic and proportionate.
- Composition consistency: maintain the exact vertical poster hierarchy with headline top, hero center, and structured information blocks below.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
외국어 회화 모임 모집 포스터, A4 세로형 커뮤니티 리크루팅 그래픽. 카페 감성의 정보형 포스터로, 오프라인 정기 회화 모임의 실제 분위기와 참여 정보를 한눈에 전달하며 신청 행동까지 자연스럽게 유도하는 용도.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Upper headline zone (top 18%): {헤드라인}을 가장 먼저 읽히는 메인 타이틀로 배치하고, 바로 아래에 {부제목}과 {모임명}을 작은 라벨처럼 붙여 모집 포스터의 성격을 명확히 보여준다.
- Event badge strip: 헤드라인 주변에 {언어·레벨}, {신청마감}, “1회 무료 체험” 같은 짧은 정보를 둥근 스티커, 말풍선, 얇은 리본 배너 형태로 배치해 실제 커뮤니티 포스터처럼 보이게 한다.
- Hero zone (middle 42%): {hero 이미지}를 중심 시각 요소로 두고, 카페 테이블 위 회화 책·노트·형광펜·머그컵·작은 국기 색감의 북마크·스마트폰 오픈채팅 화면이 함께 보이도록 구성한다.
- Info blocks (lower 30%): {정기 모임}, {장소상세}, {참가비}, {가입 방법}, {문의}를 3~4개 정보 카드로 나누고, 각 카드에 아이콘, 얇은 구분선, 작은 캡션을 더해 읽는 순서가 분명하게 이어지도록 정렬한다.
- Footer sponsor and ticket area: 하단에는 {스폰서} 표기, QR 신청 박스, “무료 체험권” 느낌의 작은 티켓 그래픽, page-safe footer note를 넣어 실제 행사 포스터의 완성도를 높인다.
- Background treatment: 아이보리 종이 질감 바탕에 따뜻 베이지 그라데이션, 잔잔한 커피 얼룩 질감, 연필로 그린 듯한 대화 말풍선 라인, 작은 별·체크·지도핀 장식을 배치해 카페 스터디 분위기를 만든다.
- Framing direction: 상단 제목-중앙 히어로-하단 신청 정보-푸터 문의로 시선이 자연스럽게 내려가도록 세로 흐름을 명확히 유지.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area: {헤드라인}을 중앙 정렬로 크게 배치하고, 손글씨 느낌과 편집 매거진 느낌이 섞인 타이포로 첫인상을 만든다. 제목 옆에는 작은 라벨 “LANGUAGE MEETUP”과 {모임명}을 넣는다.
2. Sub-info strip: 헤드라인 아래에 {부제목}과 {언어·레벨}을 한 줄 또는 두 줄로 넣어, 모집 언어와 난이도를 즉시 읽히게 한다.
3. Hero image block: {hero 이미지}를 포스터 중심부에 크게 배치하고, 커피 테이블 위의 대화용 책·노트·펜·체크리스트·스마트폰 채팅 화면·작은 좌석 번호 카드가 함께 보이도록 구성해 회화 모임의 실제 분위기를 전달한다.
4. Schedule panel: 하단 첫 카드에 {정기 모임}을 넣어 시간, 장소, 모임 길이, 대화 방식이 한 번에 정리되게 한다.
5. Venue and ticket panel: 하단 두 번째 카드에 {장소상세}와 {참가비}를 배치하고, 지도핀 아이콘, 지하철 출구 표시, “무료 체험권” 미니 티켓을 함께 넣어 오프라인 모임 정보가 현실적으로 보이게 한다.
6. Join panel: 하단 세 번째 카드에 {가입 방법}과 {문의}를 넣고, QR 코드 자리, 카톡 오픈채팅 라벨, 신청 마감일 {신청마감}을 분리해 읽기 쉽게 만든다.
7. Sponsor footer: 최하단에는 {스폰서}를 작은 로고형 텍스트 영역으로 넣고, “음료는 각자 주문 / 초보 환영 / 소규모 테이블 진행” 같은 안내 문구를 작은 캡션으로 더한다.
8. Palette and finish: 전체를 {컬러 팔레트} 기반으로 통일하고, 카드와 본문 사이에 얇은 구분선, 도트 패턴, 손그림 말풍선, 미세한 종이 입자를 넣어 정보 포스터의 가독성과 생활감을 강화한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold for title, Pretendard Medium for body, and a subtle hand-drawn Korean accent for emphasis; title size large, body size medium, line spacing generous. Badge labels may use small condensed sans-serif in English.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}를 중심으로 사용하고, 아이보리 #F6F0E6, 따뜻 베이지 #D9C7B3, 인디고 #273A67, 차콜 #2E2E2E, 커피 브라운 #8A6548을 기준 톤으로 맞춘다.
- Poster details: 실제 출력 포스터처럼 상단 작은 VOL 표기, 신청 마감 배지, 하단 QR 박스, 티켓형 쿠폰, 스폰서 라인, 지도핀 아이콘, 언어별 작은 탭을 포함한다.
- Border/shadow: 카드에는 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity의 부드러운 그림자를 주고, 외곽은 얇은 차콜 라인과 종이 위에 인쇄된 듯한 잉크 번짐으로 정리.
- Graphic accents: 말풍선, 체크 표시, 작은 별, 책갈피, 커피잔 스케치, 언어 탭 라벨을 사용해 회화 모임의 친근한 분위기를 살린다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial lifestyle photo look, 35mm full-frame lens at f/2.8 for the hero area, with a slightly elevated angle that shows the tabletop composition clearly.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, very gentle fill from the right, no harsh specular highlights; keep shadows soft and realistic.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + indigo + charcoal, with slightly muted contrast and paper-like softness, similar to a Kinfolk café editorial spread.
- Material realism: matte printed paper, fine paper grain, slight ink absorption on dark text, realistic coffee cup ceramic highlights, natural notebook texture, believable pen and book scale.

[6. MOOD]
Premium community recruitment poster — Kinfolk magazine café spread feel with a calm, editorial, real-life study-club atmosphere. 따뜻한 카페에서 처음 만난 사람들이 부담 없이 자기소개를 나누는 장면처럼 친근하고 신뢰감 있는 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함
  - "커피 한 잔, 외국어 한 시간."
  - "일요일 오후, 카페에서 가볍게 말해요"
  - "카페링고 회화클럽"
  - "영어 / 일본어 / 중국어 / 스페인어 / 베트남어 — 한 언어 + 초·중·고급"
  - "매주 일요일 14:00 / ○○ 카페 / 1.5시간 / 토픽별 자유대화"
  - "홍대입구역 3번 출구 도보 5분 / 2층 라운지룸"
  - "1회 무료 체험 / 정기 회비 월 2만 원 / 음료 별도"
  - "카톡 오픈채팅 / QR 신청 / 선착순 12명"
  - "문의 @cafe_lingo / 010-1234-5678"
  - "신청 마감 2026.05.24"
  - "후원: 동네책방 북테이블 · 카페 모카룸"
- Layout invariants: 1024x1536 세로 비율 유지, 헤드라인-히어로-정보 카드-푸터 신청 영역의 4단 구조 유지, 한글 문자는 모두 깨짐 없이 또렷해야 함.
- Render the QR area as a believable black-and-white QR-style square labeled "QR 신청" without needing to be scannable.
- Include realistic poster microcopy such as "초보 환영", "소규모 테이블", "무료 체험권", "LANGUAGE MEETUP VOL.12" in small readable areas.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Human face distortion or anatomically incorrect hands
- Celebrity composites or implying a real public figure endorsement

[1. PURPOSE]
Recruitment poster for a wine / whiskey / traditional liquor tasting gathering, designed as an elegant vertical event flyer with premium editorial styling, realistic event information, and clear membership details.
Make it feel like a polished social poster for a small, refined tasting club, suitable for print, community boards, wine bar counters, or mobile sharing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header zone (about 16%): {헤드라인} centered as the dominant editorial title, supported by a small event label such as "테이스팅 멤버 모집" and a date badge.
- Hero zone (about 38%): {hero 이미지} as the main visual anchor, large and centered, framed like a premium still-life feature with realistic glassware, bottle labels turned partly away, corks, tasting notes, and small pairing plates.
- Details zone (about 30%): {정기 모임} and {가입 방법} stacked in clean event-information blocks below the hero, with readable labels, dividers, icons, and a practical call-to-action.
- Title / category line: {모임·주류} placed near the header area as a subtle category descriptor, paired with small Korean microcopy such as "와인 · 위스키 · 전통주".
- Event info strip: include date/time/venue/ticket-style information such as "2026.05.23 토 19:30", "성수 프라이빗 테이스팅 룸", "참가비 ₩35,000부터", and "사전 신청 필수".
- Sponsor / host area: add a small footer band with "HOSTED BY ○○ TASTING CLUB", "협찬: 동네 보틀샵", and a tiny QR-style application box.
- Background: warm ivory paper base with tactile paper grain, faint wine-ring marks, subtle gold foil accents, small grape-vine line art, and a tasteful vignette toward the edges.
- Use {모임·주류}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {정기 모임}, {가입 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders exactly as provided.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header band: place {헤드라인} at the top center in a high-contrast editorial layout, with the most prominent typographic weight and strong line spacing. Add a small upper label "TASTING NIGHT" and a refined badge reading "멤버 모집".
2) Category line: place {모임·주류} just beneath or near the headline as a smaller supporting line, aligned to the same center axis, with decorative dots or a thin gold rule on both sides.
3) Hero image block: show {hero 이미지} as a polished still-life composition with wine glasses, whiskey tumbler, traditional liquor cup, bottle silhouettes, corkscrew, corks, handwritten tasting-note card, cheese, dried fruit, nuts, and linen napkin. Keep the crop premium and realistic, with reflections on glass and rich liquid color.
4) Event detail ribbon: below the hero, insert a ticket-like strip with short Korean details: "2026.05.23 토 19:30", "성수 프라이빗 테이스팅 룸", "참가비 ₩35,000부터", "12명 이내".
5) Information block 1: present {정기 모임} in 2–3 short lines, using a structured event-poster format with clear emphasis on frequency, fee range, tasting lineup, pairing snacks, and participant cap.
6) Information block 2: present {가입 방법} below the schedule block, visually separated with a thin rule, small arrow cue, QR-style square, and concise call-to-action feel.
7) Footer / palette cue: reinforce {컬러 팔레트} through small accent bars, fine rules, foil-like corner ornaments, bottle-category chips, and text highlights. Include footer microcopy: "문의 @wine.society", "협찬: 동네 보틀샵", "만 19세 이상 참여 가능".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body text in Regular/SemiBold, and a high-contrast Korean serif such as Noto Serif KR or Sandoll Myeongjo for the headline, with the headline around 42–54px and body copy around 22–28px.
- Color palette: translate {컬러 팔레트} into deep burgundy #5A1E2A, antique gold #C8A24A, charcoal #2B2B2B, and ivory #F4EFE6.
- Border/shadow: thin gold rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on the hero block, elegant decorative framing, tiny corner flourishes, and a subtle ticket-stub divider for a luxury editorial feel.
- Layout: use centered alignment with disciplined vertical rhythm, clear hierarchy, realistic print-poster spacing, and enough supporting details to feel like an actual club recruitment flyer.
- Decorative elements: add small wine stain rings, foil line art of grape leaves, bottle-neck silhouettes, tasting-score dots, and tiny category tags such as "WINE", "WHISKY", "SOOL" without overpowering the main Korean information.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial still-life look shot on a Phase One IQ4 with a 90mm lens at f/5.6, crisp detail and shallow-enough separation for premium product poster aesthetics.
- Lighting: warm window light from upper-left at roughly 45°, gentle fill from front-right, with soft specular highlights on glass and bottle edges.
- Color grade: burgundy-gold-ivory palette with restrained contrast, slightly warm highlights, clean neutral shadows, and realistic paper/foil texture.
- Material realism: visible condensation on glass, amber whiskey glow, translucent wine highlights, ceramic cup texture, linen weave, cork grain, and subtle ink absorption on the poster paper.

[6. MOOD]
Premium lifestyle club poster — Kinfolk-style editorial still life meets upscale tasting invitation, with a quiet, curated, members-only atmosphere and the practical richness of a real local event flyer.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and legibly in the rendered image:
  - "한 잔의 시간, 함께 나눠요."
  - "○○ Wine Society 또는 ○○ 위스키 모임 / 와인·전통주·증류주"
  - "매월 1회 / 인당 회비 3~5만 (와인 4종 + 안주) / 12명 이내 소모임"
  - "카톡 오픈채팅 / 매월 신청 / 만 19세 이상 한정"
  - "2026.05.23 토 19:30"
  - "성수 프라이빗 테이스팅 룸"
  - "참가비 ₩35,000부터 / 사전 신청 필수"
  - "문의 @wine.society"
  - "협찬: 동네 보틀샵"
- Keep the layout vertically balanced and ensure all text is sharp, correctly spaced, and fully readable.
- Maintain a refined poster composition with realistic bottles, glassware, tasting notes, ticket-style details, and decorative event elements; no people are required.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- aspect_ratio: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean photography club recruitment poster, magazine-style vertical flyer for offline photo walk gatherings.
Designed to attract hobby photographers and casual shooters with a believable community-poster look: real printed paper, event information, club identity, small sponsor/partner details, and editorial photography culture cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Single-page A4-vertical poster layout, with the hero collage occupying the upper 42% of the frame and text information stacked in the lower 58%.
- Main headline block sits near the upper-left over an ivory paper field, while the hero area spans wide across the top with a lively cutout collage feel.
- Use {동호회·장비} and {헤드라인} as the main editorial text anchors, supported by realistic recruitment details such as issue-style label, date/time, venue, fee, contact, sponsor strip, and small registration notes.
- Background treatment: off-white ivory paper texture with visible fine grain, subtle print speckles, charcoal rules, natural green accent blocks, tiny film-frame marks, contact icons, and a small barcode/QR-style registration area.
- Maintain a strong poster-grid structure with magazine-like asymmetry, layered paper panels, photo captions, decorative arrows, dots, and thin divider lines that make the flyer feel printed and used in a real café or camera shop.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top hero zone (upper 42%): {hero 이미지} arranged as a polished collage of camera still-life, hands holding a camera strap, film rolls, contact sheets, café table notes, sneakers on a photo-walk pavement, and outing scenery, with 2-4 framed cut panels, crisp edges, tape-corner details, and soft realistic shadow on the paper background.
2. Headline zone (upper-left overlap): {헤드라인} set large and expressive, like a modern editorial masthead, slightly offset from the hero collage for a lively club-poster rhythm. Add small cover-label text near it: "PHOTO WALK CLUB", "VOL.04", "2026 봄 출사 모집".
3. Club identity line (below headline): {동호회·장비} presented as a compact descriptor line, separated by a thin charcoal rule and aligned to the same left edge for structure. Add a small model/credit style line: "사진 제공: 동호회 기록팀 / Edited by @walk_snap".
4. Schedule block (mid-lower section): {정기 출사} placed inside a practical information band with clear spacing, using concise event-list style. Include realistic event details: "일시 2026.05.02 SAT 10:30", "집결 홍대입구역 3번 출구", "코스 연남동 골목 → 경의선숲길 → 한강 노을", "참가비 무료 / 카페 음료 개별".
5. Join-info block (lower section): {가입 방법} positioned as a practical callout, visually lighter than the headline but still prominent enough to be read at poster distance. Add ticket/registration cues: "선착순 20명", "신청 마감 04.30", "문의 @photo_walk_kr", and a small QR-code placeholder box labeled "오픈채팅 입장".
6. Palette and footer balance (bottom strip): {컬러 팔레트} reflected through the full design, with a closing band containing sponsor/partner area, tiny social handle, page-style number, and community CTA: "함께 걷고, 함께 찍고, 함께 고르기", "후원: 동네사진관 / 필름스캔 10% 쿠폰", "POSTER NO. 012".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for body text, with a bold display serif or clean gothic headline treatment; headline 72-96px equivalent, body 28-36px equivalent, label text 22-26px equivalent, micro-credit text 14-18px equivalent but still shaped like real print.
- Color palette: ivory #F4F0E6, charcoal #2B2B2B, soft black #111111, natural green #6F8467, muted accent tone from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Border/shadow: thin 1-2px charcoal rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 14% opacity on collage panels, paper-tape corners, fine halftone dots, small registration box, and understated graphic dividers.
- Poster details: include issue number, date label, venue line, sponsor strip, ticket/fee information, QR-style block, small photo captions, and decorative film-frame marks so the image reads as a real community recruitment poster.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial poster photography look, shot as if on a Fujifilm GFX 100S with 80mm equivalent for still-life elements and a 24mm wide flat-lay feel for the collage arrangement.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, with slightly cooler shadow areas to preserve the magazine-like paper realism.
- Color grade: warm ivory paper, charcoal text, muted green accent, restrained contrast, natural film-like saturation with a clean analogue print finish.
- Physical realism: visible paper tooth, slight ink absorption around Korean letters, mild scanner-like print texture, soft shadows under overlapping photo panels, realistic camera gear surfaces, and candid outdoor textures in the collage photos.

[6. MOOD]
Indie photo-club recruitment poster — Kinfolk x Aperture magazine community event feel, calm but socially inviting, like a real poster pinned at a neighborhood café, university notice board, or local camera shop.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear correctly and legibly in the final image:
  - 오늘은 어디 찍으러 갈까요?
  - 사진 동호회 모집
  - 매월 첫째·셋째 토요일
  - 도시 거리·근교 풍경·인물 모델
  - 카톡 오픈채팅
  - 카메라 종류 무관
  - 후기 공유 회식 별도
- Additional Korean poster details should appear clearly where appropriate:
  - 2026 봄 출사 모집
  - 일시 2026.05.02 SAT 10:30
  - 집결 홍대입구역 3번 출구
  - 참가비 무료
  - 선착순 20명
  - 신청 마감 04.30
  - 문의 @photo_walk_kr
- Keep all Korean characters clean and fully rendered with no distortion, no cut-off strokes, and no misspellings.
- Preserve a poster-like editorial hierarchy with one dominant headline, one collage hero, event information blocks, QR/contact callout, sponsor strip, and small realistic print details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Recruitment poster for a board game / chess / go club, designed as an A4 vertical community flyer for café bulletin boards, school/community centers, Discord, and neighborhood sharing.
Poster should feel friendly, realistic, organized, and immediately readable, with a warm tabletop still-life hero, clear event details, ticket/signup information, and small community-poster details that make it feel like a real local club announcement.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the hero still-life in the upper 46% of the canvas, with the headline in the top 15%, the topic label overlapping the hero/table area, and practical event information stacked in the lower 39%.
- Use {동호회명} and {종목} as the main club/topic line, {헤드라인} as the large conversational title, and arrange all informational blocks on a tidy single-column poster grid.
- Background treatment: warm café wood tabletop with tactile grain, beige paper flyer texture, soft coffee-ring marks, tiny pencil score notes, sticker labels, and muted gold divider lines that reinforce the board-game café atmosphere.
- Include friendly decorative graphics such as tiny dice pips, chess knight silhouette, baduk stone dots, card-corner icons, washi-tape strips, and a small QR-style signup box; keep them integrated around the information hierarchy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: set {헤드라인} large and centered, using a friendly handwritten Korean style or rounded sans; add a small eyebrow label reading “동네 전략게임 모임 OPEN” above it.
2. Hero area: arrange {hero 이미지} as a realistic tabletop still life with board game cards, wooden meeples, dice, chess pieces, go stones, a folded rule sheet, score pencil, café receipt, and a half-visible cup sleeve on a warm surface.
3. Topic line: place “{동호회명} · {종목}” directly beneath the headline or on a small cream paper tag overlapping the hero area, using bold sans typography for clarity.
4. Main event details block: show {행사일시}, {장소}, {정기모임}, and {참가비} in stacked rounded info cards with small icons for calendar, pin, clock, and ticket.
5. Signup and ticket block: present {가입방법}, {신청마감}, {티켓안내}, and {문의} near the lower third, with a visible QR-style square, short CTA button, and a small “초보 환영 / 혼자 와도 OK” badge.
6. Sponsor/footer area: place {후원협력} as a modest sponsor strip at the bottom with text-only partner names, plus small page-poster details like “VOL. 04”, “2026 동호회 모집”, and a perforated tear-off style contact row.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for key information, Pretendard Medium for body details, and a hand-drawn Korean style for the headline; headline around 78–96px, details around 30–40px, footer/sponsor text around 20–26px.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with wood brown, muted gold, warm beige, charcoal, paper cream, and small red/orange accent stickers; use dark coffee text for high contrast.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under the hero objects; thin divider rules in muted gold or charcoal; paper tags may have subtle curled edges and tactile shadows.
- Poster realism: add believable print grain, slight paper fibers, tiny registration imperfections, taped-corner accents, and local-event formatting such as date, venue, fee, sponsor, QR signup, and contact line.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm lens, f/2.8, tabletop editorial framing with a slightly elevated front view, crisp object edges, and shallow depth of field only at the hero perimeter.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, with warm indoor café ambience and subtle specular highlights on game pieces.
- Color grade: warm beige, honey brown, muted gold, and charcoal with a soft filmic contrast, similar to a Kinfolk-style tabletop editorial.

[6. MOOD]
Premium neighborhood hobby recruitment poster — Kinfolk magazine tabletop spread feel with a calm café social-club atmosphere, inviting both beginners and experienced players to join an evening of strategy games.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구:
  - 보드게임 동호회 모집

  - {참가비}

  - {문의}
  - {후원협력}
  - 초보 환영 / 혼자 와도 OK
- Layout invariants: maintain an A4 vertical flyer composition at {비율}, with the tabletop still life as the main visual focus and all event, venue, price, signup, and sponsor information clearly legible.
- Add realistic poster details: “VOL. 04”, “2026 동호회 모집”, QR-style signup square, ticket/fee label, sponsor strip, and small decorative game icons, while preserving the friendly board game / chess / go club concept.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Distorted hands/faces in any small member-photo stickers if used
