[1. PURPOSE]
Korean marathon and running crew recruitment poster, A4 vertical social flyer for Instagram, community bulletin boards, and offline printing.
Designed to promote a local running crew with a strong recruitment headline, cinematic running hero image, schedule, first meetup details, joining method, participation fee, partner strip, and realistic event-poster information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header zone (18%): {헤드라인} set as the main typographic anchor, with {서브헤드라인} and a small label reading “러닝 크루 모집” nearby for instant context.
- Middle hero zone (40%): a cinematic {hero 이미지} scene spanning most of the width, layered with route-line graphics, pace dots, bib-number motifs, and small distance markers inspired by marathon signage.
- Info zone (28%): {정기 러닝}, {첫 모임}, {집결 장소}, {참가비}, and {준비물} arranged as a realistic poster information panel with icon labels, divider lines, and bold data highlights.
- Join and ticket zone (8%): {가입 방법}, {신청링크}, and {문의} displayed as a clear call-to-action area with a QR-code style square, “무료 체험 1회” badge, and ticket-style cutout detail.
- Brand and sponsor zone (bottom 6%): {크루명·코스}, {해시태그}, and {협찬·파트너} placed as a crew identity and partner strip, using {컬러 팔레트} for accents, separators, small running icons, and emphasis strokes.
- Background treatment: urban river-path atmosphere with morning or evening sky gradients, asphalt texture, faint lane markings, reflective river light, and real poster-print grain.
- Framing direction: vertical A4 poster composition with a strong top-to-bottom reading flow, clear typographic hierarchy, and a premium athletic-event flyer finish.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area: Render {헤드라인} in a bold Korean display style at the top, occupying the visual peak of the poster; place “러닝 크루 모집” as a compact recruitment label and {서브헤드라인} as a secondary motivational line.
2. Hero image area: Place {hero 이미지} as the dominant visual centerpiece, showing a 한강 러닝 vibe with dawn or dusk natural light, runner silhouettes, river reflections, and subtle motion blur on legs and shoes.
3. Event-detail band: Add realistic poster details including {첫 모임}, {집결 장소}, {모집 기간}, and a small “BEGINNER WELCOME / 5K · 10K · HALF” sports-label motif.
4. Schedule block: Present {정기 러닝} in a structured info panel with clearly separated lines for weekday, time, route distance, and training focus; include small icons for calendar, clock, map pin, and pace group.
5. Participation block: Place {참가비}, {준비물}, and {가입 방법} beneath the schedule using a ticket-stub style layout, with a “무료 체험 1회” badge and a QR-code style application box labeled {신청링크}.
6. Contact and social block: Add {문의} and {해시태그} in the lower information area so the poster feels like a real recruitment flyer ready to post online.
7. Crew identity and sponsor strip: Anchor {크루명·코스} near the bottom as the sign-off line, supported by {협찬·파트너}, small sponsor-logo placeholders, and a thin marathon route-map graphic.
8. Color accents and separators: Apply {컬러 팔레트} to pace dots, route arrows, mini badges, headline highlights, panel dividers, and small graphic elements so the poster feels active and energetic.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for section labels, and Pretendard Regular for details; headline size should feel like 58–80 px equivalent in a 1024x1536 poster.
- Color palette: Use neon yellow, white, black, and coral as the core palette from {컬러 팔레트}; support with muted graphite gray for secondary text, route maps, asphalt texture, and separator rules.
- Layout style: Sports-editorial event poster with a bold header, documentary hero photo, structured info cards, ticket-stub CTA, QR-style signup box, sponsor strip, and small marathon-inspired decorative graphics.
- Border/shadow: Add a subtle soft drop shadow around text panels, 0–4px y-offset, 10–14px blur, 12–18% opacity; use thin rule lines, cutout notches, sticker labels, and rounded info chips where appropriate.
- Graphic treatment: Crisp iconography, route-line overlays, pace markers, bib-number typography, faint asphalt grain, and print-poster texture while keeping every important Korean line readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Documentary sports photography look, 35mm full-frame perspective with an 85mm f/1.8 look for the hero silhouette, or a 24–70mm at 50mm equivalent for a wider running-path scene.
- Lighting: Dawn or sunset natural light with soft side illumination, slight rim light on runners, and atmospheric backlight from the river/path horizon.
- Color grade: High-contrast athletic editorial grade with bright neon yellow accents, clean whites, deep blacks, and coral highlights; slightly cool shadows with natural skin-tone neutrality.
- Material finish: Printed A4 flyer realism with subtle paper grain, ink density variation, photographic halation around backlit runners, and tactile event-poster layering.

[6. MOOD]
Community-driven running club recruitment — energetic Seoul river running culture, weekend marathon training, friendly beginner welcome, Nike Running / Strava event poster energy with a clean editorial sports-culture finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구:
  - {헤드라인}
  - {서브헤드라인}
  - 러닝 크루 모집
  - 크루 {크루명·코스}
  - 정기 러닝: {정기 러닝}
  - 첫 모임: {첫 모임}
  - 집결 장소: {집결 장소}
  - 모집 기간: {모집 기간}
  - 참가비: {참가비}
  - 준비물: {준비물}
  - 가입 방법: {가입 방법}
  - 신청: {신청링크}
  - 문의: {문의}
  - {해시태그}
  - 협찬·파트너: {협찬·파트너}
- Composition invariant: Maintain a vertical A4 recruitment-poster layout with a strong headline, a dominant hero running scene, clear event details, a join CTA, and a bottom crew/sponsor strip.
- Text legibility: All Korean text must be cleanly rendered with no broken characters, no garbling, and no fake English-Korean substitutions.
- Realism detail: Include believable poster micro-elements such as route arrows, pace dots, calendar/clock/map-pin icons, QR-style signup box, ticket-stub badge, sponsor strip, and printed flyer texture.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites unless explicitly requested
- Distorted or anatomically incorrect runners

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean hiking and trekking club recruitment poster, vertical A4-style layout for community bulletin, social share, and print notice.
Create a realistic outdoor club invitation poster with a strong mountain hero image, practical event details, recruitment period, orientation notice, participation fee, preparation checklist, sponsor strip, and clear join method.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered vertical poster composition with the hero image occupying the upper 40–46% of the frame, headline / club identity band layered over or directly below the image, and detailed recruitment information arranged in stacked blocks through the lower half.
- Background: warm off-white paper texture with subtle fiber grain, natural ink absorption, tiny speckles, and slight paper shadowing around printed information blocks.
- Use a realistic community-poster hierarchy: large club name and slogan, then a date / place / fee information card, then join CTA and contact details.
- Include outdoor decorative graphics that naturally fit the theme: small contour-map lines, a trail marker icon, boot-print dots, tiny compass mark, simple mountain ridge divider, and amber label stickers.
- Use {클럽명}, {주요코스}, {헤드라인}, {시즌라벨}, {hero 이미지}, {정기산행}, {모집기간}, {오리엔테이션}, {집결장소}, {참가비}, {준비물}, {가입방법}, {문의처}, {협찬문구}, {컬러팔레트} as editable placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (top 40–46%): {hero 이미지} presented as the main visual, either a summit group selfie, ridge landscape at golden hour, or hiking gear still-life beside a trail sign; integrate a small caption label such as “이번 달 추천 코스 · {주요코스}”.
- Title band: {클럽명} placed as the primary club name line with a small badge reading {시즌라벨}; {헤드라인} directly beneath it in compact poster headline styling, visually dominant and easy to read from distance.
- Route / club identity line: {주요코스} shown as a secondary line with map-pin or trail icons, like a real hiking bulletin poster.
- Main information card: stack {정기산행}, {모집기간}, {오리엔테이션}, {집결장소}, and {참가비} in clearly separated rows with small icons for calendar, clock, location, and ticket / fee.
- Preparation strip: {준비물} displayed as short checklist chips with small outdoor gear icons such as water bottle, windbreaker, trekking shoes, headlamp, and lunch box.
- Join CTA block: {가입방법} placed near the lower third or bottom as the strongest call-to-action, with a visible QR-code placeholder box, chat bubble icon, and a short instruction line.
- Footer sponsor / contact area: include {문의처} and {협찬문구} in a small sponsor strip, plus a realistic page note such as “게시 승인: 커뮤니티 게시판 / 2026.05”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold for {클럽명}, Pretendard Bold for the main headline, Pretendard Regular / Medium for body copy, and a restrained Noto Sans KR style for schedule details; all Korean text must be crisp and print-legible.
- Color palette: use {컬러팔레트} with natural forest green, warm beige, amber, stone gray, and charcoal; use amber for badges and CTA emphasis, charcoal for primary text, and forest green for section dividers / icons.
- Border/shadow: soft realistic paper-card shadows, 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use thin mountain-ridge dividers, route-line graphics, and small label stickers instead of heavy frames.
- Layout should feel like a real local club recruitment poster, with enough specific date, venue, fee, contact, and orientation information to be believable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary outdoor look, 35mm or 50mm lens, f/5.6 for landscape clarity or f/2.8 for gear still-life separation, natural perspective without distortion.
- Lighting: overcast diffused daylight or late-afternoon mountain light from upper-left, with gentle fill from ambient sky and subtle contrast on rock textures, backpack fabric, paper grain, and trail signs.
- Color grade: earthy green, beige, amber, and charcoal with slightly restrained saturation, similar to premium outdoor magazine editorial pages and printed community posters.
- Print realism: slight ink texture on Korean typography, subtle poster-paper fibers, realistic QR placeholder, small icon labels, and clear separation between hero photo and information blocks.

[6. MOOD]
Premium outdoor community editorial — practical, warm, trustworthy, and inviting, like a well-designed neighborhood trekking club poster with real schedule details and a friendly weekend hiking atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- The following Korean strings must appear correctly and clearly in the rendered image: “산과길 트레킹 클럽”, “매달 한 산, 새로운 풍경.”, “신입 회원 모집”.
- The following event information must be legible: “매월 둘째 토요일 / 난이도별 분반 / 도시락·교통편 자율”, “모집기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “오리엔테이션 6월 6일 금요일 19:30”, “집결장소 시청역 3번 출구”.
- The CTA and practical details must be legible: “참가비 첫 산행 무료 · 이후 1회 15,000원”, “카톡 오픈채팅 / 첫 산행 무료”, “문의 010-1234-5678”.
- The composition must remain vertical and poster-like, with a single dominant hero image, realistic hiking-event information blocks, a QR-code placeholder, and sponsor / contact footer.
- All Korean typography must be crisp, legible, and free of broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or real-person impersonation

[INPUT]

- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Recruitment poster for a bicycle riding club, designed as a vertical A4-style sports flyer for local community signup, club bulletin boards, bike-shop display, and social media sharing.
Korean bicycle club recruitment poster with energetic hierarchy, realistic outdoor riding atmosphere, and practical event/signup information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center hero zone takes about 55–58% of the frame vertically, with {히어로 이미지} as the main visual, showing real riding context such as road markings, riverside railings, mountain trail dust, helmets, water bottles, cycling jerseys, and sunlight on bike frames.
- Top header band occupies about 18% of the canvas, with {메인 헤드라인} set large and bold for instant recognition, supported by {서브 카피} as a smaller motivational line.
- Use {클럽명} and {종목} as the main club identifier near the top or upper-mid area, styled like a sports team badge, route label, or jersey patch.
- Lower information block is structured like an event poster, clearly presenting {정기 라이딩}, {모집 기간}, {집결 장소}, {참가비}, {가입 방법}, and {문의 연락처} in stacked cards or strips.
- Include a realistic sponsor/support area at the bottom with {스폰서 표기}, small partner-name slots, QR-style signup box, and ticket/membership-style information.
- Background should feel like a sporty outdoor poster: deep charcoal base with bright accent bars, speed-line overlays, route-map fragments, elevation graph motifs, tire-track texture, and {장식 그래픽}.
- Use an active edge-to-edge vertical rhythm with layered panels, diagonal energy, and readable information blocks suitable for both print and mobile viewing.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): set {메인 헤드라인} in oversized bold Korean type, with {서브 카피} below it in a compact English/Korean supporting line style; add a small label such as “NEW CREW 2026” or “WEEKEND RIDE TEAM”.
2. Club identity block: place “클럽 {클럽명} · {종목}” under the headline or slightly overlapping the hero edge, using a compact badge, jersey-number tag, or route-sticker treatment for club recognition.
3. Hero image block (middle 55–58%): show {히어로 이미지} as the dominant visual with multiple riders, plausible bicycles, helmets, gloves, lights, hydration bottles, route signs, asphalt texture, greenery, and motion blur accents that make the recruitment poster feel lived-in and real.
4. Event information strip: present “정기 라이딩: {정기 라이딩}”, “모집 기간: {모집 기간}”, and “집결 장소: {집결 장소}” in a structured info band with icon-like separators, small route arrows, and distance/time chips.
5. Membership / ticket block: display “참가비: {참가비}” as a ticket-style tag or membership pass, with a small note area for first-ride guidance and safety gear reminders.
6. Signup block: display “가입 방법: {가입 방법}” and “문의: {문의 연락처}” in a strong callout area near the lower portion, including a QR-style square, Kakao open-chat style label, and clear call-to-action button.
7. Sponsor / footer area: add {스폰서 표기}, small partner logo placeholders, address-like microtext, page-safe footer details, and accent rules using {컬러 팔레트} so the poster feels like a real local cycling-club recruitment flyer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard Bold for body details, and Noto Sans KR SemiBold for secondary labels; headline size should feel oversized like a sports campaign poster, with tight line spacing and strong weight contrast.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with vivid red and yellow accents, charcoal black for the base, and green as a supportive highlight; include off-white text panels, colored stickers, and high-contrast badges where needed for readability.
- Layout detail: combine diagonal speed bars, map-grid overlays, elevation profile lines, small numbered info chips, route arrows, and tire-track textures so the poster contains realistic cycling culture cues.
- Border/shadow: use thin rectangular rules, bold section dividers, sticker-like outlines, and a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for layered info cards.
- Text hierarchy: top headline must be readable first, club identity second, hero action third, and signup/event details fourth; keep all Korean information crisp and typographically consistent.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 24mm wide-angle sports poster look, as if shot on a Canon EOS R5 with RF 24mm f/1.8 at f/5.6 for deep scene clarity.
- Lighting: bright outdoor daylight with crisp directional sun from upper-left, mild rim light on helmets and bike frames, and controlled shadows for a high-energy action feel.
- Color grade: saturated sports-poster grade with strong red/yellow accents, deep charcoal contrast, natural green outdoor tones, realistic asphalt/forest texture, and punchy highlight separation.
- Rendering: realistic riders and bikes integrated with graphic poster overlays, not a plain studio composite; include convincing contact shadows, wheel perspective, jersey fabric texture, handlebar details, tire tread, and reflective helmet highlights.

[6. MOOD]
Energetic outdoor community recruitment poster with a bold Korean sports-club flyer rhythm, weekend adventure mood, friendly local-crew authenticity, and the excitement of joining a real group ride.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as written for the poster content: “자전거 라이딩 클럽 모집”, “{메인 헤드라인}”, “{서브 카피}”, “클럽 {클럽명} · {종목}”.
- Event details must appear clearly: “정기 라이딩: {정기 라이딩}”, “모집 기간: {모집 기간}”, “집결 장소: {집결 장소}”, “참가비: {참가비}”.
- Signup and footer text must appear clearly: “가입 방법: {가입 방법}”, “문의: {문의 연락처}”, “협찬: {스폰서 표기}”.
- Maintain a vertical A4 recruitment-poster composition with one dominant hero image, clear hierarchy, realistic decorative cycling graphics, and readable information blocks.
- Keep all bicycle riders anatomically correct, bikes mechanically plausible, wheel geometry circular, helmets properly fitted, and group spacing consistent.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity face composites or unauthorized public-figure likenesses
- Misleading government, police, or federation endorsement marks

studio:prompts3:ours-954.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
사회인 테니스 동호회 모집 포스터. A4 세로형 1024x1536 비율의 매거진 톤 모집 공고로, 실제 동호회 홍보물처럼 클럽 정체성, 코트 감성, 일정·장소·비용·문의 정보를 한 장에 명확하게 담는다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 구성은 상단 클럽명·로고와 시즌 라벨, 중앙 hero 이미지, 하단 모집 안내/일정/가입 CTA 순서로 세로 흐름을 만든다.
- hero 영역이 프레임의 약 45~52%를 차지하고, 실제 테니스 코트의 라인, 라켓 스트링, 공의 펠트 질감, 코트 바닥의 미세한 먼지와 스크래치가 자연스럽게 보이도록 한다.
- 배경은 오프화이트 종이 질감 또는 클레이/하드 코트 바닥을 연상시키는 매트한 표면으로 처리하고, {컬러팔레트}를 중심으로 스포츠 클럽 포스터다운 생동감을 만든다.
- 상단에는 클럽 워드마크, 작은 시즌 배지, 모집 카피를 배치하고, 중하단에는 정보 카드, 일정 박스, 문의 CTA, 스폰서/파트너 라인을 함께 구성한다.
- 주요 텍스트는 {클럽명}, {헤드라인}, {모집안내}, {일시}, {장소}, {참가비}, {가입방법}, {문의}, {스폰서}, {드레스코드}를 사용해 실제 인쇄 포스터처럼 읽히게 배치한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone (약 14%): {클럽명}을 상단 중앙 또는 좌상단에 워드마크처럼 배치한다. 주변에 작은 테니스공 아이콘, 얇은 코트 라인 그래픽, “2026 SPRING MEMBER RECRUIT” 같은 시즌 라벨을 넣어 클럽 포스터의 현실감을 더한다.
2) Headline zone (약 10~12%): {헤드라인}을 큰 한글 타이틀로 배치한다. 바로 아래에 “사회인 테니스 모집”을 서브 타이틀로 넣고, 자간을 약간 넓힌 굵은 산세리프 계열로 모집 메시지를 선명하게 만든다.
3) Hero zone (약 45~52%): {히어로이미지}를 중앙 메인 비주얼로 크게 배치한다. 라켓 1~2개, 테니스공 2~3개, 코트 라인 일부, 작은 수건이나 물병 같은 자연스러운 스포츠 소품을 함께 두어 실제 모임 현장감을 만든다. 라켓 스트링의 격자, 공의 펠트, 클레이 가루나 하드코트 표면의 마모 흔적을 선명하게 표현한다.
4) Information block (약 16~18%): {모집안내}를 3~5개의 항목형 문장으로 정리한다. “레벨”, “요일”, “운영”, “회비” 같은 라벨을 작은 캡슐형 태그로 나누고, {일시}, {장소}, {참가비}를 별도 박스에 배치해 한눈에 들어오게 한다.
5) Join / CTA block (약 8~10%): {가입방법}과 {문의}를 하단 CTA처럼 배치한다. 카카오톡/홈페이지/QR 안내를 연상시키는 작은 사각 코드 그래픽, 화살표, 밑줄 강조를 넣고 “첫 1회 무료 체험” 문구가 잘 보이도록 한다.
6) Sponsor & detail strip (약 4~6%): 하단 가장자리에는 {스폰서}, {드레스코드}, 작은 페이지 풋터 “Poster No. 04 / Tennis Life Club”을 넣어 실제 행사 포스터처럼 완성도를 높인다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard 또는 Noto Sans KR 중심, 헤드라인은 Bold 700~800, 본문은 Medium 500~600. 제목은 44~64px 느낌, 정보 라벨은 18~22px, 본문은 22~30px 느낌으로 계층을 분명히 한다.
- Color palette: {컬러팔레트}를 기준으로 클레이 오렌지 #C86B3C, 화이트 #F7F4EE, 그린 #2F5D50, 차콜 #2B2B2B, 테니스볼 라임 #CFE85E를 포인트로 사용한다.
- Layout graphics: 얇은 코트 라인, 작은 원형 배지, 점수판을 연상시키는 숫자 태그, 티켓 형태의 CTA 박스, 스폰서 스트립을 사용해 실제 모집 포스터의 정보를 풍부하게 만든다.
- Border/shadow: 아주 옅은 드롭 섀도우(4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12~15% opacity)로 인쇄물 같은 깊이를 주고, 필요 시 얇은 선 1~2px로 정보 박스 경계를 만든다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.8 product/editorial look 또는 50mm f/2.8 close-up still life, 세로 포스터에 맞는 압축감과 선명한 디테일.
- Lighting: soft studio light from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from right, 약한 rim light로 라켓/공 가장자리를 살리고 그림자는 부드럽게 떨어지게 한다.
- Color grade: clay orange, muted green, warm white, charcoal, tennis-ball lime의 편집 톤. 채도는 낮추되 오렌지와 그린의 대비는 선명하게 유지한다.
- Texture: 종이 인쇄 질감, 코트 바닥의 미세한 입자, 라켓 그립의 패브릭 텍스처, 공의 보송한 펠트가 자연스럽게 보이도록 한다.

[6. MOOD]
Kinfolk 매거진의 라이프스타일 편집 페이지와 실제 스포츠 클럽 모집 포스터가 결합된 분위기. 차분하지만 활동적이고, 퇴근 후 함께 운동하러 가고 싶은 따뜻한 커뮤니티 감성을 전달한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “사회인 테니스 모집”, “오늘부터 테니스, 시작해요.”, “한강 테니스 클럽”, “초·중·고급 레벨별 / 매주 수·금·토 / 코트 임대 포함 / 월 8만”, “2026년 5월 15일 금요일 오후 7시 30분”, “잠실 한강공원 테니스장 3번 코트”, “월 회비 80,000원 / 첫 1회 무료 체험”, “홈페이지 또는 카톡 채널로 신청”, “문의 @hangangtennis / 010-1234-5678”.
- 한글 깨짐 없이 선명하게 렌더링하고, 숫자·요일·가격·연락처의 자릿수와 구분 기호가 읽히게 한다.
- 테니스 라켓, 공, 코트 라인, 그립, 스트링의 형태는 실제 물성과 비율을 유지해야 한다.
- 실제 인물의 손이나 얼굴이 포함될 경우 손가락 수, 얼굴 비율, 관절 방향이 자연스러워야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or misleading celebrity likeness
- Severely distorted hands, faces, tennis rackets, or unreadable contact text

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean badminton and table tennis club recruitment poster, A4 vertical flyer for community noticeboards, sports center bulletin boards, apartment elevators, and social sharing.
Approachable local club promo design with a bright hero image, realistic event details, membership information, sponsor/footer area, and friendly call-to-action hierarchy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster layout: top headline band about 16% of the frame, central hero image block 44–46%, information and schedule section about 24%, bottom CTA and sponsor band about 10%.
- Subject placement: {모임명} and {종목·동호회} identify the club at the top, while {hero 이미지} dominates the center with lively racket-sport motion.
- Background treatment: white sports-center bulletin paper base with faint badminton court lines, table-tennis table edge graphics, shuttlecock feather marks, ping-pong ball trail dots, and small sticker-like accent shapes in green, yellow, and teal.
- Poster realism: include a small recruitment label, date/time/venue icons, price/fee row, QR-code placeholder box, phone/contact microcopy, and a low footer area for partner or sponsor names.
- Place {헤드라인}, {서브헤드라인}, {모집 일정}, {장소}, {참가비}, {준비물}, {가입 방법}, and {문의 연락처} as clearly separated text areas with strong visual hierarchy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 16%): set {헤드라인} in a soft but confident Korean display style, centered, with {서브헤드라인} below it and a short green-yellow accent stroke or racket-string divider.
2. Club identity strip: place {모임명} and {종목·동호회} as compact badges near the top-left or just under the headline, such as “동호회 모집”, “초보 환영”, “라켓 대여 가능”.
3. Main hero area (mid 44–46%): feature {hero 이미지} as the visual anchor, either a lively shuttlecock-and-racket still life, a table-tennis paddle with ball bounce motion, or two casual players mid-rally on an indoor court, with natural sports-center floor texture and motion streak accents.
4. Information block (lower mid 24%): arrange {모집 일정}, {장소}, {참가비}, and {준비물} in stacked rows with small icons, dividers, and highlight chips so date, location, fee, and preparation details read quickly.
5. CTA block (bottom 10%): place {가입 방법} as the largest bottom callout, add {문의 연락처}, a QR-code placeholder labeled “오픈채팅 바로가기”, {SNS태그}, and a small sponsor/partner line {후원·협력}.
6. Decorative poster details: add small corner labels such as “OPEN MEMBER”, “1회 체험 무료”, “초보·복식 파트너 환영”, plus subtle diagonal court-line graphics and ball/shuttle trail dots around the hero.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold for headlines, Noto Sans KR Medium for details, and Pretendard Regular for supporting lines; headline size should feel bold enough for A4 print, with detail text around 30–40% smaller.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with clear sports-poster contrast; use green #2E7D32, yellow #F6C445, teal #1FA6A0, white #FFFFFF, charcoal #263238, and small warm gray paper shadows.
- Graphic system: rounded rectangle info cards, small circular icons for calendar/location/fee/contact, racket-string divider patterns, shuttlecock feather texture, ping-pong ball dotted trails, and energetic slanted accent labels.
- Border/shadow: add a soft drop shadow under the hero element, about 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 15% opacity; use thin divider rules in charcoal and teal for structure.
- Print realism: make the poster look like a polished local club flyer ready for printing, with believable paper texture, ink-friendly saturation, and legible Korean text at A4 scale.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial sports poster look, shot like a 50mm lens at f/2.8 for a slightly compressed but energetic composition, or a top-down 35mm product-style framing if using shuttlecock and racket still life.
- Lighting: bright studio daylight with softbox key light from upper-left at about 45°, subtle fill from right, and controlled highlights on racket strings, paddle rubber, shuttlecock feathers, and glossy ping-pong ball surface.
- Color grade: bright white base with saturated green, yellow, and teal accents; crisp contrast, realistic indoor gym highlights, polished print-friendly saturation, and slight paper grain.

[6. MOOD]
Energetic community sports flyer with practical Japanese club-poster organization, friendly Korean neighborhood noticeboard warmth, and lively racket-sport movement that makes beginners feel welcome.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어갈 문자열 — “{헤드라인}”, “{서브헤드라인}”, “{모임명}”, “{종목·동호회}”, “{모집 일정}”, “{장소}”, “{참가비}”, “{준비물}”, “{가입 방법}”, “{문의 연락처}”, “{후원·협력}”, “{SNS태그}”.
- Add realistic poster microcopy in Korean: “동호회 모집”, “초보 환영”, “1회 체험 무료”, “라켓 대여 가능”, “오픈채팅 바로가기”, “복식 파트너 환영”.
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and properly rendered; no broken syllables, no spacing errors, no mixed-language corruption.
- Composition invariant: vertical A4 flyer feel with a clear top headline, centered hero, information block below, and CTA/sponsor area at the bottom.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites without permission

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
사회인 농구 동호회 모집 포스터 for print-like vertical recruitment use, with a strong sports poster hierarchy and social-share readability.
Designed to feel like a competitive club recruitment sheet for adult amateur players.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster layout: vertical A4-style composition, hero action zone occupying the upper 52% of the frame, text stack occupying the lower 48% with clear hierarchy.
- Main subject area: {hero 이미지} placed as the central visual anchor, cropped bold and dynamic so the court energy reads immediately at thumbnail size.
- Team identity area: {팀명·로고} positioned near the top-left or top-center, sized like a club header rather than a tiny label.
- Headline band: {헤드라인} placed across the mid-to-upper area, overlapping the hero slightly for a modern sports-poster look.
- Info block: {모집 안내} arranged in a compact lower section with distinct line breaks and generous tracking for legibility.
- Contact block: {가입 방법} placed at the bottom as a clear action area, separated from the main body with a line or subtle panel.
- Background treatment: deep court-inspired dark base with orange accent glow, subtle parquet texture, clean poster grid, and controlled negative space around the typography.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top identity strip — Set {팀명·로고} in a strong club-badge style header, aligned to the upper area with compact spacing, white or gold text on a dark field, with thin separator lines for structure.
2. Hero image block — Place {hero 이미지} as the dominant visual element in the upper half, with crisp sports-photo contrast, energetic diagonal motion, and enough empty edge space to prevent text collision.
3. Headline emphasis — Render {헤드라인} as the most eye-catching typography layer, using oversized bold Korean text with one English accent if present, slightly angled or stacked for game-day intensity.
4. Recruitment details block — Present {모집 안내} as a neat information panel in the lower-middle area, using bullet-like line breaks, small icons only if minimal, and strong spacing between each condition.
5. Contact / join block — Place {가입 방법} near the bottom on a dark or orange-accented strip, making the call-to-action clearly separate and easy to scan.
6. Footer discipline — Keep the bottom margin clean, with a subtle court-line motif or thin rule to close the layout without clutter.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for body info, with occasional condensed sports-poster styling; headline size should feel roughly 68–96 px relative scale, body 24–34 px, footer 20–26 px.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} translated into specific tones — vivid basketball orange #F36B21, deep black #101010, clean white #F7F7F4, muted gold #C9A24A; use orange for energy accents and gold sparingly for premium highlights.
- Border/shadow: subtle 1.5px rule lines in warm white, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity behind key text blocks; avoid heavy glow.
- Texture: faint indoor court floor grain, matte poster paper feel, slightly distressed but clean edges for a real recruitment flyer aesthetic.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm sports documentary look, equivalent to a Canon EOS R5 with 35mm f/1.4 for the overall poster photo treatment; if using a dunk silhouette, keep it crisp and graphic rather than blurry.
- Lighting: high-contrast gym lighting with overhead arena lights, slight side rim from upper-right, controlled shadow falloff, no flat studio wash.
- Color grade: orange-black-white court palette with warm highlights, neutral skin-free sports tone, slightly cinematic contrast and deep blacks.

[6. MOOD]
Competitive amateur-league sports poster — Nike basketball recruitment campaign meets a KBL event flyer energy, with a disciplined and energetic club identity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함:
  - 사회인 농구 모집
  - {팀명·로고}
  - {헤드라인}
  - {모집 안내}
  - {가입 방법}
- If any human silhouettes appear, anatomy must be correct and athletic, with natural basketball poses and realistic proportions.
- Keep the composition exactly poster-like: hero image above, information blocks below, no random extra copy.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Extra event details not provided in the source
- Overly polished AI-smooth skin or plastic basketball textures
- Sexualized sportswear or body emphasis
- Distorted hands, faces, rims, or basketball anatomy

studio:prompts3:ours-951.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- ratio: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
사회인 풋살·조기축구 모집 포스터, A4 세로형 인쇄/게시용 홍보 디자인.
야간 풋살장 조명, 실제 동호회 게시판 감성, 경기 일정표와 참여 정보가 함께 보이는 현실적인 커뮤니티 모집 포스터.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 상단 18%: {팀명·로고}를 클럽 엠블럼처럼 배치하고, 바로 아래에 {헤드라인}을 크게 둔다. 주변에 작은 라벨 텍스트로 “2026 SPRING MEMBER RECRUIT”, “LOCAL FUTSAL CLUB”, “VOL.07”을 넣어 실제 포스터 인쇄물처럼 보이게 한다.
- 중앙 50%: {hero 이미지}를 메인 비주얼로 크게 구성하되, 야간 풋살 코트에서 공을 컨트롤하는 인물 실루엣, 잔디 질감, 코트 라인, 플러드라이트, 골대 일부가 함께 보이도록 한다. 배경에는 땀, 먼지, 잔디 알갱이, 라이트 플레어가 자연스럽게 들어간다.
- 하단 32%: {모집 안내}와 {가입 방법}을 읽기 쉽게 구획해 배치하고, 연락/참여 정보는 한눈에 보이도록 카드형 영역으로 정렬한다. 작은 지도 핀, 달력, 시계, 축구공 아이콘을 곁들인다.
- 하단 정보 영역에는 현실적인 세부 요소를 추가한다: “모집 기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “장소: 동네 풋살파크 A코트”, “준비물: 풋살화·개인 음료”, “문의: @sunday_futsal”, “참가비: 첫 참여 무료”.
- 맨 아래에는 협력/후원 영역처럼 “협력: 지역 스포츠샵 · 동네 카페 · 풋살파크”를 작게 넣고, QR 코드처럼 보이는 오픈채팅 안내 박스와 짧은 주의 문구 “우천 시 공지방 안내”를 포함한다.
- 전체 배경은 잔디 그린과 야간 그라데이션이 섞인 스포츠 포스터 느낌으로, 가장자리에는 조명 번짐과 코트 펜스 실루엣이 보이는 구조를 사용한다.
- {컬러 팔레트}를 기반으로 강조 색은 헤드라인, CTA, 구분선, 일정 라벨, 작은 스티커형 배지에 사용한다.
- 세로 A4 비율을 유지하며 상→중→하 정보 흐름이 명확하도록 구성하고, 실제 동네 체육관 게시판에 붙어 있을 법한 밀도 있는 정보 디자인으로 완성한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone: {팀명·로고}를 상단 중앙에 배치하고, 로고가 없을 경우 방패형 텍스트 엠블럼처럼 강한 대비의 타이포로 처리한다. 엠블럼 주변에 작은 별, 풋살공 라인 그래픽, “SINCE 2024”, “SUNDAY CREW” 같은 보조 텍스트를 넣어 클럽 정체성을 강화한다.
2) Main headline zone: {헤드라인}을 굵은 산세리프 한글로 크게 넣어 포스터의 첫 인상을 만든다. 문장은 1줄 또는 2줄로 나누되, 핵심 문구가 가장 먼저 읽히게 한다. 헤드라인 옆에는 빨간 스티커형 배지로 “신입 모집”, “첫 참여 무료”를 배치한다.
3) Hero visual zone: {hero 이미지}를 중앙 대형 비주얼로 넣고, 풋살 코트 라인·조명·공·실루엣·골대·철망 펜스 중 최소 4개 요소가 함께 보이도록 구성한다. 공은 중앙 하단 쪽에 크게 보이게 하여 시선을 끌고, 선수의 움직임에는 약한 모션 블러와 림라이트를 적용한다.
4) Match detail strip: 중앙 이미지 하단을 가로지르는 얇은 경기 정보 바를 추가한다. Korean text examples: “SUN 07:00 / 19:00”, “초보 환영”, “남녀 누구나”, “친선 경기 중심”, “매너 플레이 필수”.
5) Info block zone: {모집 안내}를 아이콘 또는 짧은 항목형 텍스트로 정리해 가독성을 높인다. 예: 경력 무관, 요일/시간, 회비, 유니폼 정보가 분리되어 보여야 한다. 각 항목은 작은 라벨 박스와 숫자 마커 “01, 02, 03, 04”로 정리한다.
6) Join block zone: {가입 방법}은 CTA처럼 강조하고, 오픈채팅/DM/첫 참여 무료 같은 행동 유도 문구가 즉시 읽히도록 하단 또는 우측 하단에 고정한다. CTA 영역에는 QR 자리, 카카오톡 말풍선 아이콘 스타일, 인스타그램 DM 라벨, “지금 신청하기” 버튼형 그래픽을 넣는다.
7) Event and venue details: 실제 포스터처럼 날짜·시간·장소·문의 정보를 보강한다. Render Korean details such as “모집 기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “장소 동네 풋살파크 A코트”, “문의 @sunday_futsal”, “참가비 첫 참여 무료”, “정원 24명 선착순”.
8) Sponsor footer: 하단 가장 아래에 작은 sponsor strip을 넣는다. Render Korean text: “협력: 지역 스포츠샵 · 동네 카페 · 풋살파크”, “게시 문의 010-0000-0000”, “우천 시 공지방 안내”. 실제 로고처럼 단순 워드마크와 작은 박스들을 배치한다.
9) Palette application: {컬러 팔레트}의 녹색은 배경 잔디/포인트, 화이트는 텍스트 박스, 빨강은 핵심 강조와 CTA, 차콜은 본문 가독성에 사용한다.
10) Final balance: 상단은 브랜딩, 중앙은 액션 이미지, 하단은 실용 정보와 참여 CTA로 구성해 실제 모집 공고처럼 신뢰감 있게 마무리한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for headline, Pretendard SemiBold for info text, Noto Sans KR Medium for details; 헤드라인은 56–72px급, 본문은 22–30px급, 보조 라벨은 14–18px급으로 계층을 분명히 한다.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} 기반으로 forest green #2F6B3C, grass green #4B8B4A, white #F7F7F2, accent red #D93B3B, charcoal #2B2B2B를 조합한다.
- Border/shadow: 정보 박스는 1.5px solid white or light gray 라인, 헤드라인은 매우 약한 drop shadow 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 18% opacity로 선명도를 높인다. CTA 버튼은 accent red fill과 white type으로 즉시 보이게 한다.
- Layout treatment: 굵은 구획선, 직사각형 카드형 정보 영역, 경기 일정표 스타일의 얇은 스트립, 작은 배지와 스티커 라벨을 사용해 스포츠 클럽 모집 포스터 특유의 실용적 인상을 유지한다.
- Realistic print details: 아주 약한 종이 질감, 접힌 자국처럼 보이는 미세한 세로/가로 라인, 인쇄 잉크의 살짝 거친 가장자리, 야외 게시판 포스터 같은 현실감을 더한다.
- Decorative sports elements: 작은 축구공 패턴, 코트 라인 다이어그램, 유니폼 등번호 “7”, 호루라기 아이콘, 스코어보드 느낌의 숫자 블록을 배경과 정보 영역에 자연스럽게 배치한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm wide-angle documentary look, slightly low-angle composition with f/2.8 depth separation for the hero area.
- Lighting: night stadium floodlights from upper-left and upper-right, strong edge highlights on silhouettes, subtle ambient fill from the field for readability. Add visible light haze, turf reflections, and small lens flares around the floodlights.
- Color grade: deep green + white + signal red with charcoal shadows, slightly high contrast, crisp sports-poster finish.
- Image realism: the hero area should feel like an actual amateur futsal night match photo, with synthetic turf texture, worn white court markings, chain-link fence hints, goal net fragments, scuffed ball surface, and believable human movement.

[6. MOOD]
Community sports recruitment poster — local futsal club flyer meets modern amateur league announcement, like a polished club bulletin with stadium-night energy, friendly weekend-team atmosphere, and practical sign-up information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함.
  - "매주 일요일, 그라운드에서 만나요."
  - "경력 무관 / 매주 일요일 07:00·19:00 / 회비 3만 / 유니폼 무상 지급"
  - "카톡 오픈채팅 또는 인스타 DM / 첫 참여 무료"
  - "사회인 풋살 모집"
- Additional Korean text that may appear clearly in the poster:
  - "모집 기간 2026.05.01–05.31"
  - "장소: 동네 풋살파크 A코트"
  - "정원 24명 선착순"
  - "문의 @sunday_futsal"
  - "협력: 지역 스포츠샵 · 동네 카페 · 풋살파크"
  - "우천 시 공지방 안내"
- Layout invariants: 상단 팀명/로고, 중앙 hero, 하단 모집 안내/가입 방법의 3단 구성 유지.
- Typography must remain clean and highly legible in Korean.
- Keep all essential recruitment information visible as if this is a real poster someone could photograph on a gym bulletin board.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

사회인 야구팀·아마추어 리그 모집용 세로형 스포츠 포스터 광고.

[장면]
1024x1536 세로 A4 포스터로, 어두운 야구장 잔디와 경기장 조명을 연상시키는 배경 위에 중앙 정렬 흐름을 만든다. 상단에는 {팀명·로고}를 간결하고 선명하게 배치하고, 바로 아래에 {헤드라인}을 크게 넣어 강한 모집 메시지를 전달한다. 중앙에는 {hero 이미지}를 프레임의 핵심 비주얼로 크게 배치해 야구 선수의 스윙 실루엣, 배트, 공, 글러브, 지면 질감을 함께 보여준다. 하단에는 {모집 안내}와 {가입 방법}을 얇은 구분선과 박스형 영역으로 정리해 일정, 장소, 회비, 연락 방법이 한눈에 읽히게 한다.

[스타일]

[텍스트]

studio:prompts3:ours-949.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- format: B5 vertical Korean coloring book cover + inside-preview product layout

[1. PURPOSE]
Design a Korean coloring book cover and inside-preview promo layout, suitable for bookstore thumbnail, online shop listing, and social media product image.
Create a title-led product composition with a realistic book cover mockup, sample inner-page panels, pricing and publication details, and tactile stationery elements that make the coloring book feel purchasable and giftable.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the book cover as the main hero, occupying about 55% of the frame height, with {도서명} and {서브카피} placed in the upper title area of the cover.
- Use {컬러링북_종류} as the core concept cue, with {표지_일러스트} on the cover and {내지_샘플} displayed as inside-page preview tiles below.
- Add a visible book spine strip along the left edge of the cover mockup, including {출판사명}, {저자명}, and a small volume/date mark {출간월}.
- Arrange 4 inside-preview panels in the lower half with page captions, tiny page numbers, and a page indicator so the viewer can understand the book structure at a glance.
- Include realistic product details: {가격}, {권장연령}, {페이지수}, {부록정보}, {ISBN표기}, a barcode block, and a small promotional tag reading {판매문구}.
- Surround the layout with natural stationery context such as colored pencils, a paper swatch, a small eraser, washi tape strips, page tabs, and soft paper texture, all coordinated with {컬러_팔레트}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero title zone (top 20%): Set {도서명} as the largest Korean title, with {서브카피} directly below in a warm editorial subtitle style; include a small label for {컬러링북_종류} near the title.
- Main cover zone (middle 40%): Present {표지_일러스트} as the central cover artwork; show the book as a slightly raised printed mockup with visible cover thickness, subtle paper grain, and a spine credit strip containing {출판사명} · {저자명} · {출간월}.
- Cover metadata: Place {권장연령}, {페이지수}, and {부록정보} as small rounded info chips on the cover or adjacent belly-band area; add {가격} and {ISBN표기} near the bottom-right with a realistic barcode graphic.
- Preview zone (lower middle 25%): Arrange {내지_샘플} as 4 preview tiles in a tidy 2x2 grid, each tile framed like a real coloring page preview with captions such as “01 동물 도안”, “02 꽃과 정원”, “03 풍경 산책”, “04 보너스 패턴”.
- Information zone (bottom 15%): Add a compact product copy block with {포함_내용}, {해시태그}, and {판매문구}; include micro icons for preview, guide, pencil, and gift wrap to make the selling points scannable.
- Palette application: Use {컬러_팔레트} across title accents, spine strip, preview panel frames, page tabs, sticker labels, pencil props, and small decorative graphics while keeping the overall design print-realistic.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main headline in ExtraBold or Bold, and Medium/Semibold for supporting text; add a friendly handwritten accent font only for small captions or sticker labels.
- Color palette: Follow {컬러_팔레트} with specific tonal control—base paper tone soft white (#F7F4EE), outline text dark charcoal (#2B2B2B), accent blocks saturated but not neon, and gentle paper-shadow neutrals.
- Book realism: Show printed cover edges, light paper fibers, faint registration texture, subtle ink density variation, and a realistic back-cover barcode/ISBN area.
- Preview detail: Inner pages should be mostly black-and-white line art, with optional tiny colored guide marks or one partially colored sample area to imply how the book is used.
- Border/shadow: Use thin 1–2px borders on preview panels, with a soft drop shadow of 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and about 15% opacity for subtle separation.
- Decorative product elements: Add page tabs, pencil shavings, washi tape, small “미리보기” sticker, color chips, and caption labels where they support the product story and do not cover essential Korean text.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Clean flat product mockup look, as if shot with a 50mm lens at f/5.6 for balanced sharpness and minimal distortion.
- Lighting: Even studio lighting with softbox fill from upper-left and gentle secondary fill from right, producing soft edge separation without harsh glare.
- Color grade: Crisp paper-white base with controlled pastel or monochrome accents depending on {컬러링북_종류}; keep print-like clarity, readable Korean typography, and editorial product realism.
- Surface treatment: matte paper, lightly textured cover stock, natural stationery shadows, and soft tactile details that resemble a real online bookstore product photograph.

[6. MOOD]
Bookstore-ready Korean stationery catalog aesthetic — a warm modern coloring book product spread with gift-shop charm, editorial packaging structure, hand-drawn line art, and believable online marketplace details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- 다음 한글 문구는 깨짐 없이 정확히 보여야 한다: {도서명}, {서브카피}, {컬러링북_종류}, {포함_내용}, {가격}, {ISBN표기}.
- 표지에는 “{저자명}”, “{출판사명}”, “{출간월}”, “{권장연령}”, “{페이지수}”가 작은 출판 정보처럼 읽혀야 한다.
- 내지 미리보기 4컷에는 “01 동물 도안”, “02 꽃과 정원”, “03 풍경 산책”, “04 보너스 패턴” 같은 한글 캡션과 작은 페이지 번호가 보여야 한다.
- 전체 이미지는 컬러링북 표지와 내지 샘플을 동시에 소개하는 한국어 상품 디자인으로 명확히 인식되어야 하며, 제목·가격·미리보기 패널은 썸네일에서도 읽을 수 있어야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Blurry, unreadable, or garbled typography
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized portrait likenesses

studio:prompts3:ours-948.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Game platform-specific ad banner for a game campaign, designed to match the selected genre/platform while remaining conversion-focused, visually rich, and ready for paid media, launcher banners, store promotions, and social sharing.
Create a polished promotional layout that can adapt from mobile RPG to console action, PC MMORPG, esports shooter, or casual puzzle without changing the core ad structure, while adding believable campaign details and platform-specific advertising cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero subject placement: {hero 이미지} occupies the left 55–60% of the frame as the primary focal point, with the right side reserved for headline, release info, CTA, and platform/download information in a stacked advertising column.
- Background treatment: deep cinematic backdrop matched to {컬러 팔레트}, layered with in-game environment silhouettes, faint battle/city/map fragments, UI hologram panels, skill particles, platform-themed light streaks, and subtle depth haze so the banner feels like a real launch campaign.
- Information framing: build a strong left-to-right reading flow with the hero breaking slightly into the center, headline and campaign details on translucent glass panels or metallic UI plates, plus small realistic ad elements such as a QR download box, event tag, countdown label, community handle, and tiny legal/credit text.
- Layout must adapt to {게임 장르·플랫폼} while preserving the same ad structure, with {비율} as a horizontal banner composition.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main hero zone (left 55–60%): render {hero 이미지} as a high-impact centerpiece with cinematic contrast, crisp edges, textured costume/armor/skin detail, dynamic pose, and controlled special effects such as weapon glow, skill trails, speed lines, puzzle sparkles, mech HUD reflections, or UI-like aura depending on {게임 장르·플랫폼}.
2. Headline block (upper-right): place {헤드라인} in bold, oversized Korean typography with strong hierarchy; add a short campaign kicker above it such as “NEW SEASON UPDATE”, “GRAND OPEN”, or “런칭 캠페인” and keep the main headline dominant and readable.
3. Release / event block (mid-right): show {출시·이벤트} as compact supporting copy inside a capsule or panel, separated with accent dividers, small calendar icon, timer chip, and one or two short Korean micro-blurbs such as “한정 보상 지급” and “지금 접속 혜택”.
4. CTA / download block (lower-right): place {플랫폼·다운로드} as a row or stacked list of platform labels/icons, styled like realistic distribution channels for the selected game type; add a bold CTA button reading “지금 플레이” or “사전예약하기”, a small QR code area labeled “QR 스캔 후 다운로드”, and a tiny URL-style line such as “game.example.kr”.
5. Supporting ad details: include believable campaign texture such as reward item cards, small character class icons, screenshot thumbnails, leaderboard strip, coupon code label “EVENT CODE: START2026”, official community handle “@game_kr”, and a compact sponsor/partner strip if it fits the platform tone.
6. Color and accent system: apply {컬러 팔레트} consistently across glow effects, separators, key text accents, CTA button, reward cards, and background highlights so the ad feels genre-specific and cohesive.
7. Finishing details: add energy particles, lens bloom, subtle motion blur on effects, metallic or glass UI reflections, tiny publisher-credit text, and premium ad polish that makes the composition feel like a major launch campaign rather than a generic poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline at very large size, with tight tracking and clean geometric alignment; use Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Medium for supporting copy, CTA labels, platform text, and micro-copy; if the selected genre leans fantasy, allow a secondary accent in Nanum Myeongjo Bold for emphasis only.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트} with genre-matched tones such as dark purple and gold for RPG, pastel accents for casual puzzle, neon cyan/magenta for sci-fi or esports, or cool metallic cinematic tones for console; keep high-priority text in white, pale gold, electric cyan, or near-black depending on contrast.
- Panel and shadow system: use translucent glassmorphism panels, beveled sci-fi plates, parchment-like fantasy labels, or glossy mobile UI cards depending on {게임 장르·플랫폼}; use a soft drop shadow with 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 18% opacity on headline text; add subtle inner glow around hero effects and a faint vignette to anchor the composition.
- Realism of ad details: make platform icons, QR area, event chips, reward cards, and community labels look intentionally designed and printable, with tiny but plausible Korean microtext and clear visual hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: cinematic promotional key art look, shot as if on a full-frame 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens for hero depth, or a 35mm editorial game poster framing if the image resembles a wider scene; keep subject separation sharp and premium.
- Lighting: dramatic studio key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, with a soft fill from lower-right and a narrow rim light to carve out the hero silhouette; add glow sources that match the game effects and platform tone.
- Color grade: match {컬러 팔레트} with deep shadows, saturated accent highlights, and controlled contrast; keep blacks rich but not crushed, preserve bright UI-like text readability, and allow atmospheric reflections on panels and metallic surfaces.

[6. MOOD]
Premium game launch advertising — a AAA trailer-poster feel with the clarity and punch of a major mobile-to-console campaign, similar to high-end publisher key art, game launcher takeover banners, social ad creatives, and store-feature graphics packed with believable launch-event information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim Korean strings must appear correctly in the rendered image: {헤드라인}, {출시·이벤트}, {플랫폼·다운로드}
- Also include several short Korean ad details rendered cleanly, such as “지금 플레이”, “사전예약하기”, “한정 보상 지급”, “QR 스캔 후 다운로드”, “공식 커뮤니티 @game_kr”, and “EVENT CODE: START2026”.
- The overall composition must keep the hero on the left and information on the right in a stable advertising layout.
- Typography must stay crisp and correctly rendered in Korean and English, with no broken characters.
- The image should feel like a real game ad with campaign UI, download cues, reward/event information, and platform-specific atmosphere, not an illustrated editorial or generic poster.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or fake certification marks
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized real-person likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-947.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean and English campus tour 안내 poster for university and high school admissions marketing, tall A4-style layout.
Designed as a trustworthy recruitment flyer with a hero campus collage, practical visitor information, reservation guidance, and an admissions-event atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical A4 poster layout with a strong top-to-bottom reading flow; the school identity and event badge occupy the top 16%, the headline + hero campus image block takes the middle 44%, and the schedule, benefits, venue, reservation, sponsor, and contact information fill the lower 40%.
- Place {학교명_로고} with {영문학교명} in the masthead zone, paired with a small event label such as “2026 OPEN CAMPUS TOUR” and a campus admissions badge.
- Set {헤드라인} directly under the masthead in a prominent headline band, followed by {서브카피} as a concise invitation line.
- Use {hero_이미지} as the central visual anchor, framed as a polished campus collage or split scenic highlight: main gate, library facade, seminar classroom, students walking, and a small tour-guide moment.
- Place {투어_일정} in a clear schedule card near the mid-lower area, with date, time, program order, and duration separated into readable rows.
- Add {장소_동선} as a venue and route strip with simple directional icons, a small campus-map thumbnail impression, and arrival guidance.
- Present {포함_내용} as an admissions benefit checklist with small icons, short labels, and a few realistic details such as mentor talk, dormitory look-around, and cafeteria tasting.
- Add {신청_정보} as a ticket/reservation block with QR-code placeholder, registration deadline, capacity note, and participation fee.
- Place {문의_정보} and {후원_협력} in the footer area with phone, email, website, admissions office name, and a small sponsor/cooperation row.
- Use {컬러_팔레트} across header accents, dividers, schedule tags, map pins, QR frame, and decorative campus-line graphics.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top identity band: render {학교명_로고} as the primary institutional mark with {영문학교명} beneath or beside it; include a small “입학홍보처 주관” style credit line without making it look like a fake official seal.
2. Event label and headline: show “2026 CAMPUS TOUR GUIDE” or “OPEN CAMPUS DAY” as a compact bilingual event label, then set {헤드라인} in a bold Korean display style spanning most of the width.
3. Subcopy band: place {서브카피} under the headline in medium-weight Korean type, using one short sentence that explains who the tour is for.
4. Hero image block: compose {hero_이미지} as a cohesive admissions-brochure photo set; combine campus architecture, lecture atmosphere, student guide interaction, and outdoor walkway energy into one integrated visual block.
5. Schedule panel: place {투어_일정} inside a bordered information card with labels such as “DATE”, “TIME”, “PROGRAM”, and “DURATION”; use clear bullet separators and highlight the main date in the school accent color.
6. Venue and route strip: present {장소_동선} with a pin icon, small route arrows, meeting point, parking or public transit note, and a tiny campus-map graphic impression.
7. Benefits panel: present {포함_내용} as a structured checklist or stacked benefit cards aligned to the same grid as the schedule box.
8. Reservation and ticket block: show {신청_정보} with a QR-code placeholder, “무료 / 사전예약”, application deadline, seat limit, and a short CTA button such as “지금 신청하기”.
9. Footer information: include {문의_정보}, {후원_협력}, website line, page-code or document number, and a slim decorative rule so the poster feels like a real admissions office announcement.
10. Decorative system: apply {장식_그래픽} as campus-line illustrations, subtle route dots, notebook-tab labels, small calendar icons, and admissions-themed chips.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the headline, Pretendard Medium for body copy, and a slightly condensed sans style for schedule labels; headline size should dominate, while schedule, venue, and reservation text remains readable at poster distance.
- Color palette: use {컬러_팔레트} as the key accent system, paired with white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2B2B, warm gray #E8E8E8, and one soft campus-tint background panel.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1px neutral rules, subtle card borders, rounded 10–18px information panels, and a soft drop shadow with 0–4px y-offset, 10–14px blur, 10–15% opacity for the hero and info panels.
- Information graphics: use small calendar, clock, map-pin, bus, QR, checklist, and speech-bubble icons in a consistent line style.
- Poster realism: include believable admissions-office details such as application period, capacity, venue name, inquiry number, QR reservation area, sponsor/cooperation row, and small print notes.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: create the campus imagery with a 24mm wide-angle architectural feel for buildings and a 50mm natural-perspective look for student scenes, composed like a polished admissions brochure photo set.
- Lighting: bright overcast daylight or soft morning window light from upper-left, with gentle fill from front-right to keep faces and buildings evenly exposed and formal.
- Color grade: clean institutional tones with white, deep navy, muted green, and warm gray; keep saturation controlled and contrast moderate for a trustworthy school-promo look.
- Image texture: realistic printed-poster finish with crisp vector typography, high-resolution campus photography, refined paper grain, and precise panel edges.

[6. MOOD]
Editorial admissions brochure — polished university open-campus flyer aesthetic, like a premium education magazine event poster with a welcoming school-tour atmosphere, real visitor guidance, and confident institutional design.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: {학교명_로고}, {영문학교명}, {헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {투어_일정}, {장소_동선}, {포함_내용}, {신청_정보}, {문의_정보}, {후원_협력}
- Poster must visibly include: “2026 OPEN CAMPUS TOUR”, “무료 사전예약”, “QR 신청”, “입학홍보처 문의”, “집결 장소”, “투어 소요 90분”.
- Layout invariants: vertical A4 poster, clear hierarchy from school identity to headline to hero campus image to schedule to reservation/contact, with realistic admissions-event density and stable perspective on all text.
- All Korean text must render crisply with correct spacing, punctuation, and line breaks.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- AI-generated gibberish text
- Celebrity composites or unrelated public figures

studio:prompts3:ours-946.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean food truck and flea market promotional poster, A4 vertical ad for social-media and print use.
A lively, information-rich neighborhood event flyer that combines a main hero scene, schedule block, participating vendors, event details, sponsor strip, ticket/entry info, and bold Korean headline hierarchy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the main event title at the upper 18% of the frame, with the hero image occupying the middle 42–48% and layered information blocks stacked through the lower third.
- Use {행사·트럭명} as the primary event identifier, with {헤드라인} directly below it in a handwritten supporting style.
- Place {hero 이미지} as the largest visual element, framed like a pasted poster cutout or printed photo card with lively market energy, visible food truck details, vendor tents, shoppers, menu boards, price tags, string lights, bunting, and clear depth separation.
- Keep {일정·장소} and {참여 가게·메뉴} in compact poster panels with strong spacing and separators, so the layout reads quickly at a glance.
- Add a realistic event-detail system around the main content: small labels such as “입장 무료”, “현장 결제 가능”, “반려동물 동반 가능”, “우천 시 일부 변경”, plus ticket/entry info and a small QR-style placeholder area labeled “자세히 보기”.
- Include a sponsor/support area near the footer with small Korean labels like “주최 동네마켓”, “협찬 로컬상점연합”, “문의 @market_today”, set as tiny but legible poster microcopy.
- Apply {컬러 팔레트} across headers, accents, dividers, stickers, ribbons, price-label shapes, and decorative graphic elements, while using a warm printed-paper base with subtle grain and ink texture.
- Follow {비율} as a tall vertical editorial-ad composition with energetic event-flyer density and tight, intentional margins.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 18%): set {행사·트럭명} in a bold Korean display headline, then place {헤드라인} beneath it in a casual brush-script or hand-drawn subline; add a small issue/event label such as “LOCAL MARKET POP-UP”, “2026 SPRING EDITION”, or “VOL. 07” in tiny uppercase text near the title.
2. Hero zone (middle 45%): show {hero 이미지} as the central attention anchor, with a dynamic open-air market scene feel: food truck counter, steam from hot food, colorful canopy tents, shoppers holding paper cups, handmade goods tables, chalkboard signs, crates, picnic stools, and realistic street-fair depth; use crisp cutout edges and subtle shadowing so it sits clearly on the printed page.
3. Schedule zone (lower-middle left or centered strip): display {일정·장소} inside a compact rectangular label area with clear separators, using date/time/location/notice formatting that reads instantly; enrich it with small labels like “DATE”, “TIME”, “PLACE”, “NOTICE” and Korean microcopy such as “오전 11시 오픈”, “선착순 이벤트”.
4. Vendor/menu zone (lower-middle right or stacked panel): organize {참여 가게·메뉴} as short, punchy lines or dot-separated items; add small price-tag style examples like “대표 메뉴 ₩7,500~”, “수제 디저트”, “빈티지 소품”, “핸드메이드 굿즈” without replacing the required placeholder text.
5. Event details band: add a narrow ribbon or sticker row with concise Korean info: “입장 무료”, “테이크아웃 가능”, “현장 이벤트”, “스탬프 투어”, “포토존 운영”; include arrow icons, small stars, dots, ticket stubs, and stamp-like badges in {컬러 팔레트}.
6. Sponsor and contact footer: include a small sponsor strip, contact handle, QR-style square, and tiny legal/event notes such as “문의 @market_today”, “행사 내용은 현장 상황에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다”, “주차 공간이 협소하니 대중교통 이용 권장”.
7. Accent system: use stickers, dots, arrows, stamp-like shapes, torn-paper tabs, hand-drawn food doodles, mini map-pin icons, and decorative dividers in {컬러 팔레트} to amplify the flea-market energy while preserving the title-to-hero-to-info reading order.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main title at roughly 72–96px feel, with a hand-drawn brush font or Nanum Pen Script for the subtitle at roughly 28–40px feel; keep supporting text in Pretendard Medium, and use small condensed sans-serif for labels, sponsor names, and footer microcopy.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트} with vivid yellow, red, teal, and charcoal accents; background should feel like warm off-white printed stock with subtle paper fiber, ink speckle, faint halftone texture, and lightly imperfect screen-print edges.
- Border/shadow: add thin charcoal divider lines, sticker-like outlines, torn-paper borders, ticket-stub perforation details, washi-tape corners, and a soft drop shadow of about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for the hero and panel blocks.
- Poster realism: make the flyer feel like a real local event advertisement photographed or rendered as a finished print design, with believable spacing, layered paper pieces, tiny registration marks, small icons, price tags, and lively but readable information density.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary event-poster feel with a 35mm lens look for the crowd-and-booth scene, slightly wide perspective, crisp foreground emphasis, and mild depth layering.
- Lighting: bright daylight outdoor market lighting, like late-morning open-air coverage with soft overhead diffusion and gentle directional contrast; keep highlights lively but not blown out.
- Color grade: lively street-festival grade with saturated yellow/red/teal accents, charcoal text, and slightly warm neutral skin/food tones.
- Print finish: tactile matte poster finish with slight risograph/screen-print influence, visible paper grain, mild ink misregistration on decorative accents, and realistic shadows under taped labels and cutout panels.

[6. MOOD]
Energetic local market flyer — feels like a well-designed neighborhood festival poster with the upbeat density of a modern street fair campaign, full of food smells, handmade goods, friendly crowds, colorful stalls, and practical event information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문구: {행사·트럭명}, {헤드라인}, {일정·장소}, {참여 가게·메뉴}
- Additional Korean poster text may include: “입장 무료”, “현장 결제 가능”, “스탬프 투어”, “포토존 운영”, “문의 @market_today”, “주최 동네마켓”, “협찬 로컬상점연합”, “자세히 보기”, “대표 메뉴 ₩7,500~”.
- Preserve a clear poster hierarchy: title first, hero second, information blocks third; do not distort the layout into a random collage.
- Keep all Korean text readable and properly aligned, with no broken Korean characters, garbled spacing, or illegible typography.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-945.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
신혼여행 i2i 합성 이미지, {비율} 인스타 피드용 커플 여행 포토에디토리얼.
휴양지 배경과 자연스러운 커플 포즈를 결합한 감성적인 여행 앨범 컷으로, 실제 부부가 여행 중 남긴 SNS 포스트처럼 장소감, 기록성, 작은 인터페이스 디테일까지 담는다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 인물}은 화면 중앙 55~60%를 차지하도록 배치하고, 상반신 또는 전신이 배경과 자연스럽게 어우러지게 구성한다.
- {합성 배경}은 원근감이 살아 있는 여행지 배경으로 두되, 바다 수평선, 리조트 테라스, 야자수, 유럽 골목, 풀빌라 수면 반사처럼 실제 여행지에서 보이는 디테일이 프레임 안에 읽히게 한다.
- {의상·소품}은 여행 분위기를 강화하는 방향으로 정리하되, 인물 얼굴과 신체 비율은 원본을 보존한다. 선글라스, 라탄백, 작은 꽃다발, 여권 케이스, 카메라 스트랩, 호텔 키카드, 커플 링처럼 장소와 어울리는 소품은 자연스럽게 포함한다.
- 메인 문구 {메인 문구}는 하단 중앙 또는 하단 좌측에 배치하고, {여행 날짜}와 {여행 장소}가 함께 보이는 작은 날짜/장소 라벨과 조화롭게 정렬한다.
- 전체 구도는 럭셔리 여행 매거진의 커플 화보와 인스타그램 피드 포스트가 결합된 느낌으로, 실제 사진 위에 세련된 기록형 텍스트, 해시태그, 작은 SNS UI 요소가 얹힌 이미지로 완성한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Background layer: {합성 배경}을 넓게 깔고, 수평선/건물선/수면 반사/테이블 위 음료/리조트 패브릭/바닥 타일/현지 식물/멀리 흐릿한 여행객 실루엣 등 배경의 대표 요소가 프레임 안에서 자연스럽게 읽히도록 구성한다.
- Subject layer: {원본 인물}을 배경 앞에 자연스럽게 합성하며, 피부 톤과 가장자리 경계는 부드럽게 블렌딩해 컷아웃 티를 줄인다. 머리카락 가장자리, 손가락, 옷자락, 발 주변 그림자가 실제 현장 조명과 맞아야 한다.
- Outfit & props: {의상·소품}은 휴양지, 유럽 도시, 풀빌라 등 {합성 배경}의 장소성에 맞게 맞춘 듯 보이도록 연출한다. 부케 리본, 리넨 셔츠, 원피스, 샌들, 여행용 카메라, 냉음료 컵, 호텔 룸키 같은 디테일을 통해 신혼여행 분위기를 강화한다.
- Text layer: {메인 문구}는 한글 손글씨 또는 얇은 영문 캘리그래피 느낌으로 넣고, 하단에는 기록 텍스트를 함께 배치한다. Set Korean date/location label: "{여행 날짜}  |  {여행 장소}". Add small caption: "{보조 캡션}" and handle text "{계정 핸들}".
- Social detail layer: 인스타그램 카드처럼 작은 하트/댓글/공유/저장 마이크로 아이콘을 하단 가장자리 또는 우측 하단에 배치하고, 해시태그 느낌의 짧은 한국어 텍스트 "{해시태그}"를 작게 넣는다. 얇은 반투명 아이보리 캡션 스트립, 작은 위치 핀, 날짜 스탬프, 손그림 하트 태그가 개인 앨범 메모처럼 사진 위에 얹히게 한다.
- Finish pass: 전체 톤을 {컬러·라이팅}에 맞춰 통일하고, 그림자는 너무 진하지 않게 처리해 실제 여행 스냅처럼 보이게 한다. 필름 그레인, 렌즈 플레어, 하이라이트 번짐, 피부의 자연스러운 질감, 의상 주름, 바람에 흔들린 머리카락, 물결 반사, 모래 입자와 같은 여행 현장의 촉감을 살린다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: hand-drawn Korean script or elegant travel calligraphy, light to medium weight, 24~40px; if English is used, use a thin serif or elegant handwritten style, 22~36px. Micro text such as handle, date, hashtags, and caption should be 10~18px but still legible.
- Color palette: warm sand #D9C6A3, sea blue #7FB7C9, ivory #F7F2EA, soft coral #E8A38A, muted gold #C9A46A.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity on the subject edges; no hard outline, no sticker-like contour.
- Graphic accents: add small semi-transparent ivory caption strip, tiny muted-gold location pin icon, soft coral hand-drawn heart, and delicate travel-stamp style date mark that feels like a personal album annotation rather than an advertisement.
- Realism details: include plausible travel textures such as linen fabric, sand, water reflection, stone pavement, rattan weave, palm leaves, hotel balcony rail, table glass reflection, luggage tag, passport case, handwritten itinerary card, or distant people softly blurred in the background when appropriate to {합성 배경}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 50mm or 85mm full-frame portrait look, f/2.8–f/4, shallow but readable depth of field, clean travel-editorial framing.
- Lighting: golden hour sunlight from one side, soft natural fill from the opposite side, gentle shadow transitions, slight rim light around hair and shoulders.
- Color grade: warm cream + aqua blue + muted sunset amber, with low saturation and a polished cinematic travel-magazine finish.
- Image quality: realistic skin texture, believable fabric folds, accurate contact shadows, natural lens compression, subtle bokeh, high-resolution editorial retouching without plastic smoothing.

[6. MOOD]
Premium honeymoon travel editorial — feels like a Kinfolk x Condé Nast Traveler spread with a cinematic K-drama vacation still, plus the intimacy of a real couple’s Instagram memory post. {스타일}의 감도를 살리되, 개인이 실제로 올린 여행 기록처럼 따뜻하고 사적인 순간으로 느껴지게 한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함 — "우리의 첫 여행."
- Additional Korean text accuracy: 작은 보조 문구로 "2026.05.01  |  발리, 짐바란", "DAY 3 · 노을 산책", "@our_honeymoon", "#신혼여행 #우리의첫여행 #노을산책"이 깨짐 없이 읽혀야 한다.
- Original identity preservation: {원본 인물}의 얼굴 특징, 커플 관계, 표정은 유지하고 다른 사람으로 바뀌지 않게 한다.
- Composition invariant: 여행지 배경과 인물의 조합이 자연스럽고, 신혼여행 분위기의 로맨틱한 스냅처럼 보여야 한다.
- Typography invariant: 한글·영문 모두 깨짐 없이 선명해야 하며, 문구는 세련된 여행 기록처럼 작고 정돈되게 배치한다.
- Integration invariant: {합성 배경}, {의상·소품}, {컬러·라이팅}, {스타일}, {비율}의 의도가 실제 촬영본처럼 하나의 장면으로 통합되어야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity face composites unless the celebrity is explicitly provided in the reference image

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean multigenerational family photo studio advertisement, vertical A4 poster for print and social media.
Premium studio promo with a realistic 3-generation or 4-generation family hero image, package pricing, booking details, seasonal campaign labels, and warm heirloom-style design accents.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Upper header zone (top 16%): {스튜디오·로고} centered as the brand masthead, with a small campaign kicker above or beside it such as “2026 봄 가족사진 기획전” and the headline directly beneath it in a strong editorial hierarchy.
- Hero zone (center 44%): {hero 이미지} placed as the main visual, occupying most of the middle frame; show a real studio portrait scene with grandparents, parents, children, and optional great-grandparent seated/standing in a natural arrangement, including a classic chair, subtle textile backdrop, and soft studio floor shadow.
- Package/info zone (lower 32%): {패키지 안내} and {촬영 정보} arranged in a polished studio-ad layout with clear label/value separation, small icons, a reservation CTA strip, and a compact QR-code-style booking box.
- Background treatment: ivory studio backdrop with warm beige tonal variation, subtle paper-grain texture, faint linen curtain detail, muted gold divider lines, and gentle depth from realistic shadows.
- Add footer details that make it feel like a real poster: “상담 예약 OPEN”, “가족사진 주간 05.01–06.30”, “문의 02-000-0000”, “@family.studio”, “협력: 한복 대여 · 메이크업 제휴”, plus a small sponsor/partner area using discreet text and simple marks.
- Use {스튜디오·로고}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {패키지 안내}, {촬영 정보}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} as user-customizable placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Brand masthead: place {스튜디오·로고} at the top center in a refined logo-like treatment, paired with tiny studio credit text such as “SINCE 2012 · FAMILY PORTRAIT STUDIO” and a small date label “2026년 5월 프로모션”.
2) Main headline: set {헤드라인} immediately below the masthead, centered, in large bold Korean serif typography with high contrast strokes and crisp alignment; add one short supporting line beneath it: “부모님과 아이들이 함께 남기는 오늘의 기록”.
3) Hero image: feature {hero 이미지} as the central visual, with a soft natural studio look, realistic skin tones, textured formal clothing, neat hair styling, and a composed intergenerational pose that feels warm but formal; include natural micro-details like hands resting on shoulders, a child holding a small bouquet, grandparents seated on a wooden chair, and subtle framed family-album props near the floor.
4) Package block: present {패키지 안내} in a compact premium text box near the lower third, using clean label/value separation, muted gold section labels, and readable pricing lines; add small service chips such as “원본 제공”, “리터칭 포함”, “가족 의상 상담”.
5) Booking information: place {촬영 정보} beneath the package block, smaller than the package text, with a tidy service-info layout, calendar/time icons, and a strong CTA button-style line reading “지금 상담 예약하기”.
6) Poster footer: include ticket-like reservation information and practical store details, such as “예약금 5만원 · 잔금 촬영 당일”, “서울 강남구 스튜디오로 24”, “주차 가능”, and a small QR-code-style square labeled “예약 QR”.
7) Final polish: apply {컬러 팔레트} consistently across background, typography accents, decorative dividers, footer tags, and subtle corner ornaments; preserve a polished print advertisement finish while allowing realistic studio props, textures, and informational details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for service info in regular to medium weight, and Nanum Myeongjo or a high-contrast Korean serif for the headline in bold; headline size should dominate, with smaller supporting text around 28–36 px equivalent and micro footer text around 16–22 px equivalent.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with ivory #F6F1E8, warm beige #D8C2A8, charcoal #2D2A26, and muted gold #C7A56A.
- Border/shadow: subtle thin rules, ticket-stub dividers, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, refined editorial accents, and delicate gold corner flourishes.
- Layout details: include a realistic poster information hierarchy with headline, campaign subtitle, hero portrait, package pricing card, reservation CTA, contact line, QR-code-style box, partner/sponsor strip, and small copyright/credit text.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio portrait look, 85mm f/1.4 with a slight stop-down to f/2.8 for group sharpness and natural facial separation.
- Lighting: large softbox at 45° from upper-left with gentle fill from front-right, controlled rim separation, soft shadow under chin and shoulders, and natural catchlights in eyes.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + charcoal + restrained gold, with clean neutral skin tones, realistic fabric texture, subtle paper grain, and a gentle magazine-print finish.
- Realism cues: believable family height differences, mixed ages from child to grandparent, natural hand placement, modest formal Korean family attire, possible hanbok option shown as a small visual cue, and softly visible studio floor/background transitions.

[6. MOOD]
Premium family portrait editorial — Vogue Family-style studio advertisement with a calm, heirloom-album presentation, but with the fullness of a real promotional poster: campaign dates, booking path, package details, and warm studio atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim strings must appear correctly in the rendered image:
  - “3대가 한 프레임에.”
  - “베이직 (15장 인화 + 액자 1) 39만 / 프리미엄 (30장 + 앨범) 79만 / 한복 옵션”
  - “예약 평일·주말 / 2시간 / 의상 대여 별도 / 메이크업 옵션”
  - “2026 봄 가족사진 기획전”
  - “상담 예약 OPEN”
  - “가족사진 주간 05.01–06.30”
  - “지금 상담 예약하기”
  - “문의 02-000-0000”
  - “@family.studio”
- The family group should feel like a real 3-generation or 4-generation studio portrait, with natural poses, aligned faces, balanced spacing, believable age differences, and respectful formal styling.
- Keep all typography clean and fully legible; maintain a vertical poster layout with clear hierarchy, realistic information density, and premium studio-ad polish.
- Ensure {비율} is respected in the poster composition and that {컬러 팔레트} guides all accents, separators, and background tones.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean baby shower / prenatal care / full-term pregnancy card, elegant A4 vertical editorial layout for sharing, with a warm family keepsake feel and real printed-announcement details.
Printable-style announcement card that highlights one event type, a gentle hero image, a structured info box, and small supporting details such as date labels, location notes, captions, decorative tags, RSVP cues, and soft baby-themed motifs.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical A4 poster framing in {비율}, with the hero image occupying the upper 45–50% of the page and the text blocks stacked below in a polished editorial rhythm.
- Top headline area centered, with a small date/category label, a tiny issue-like keepsake mark such as "MOM NOTE VOL.01", and refined divider accents.
- Hero image should be framed as a soft focal point, while the info box, family section, and small supporting labels feel like a realistic printed baby announcement.
- Background treatment: warm ivory paper texture with visible fine paper grain, soft pastel washes, faint botanical line art, tiny star/dot accents, a subtle calendar sticker, and gentle tape or tag details that match {컬러 팔레트}.
- Use {카드 종류·예정일}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {정보 박스}, {가족·아빠}, {컬러 팔레트}, and {비율} placeholders naturally in the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 15%): set {카드 종류·예정일} as a small category line centered above the main title, with thin divider accents, a tiny "D-DAY NOTE" label, and a small date stamp such as "2026.05" or "우리 아기 기록".
2. Main headline zone (next 12%): place {헤드라인} in a soft Korean serif masthead style, centered, with calm authority and slightly increased letter spacing; add a very small subtitle line below such as "엄마가 되는 시간." or "우리 가족에게 온 가장 다정한 소식".
3. Hero zone (middle 40–45%): present {hero 이미지} as the main visual, either a softly backlit pregnant portrait, a cozy baby-shower still life with tiny shoes, ribbon, flowers, ultrasound photo corner, gift card, and folded blanket, or a gentle family hand-on-belly moment; crop like a lifestyle magazine photo with soft shadow, rounded paper-photo corners, and a small caption strip reading "오늘의 기록".
4. Information zone (lower middle 18–20%): place {정보 박스} inside a bordered card with aligned labels, evenly spaced rows, and form-like content; include realistic Korean labels such as "날짜", "시간", "장소", "드레스 코드", "RSVP", "선물 안내", and a tiny contact line like "문의 @baby.note" if it fits the theme.
5. Family line zone (lower 8–10%): include {가족·아빠} as a secondary line beneath the info box, styled smaller and warmer than the headline; add a small handwritten-style caption such as "아빠의 한마디" or "우리 셋이 처음 만나는 계절" nearby.
6. Footer balance zone (bottom margin): use {컬러 팔레트} across tiny accents, rules, baby icons, calendar marks, flower sprigs, sticker tags, page-code text such as "CARD 01 / KEEPSAKE", and a small QR-like RSVP block or barcode-style decorative strip so the page feels like a real event card.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for labels and body text, and Nanum Myeongjo or a refined Korean serif for the headline; headline weight 600–700, body weight 400–500, with clear size contrast and crisp Korean glyph rendering.
- Color palette: apply {컬러 팔레트} as the main scheme; keep the base background in warm ivory #F7F1E8, with pastel accents that may include baby pink, light blue, soft green, cream beige, muted lavender, and charcoal.
- Border/shadow: use a thin 1px or 1.5px outline in muted charcoal or pastel tone, plus a soft drop shadow at 4px y-offset, 12px blur, around 12–18% opacity.
- Decorative system: include refined baby-shower details such as ribbon corners, tiny safety-pin icons, pressed-flower illustrations, a calendar sticker, a small "D-30" tag, photo-caption tape, and fine dotted dividers, all coordinated with {컬러 팔레트}.
- Text hierarchy: make {헤드라인} the largest Korean text, {카드 종류·예정일} the elegant category/date line, {정보 박스} the most readable practical section, and {가족·아빠} the intimate closing note.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: use a 50mm or 85mm portrait lens at f/2.0–f/2.8 for the hero image, or a 35mm flat editorial framing for a still-life baby-shower card feel.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with subtle fill on the opposite side; if using still life, keep the shadows feathered and natural, like a lifestyle magazine shoot.
- Color grade: warm ivory, blush, powder blue, pale sage, and charcoal; gently desaturated, with clean highlight roll-off and natural paper-and-fabric texture.
- Realism cues: show tactile printed-card details such as faint paper fibers, embossed-looking dividers, soft photo edges, tiny ink registration imperfections, pastel washi tape, and delicate shadow layering between the photo, stickers, and info box.

[6. MOOD]
Soft maternity editorial — a Kinfolk-style keepsake card with the calm tenderness of an upscale family announcement, enriched with realistic baby-shower stationery details and affectionate family notes.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 깨지지 않고 정확하게 보여야 함: "엄마가 되는 시간."
- Korean text accuracy: {카드 종류·예정일}, {헤드라인}, {정보 박스}, {가족·아빠}에 들어가는 한글은 자연스럽고 정확한 맞춤법이어야 함.
- Add readable supporting Korean microcopy where appropriate, such as "날짜", "시간", "장소", "드레스 코드", "RSVP", "선물 안내", "오늘의 기록", "아빠의 한마디", "우리 아기 기록", without overpowering the main placeholders.
- Layout invariants: one clear hero image, one headline, one info box, one family line; maintain a clear vertical hierarchy with readable spacing and no crowded overlap.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
