[1. PURPOSE]
Korean parent milestone celebration invitation card for hwangap / hwan-gap, chilsun, palsun family banquet. Vertical A4-style premium family event card designed for print, KakaoTalk sharing, and keepsake framing, with clear Korean typography and warm ceremonial atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: elegant vertical invitation card with a centered hero portrait taking about 40–44% of the frame height, a refined headline block in the upper third, and event details, RSVP, family host names, and small 안내 정보 stacked in polished sections below.
- Background treatment: warm ivory hanji-like paper texture with visible fibrous grain, faint traditional cloud motif, soft gold speckles, and a thin Korean ornamental border using {컬러 팔레트}.
- Framing direction: formal, symmetrical, and respectful; use layered spacing, delicate divider rules, small corner ornaments, and a ceremonial information hierarchy for {헤드라인}, {주인공 사진}, {일정·장소}, {가족·자녀}, {RSVP 연락처}, and {상차림·교통 안내}.
- Use {잔치 종류·주인공} as the main contextual line, {기념 라벨} as a small medallion or ribbon tag, {헤드라인} as the typographic focal point, {초대 문구} as the warm introductory copy, {주인공 사진} as the central visual anchor, {일정·장소} as the event info block, {가족·자녀} as the host-name footer, and {컬러 팔레트} for all accent colors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top title zone (upper 18%): place {기념 라벨} in a small gold-and-red medallion or ribbon label, then set {잔치 종류·주인공} in a refined line above {헤드라인}. Use large Korean serif calligraphy-inspired type for {헤드라인}, centered, ceremonial, and highly legible.
2. Invitation message zone (upper-middle 10%): add {초대 문구} in 2–3 short Korean lines beneath the headline, with elegant line breaks and a small decorative divider such as a plum blossom, knot motif, or thin gold rule.
3. Hero zone (middle 38–42%): place {주인공 사진} as the main image, framed by a soft oval or rounded-rectangle matte with subtle gold trim; include realistic details such as hanbok silk texture, corsage, family hands gently gathered, studio backdrop, or banquet-table warmth when appropriate.
4. Event detail zone (lower-middle 17%): set {일정·장소} in two to four neatly separated lines with icons or small labels for 일시, 장소, 안내. Add {상차림·교통 안내} in smaller text as a practical note.
5. RSVP and family name zone (lower 10%): place {RSVP 연락처} with phone/Kakao-style contact formatting, then add {가족·자녀} in small, evenly spaced text as hosts.
6. Bottom finish (last 5–7%): add a refined ornamental footer line, small date stamp, and dress note {드레스코드}; keep the look like a premium Korean banquet invitation rather than a casual flyer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for headline and event details, with bold 700–800 weight for {헤드라인} and medium 400–500 weight for body text; small labels, RSVP, and captions can use Pretendard 400–500. Headline size should feel like 42–56 px equivalent, event details around 22–28 px, family names around 16–20 px equivalent.
- Color palette: ivory #F5EFE4, deep red #8B1E2D, gold #C8A24A, charcoal #2B2B2B, with optional muted jade #6F8C72 for tiny traditional accents; these should match {컬러 팔레트} and be used consistently for hierarchy, divider rules, medallions, and floral ornaments.
- Border/shadow: use a very soft drop shadow under the hero frame, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12–15% opacity; thin divider rules in muted gold; add tasteful Korean stationery details such as corner knots, small plum blossoms, hanji grain, and subtle foil-like highlights.
- Information realism: include invitation-card details that feel printable and real, such as RSVP line, family host line, meal/parking note, date stamp, and location label; ensure all Korean text has natural spacing and punctuation.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial portrait look shot on Sony A7 IV with FE 85mm f/1.8 for a formal half-body parent portrait, or Canon EOS R6 Mark II with RF 50mm f/1.8 STM for a more intimate family group composition; if the hero is a card-style composite, mimic a clean studio portrait crop with realistic depth and natural skin texture.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, warm rim light on hair and shoulders, and delicate catchlights; if using a family photo feel, emulate diffused window light with mild bounce fill to keep skin tones natural.
- Color grade: warm ivory base with deep ceremonial red accents, slightly desaturated neutrals, subtle gold highlight emphasis, natural skin tones, and clean premium print-ready contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Respectful Korean family celebration invitation — traditional banquet card meets modern editorial stationery, with the warmth of a family keepsake, the dignity of a high-end wedding suite, and the clarity of a printed event announcement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear correctly and legibly in Korean: "한평생을 함께해 주신 분께.", {잔치 종류·주인공}, {기념 라벨}, {헤드라인}, {초대 문구}, {일정·장소}, {상차림·교통 안내}, {RSVP 연락처}, {가족·자녀}, {드레스코드}.
- Render realistic Korean invitation details such as "일시", "장소", "RSVP", "주차 안내", "가족 일동", and a date stamp like "2026.07.20" without broken characters.
- Layout invariants: maintain a formal centered composition, with the hero image as the main focal anchor and the text hierarchy clearly separated into title, invitation message, hero portrait, event details, RSVP, and family names.
- If any human figures appear in {주인공 사진}, they must look natural, dignified, age-appropriate, and anatomically correct.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites unless explicitly requested
- Text distortion that harms readability

[1. PURPOSE]
Wedding seating chart and ceremony program card in A4 portrait format, designed for elegant Korean wedding print use and shareable invitation stationery.
Realistic premium wedding guide sheet that combines ceremony order, table assignment guidance, venue schedule, reception notes, and guest-facing practical details in one polished editorial layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered vertical A4 wedding stationery poster with a refined editorial grid: identity/header area at the top (about 14%), main ceremony program block in the middle (about 40%), seating/table guide below it (about 28%), and venue/contact footer (about 14%).
- Use {신랑·신부} as the primary identity line near the top, followed by {헤드라인} as the focal headline.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Add realistic print finishing details: faint debossed monogram, lightly textured ink edges, tiny registration-like crop ticks outside the main frame, and gentle paper grain visible in flat color areas.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing flat-design print layout, simulated as a high-resolution editorial stationery mockup, equivalent to an overhead product shot on a Canon TS-E 50mm f/2.8L tilt-shift look for perfect rectangular alignment.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left with gentle fill from right, producing even paper tonality and faint shadow edges only.
- Color grade: warm ivory + muted blush + soft sage + antique gold with restrained contrast, like a modern Korean wedding editorial spread.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean wedding stationery — a Vogue Weddings x Kinfolk-inspired ceremony card aesthetic with calm editorial elegance, realistic hotel-wedding information density, soft romance, and polished print-shop craftsmanship.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문자열: {신랑·신부}, {헤드라인}, {식순}, {좌석·테이블 안내}, {식장·일정}, {추가 안내}, {문의 연락처}, {좌석 코드}, {장식 문구}.
- Include these rendered Korean labels clearly somewhere on the page: “예식 순서”, “좌석 안내”, “피로연 안내”, “모바일 안내”, “문의”.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

Church seasonal event card for Easter, Christmas, or Thanksgiving, designed as a vertical A4-style announcement poster for worship service promotion, community sharing, bulletin boards, and mobile invitation forwarding.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: place {발행정보} in small type at the very top, then show {행사·시즌} as a seasonal ribbon label or capsule tag, followed by {헤드라인} in the dominant title area and {부제} directly underneath.
2. Hero zone (mid frame): render {hero 이미지} as the main seasonal visual, integrated with the poster through soft shadows, paper texture, and subtle decorative framing; make it symbolic, reverent, and church-appropriate.
3. Event details block: below the hero, create a prominent information card showing 일시 {행사일시}, 장소 {장소·주소}, and 등록 {입장·등록}, with calendar/map/QR micro icons.
4. Program schedule block: set {일정·예배} as a compact timeline with time markers, small dividers, and a warm bulletin-style layout suitable for worship, special music, children’s presentation, fellowship, or meal details.
5. Contact and access block: place {교회·연락처} and {담당자·문의} in the lower section with phone, Kakao channel, parking, public transport, and shuttle cues where appropriate.
6. Host / sponsor strip: add a small bottom area for {주관·후원}, plus a realistic QR placeholder box labeled {등록QR문구}; the QR box should feel like a printed invitation detail, not a dominant graphic.
7. Seasonal decoration: add {장식 모티프} around corners, header ribbons, section dividers, and small sticker-like labels; decorations should support the selected holiday and make the card feel designed for a real church event.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Border/shadow: use delicate line borders, layered paper cards, and a soft drop shadow at 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity when needed for dimensionality.
- Text hierarchy: headline first, subtitle second, date/time/venue third, then program schedule, registration, contact, and host/sponsor details; Korean line breaks should look intentional and natural.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: if rendered as a photographic poster, use a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 for the hero subject or a 50mm f/1.8 for balanced bulletin realism; if illustrated, keep the same framing discipline and poster clarity.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, gentle fill from front-right, no harsh contrast, with slightly brighter emphasis on the hero visual and title area.
- Color grade: church-poster editorial grade with creamy whites, subdued seasonal accents, realistic print texture, and polished announcement saturation; avoid neon intensity and maintain a calm, welcoming worship-event look.

[6. MOOD]
Seasonal church bulletin — elegant Sunday worship announcement card with a Korean church newsletter, holiday service poster, and warm community invitation feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 포스터에 다음 한글 요소가 또렷하게 보여야 함: {행사·시즌}, {발행정보}, {헤드라인}, {부제}, 일시 {행사일시}, 장소 {장소·주소}, 등록 {입장·등록}.
- Program and contact text must be legible: 프로그램 {일정·예배}, 문의 {교회·연락처}, 담당 {담당자·문의}, 주관·후원 {주관·후원}, QR 안내 {등록QR문구}.
- If the seasonal theme is shown as text, it must be rendered exactly and clearly in Korean with no broken characters.
- Maintain a formal church-card hierarchy: headline first, hero second, event details third, schedule and contact details clearly separated, with all Korean text crisp, properly spaced, and fully legible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Seokgatanshinim Day / Lotus Lantern Festival vertical poster for temple-event promotion, designed as a ceremonial cultural announcement with strong editorial hierarchy.
Use a luxurious festival-poster look with lantern procession energy, realistic printed-event information, and a rich temple-night atmosphere suitable for social sharing, street posting, temple bulletin boards, and print display.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster uses a tall A4-like vertical layout with the hero occupying about 58% of the frame, headline zone 16%, and schedule/program/sponsor information stacked in the lower third.
- Main subject placement: {행사·사찰} naming and temple-night atmosphere anchored in the upper half, with {hero 이미지} dominating center and flowing diagonally upward like a lantern parade through a real courtyard.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: place {행사·사찰} near the upper margin in a refined ceremonial style, with small supporting Buddhist-event labeling feel such as 불기 2570년 · 부처님오신날 봉축, aligned center and slightly compressed for poster authority.
2. Headline block (upper 18%): render {헤드라인} as the dominant typographic focal point in bold Korean Myeongjo with a touch of classical Hanja presence, using high contrast against the dark background and subtle gold accent; add a small subtitle line beneath such as 마음에 등불을 밝히는 밤.
3. Hero scene (mid 50%): visualize {hero 이미지} as a vibrant lantern procession or temple-night celebration, with layered lantern strings, illuminated floral motifs, temple eaves, soft silhouettes of visitors holding lanterns, prayer flags, candlelight bowls, and a rich festival density; keep the subject sharply readable and luminous rather than abstract.
4. Event details strip (lower 17%): place {일정·장소} in a clean, structured block with smaller but highly legible typography, using thin dividers and compact line spacing; include realistic supporting labels in Korean such as 일시, 장소, 참여안내, 문의, 무료입장, 우천 시 일부 프로그램 변경.

6. Sponsor and ticket area: include a compact lower footer strip with 후원, 협력, 접수처 labels, small sponsor-name text placeholders such as 지역불교문화회 · 연등회 준비위원회, a realistic QR/ticket box labeled 참여 신청, and a small contact line like 문의 02-000-0000.
7. Palette integration: apply {컬러 팔레트} throughout lantern glow, accent rules, lotus ornaments, info-panel dividers, and title highlights so the whole composition feels unified rather than patchworked.
8. Footer anchor: keep {비율} implied by the vertical layout and preserve a polished print-poster finish with an authentic event-information footer, tiny credit line such as 디자인·사진 제공 {행사·사찰}, and small page-like production mark 봉축 포스터 2026.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: headline in Nanum Myeongjo or Noto Serif KR Bold, 56–72px equivalent; supporting text in Pretendard Medium / Noto Sans KR Regular, 22–30px equivalent; footer microcopy 12–16px equivalent; Hanja accents can be slightly condensed and tracked wider.

- Border/shadow: use subtle gold rule lines, thin ornamental lotus dividers, soft lantern glow halos, and a light drop shadow around text panels 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; avoid glossy 3D effects.
- Poster finish: crisp print texture, slightly matte paper feel, fine grain, ink density variation, and subtle paper fiber to echo a cultural-event offset print.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: cinematic 50mm lens look with shallow depth of field, or 85mm f/1.8 portrait compression for the lantern procession hero; keep perspective dignified and poster-friendly.
- Lighting: moonlit temple-night ambience with warm lantern illumination from below and behind, soft rim light outlining the procession, candle glow on stone pavement, and gentle ambient fill to preserve details in dark areas.
- Color grade: rich night-charcoal base with glowing pink, yellow, red, teal, and gold lantern accents; slightly lifted highlights, deep shadows, and a festival-cinematic contrast curve.
- Realism cues: believable temple courtyard scale, layered lantern cords receding in depth, visible paper-lantern texture, subtle smoke or incense haze, soft human silhouettes, authentic printed typography edges, and a balanced mix of photography-like hero imagery with editorial poster design.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Buddhist cultural-festival editorial — like a high-end heritage event poster seen in a Kinfolk-meets-cinematic temple-night presentation, warm, reverent, festive, and inviting for families and local community visitors.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구: {행사·사찰}, {헤드라인}, {일정·장소}, {포함 행사}.

- Preserve the poster hierarchy so the headline is the strongest text element, followed by the luminous hero image, then the schedule, program details, ticket/participation info, and sponsor footer.
- Keep all Hangul and Hanja crisp and correctly formed, with no character breakup or spacing errors.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean church or cathedral event announcement card, vertical A4-style layout for bulletin, lobby poster, parish notice board, KakaoTalk sharing, and social media story repost.
Elegant faith-based informational design with realistic worship schedule details, event logistics, invitation copy, and a calm ceremonial tone.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main layout: centered vertical poster with the hero image occupying the upper 38–42% of the frame, followed by a structured information card beneath it.
- Background treatment: soft ivory paper texture with a warm cream gradient wash, faint linen grain, subtle gold ink accents, and a gentle printed bulletin feel.
- Framing and spacing: balanced editorial spacing with thin divider lines, small cross or dove line icons, date badges, and a footer information band for contact, venue, and application details.
- Use {교회·성당명}, {영문명}, {헤드라인}, {부제}, {주일·예배 시간}, {특별 행사}, {행사일시}, {장소}, {신청안내}, {문의}, {주소}, {주최부서}, {후원문구}, {하단성구}, {hero 이미지}, {컬러 팔레트} placeholders naturally within the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top hero zone (upper 40%): {hero 이미지} presented as the primary visual anchor, softly lit and editorially cropped to emphasize the church interior, cross, stained glass, bell tower, candles, pews, altar flowers, or warm sanctuary atmosphere. Add a small gold date ribbon in one corner reading {행사일시}.
2. Identity zone (below hero, about 12–14% height): {교회·성당명} set large and centered, {영문명} in small caps or refined sans-serif beneath it, followed by {헤드라인} as the main invitation line.
3. Invitation copy zone (about 8–10% height): {부제} arranged as one or two readable Korean lines with a subtle decorative divider, such as a fine gold rule, small cross icon, or botanical flourish.
4. Schedule zone (middle-lower 18–22%): {주일·예배 시간} organized into clear readable rows with weekday labels, time chips, and small service icons; keep hierarchy strong for quick scanning.
5. Special events and logistics zone (lower 14–17%): {특별 행사}, {장소}, and {신청안내} presented as a concise event information block with date/time, venue, registration or attendance guidance, and a small ticket-style or bulletin-label treatment.
6. Footer information band (bottom 7–9%): include {문의}, {주소}, {주최부서}, {후원문구}, and {하단성구} in smaller type, with page-like printed details, a small QR-style application box, and a tasteful sponsor/host area.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for schedules and details, Nanum Myeongjo or a refined Korean serif for the headline; headline bold 34–44px equivalent, church name 38–52px equivalent, supporting text 18–24px equivalent, footer text 12–16px equivalent, generous line height.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with ivory #F7F2E8, soft cream #FFF9F1, muted gold #C9A86A, warm gray #6A6258, charcoal #2E2A27, plus muted olive or pale blue only as restrained accent if needed.
- Border/shadow: ultra-subtle 1px warm-gray divider lines, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity for the hero panel or text card, and small foil-like gold details on section labels.
- Realistic printed details: include bulletin-style labels such as 예배 안내, 특별 행사, 오시는 길, 문의, 신청, 주최; use small icons, micro dividers, and a QR-style square without pretending to be an official certification.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm or 50mm full-frame look, similar to a clean editorial architectural photograph, f/4 for the hero image, straight perspective with minimal distortion.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at roughly 45°, gentle ambient fill from right, polished but not glossy; if depicting stained glass, include faint warm transmitted glow across pews or stone walls.
- Color grade: warm ivory + muted gold + charcoal with restrained contrast, slightly desaturated highlights, calm and reverent editorial finish.
- Material realism: matte printed card stock, faint paper fibers, soft ink texture, subtle shadow under layered panels, believable poster/bulletin typography rather than flat UI.

[6. MOOD]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean temple stay promotional poster for a Buddhist temple information campaign, vertical A4-style ad layout.
Designed to present temple identity, seasonal retreat program details, event information, pricing, reservation path, and cultural-travel atmosphere in a calm but realistic premium tourism-ad format.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Portrait poster with a balanced editorial hierarchy: atmospheric temple hero image occupies the upper 52% of the frame, headline and subtitle sit across the middle band, and program, schedule, fee, reservation, and sponsor information are stacked in the lower section.
- {사찰명} and {종파표기} appear near the top as the institutional identity line, with a small temple emblem-style lotus graphic, hangul/hanja feeling, and a refined vertical poster grid.
- Background should feel like warm hanji paper with visible fibrous texture, faint ink-wash mountain silhouettes, dancheong pattern strips, lotus petal ornaments, and small paper ticket/QR reservation elements that belong naturally to a temple-stay advertisement.
- The hero scene should include realistic temple details: tiled roof eaves, wooden pillars, stone steps, a pagoda or lotus lanterns, pine forest, early morning mist, and a modest visitor path, while keeping all essential Korean information readable.
- {헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {템플스테이명}, {일정}, {운영기간}, {장소}, {프로그램안내}, {참가비}, {예약마감}, {예약연락처}, {후원협력}, {컬러팔레트}, and {비율} must be clearly structured as separate poster information zones, with visual rhythm created by dividers, stamps, icons, and small ornamental graphics.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top band (10%): place {사찰명} with {종파표기} as a restrained identity line in Korean calligraphic display style; add a small lotus symbol, thin dancheong-color rule, and issue-like campaign label such as “2026 봄 산사문화 안내”.
- Hero zone (upper 52%): show {히어로이미지} as the main visual anchor, composed like a serene Korean cultural-travel poster with mist, soft daylight, layered trees, temple roofline depth, stone lanterns, lotus lantern strings, and a small wooden wayfinding sign.
- Headline band (mid 13%): set {헤드라인} prominently over a softly textured hanji panel; place {서브카피} below it as a calm invitation line, using antique gold or charcoal contrast and a subtle brush-stroke underline.
- Event detail block (lower 12%): present {템플스테이명}, {일정}, {운영기간}, and {장소} in a poster-style schedule table with small icons for moon/sun, meditation, meal, and tea conversation.
- Program and fee block (lower 11%): present {프로그램안내} and {참가비} in concise stacked lines, using dotted dividers, small lotus bullets, and a dancheong red/green accent label for “체험 안내”.
- Reservation block (bottom 8%): place {예약마감} and {예약연락처} as a clear final callout with a small QR-code placeholder box, ticket-style reservation strip, phone/web icons, and the phrase “선착순 접수”.
- Sponsor/footer band (bottom 4%): include {후원협력}, page-like footer text, and {비율}; style it like a real cultural poster sponsor area with small monochrome partner-name text and thin rules.
- Color system: apply {컬러팔레트} across title accents, dancheong dividers, lotus ornaments, QR/ticket box borders, and small footer labels, while maintaining a warm hanji base and charcoal typography.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: headline in a refined Korean display font such as Noto Serif KR SemiBold or Nanum Myeongjo Bold, body text in Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Medium; use a calligraphic accent only for the temple name and one short seal-like decorative label, not for dense information.
- Layout language: premium Korean tourism poster mixed with temple-brochure practicality; combine a photographic hero, hanji texture panels, small lotus/dancheong ornaments, a schedule table, sponsor/footer area, and reservation QR block.
- Color palette: use warm hanji beige, dancheong red, dancheong green, charcoal black, muted gold, and soft pine-gray; if represented as tones, keep them close to #F2E7D5, #B83B2E, #2F7A57, #2E2E2E, #B08A3C, #6E7666.
- Border/shadow: thin gold or charcoal rules, paper-card shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, about 15% opacity; use realistic printed-poster depth, ink texture, and slight paper grain rather than heavy glossy effects.
- Decorative elements: include temple-appropriate visual details such as lotus motifs, cloud-scroll ornaments, small dancheong corner marks, prayer-bead divider dots, a wooden sign illustration, and a realistic QR placeholder, all integrated with the typography.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic architectural editorial look, 35mm full-frame perspective for a gently wide temple scene, or 50mm standard lens for a balanced poster photograph; keep geometry natural and undistorted.
- Lighting: early morning mist or overcast diffused daylight, soft light from upper-left with faint fill from right, subtle atmospheric haze around the temple roofline, pagoda, pine trees, and lanterns.
- Color grade: warm cream base with muted dancheong red and green, charcoal text, antique gold highlights, soft pine-gray shadows, and natural stone/wood tones; saturation moderate and elegant.
- Print realism: simulate high-quality matte paper, slightly absorbent ink, delicate hanji fibers, crisp Korean type, small footer text, QR block edges, and fine ornamental lines suitable for a 1024x1536 vertical poster.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean cultural-travel poster — calm mountain temple air, early morning incense, soft bells, hanji brochure tactility, dignified Buddhist heritage, and practical temple-stay reservation information presented like a refined destination advertisement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the rendered image:
  - {사찰명}
  - {종파표기}
  - {헤드라인}

  - {템플스테이명}

  - {참가비}
  - {예약마감}

- Include realistic poster microcopy such as “선착순 접수”, “QR 예약”, “체험 안내”, “문의”, and “2026 봄 산사문화 안내” in readable Korean, integrated with the reservation and footer zones.
- Maintain a vertical A4-style poster structure with a dominant temple hero image, realistic tourism-ad details, legible Korean typography, and no distortion of temple rooflines, pagoda shapes, QR block, schedule table, or text blocks.
- Ensure all Korean characters render correctly and remain fully readable, especially small schedule, pricing, sponsor, date, venue, and contact information.

[1. PURPOSE]
DIY woodworking and furniture-making class poster, vertical A4-style editorial promo for a craft studio.
Designed to feel like a premium workshop flyer that can advertise weekend classes, materials included, handmade furniture projects, a real venue schedule, and an inviting hands-on studio atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top area (about 15%): {공방·로고} centered as the studio identity, set like a compact atelier masthead with a small date label, thin rule, and studio-credit microcopy beneath.
- Main hero zone (middle 45%): a realistic workshop scene based on {hero 이미지}, featuring wood boards, saw, chisel, hammer, clamps, measuring tape, pencil marks, sandpaper, wood shavings, a workbench, and a small finished stool or side table as the main visual anchor with clear depth.
- Headline block (upper-mid 18%): {헤드라인} placed large and bold, aligned to complement the hero without covering the most important tools; add a short Korean subline and badge-like class label.
- Class info band (lower-mid 14%): {수업 종류} and {일정·가격} stacked in concise brochure-style lines, supported by event details such as date/time/venue, materials included, reservation note, and ticket information.
- Bottom area: sponsor/contact strip with a small barcode or QR-style reservation block, address line, phone/contact line, and decorative dividers inspired by ruler ticks and wood joinery marks.
- Background: warm workshop interior tones, visible wood grain textures, cream paper stock feel, natural tabletop shadows, small practical craft details, and editorial poster layering.
- Use {공방·로고}, {헤드라인}, {수업 종류}, {일정·가격}, {hero 이미지}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone: place {공방·로고} at the top center in a compact logo-like lockup, with Korean + English balance, a small line reading "WOODWORKING CLASS 2026", and a fine divider line beneath.
2. Hero zone: build the central visual from {hero 이미지}, showing handcrafted wood, tools, pencil guide marks, clamps, cut boards, a realistic work surface, and one finished furniture display, framed as polished editorial still-life photography.
3. Title zone: set {헤드라인} in a bold Korean headline treatment, large enough to dominate the upper-middle area while keeping the hero visible; include the supporting line "내 손으로 완성하는 첫 가구" and a small badge "주말 원데이 클래스".
4. Course details zone: present {수업 종류} as a neat multi-item list, using separators, ruler-tick dividers, and small icon-like markers for project types such as stool, shelf, tray, or side table.
5. Schedule/pricing zone: place {일정·가격} near the lower section in a clear info-card rhythm, like workshop brochure metadata; add fixed supporting details "재료비 포함", "초보자 환영", "소수정원 6명".
6. Event details zone: include realistic poster information: "2026.05.23 SAT", "14:00–17:30", "서울 성수동 우드스튜디오", "예약 QR / 현장결제 가능", and "문의 02-000-1842".
7. Sponsor and footer zone: add a bottom strip with "후원 LOCAL MAKER LAB · WOOD MARKET", a tiny page/poster code "POSTER NO. 024", small credit text "photo by studio craft team", and a barcode-style reservation block.
8. Overall layout: maintain a vertically balanced poster hierarchy from logo to hero to class information to footer, with tactile workshop details that make the flyer feel printed, useful, and real.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard Medium and Noto Sans KR Regular for details; headline size should feel poster-large, info text small but crisp and highly legible.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with wood brown, warm amber, charcoal, and white; accent with soft cream (#F5F0E8), walnut brown (#7A4E2D), deep charcoal (#2B2B2B), and amber light (#D8A15B).
- Graphic system: use thin ruler marks, joinery-inspired line dividers, small rounded labels, subtle paper grain, and warm printed ink texture; apply {비율} to keep the vertical poster composition consistent.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on the hero object and info blocks; thin separators in muted charcoal, with refined craft-poster framing and tactile printed layers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 commercial still-life look with 50mm or 85mm lens, f/2.8 to f/4, natural perspective with slight depth separation, similar to high-end workshop/editorial product photography.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, mild shadow falloff across the wood surface, realistic reflections on tools without glare.
- Color grade: warm cream + amber highlights + natural walnut browns + restrained charcoal contrast, with a slightly matte editorial finish.
- Physical realism: wood grain should show varied fibers, end grain, sawdust, sanding marks, and small imperfections; metal tools should have realistic edges, scratches, and believable scale.

[6. MOOD]
Premium craft-studio editorial — feels like a Kinfolk-style workshop feature mixed with a refined local atelier event poster, warm, tactile, practical, and inviting for beginners who want to build real furniture.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as written, with no broken characters:
  - "DIY 우드 클래스"
  - {공방·로고}
  - {헤드라인}
  - {수업 종류}

[INPUT]
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean flower class promotional poster, vertical A4-style editorial layout for workshop marketing.
Designed for social media and offline flyer use, with a premium studio-flower aesthetic, realistic class details, and readable booking information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top brand block: {공방로고} set as a compact atelier masthead near the top-left, with a small English/Korean studio line and a tiny floral glyph.
- Event label and date badge: {행사라벨} and {날짜뱃지} placed near the upper-right as printed poster metadata, using a rounded tag or narrow vertical label.
- Main headline area: {헤드라인} centered in the upper-middle third, large enough to dominate the poster, with {서브카피} directly below in smaller type.
- Hero image placement: {히어로이미지} as the central visual anchor, taking about 42% of the frame, showing real workshop materials such as dried flowers, scissors, twine, kraft paper, ribbon, glass vase, flower tape, and a half-finished bouquet on a wooden table.
- Class information card: {수업종류}, {일정가격}, {장소}, {예약문의}, and {티켓정보} arranged as a structured event-detail block under or beside the hero image.
- Footer sponsor area: {스폰서} shown in a small sponsor/partner strip with simple text logos and a “with” label, clearly separated from the booking details.
- Decorative graphics: use pressed-flower silhouettes, tiny botanical line drawings, tape corners, paper receipt-like labels, and thin divider rules in the palette, supporting the workshop mood without covering any text.
- Palette treatment: {컬러팔레트} applied across background, accents, floral tones, tags, and typography with balanced contrast so the Korean text remains crisp.
- Overall framing: portrait poster layout with elegant editorial alignment, tactile printed-paper feeling, and believable offline flyer density.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer — soft ivory paper backdrop with subtle linen grain, faint scanned-paper flecks, gentle warm tint, and a few realistic paper fibers.
2. Brand header — {공방로고} placed near the top-left or top-center depending on balance, styled like a refined boutique atelier identity with a small flower mark.
3. Poster metadata — {행사라벨} and {날짜뱃지} displayed as small but readable printed labels, similar to an event poster issue/date note.
4. Headline block — {헤드라인} rendered prominently with strong hierarchy, allowing the quote-like phrase to become the emotional center of the poster; {서브카피} appears as a calm explanatory line.
5. Hero visual — {히어로이미지} shown as a magazine-quality floral still life or completed bouquet scene, with realistic dried petals, stems, paper wrap texture, metal scissor reflections, cotton ribbon, and natural object edges.
6. Class details — {수업종류} displayed as a neat workshop list, followed by {일정가격}, {장소}, {예약문의}, and {티켓정보} in a highly legible schedule-card section with small icons such as clock, pin, phone, and ticket.
7. Sponsor and partner footer — {스폰서} placed in a compact footer strip with muted divider lines, sponsor labels, small partner names, and a short “supported by” note.
8. Palette accents — {컬러팔레트} echoed in thin rules, botanical drawings, small stickers, paper tags, pressed-flower shapes, and subtle shadowed layers rather than heavy fills.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body and details, with a bold Korean serif like Noto Serif KR or Sandoll Myeongjo for {헤드라인}; headline size should be roughly 2.5–3.5x the info text.
- Color palette: use {컬러팔레트} as the dominant scheme, translating it into dusted pink, sage green, ivory #F6F1E8, and charcoal #2F2F2F accents.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for paper tags and hero object; thin 1px rules or subtle divider lines in muted charcoal.
- Text treatment: keep Korean text sharp, evenly tracked, and printed-like, with no distortion or decorative masking over important information.
- Detail density: include realistic poster information such as date, time, venue, reservation contact, price, ticket note, and sponsor/partner area so it feels like an actual workshop flyer.
- Decorative treatment: botanical line art, dried flower silhouettes, small paper stickers, and washi-tape corners may appear as atmospheric supporting elements, while preserving hierarchy and legibility.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: medium-format editorial still life look, Phase One IQ4 aesthetic with 80mm lens at f/5.6 for the floral hero; shallow enough separation to feel premium but not blurry.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with a gentle fill from right side and minimal shadow hardness, similar to Kinfolk-style tabletop photography.
- Color grade: muted blush, sage, cream, and charcoal with slightly lowered saturation, clean whites, and warm natural paper tonality.

[6. MOOD]
Premium boutique flower-workshop editorial — Kinfolk magazine spread feel with refined handmade craft sensibility, tactile flower-studio realism, and a calm weekend-class atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 포스터에 {헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {수업종류}, {일정가격}, {장소}, {예약문의}, {티켓정보}, {행사라벨}, {날짜뱃지}가 정확하고 읽기 쉽게 보여야 함.
- Essential rendered phrases must remain clean and legible: “오늘 만든 꽃다발, 오랫동안.”, “주말 14:00·17:00 / 2시간 / 인당 6만~9만원 / 꽃 가져갈 수 있음”, “꽃다발 / 부케 / 드라이플라워 액자 / 화분 / 리스 / 코사지”.
- Layout invariants: vertical A4 poster composition, clear hierarchy from logo to event label to headline to class info, and the hero floral visual must remain the central anchor.
- Include realistic event-poster content: 날짜, 시간, 장소, 예약 문의, 티켓 안내, 후원/협찬 영역이 실제 인쇄 홍보물처럼 배치되어야 함.
- Typography must remain fully legible and clean, with no broken Hangul, no substituted characters, and no overlapping that hides the schedule, venue, or booking text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean calligraphy and brush-lettering class poster, A4 vertical editorial flyer for studio promotion.
Designed for workshop signup, with a tactile print-poster composition that emphasizes brush, ink, hanji paper, class details, and handmade lettering atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: A4 portrait poster with a top studio logo zone, a bold headline band beneath it, a central hero image area occupying about 42% of the frame, and a detailed class-information block at the bottom.
- Subject placement: {hero 이미지} sits as the main visual anchor in the center-mid area, surrounded by natural studio-context details such as ink stone, brush rest, stacked hanji sheets, drying brush strokes, and small paper labels that support the workshop theme.
- Background treatment: matte hanji-paper texture in warm beige, with visible fiber grain, slight deckled edges, faint ink smudges, and subtle pressure marks from real printed paper.
- Spacing and framing: left-aligned text hierarchy with editorial rules, brushed dividers, tiny registration marks, and a practical poster rhythm readable from a distance.
- Poster enrichment: include event details, date/time/venue, ticket or signup information, sponsor/cooperation area, a small QR-style signup box, a red accent tag, and decorative ink-wash graphic elements that feel hand-printed rather than digital.
- Use {공방·로고}, {헤드라인}, {수업 종류}, {일정·가격}, {hero 이미지}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders exactly where the customizable content belongs.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top band: place {공방·로고} near the upper center as a studio mark, styled like a refined workshop masthead. Add tiny editorial metadata nearby: "VOL.03 WORKSHOP POSTER" and "봄학기 수강생 모집" in small, crisp type.
- Headline band: set {헤드라인} directly below the logo area, larger and more dramatic, with the feeling of brushed ink on paper and a strong vertical presence. Include the short supporting line "먹 향이 남는 저녁 클래스" beneath the headline.
- Hero area: show {hero 이미지} in the center as a close-up editorial composition of brush, ink, paper, or handwritten stroke detail; keep it crisp, tactile, and naturally imperfect. Add visible ink pooling, feathered stroke edges, a small ceramic ink dish, brush fibers, paper fibers, and a few handwritten practice sheets partially overlapping.
- Course information block: place {수업 종류} as a compact multi-line list, clearly separated with line breaks, dot separators, or thin charcoal rules. Add a small red label reading "초보 환영" and a stamp-like decorative accent reading "모집중".
- Schedule and pricing block: position {일정·가격} near the lower third in a smaller but still prominent type size, using structured lines for weekly schedule, price, trial class, materials included, ticket/signup status, and reservation note.
- Event detail row: include "2026.05.18 개강", "매주 화·목 저녁 7:30", "장소: 서촌 작업실 2층", and "정원 8명" as practical poster information.
- Signup/footer area: add "예약 문의 010-1234-5678", "@ink_studio", "신청 QR", "재료비 포함", "현장 결제 가능", and "EARLY BIRD -10%" in small supporting text, plus a sponsor/cooperation line "협력: 한지상점 고운결".
- Footer balance: use the lower margin for a realistic printed flyer finish with small contact text, a QR-style square, light ink flecks, and fine paper texture.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: combine a bold Korean serif style similar to Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the headline, with a clean sans-serif such as Pretendard for supporting details; headline weight heavy, body weight regular to medium, sizes clearly separated by hierarchy.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with hanji beige, sumi black, seal red, and charcoal; keep the red as a controlled accent for labels, small stamp marks, and signup emphasis.
- Graphic system: use thin editorial rules, hand-brushed divider strokes, small vertical labels, understated registration marks, and a QR-style signup block to make the poster feel like a real workshop flyer.
- Border/shadow: allow a subtle printed-paper edge, faint ink-wash corner texture, and a soft shadow under the hero detail, about 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity, to preserve a tactile printed-poster feel.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial still-life captured with a Canon EOS R5, 50mm lens at f/4, or an 85mm lens at f/2.8 for a tighter close-up of brush and ink texture.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at roughly 45°, with a gentle fill on the right side; preserve paper grain, ink edges, brush hairs, and ceramic ink-dish texture without harsh specular highlights.
- Color grade: warm cream and paper beige base, deep charcoal blacks, muted vermilion red accent, and slightly desaturated tones for a calm print-editorial finish.
- Material realism: show absorbent hanji fibers, uneven ink density, tiny brush bristle marks, slight paper curling, and authentic offset-print softness in small text areas.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean arts workshop editorial — feels like a refined gallery class poster combined with a warm neighborhood studio signup flyer, tactile, crafted, calm, and inviting.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "붓끝에서 피어나는 시간.", "한글 캘리", "한자 서예", "영문 캘리", "손글씨 다이어리", "디지털 캘리(아이패드)", "주 1회 2시간", "4주 16만원", "1회 체험 4만원", "도구 포함"
- Additional poster text accuracy: "봄학기 수강생 모집", "먹 향이 남는 저녁 클래스", "2026.05.18 개강", "매주 화·목 저녁 7:30", "장소: 서촌 작업실 2층", "정원 8명", "예약 문의 010-1234-5678", "@ink_studio", "신청 QR", "재료비 포함", "현장 결제 가능", "초보 환영", "모집중", "협력: 한지상점 고운결", "VOL.03 WORKSHOP POSTER", "EARLY BIRD -10%"
- The composition must remain A4 vertical with a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy: logo, headline, hero, course list, schedule/pricing, signup/footer details.
- Keep brush stroke edges, ink texture, paper grain, QR-style box, small contact text, and all Korean characters crisp and correctly formed.

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean leathercraft handmade bag advertisement poster, vertical A4-style commercial layout for premium workshop branding, handmade bag sales, and class/service promotion.
Editorial product-ad look with a warm artisan workshop feel, designed for print display, café/workshop bulletin boards, and social sharing as a premium craft poster.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top-left brand block: {공방·로고} set as a compact bilingual logo/title stack, occupying about 15% of width, paired with a small leather stamp motif and workshop tag line.
- Top-right event label: {이벤트명} in a small capsule or stitched leather label graphic, balancing the brand block and immediately signaling a special workshop/sale program.
- Main headline band: {헤드라인} placed prominently in the upper third, spanning roughly 70% of the page width with strong hierarchy and a subtle handwritten accent stroke.
- Product showcase zone: {제품 종류} arranged as a refined catalog-style visual cluster in the central to lower-middle area, with one hero bag dominant and the rest supporting around it as labeled product cards or hang-tag notes.
- Hero image: {hero 이미지} shown as a realistic still life with leather goods, waxed thread, awl, ruler, brass rivets, pattern paper, cutting mat edge, stitching pony, and worn workshop table details.
- Material/price info strip: {소재·가격} placed in a smaller text block near the lower third, visually balanced and easy to scan, with divider lines and small pictogram bullets.
- Event details band: include {날짜·시간}, {장소}, {예약·문의}, and {혜택문구} in the lower area like a premium poster information footer.
- Sponsor/collaboration area: {후원·협업} placed as small sponsor-style text or logo placeholders near the bottom, with {SNS} beside save/share-style micro icons.
- Background treatment: warm workshop desk surface with leather grain texture, matte wood, brass tool highlights, coffee-ring stains, pencil guide marks, soft shadowed corners, and tactile paper/leather textures in dark brown, beige, charcoal, and muted gold.
- Use a vertical poster framing with clear top-to-bottom reading order and enough real workshop details to feel handcrafted and lived-in.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): render {공방·로고} as the brand signature, with a clean bilingual lockup feel, slightly condensed and centered-left for a boutique workshop identity. Add {이벤트명} as a small stitched label or leather patch on the opposite side.
2. Headline area (upper 20%): place {헤드라인} in bold Korean typography, large enough to be the dominant text element, with one line or two balanced lines depending on fit; add a tiny subcaption reading “주문 제작 · 클래스 · 선물 패키지” if space allows.
3. Hero product area (mid 42%): show {hero 이미지} as the main visual anchor, styled like a premium magazine still life on a leather working desk. Arrange hammer, waxed thread, needles, edge beveler, brass hardware, paper patterns, and leather swatches naturally around the product.
4. Product variety area (lower-mid 16%): integrate {제품 종류} as smaller supporting product labels, hang tags, or a tidy product lineup with price-note markers such as “BEST”, “ORDER”, and “CLASS”.
5. Service/material area (bottom 14%): place {소재·가격} in a concise information block with clear hierarchy, using smaller type, warm gray separator rules, and icons for leather, thread, class, and custom order.
6. Event/CTA footer (bottom 10%): render {날짜·시간}, {장소}, {예약·문의}, {혜택문구}, {후원·협업}, and {SNS} like a realistic event poster footer with ticket/reservation information and small sponsor credits.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for brand and info text, and a hand-drawn accent style for the phrase “한 땀 한 땀”; headline size should feel like 68–90 px on 1024x1536.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with deep brown #4A2E21, warm beige #D8C3A5, charcoal #2D2A28, and brushed gold #B08A57; use paper-like off-white highlights near #F5EFE6.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow under the hero product, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; thin separator rules in warm gray for text sections; decorative stitches, brass rivet dots, small leather hang tags, and hand-drawn measurement ticks may frame key information.
- Poster details: include a realistic ticket/reservation footer, date/time/venue line, contact line, sponsor/collaboration area, and small social icons to make the advertisement feel like a finished printed promotion.
- Texture handling: emphasize vegetable-tanned leather pores, edge burnishing, stitch holes, waxed thread fibers, matte tool metal, and softly worn wooden desk grain.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 medium-format look with an 80mm lens at f/4 for a polished editorial product still life, shallow but controlled depth of field.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, with a faint warm rim to bring out leather edges and tool metallic highlights.
- Color grade: warm sepia-brown with beige paper tones, charcoal contrast, and restrained gold accents; keep saturation moderate and texture-rich.

[6. MOOD]
Premium artisan workshop editorial — Kinfolk magazine craft spread meets Aesop product storytelling, with a calm but high-end handmade brand presence, realistic class-poster information, tactile leather texture, and a quiet boutique workshop atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as rendered text for the following strings where used: "한 땀 한 땀, 평생 가는 가방.", "가죽공방", "이태리 베지터블 가죽", "일본산 실", "인당 25만원 ~ 80만원", "클래스 가능".
- Event and CTA text should be crisp and readable when present: "원데이 클래스 오픈", "2026.05.18 토요일 13:00–17:00", "서울 성수동 ○○ 가죽공방", "예약 문의 010-1234-5678", "수강생 키트 증정 · 당일 완성", "협업 ○○ 원단상회 · 로컬마켓", "@oo_leather".
- Keep all typography crisp and fully legible in Korean and English, including small labels, product tags, prices, date/time, venue, and contact information.
- Preserve a premium commercial poster composition with realistic leather goods, natural tool placement, no face distortion, no extra limbs, and no broken layout hierarchy.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness mashups

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean pottery one-day class promotional poster, A4 vertical editorial flyer for a ceramics studio. Designed for workshop signup, Instagram feed promotion, local class listing, and printed notice board use, with realistic event information, reservation cues, and tactile ceramic-studio atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top identity area (about 14%): {공방명·로고} as a refined studio lockup with a small English subtitle, issue-style class label, and a thin handmade-clay divider.
- Main headline zone (about 16%): {헤드라인} set large and prominent, anchored near the upper-middle so it reads first, with a short supporting caption {서브카피} beneath it.
- Event detail ribbon: include {행사 정보} as date, time, class duration, and class type in compact poster-style chips or small stacked labels.
- Hero image zone (mid 40%): {히어로 이미지} as the dominant visual, framed like an editorial studio feature with visible clay texture, tools, hands, wheel marks, glaze samples, and finished ceramic pieces.
- Class and pricing blocks: {수업 종류}, {일정·가격}, and {예약 안내} arranged as readable information cards with small icons such as calendar, clock, map pin, and ticket tag.
- Venue/contact footer: {장소·문의} plus {협력·후원} in a sponsor/partner strip, with a small reservation QR-style square, social handle, and ticket note.
- Decorative craft graphics: {장식 요소} integrated around the layout as small clay stamps, brush strokes, glaze dots, kiln-line marks, and hand-drawn ceramic silhouettes that support the workshop theme.
- Palette and background: {컬러 팔레트} with a paper-like warm off-white base, subtle craft-studio fiber texture, earthy contrast, and layered editorial depth.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone: place {공방명·로고} at the top as a compact bilingual brand mark, adding “ONE DAY CERAMIC WORKSHOP” and a small class number/date tag such as “CLASS NO. 05”.
2) Headline zone: set {헤드라인} large in a bold Korean serif, preserving the quotation style and strong visual emphasis; place {서브카피} below in a calmer sans-serif line.
3) Event ribbon: show {행사 정보} in three to four small information chips, for example “5월 주말반”, “14:00 / 17:00”, “2시간 진행”, “초보자 환영”.
4) Hero zone: show {히어로 이미지} as the primary visual, either hands shaping clay on a wheel, a cup being trimmed, glaze being brushed, or finished cups and plates on a studio table, photographed with realistic tactile texture.
5) Information zone: place {수업 종류} and {일정·가격} as two separate cards or stacked rows, each with label headers such as “CLASS”, “PRICE”, “FIRING”, and “DELIVERY”.
6) Reservation zone: include {예약 안내} as a ticket-style box with reservation deadline, deposit note, QR-style square, and Instagram or Kakao contact cue.
7) Footer zone: include {장소·문의} and {협력·후원}; add a small sponsor strip, address line, phone/contact, and “선착순 마감” note, while keeping the poster clearly readable at 1024x1536.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: headline in Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Serif KR Bold, around 54–72px; supporting text in Pretendard Regular/Medium around 22–30px; small labels and footer information around 16–20px with clear contrast.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with clay beige #D8C1A1, warm amber #C9893E, off-white #F7F2EA, charcoal #2F2A26, and muted terracotta #A96542; keep saturation earthy and handmade.
- Poster details: use small event-label boxes, fine dividers, sticker-like ticket tags, QR-style reservation block, sponsor strip, and subtle ceramic-tool icons to make the flyer feel like a real local class advertisement.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity for the hero image, information cards, or ceramic objects; avoid hard bevels and glossy plastic effects.
- Texture handling: show real clay grains, wheel rings, glaze test tiles, linen apron fabric, wooden table marks, and paper fiber background without overpowering the typography.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial product-photo look shot on a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 for hands-and-clay closeups, or a 50mm lens for a balanced studio scene; shallow depth of field but still legible texture.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from the right, creating realistic clay highlights and soft shadows; studio-natural, not flashy.
- Color grade: warm cream + clay beige + amber + charcoal, with slightly desaturated highlights and rich midtones for a tactile ceramics-magazine look.

[6. MOOD]
Premium craft studio editorial — feels like a contemporary Korean ceramics workshop poster with the quiet tactile warmth of a magazine feature, practical signup information, and inviting handmade detail.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and without broken characters: “손끝에서 빚는 시간.”, “○○ 공방”, “○○ 도예”, “ONE DAY CERAMIC WORKSHOP”, “컵·접시·꽃병·인센스 홀더”, “물레 vs 핸드빌딩”, “1회 또는 4회”, “5월 주말반”, “14:00 / 17:00”, “2시간 진행”, “인당 4.5만원”, “가마·유약 후 2주 뒤 발송”, “선착순 8명”, “예약 DM @00_ceramic”, “서울 마포구 공방길 12”.
- Required poster realism: include date/time/venue, ticket or reservation information, contact handle, small QR-style reservation square, class capacity note, and a sponsor/partner area.
- Composition invariants: vertical A4 poster framing, headline-first hierarchy, hero image as the dominant visual element, readable class information blocks, and crisp Korean typography.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / government certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness
- Fake award badges presented as official credentials

[1. PURPOSE]
Knit and crochet pattern card template for a handmade craft post, A4 portrait editorial layout. Designed to present one project like a real downloadable pattern preview with a hero image, designer credit, skill info, material specs, price/date details, and social sharing elements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Full-page A4 vertical craft pattern card with a warm editorial header, central project photograph, and practical reference blocks in the lower half.
- Subject stack: {프로젝트명} and {도안 종류} as the main topic, {히어로 이미지} occupying the visual middle, and {상세 정보} plus {준비물} arranged as labeled reference data below.
- Background treatment: warm paper-like ivory base with visible cotton-fiber texture, faint stitch-grid hints, tiny yarn lint speckles, washi-tape accents, and a handcrafted scrapbook feel.
- Add realistic pattern-card metadata: {브랜드명}, {디자이너}, {도안 코드}, {날짜}, {가격}, {소셜 핸들}, {해시태그}, and {페이지 표시} placed like a boutique craft studio release card.
- Use {컬러 팔레트} as swatches, stitch markers, small divider lines, icon tabs, yarn-label stickers, and decorative corner graphics.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band (upper 18%): set {헤드라인} in a bold Korean display style, with {프로젝트명} larger underneath or beside it; add a small issue-style label reading {도안 코드} · {날짜} · by {디자이너}.
2. Category and difficulty line (below header): place {도안 종류} and {난이도와 기간} as concise metadata chips separated by stitched dots, mini yarn-ball icons, or short ruler marks.
3. Hero panel (middle 45–50%): show {히어로 이미지} as the main focal element, framed like a printed craft-photo card pinned with translucent tape; include believable tabletop props such as yarn skeins, stitch markers, row counter, measuring tape, paper chart, pencil notes, and crochet/knitting needles.
4. Detail card cluster (lower middle 20–25%): arrange {상세 정보} in 2–4 rounded rectangles with clear labels for 게이지, 필요 실량, 바늘 호수, 완성 사이즈; include small icons for yarn weight, needle, ruler, and time.
5. Materials and chart strip: add a compact checklist using {준비물}, a tiny stitch-symbol chart preview, a measurement diagram silhouette, and a row-count note to make the card feel like an actual pattern preview.
6. Footer area (lower edge): place {브랜드명}, {소셜 핸들}, {해시태그}, {가격}, {페이지 표시}, and {CTA 문구}; include save/share micro icons, a small QR-like pattern download box, and a handwritten tip line using {팁 문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold Korean headline in Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black, subtitle in Noto Sans KR Medium, small labels in Pretendard Regular, handwritten accent in a brush-script or hand-drawn Korean style; headline around 54–72px equivalent, body 22–28px, labels 16–20px.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with ivory #F6F0E6, warm beige #D8C3A5, mustard #C79A2B, teal #4E8C8A, and charcoal #2E2E2E; keep the palette muted, tactile, and print-friendly.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal hairline rules, stitched dashed dividers, rounded cards with 10–14px radius, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12–15% opacity, no glossy effects.
- Texture: subtle recycled-paper grain, soft yarn-fiber noise, slightly uneven ink edges, rubber-stamp date texture, faint pencil measurement marks, and small fabric-label details.
- Decorative craft graphics: small yarn balls, stitch markers, safety pins, scissors silhouette, washi tape strips, row counter numbers, and tiny swatch samples may appear where they support the pattern-card story.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial flat-lay look, 35mm lens at f/4 for the overall composition, with a slightly closer 50mm crop feel for the hero panel.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, minimal hard shadowing, natural tabletop reflection kept low.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + mustard + muted teal + charcoal, with low contrast and slightly desaturated handmade print tone.
- Material realism: cotton paper, matte ink, wool fuzz, wooden needle grain, metal stitch marker glints, and soft fabric folds should be visible without turning plastic-smooth.

[6. MOOD]
Independent craft magazine spread — Kinfolk x Mollie Makes editorial feel with a calm handmade stationery aesthetic, like a cozy Korean knitting studio releasing a seasonal downloadable pattern.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열 — "한 코 한 코, 따뜻한 겨울로.", {프로젝트명}, {도안 종류}, {난이도와 기간}, {상세 정보}, "게이지", "필요 실량", "바늘 호수", "완성 사이즈".
- 실제 카드에 보이는 추가 문구 예시: "도안 미리보기", "오늘의 뜨개 기록", "저장하고 주말에 떠요", "슬라이드 1/3", "PDF 도안 다운로드".
- Pattern-card realism: include date, designer credit, pattern code, price, social handle, hashtags, QR-like download box, and a few believable hand-written correction notes around the chart preview.
- All small label boxes must remain legible and evenly spaced; the hero image must stay centered and clearly separated from the text blocks while props, textures, labels, and decorative tags enrich the handmade scene.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or misleading celebrity endorsement
- Illegible QR/text blocks that replace required Korean copy

[1. PURPOSE]
Accessory advertisement image transformation for a square social ad. Preserve the original jewelry product identity while upgrading it into a polished editorial-style lifestyle advertisement with model-worn closeups, realistic Korean campaign copy, and social-commerce details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Primary composition: the original jewelry product in {원본 정물} is translated into {변환 컷}, with tight closeups on ear, fingers, neck, and wrist occupying about 70% of the frame.
- Background treatment: magazine-like neutral ivory studio backdrop with soft depth, warm skin tones, fabric texture, and natural highlights that make the product silhouette readable and premium.
- Framing direction: crop tightly around the jewelry zones so the accessories remain the hero; build a designed typography panel and small social-ad UI elements around the closeups.
- Styling continuity: preserve the exact product look from {아이템·소재} while applying the outfit and grooming direction from {스타일링}.
- Text placement: integrate {브랜드명}, {헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {가격표기}, {날짜·장소}, {핸들}, {해시태그}, and {CTA} as refined Korean ad copy with realistic social post details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero product area: show the jewelry as worn on the model, with close framing that emphasizes surface shine, prong detail, pearl luster, gemstone sparkle, clasp detail, and metal texture from {아이템·소재}.
2) Feature crop zones: arrange a premium editorial collage of ear, hand, neck, and wrist detail areas, using soft overlapping image panels and natural crop boundaries so multiple wear contexts are visible in one square composition.
3) Outfit and grooming layer: apply {스타일링} with visible fabric weave, natural hair strands, refined nail tone, soft makeup texture, and realistic skin detail suited to a luxury accessory advertisement.
4) Brand and copy layer: place {브랜드명} as a small top label, {헤드라인} as the main Korean headline, {서브카피} as a supporting caption, and {가격표기} as a discreet product information tag.
5) Social-commerce layer: include {핸들}, {해시태그}, {날짜·장소}, a save/share micro-icon row, and {CTA} in a tasteful bottom or side card, like a polished Instagram shopping campaign.
6) Palette and finish: unify the image with {컬러 팔레트} tones, maintaining a fashion magazine feel with soft contrast, delicate sparkle accents, thin divider lines, and crisp product edges.
7) Size and format: keep the entire scene optimized for {비율} with sharp edge definition, balanced square composition, and readable Korean typography.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, mixing light, medium, and semibold weights; elegant tracking for {브랜드명}, larger refined headline treatment for {헤드라인}, and compact caption sizing for {서브카피}, {핸들}, {해시태그}, and {CTA}.
- Color palette: ivory, gold, charcoal, and nude from {컬러 팔레트}, with restrained highlight sparkle, soft neutral shadows, and warm reflective jewelry tones.
- Graphic system: use thin charcoal divider lines, translucent ivory caption cards, small foil-like sparkle marks, product-code style micro text, and rounded save/share icon buttons that feel like a realistic social ad layout.
- Border/shadow: refined editorial panel shadowing, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with delicate hairline framing around text cards and product detail insets.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame editorial fashion shot, 85mm f/1.4 portrait lens for the model closeups, with sharp macro-like detail on the jewelry surfaces.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle rim highlight to catch metal edges and gemstone sparkle.
- Color grade: warm ivory base with muted gold highlights, controlled charcoal contrast, and soft nude skin tones; clean commercial editorial grading.

[6. MOOD]
Premium jewelry magazine campaign — Vogue Korea beauty accessory editorial blended with an elegant Instagram shopping ad, calm luxury, intimate closeup styling, and polished Korean lifestyle branding.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문구: {브랜드명} / {헤드라인} / {서브카피} / {가격표기} / {날짜·장소} / {핸들} / {해시태그} / {CTA}
- Preserve the original product identity from {원본 정물} and the exact accessory material appearance from {아이템·소재}.
- Keep the model transformation consistent with the source framing: ear, finger, neck, and wrist closeups only, with the accessory as the strongest focal point.
- Hands, ears, neck, wrists, nails, and jewelry contact points must remain anatomically correct, natural, and premium-looking.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure identity swaps

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean salon advertisement poster for eyelash, waxing, and semi-permanent beauty services, designed as a polished beauty campaign poster with practical booking information, seasonal promotion details, and optional before/after proof.
Vertical A4-style commercial poster for social media and print, with premium Korean beauty-salon editorial polish, readable Korean typography, realistic salon atmosphere, and content-rich promotional details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero placement: {hero 이미지} occupies the upper 42% of the layout as the visual anchor, cropped tightly around eyes, brows, lashes, brow mapping tools, tweezers, wax beads, or a treatment-bed detail, with the headline integrated over a soft translucent panel or adjacent editorial title area.
- Header zone: {헤드라인} sits in the top 16% with strong hierarchy, aligned slightly left of center for a modern magazine-ad feel; add a small campaign kicker such as “2026 BEAUTY CARE PROMO” or “NEW CLIENT EVENT” above it.
- Service block: {살롱·시술} appears beneath the header in a smaller but highly legible line, keeping eyelash, waxing, and semi-permanent treatment categories immediately identifiable.
- Information block: {시술 정보} is arranged in a mid-lower salon menu panel with compact spacing, thin dividers, dot leaders, service times, price cues, maintenance notes, and booking guidance.
- Optional comparison block: {비포·애프터} appears as a smaller boxed element in the lower third, balanced against the information block, clearly labeled “BEFORE” and “AFTER” plus Korean micro-copy such as “시술 직후 예시”.
- Promotional detail area: include realistic poster elements such as “첫 방문 20%”, “예약제 운영”, “1:1 맞춤 디자인”, “카카오 예약 가능”, a small QR-code-style booking box, phone/contact line “02-000-0000”, address line “서울 강남구 뷰티로 24”, and business hours “MON–SAT 10:00–20:00”.
- Footer and brand information: add small salon credit text, model/service credit, promotion period, and a subtle barcode or receipt-style reference strip for a real printed-ad feeling: “PROMO PERIOD 2026.05.01–05.31”, “MODEL: JIYUN”, “PHOTO: SALON ARCHIVE”.
- Background surface: soft nude-beige or warm off-white satin paper backdrop with realistic salon-editorial texture; include delicate shadows from beauty tools, faint cosmetic powder marks, pearl pins, clean cotton pads, brow pencil, wax spatula, or lash brush details where natural.
- Use {살롱·시술}, {헤드라인}, {hero 이미지}, {시술 정보}, {비포·애프터}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders throughout the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (upper 42%): {hero 이미지} rendered as the dominant focal image, either a close-up of a woman’s eyes and brows after lash or brow styling, or an elegant still life of beauty tools on a salon tray, with soft realistic shadow, crisp edges, fine skin texture, individual lash strands, and credible treatment-room lighting.
2. Headline area (top band): {헤드라인} set in bold Korean display type with strong contrast, positioned to feel like a premium salon campaign headline; include the exact Korean cover-style line “매일 아침, 5분이 줄어드는 마법.” as a supporting slogan when possible.
3. Service identifier line: {살롱·시술} placed directly under the headline in a smaller clean sans-serif line, clarifying service category and treatment types at a glance; add small separator dots or tags such as “속눈썹펌 · 브라질리언 왁싱 · 눈썹 반영구”.
4. Information panel (mid-lower): {시술 정보} arranged as structured salon service details with separators, dot leaders, time, price, retouch period, aftercare, and consultation notes; include short Korean rows like “소요시간 60–90분”, “유지기간 4–6주”, “첫 방문가 ₩59,000~”, “당일 세안 주의”.
5. Comparison block (lower section): {비포·애프터} shown as a boxed before/after comparison if used, with symmetrical proportions, consistent cropping, small labels “BEFORE / AFTER”, and caption text “개인별 결과 차이 있음” so the result feels credible and tidy.
6. Booking and trust details: add a bottom-right QR-code-style reservation block labeled “빠른 예약”, a small channel handle “@your_salon”, contact line, address, business hours, and “100% 예약제” as realistic commercial poster information without implying official certification.
7. Footer color support: {컬러 팔레트} applied to accents, thin rules, highlight tags, price markers, service icons, and small decorative stars or curved line graphics so the poster feels coordinated and brand-consistent.
8. Canvas ratio discipline: {비율} maintained as a strict vertical poster grid with clear hierarchy from hero to headline to service menu to booking footer, allowing natural salon props and printed-ad details around the main content.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the headline at roughly 58–72px, Pretendard Medium for supporting lines at 24–32px, and Noto Sans KR Regular for details at 18–24px; use small condensed English labeling for “BEFORE”, “AFTER”, “BOOKING”, and “PROMO PERIOD”.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트} with soft pink, nude beige, charcoal, and gold accents; suggested tones include #F3D7D7, #E9D7C7, #2E2E2E, and muted gold #B89A5A.
- Border/shadow: thin gold separator lines, soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity for hero, comparison boxes, booking QR area, and service cards.
- Texture: matte paper or satin print finish with subtle grain, realistic ink density, soft cosmetic powder texture, and gentle reflections on tweezers, lash brushes, wax jars, or acrylic salon trays.
- Decorative details: use small blush-pink stickers, gold line flourishes, tiny sparkle icons, service tags, dot dividers, and receipt-like footer marks to make the poster look like an actual salon promotion rather than a flat mockup.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 portrait look for the eye/brow close-up, or Canon EOS R5 with 50mm macro at f/4 for the beauty-tool still life; clean focus, shallow depth of field, sharp lashes and brows, and softly blurred salon background.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from the right, controlled cosmetic highlights on skin and tools, and natural shadow softness across paper panels and product surfaces.
- Color grade: soft blush pink + warm beige + charcoal contrast, with restrained gold accents, slightly desaturated skin tones, creamy highlights, and polished beauty-campaign retouching.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean beauty editorial ad — Elle Korea / W Korea campaign polish blended with a real Gangnam salon promotion: feminine, trustworthy, appointment-ready, detailed, and commercially usable.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following exact Korean string must appear correctly in the layout: “매일 아침, 5분이 줄어드는 마법.”
- Include believable Korean promotional text where appropriate, such as “첫 방문 20%”, “1:1 맞춤 디자인”, “빠른 예약”, “유지기간 4–6주”, “당일 세안 주의”, “서울 강남구 뷰티로 24”, and “@your_salon”.
- Preserve clean facial anatomy if a model is shown: eyes, brows, lashes, eyelids, and skin proportions must look natural and professionally retouched, with visible individual lash strands and realistic brow texture.
- If a before/after block is used, the comparison must stay visually balanced, clearly labeled, and credible, with a small disclaimer “개인별 결과 차이 있음”.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

- Poster layout: a tall A4-style vertical ad with the {브랜드·제품} line-up anchoring the lower third, the {헤드라인} occupying the top header zone, and the main hair texture hero centered to fill about 55–60% of the frame.
- Background treatment: warm ivory studio backdrop with subtle paper grain, soft beige gradient, natural wood/stone cosmetic styling surfaces, faint botanical shadow, and refined beauty-counter realism.
- Framing direction: create an elegant premium commercial layout where headline, campaign details, benefit keywords, product lineup, CTA, QR/barcode, and small retail copy all feel intentionally typeset and ready for a printed beauty poster.
- Place {브랜드·제품} in a neat commercial lineup, {헤드라인} as the main statement, {hero 정물} as the central beauty focal point, {성분·효능} as supporting micro-copy, {모델·결} as a secondary texture/beauty accent, {컬러 팔레트} as the overall palette logic, and {캠페인 정보}, {프로모션 문구}, {구매 정보}, {용량·가격}, {리뷰 카피}, {QR·바코드} as realistic retail-ad details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band (top 15–18%): set {헤드라인} in bold Korean typography, centered or slightly left-aligned, with {캠페인 정보} as a small editorial kicker above or beside it, like “2026 봄 헤어 리추얼 캠페인”.
2. Main hero zone (middle 45–55%): render {hero 정물} as a refined beauty-ad composition, with glossy, healthy hair texture emphasized and product bottles arranged in a premium lineup; the hair should look smooth, dimensional, and touchable rather than overly retouched.
3. Texture accent layer: integrate {모델·결} as a side or lower-side supporting visual, such as a flowing hair strand close-up or partial model hair silhouette, to reinforce shine and softness while maintaining product visibility.
4. Benefit copy area: place {성분·효능} as small keyword text blocks near the hero or product base, using short separated labels with subtle dividers, ingredient dots, or thin gold rules; add {리뷰 카피} as a tiny magazine-style endorsement line.
5. Retail information strip: include {용량·가격} and {프로모션 문구} in a lower-middle or lower-right information block with small icon-like labels for “손상 케어”, “윤기”, “두피 진정”, and “컬러 보호”.
6. Brand base zone (bottom 18–22%): place {브랜드·제품} with a stable commercial layout, aligning the product lineup cleanly and keeping the lower edge visually grounded; add {구매 정보} as a CTA line and place {QR·바코드} as a small scannable-looking retail element near the bottom corner.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the headline, with 44–60px feel; use Pretendard Medium/Semibold for ingredient copy at 18–24px; use 11–14px small caps or compact Korean text for campaign date, volume, price, QR label, and promotional details.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트} with ivory #F4EFE6, warm gold #C8A45A, wood brown #8A6747, and charcoal #2D2D2D; keep all tones soft, premium, and naturally warm.
- Detail styling: use thin gold divider lines, small circular ingredient markers, cream paper labels, subtle soft drop shadows under products around 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, and realistic bottle highlights.
- Commercial realism: include practical packaging details such as bottle caps, pump nozzles, tiny front-label text blocks, volume notation, price tags, QR/barcode block, and a small campaign footer so the poster feels like a real store or magazine advertisement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial beauty-product photography with a Canon EOS R5 and 85mm f/1.4 portrait look for the model hair texture, plus a 100mm macro feel for bottle surface detail; product lineup should feel shot like a high-end cosmetic campaign.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45° with a gentle white reflector fill from lower-right, plus a faint rim light to define hair sheen; studio-clean but naturalistic.
- Color grade: warm ivory + honey gold + soft brown + charcoal, with gentle contrast and slightly creamy highlights; preserve realistic hair shine and clean bottle reflections.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean beauty campaign — feels like an Aesop / Amorepacific-style editorial ad with Kinfolk-like restraint, a polished magazine-cover finish, and believable high-end drugstore retail information.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구는 {헤드라인}, {브랜드·제품}, {성분·효능}, {캠페인 정보}, {프로모션 문구}, {구매 정보}, {용량·가격}, {리뷰 카피}, {QR·바코드}에 들어가는 모든 한글 텍스트.
- Exact rendered Korean string requirements:
  - "매일 아침, 빛나는 머릿결."
  - "2026 봄 헤어 리추얼 캠페인"
  - "출시 기념 2주 한정 15% 혜택"
  - "오늘의 윤기 루틴, 공식몰에서 만나보세요"
  - "샴푸 500ml ₩28,000 · 트리트먼트 300ml ₩32,000"
  - "사용 7일 후, 손끝에 남는 부드러움"
  - "QR로 성분표 확인 · BAR 880 247 0526"
  - 브랜드명/제품명은 {브랜드·제품}에 입력된 한글을 정확히 유지
  - 성분·효능 키워드는 {성분·효능}에 입력된 한글을 정확히 유지
- Hair and product realism: hair strands must look smooth and physically plausible, with accurate shine and flow; bottles must be cleanly shaped, evenly aligned, and labeled like real premium cosmetic packaging.
- Layout invariant: keep the headline on top, hero composition in the center, supporting ingredient copy nearby, retail information and CTA below, and the product lineup grounded at the bottom.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken or garbled Korean characters
- Misspelled required Korean text
- Unrequested celebrity composites

[1. PURPOSE]
