Specific concept: one hero perfume bottle, fragrance-note callouts, model close-up, launch information, and realistic retail campaign details for a high-end fragrance release.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero bottle is placed slightly below center, taking about 38% of the frame height, with the model close-up balanced on one side and headline occupying the upper band.
- Background is a dark charcoal-to-deep-warm-neutral editorial set with subtle gradient depth, polished stone or lacquered tray surfaces, soft fabric folds, botanical fragments, and visible perfume mist that feel natural to a luxury fragrance shoot.
- Arrange supporting campaign copy, launch date, retail information, fragrance notes, and a small barcode/QR-style purchase marker as authentic advertisement details without overpowering the hero bottle.
- Use {향수 톤·브랜드}, {헤드라인}, {서브 카피}, {hero 정물}, {노트 안내}, {모델·라이프}, {컬러 팔레트}, {캠페인 시즌}, {출시 정보}, {판매 정보}, {CTA 문구}, {향수 라벨}, {디테일 소품} as the controllable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top area: place {헤드라인} in a strong luxury masthead style, aligned cleanly with wide tracking; add {캠페인 시즌} as a small editorial line such as a season/issue marker near the top corner.
- Upper-mid area: include {서브 카피} as refined supporting copy beneath the headline, using elegant line breaks and premium magazine spacing.
- Hero center: render {hero 정물} as the visual anchor, with the bottle sharply lit, crisp glass edges, a soft grounded shadow, and faint mist, dew, petal, or leaf accents around it.
- Bottle label: the bottle front must show {향수 라벨} as a clean, readable label or engraved plaque, consistent with {향수 톤·브랜드}.
- Note zone: present {노트 안내} as a fragrance-pyramid, stacked note block, or translucent card overlay, visually secondary but legible, with fine divider rules, tiny ingredient icons, or botanical line drawings.
- Model area: integrate {모델·라이프} as a close beauty crop, with face, neck, collarbone, or wrist styling like a magazine fragrance ad, keeping the product as the primary focus.
- Launch and retail zone: place {출시 정보}, {판매 정보}, and {CTA 문구} near the lower third or bottom band with a small barcode/QR-style graphic, price line, store address, website/social handle, and purchase cue.
- Detail styling: add {디테일 소품} around the product, such as petals, dark stone, silk ribbon, atomized mist, droplet highlights, botanical sprigs, or a folded campaign card, all in the same premium art direction.
- Palette application: use {컬러 팔레트} across background, typography accents, reflections, label foil, model styling, and decorative details for a consistent luxury identity.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Sans KR Bold or Pretendard SemiBold for supporting Korean text, and a refined serif such as Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo Bold for the headline; headline size should dominate the upper third, with smaller supporting text in 16–24px feel and micro-copy in 10–14px feel.
- Color palette: translate {컬러 팔레트} into specific tones such as deep gold #B68A2E, charcoal #1E1E22, white #F7F5F0, nude beige #D8C2B0, with subtle warm metallic highlights.
- Layout rhythm: combine large headline typography, elegant note cards, label copy, retail information, and small barcode/QR elements so the poster reads like a real fragrance campaign placed in a premium magazine or boutique window.
- Border/shadow: use a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity beneath the bottle and model edges; use fine gold divider lines, delicate corner ticks, or foil-like typographic accents when appropriate, but no hard outline and no neon glow.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end beauty/product editorial look, shot as if on a Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm lens for bottle hero and an 85mm f/1.4 portrait crop for the model area, shallow depth of field but product remains tack sharp.
- Lighting: studio softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, subtle warm fill from front-right, fine rim light to define the glass edges, with controlled specular highlights on the bottle.
- Color grade: warm gold + charcoal contrast with soft ivory highlights and muted nude skin tones, inspired by luxury fragrance campaigns in Vogue Beauty and Aesop-style restraint.

[6. MOOD]
Premium niche perfume editorial — feels like a Tom Ford / Chanel fragrance campaign photographed for a high-end beauty spread, with the realism of an actual launch advertisement including product label, fragrance notes, date, price, store details, and purchase CTA.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구: "한 줄기 향, 잊을 수 없는 인상."
- 광고 안에 다음 한글 정보가 선명하게 보이도록 구성: "2026 봄 리미티드 캠페인", "공식 출시 2026.05.15", "프리미엄 부티크 및 온라인 스토어", "지금 향을 만나보세요".
- 향수 노트 안내는 "탑 노트", "미들 노트", "베이스 노트" 구분이 읽히도록 배치하고, 가격·용량 정보는 작은 리테일 카피로 자연스럽게 포함한다.
- All Korean typography must be crisp, correctly spaced, and fully legible with no broken characters.
- The composition must preserve the luxury perfume-ad balance: bottle hero, fragrance notes, model close-up, launch details, and retail CTA all visible without crowding.
- Keep the product as the primary focal point; the model must support the fragrance story, not overpower it.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity face composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness
- Nude exposure or sexual emphasis

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean base makeup advertisement poster, premium cosmetic editorial layout, vertical A4-style brand ad for social and retail display.
Focus on a clean lineup-driven composition that sells cushion, foundation, concealer, and primer as a unified base makeup system.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero section occupies the upper 42% of the frame, with {hero 정물} arranged as the visual anchor and slightly overlapping the midsection for depth.
- Header zone is centered in the top 12%, with {헤드라인} set as the primary attention point and spaced away from the edges for a polished magazine-ad feel.
- Product lineup zone spans the lower-mid 28%, showing {컬러 라인업} in a clean, evenly spaced grid with clear tonal progression.
- Texture/model support zone sits along one side or lower corner, using {모델·텍스처} to demonstrate skin finish and base coverage without overpowering the product hero.
- Overall background should be a soft editorial surface in ivory-to-nude beige, with subtle paper grain and faint studio shadowing; no busy props, no strong gradients.
- Maintain generous negative space around all text blocks, with crisp framing and balanced asymmetry like a high-end beauty magazine ad.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header: Set {헤드라인} centered in bold Korean typography, with tight vertical stacking, slightly condensed letterforms, and clear contrast against the pale background.
2. Brand/product line: Place {브랜드·제품} near the header or upper-left area in smaller supporting text, styled like a luxury campaign subline rather than a loud banner.
3. Hero still life: Build {hero 정물} as the main product cluster, with the cushion compact, foundation bottle, puff, and a few swatch strokes arranged in a refined diagonal or shallow arc.
4. Shade system: Present {컬러 라인업} as a compact set of shade cards, tiny swatches, or small labeled chips, aligned in a neat row with even spacing and visible shade separation.
5. Texture demonstration: Integrate {모델·텍스처} as a cropped skin close-up or wrist/application detail, showing smooth base finish, natural pores, and soft-focus realism without heavy retouching.
6. Palette integration: Apply {컬러 팔레트} to the background accents, shadow tones, swatch colors, and any framing devices, keeping the overall look elegant and restrained.
7. Final layout balance: Reserve clean breathing room at the bottom for ad readability, with all elements arranged as a premium product announcement rather than a crowded catalog page.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for main Korean text, bold weight for the headline and medium weight for supporting copy; headline size should feel large and poster-like, with sharp edges and clean spacing.
- Color palette: Base the design on {컬러 팔레트}, interpreted as ivory #F4F0E8, nude beige #D8C1AD, dusty pink #CFA0A0, and charcoal #2F2F31, with soft warm-gray secondary tones.
- Border/shadow: Use subtle editorial shadows only, such as soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity; no hard outlines, no glossy neon effects.
- Surface treatment: Add faint paper texture or matte cosmetic-ad texture, with a refined studio print finish and delicate tonal transitions.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: High-end beauty campaign look shot on a Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm lens at f/5.6 for the hero still life, plus an 85mm f/1.4 portrait-style crop for the skin/texture detail.
- Lighting: Soft studio key light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from right and a faint rim highlight to define product edges; controlled, diffused, and clean.
- Color grade: Warm ivory, nude beige, muted blush, and charcoal-black contrast, with a slightly soft editorial print finish and no harsh saturation.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean beauty editorial — a Vogue Korea / Aesop-inspired campaign page with restrained luxury and precise cosmetic product clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as written:
  - "피부 위 가장 가벼운 마무리."
- Korean text accuracy: preserve the following verbatim labels exactly if shown in the layout:
  - "브랜드·제품"
  - "헤드라인"
  - "hero 정물"
  - "컬러 라인업"
  - "모델·텍스처"
  - "컬러 팔레트"
- Composition invariants: keep the composition vertical, premium, and lineup-focused; all four shade variations must remain clearly distinguishable.
- Realism invariant: skin texture should look natural and not overly airbrushed; product edges should stay crisp and anatomically correct if hands or wrists are shown.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

- Distorted hands, fingers, or product shapes
- Crowded layout that hides the shade lineup

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean skincare step-by-step advertisement poster, clean beauty editorial layout, vertical A4-like social ad for skincare routine education and product branding.
Premium cosmetic campaign feel with a structured four-step product story, realistic retail information, ingredient callouts, and a polished skincare routine guide designed for a real in-store or social media launch.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main composition: {브랜드·제품} is presented as a staged skincare lineup, with the hero still life occupying the middle 55% of the frame and a clear text hierarchy stacked above, beside, and below it.
- Background treatment: smooth off-white to soft gradient backdrop, matte paper-like surface, subtle linen texture, ceramic tray, translucent water droplets, botanical sprigs, soft petals, and a small glass dish to create a believable premium skincare set.
- Framing direction: headline in the upper third, hero product routine in the center, step guidance and ingredient information in the lower third, with a small retail footer including campaign date, website-style line, QR/barcode area, and customer-service micro text.
- Use {브랜드·제품}, {헤드라인}, {hero 정물}, {단계 안내}, {성분·효능}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header zone (top 18%): place {헤드라인} centered, bold and highly legible, with a small upper label such as “SKINCARE ROUTINE GUIDE · VOL.04” and “2026년 5월 캠페인” above it for a realistic campaign-poster feel.
2) Hero zone (middle 45-55%): show {hero 정물} as the main visual, arranged as a premium cosmetic still life with four containers in a refined editorial composition on a ceramic tray; include visible product label details, caps, pumps, cream jar texture, soft shadows, condensation-like droplets, and a folded cotton towel partially visible behind the lineup.
3) Step zone (lower middle 15-20%): render {단계 안내} as a clear sequential flow, using numbered circular markers, tiny skincare pictograms, arrows, and short Korean labels that guide the routine from left to right; include a small caption line “아침·저녁 데일리 루틴” beneath the flow.
4) Ingredient zone (lower 10-15%): place {성분·효능} as concise keyword chips or small caption text, supported by delicate divider lines, tiny molecule icons, leaf illustrations, and benefit tags such as “수분”, “광채”, “장벽”, “결케어”.
5) Brand zone (integrated identity): place {브랜드·제품} as the brand/product identifier near the footer and subtly repeated on product packaging; add realistic ad details including “공식몰 단독 구성”, “₩39,000부터”, “www.brand.co.kr”, “고객센터 1588-0000”, a small QR code block, and a thin barcode-style rectangle without implying certification.
6) Layout ratio: design for {비율} within the 1024x1536 vertical poster format, balancing product photography, Korean copy, ingredient chips, and footer information like a finished cosmetic campaign key visual.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the headline in bold 800 weight, 44-56px equivalent; use 500-600 weight for supporting labels, product notes, campaign date, price, QR caption, and ingredient text, keeping the hierarchy crisp and modern.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트}, with ivory / dusty pink / sage green / charcoal accents; keep main text in deep charcoal or muted green for premium clarity, with dusty rose highlights and soft sage label panels.
- Graphic system: use rounded ingredient chips, fine divider rules, small numbered badges, translucent pastel panels, subtle botanical line art, and realistic print-ad microcopy to make the poster feel complete and commercially usable.
- Product finish: soft matte glass and satin plastic surfaces, legible Korean label printing, realistic cap seams, faint reflection on the tray, and gentle contact shadows that anchor every object.
- Footer details: add a small campaign information bar with date/time-style copy, online-store note, QR/barcode area, and short disclaimer-like product-use text in Korean at tiny but cleanly rendered size.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end product photography look, shot on a Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm or 110mm macro lens at f/8 for sharp packaging detail and clean separation.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from the front-right and a faint rim highlight to define bottle edges; controlled cosmetic reflections, natural tray shadows, and delicate highlights on droplets and glass.
- Color grade: clean beauty editorial grade with soft ivory highlights, dusty rose mids, muted sage accents, and deep charcoal text contrast; slightly desaturated, premium, airy finish with believable print-ad realism.

[6. MOOD]
Premium clean-beauty campaign — Aesop / Byredo product editorial with Kinfolk magazine restraint, enriched with real skincare retail-poster details, tactile product styling, and calm Korean beauty-brand sophistication.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and cleanly in the image: “피부의 결을 살리는 4단계.”, “1단계 토너 → 2단계 앰플 → 3단계 세럼 → 4단계 크림”, “나이아신아마이드·히알루론산·비타민C·세라마이드”.
- Additional Korean microcopy may appear as realistic poster details: “아침·저녁 데일리 루틴”, “2026년 5월 캠페인”, “공식몰 단독 구성”, “₩39,000부터”, “수분·광채·장벽·결케어”.
- Text integrity: keep all Korean characters sharp and correctly formed, with no broken syllables and no spacing errors; hierarchy should make the headline, step sequence, ingredients, brand/product name, and footer details readable.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-924.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
카쉐어링·렌터카 비교 인포카드, 4개 서비스 비교 그리드, 소셜 공유용 정사각형 카드.
짧은 시간 대여부터 주말 여행까지의 사용 시나리오를 한눈에 비교하는 모바일 친화형 정보 디자인.
실제 카드뉴스 1장처럼 날짜, 슬라이드 번호, 저장/공유 유도 문구, 출처 라벨을 포함해 정보성과 공유성을 높인다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: the hero zone occupies about 40% of the frame, with {히어로 이미지} arranged as a compact collage in the upper-middle area.
- Header block spans the top 17% with {헤드라인} as the main title, followed by a smaller comparison subtitle using {서비스 비교}.
- Add a small top meta row: {발행일} on the left, {계정명} on the right, plus a compact slide indicator {슬라이드 번호}.
- Comparison module sits in the middle 33% as a 5-box grid for {비교 항목}, with equal spacing, thin dividers, small pictogram icons, and color-coded service chips.
- Scenario strip sits in the lower 18% with {추천 시나리오} as two short quote-style callouts, aligned left and right for balance.
- Footer zone includes {해시태그}, a tiny save/share icon row, {CTA 문구}, and a small source note {출처 문구}.
- Background uses off-white matte paper with faint Seoul city-map lines, parking-pin marks, dashed road graphics, tiny fuel/EV charging symbols, and soft editorial card framing.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top meta row: place {발행일}, {계정명}, and {슬라이드 번호} in small Pretendard Medium text, using charcoal gray and one green accent dot.
2. Header area: place {헤드라인} in bold Korean typography, large and centered-left, with tight but readable line breaks; emphasize “30분” and “며칠” with green/red highlight underlines.
3. Service comparison line: set {서비스 비교} as a compact subheading beneath the headline, separated by a thin rule and small car-key icon.
4. Hero collage: place {히어로 이미지} as the main visual cluster, combining 4 vehicle silhouettes, app screen mockups, parking lot pins, a city skyline strip, and colored service labels in the order shown by {서비스 비교}.
5. Comparison grid: render {비교 항목} as five evenly sized rounded boxes, each with concise labels, mini icons, and four tiny brand-colored rating dots or short tags.
6. Scenario callouts: place {추천 시나리오} in two quote bubbles with small route arrows and calendar/clock pictograms, creating a quick decision guide.
7. Footer social layer: add {해시태그}, micro save/share/comment icons, {CTA 문구}, and {출처 문구} as real social-card details without disrupting the main reading order.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline at 44–52px, Pretendard SemiBold for subheads at 20–24px, Pretendard Regular for labels at 14–16px; keep Korean text crisp and evenly tracked.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} mapped to vivid green, muted green, saturated red, dark charcoal, and clean white; use accent colors to separate the four services and support quick scanning.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px charcoal rules, rounded 18px cards, soft drop shadow with 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity.
- Box styling: comparison boxes should have white fill, subtle tint borders using brand accents, icon-label layout, micro captions, and small check/clock/map symbols.
- Realistic UI details: add app-style top bars, tiny map pins, tab labels, price tags, insurance badge labels, and car-class chips such as “경차”, “SUV”, “전기차”.
- Social-card details: save/share micro icons, slide number, handle, hashtag line, and CTA must look like a polished Korean Instagram card news asset.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame documentary-style product composite, equivalent to a Sony A7R IV with a 35mm f/2.8 lens look, straight-on editorial framing.
- Lighting: even studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with a gentle fill from lower-right, soft reflections on the vehicle surfaces, controlled contrast across all elements.
- Color grade: bright editorial white base with saturated brand accents in green and red, neutral charcoal text, slight cool undertone for a modern app-comparison feel.
- Surface detail: matte laminated card texture, faint paper grain, subtle printed-ink edge texture, and light shadowing around each rounded module.

[6. MOOD]
실용적인 자동차 소비 가이드 카드뉴스 — 한국 모빌리티 앱, 여행 플랫폼, 생활경제 매거진의 SNS 비교 콘텐츠처럼 신뢰감 있고 빠르게 읽히는 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보이도록 할 것.
  - "30분부터 며칠까지, 차 빌리는 새 방법"
  - "쏘카 vs 그린카 vs 롯데렌터카 vs SK렌터카"
  - "시간당 가격 / 보험 포함 / 차종 다양 / 픽업 위치 / 앱 사용성"
  - "30분 잠깐 외출 → 쏘카"
  - "주말 1박 2일 여행 → 롯데렌터카"
  - "저장해두고 여행 전 비교하기"
- Render the meta/social text clearly: "2026.05 기준", "@move_compare", "1/5", "#카쉐어링 #렌터카 #국내여행".
- All four services must be represented consistently in the comparison structure, with no missing item or swapped brand order.
- Headline, comparison items, scenario text, hashtags, CTA, and source note must remain legible, properly spaced, and free of broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Missing or altered required Korean text strings
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures

studio:prompts3:ours-923.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean driving school promotional poster for admissions, license lessons, and road-driving packages, designed as a tall A4 advertising flyer for offline print, academy windows, bus-stop boards, and social media sharing.
Create a realistic local-service advertisement with strong conversion hierarchy, believable academy details, course list, pricing block, date/venue/contact information, and a bottom booking CTA optimized for fast readability.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top zone (18%): centered {학원명·로고} as the brand masthead with a small academy emblem, compact English sub-label, issue-style promo tag such as "2026 봄 등록 이벤트", and the {헤드라인} directly beneath it in a bold promotional banner style.
- Middle hero zone (42%): {hero 이미지} as the main visual anchor, framed as a real driving-instruction scene: student driver, calm instructor, academy vehicle with roof sign, road cones, crosswalk markings, blue sky reflection, and safe road-travel energy.
- Lower information zone (25%): stacked service list and price/package blocks using {수업·면허 종류} and {가격·패키지}, with extra realistic sub-panels for class timetable, shuttle notice, registration benefits, and small comparison badges.
- Bottom CTA zone (15%): {CTA·매장} placed as a strong contact strip with phone-booking, Kakao consultation, QR-code area, address line, shuttle route note, and reservation deadline.
- Background treatment: commercial poster background with subtle automotive dashboard texture, asphalt-road gradient, faint lane-line graphics, traffic-sign accents, modern blue-white-gray gradients, and yellow emphasis labels for pass-rate and package highlights.
- Use {학원명·로고}, {헤드라인}, {수업·면허 종류}, {가격·패키지}, {hero 이미지}, {CTA·매장}, {비율} placeholders exactly where user content varies.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Masthead area: place {학원명·로고} at the top center with a strong advertisement logo treatment, wide tracking, compact emblem-like balance, and small Korean/English academy descriptor such as "DRIVING ACADEMY · LICENSE COURSE".
2. Promo label and headline block: add a small date ribbon "2026년 5월 등록생 모집" and set {헤드라인} immediately below the masthead in large, bold Korean typography, occupying the visual anchor position above the hero image.
3. Hero panel: render {hero 이미지} in the central stage as a bright, persuasive driving-school visual, with instructor/student or academy vehicle composition, realistic steering-wheel/dashboard details, road-practice cones, license-test course markings, crisp edges, and believable reflections.
4. Course list panel: show {수업·면허 종류} in a neat multi-item layout, using pill labels, small vehicle icons, checkmarks, and section tags like "면허반", "도로주행", "장롱면허 연수" for fast scanning.
5. Pricing panel: display {가격·패키지} in a high-contrast box with emphasis on the package price and support benefits, plus small realistic notes such as "교재비 별도", "평일/주말반 상담 가능", and "선착순 혜택" without overpowering the main price.
6. Details strip: include believable poster information blocks: "운영시간 09:00–21:00", "셔틀 운행: 역 앞 10분 간격", "준비물: 신분증", "상담 예약 필수", and a tiny map-pin line connected visually to the bottom CTA.
7. CTA panel: place {CTA·매장} at the bottom as a contact and action strip, with a phone-booking / chat-consultation feel, QR-code placeholder box, contact icons, address line, and compact spacing.
8. Overall framing: keep all sections vertically stacked with strong separation, preserving an A4 portrait promotional flyer structure while adding real-world ad elements like barcode/QR area, small disclaimer text, sponsor/partner strip, road-sign decorations, and micro-copy.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for headlines, Pretendard Medium for details, 58–72px headline scale, 24–34px supporting text scale, 14–18px micro-copy for date, address, notes, and QR labels.
- Color palette: navy #163B6B, sky blue #4FA3D9, white #F7FAFC, light gray #E5EAF0, asphalt gray #606A75, yellow accent #FFD24A for emphasis, with small red-orange alert tags only for deadlines or limited offers.
- Border/shadow: thin white dividers, soft drop shadow 0px 8px 20px 12% opacity, rounded rectangle panels with polished brochure styling, realistic paper-print contrast, glossy hero-panel highlight, and subtle road-lane divider graphics.
- Decorative elements: use automotive icons, map pin, steering wheel symbol, traffic cone, road sign shape, QR-code box, mini timetable grid, and partner/sponsor area as small supporting graphics that make the poster feel printed and local.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm standard lens look, f/4, crisp commercial advertising perspective with slight depth separation on the hero area.
- Lighting: bright studio key from upper-left at 45° with soft fill from front-right, balanced highlight control, clean high-visibility poster lighting, and natural reflections on car windows and dashboard surfaces.
- Color grade: cool blue-white corporate grade with subtle warm yellow accents for trust, pass-rate emphasis, and promotional urgency.
- Print realism: sharp vector-style typography over a photographic hero composite, slight paper grain, believable poster ink density, clean QR/barcode-like micro area, and realistic local academy flyer finish.

[6. MOOD]
Commercial education brochure aesthetic — trustworthy, energetic Korean driving academy flyer with the disciplined clarity of a real local service advertisement, enhanced by practical details, road-practice atmosphere, and approachable registration guidance.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열:
  - "○○ 운전학원 / ○○ 자동차전문학원 — 한글 + 영문"
  - "한 번에 합격하는 운전면허."
  - "1종 보통 / 2종 보통 / 2종 자동 / 1종 대형 / 도로주행 패스 / 운전 연수"
  - "2종 자동 패키지 79만원 (이론·기능·도로주행) / 합격 보장 / 무료 재교육"
  - "학원 위치 / 셔틀버스 / 카톡 1:1 상담 / 사전 예약"
  - "2026년 5월 등록생 모집"
  - "운영시간 09:00–21:00"
  - "셔틀 운행: 역 앞 10분 간격"
  - "준비물: 신분증"
  - "QR 상담예약"
  - "평일반 · 주말반 · 야간반"
- Layout invariants: keep the poster in a vertical A4 portrait hierarchy with the headline above the hero, course/pricing information below the hero, and CTA anchored at the bottom.
- Text must be sharp, evenly spaced, and fully legible in Korean with no broken characters.
- Maintain all placeholders exactly: {학원명·로고}, {헤드라인}, {수업·면허 종류}, {가격·패키지}, {hero 이미지}, {CTA·매장}, {비율}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-922.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean 자동차보험 또는 자동차검사 광고 포스터, 세로형 A4 레이아웃, 신뢰감 있는 금융/정비 서비스 홍보물.
Direct-response ad design for either auto insurance or vehicle inspection service, optimized for quick reading, reservation, and contact action.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas is vertical A4-like 1024x1536, designed as a premium local-service advertising poster for print, storefront display, and mobile sharing.
- Use a strong top headline band, a realistic central hero visual occupying about 50–54% of the frame, a lower service-information block, and a bottom CTA footer with reservation/contact details.
- Main subject should be centered and slightly oversized for premium ad impact: a clean modern sedan/SUV, inspection bay, insurance document, tablet quotation screen, mechanic or consultant handshake depending on {히어로장면}.
- Background treatment: white to cool-gray corporate base with deep navy structural panels, gold divider lines, faint road-lane graphics, inspection checklist textures, small safety pictogram accents, and realistic paper/document details.
- Use {서비스명}, {헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {히어로장면}, {주요혜택}, {프로모션기간}, {상담전화}, {카카오채널}, {지점주소}, {영업시간}, {예약문구}, {배지문구}, {QR라벨}, {고지문구}, {컬러팔레트} as content placeholders while maintaining a clear hierarchy and official advertising tone.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (about 18%): place {서비스명} as a concise official service-brand label at the upper left or centered; include a small category tag such as “자동차보험 상담” or “자동차 정기검사 예약”. Beneath it, set {헤드라인} as the dominant bold Korean headline, with {서브카피} as a one-line support message.
2. Hero zone (middle 52%): feature {히어로장면} as the main visual, rendered like a real commercial photo. If insurance-focused, show a vehicle three-quarter front view with a consultant holding a tablet quotation screen, a signed document folder, and a handshake. If inspection-focused, show a vehicle in an inspection lane with a uniformed inspector, lift equipment, clipboard checklist, tire/brake inspection details, and readable safety signage.
3. Trust and benefit strip (lower-middle 14%): present {주요혜택} as 4 short benefit chips or rounded cards with small line icons, separated by thin gold dividers. Add {배지문구} as a credible service highlight badge, but do not make it look like a government seal or official certification.
4. CTA footer zone (bottom 16%): create a high-contrast navy or charcoal CTA bar with {예약문구}, {상담전화}, {카카오채널}, {지점주소}, {영업시간}, and {프로모션기간}. Add a small QR placeholder box labeled {QR라벨}, plus a fine-print line using {고지문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for {헤드라인}, Pretendard SemiBold for CTA, Pretendard Medium for body copy, and a clean sans-serif with tight leading for {주요혜택}; headline size should visually dominate around 54–72 px equivalent, body around 22–30 px equivalent, fine print around 14–18 px equivalent.
- Color palette: deep navy #0B1F3A, gold #C9A24A, white #FFFFFF, charcoal #2B2F36, cool gray #E9EDF2, and muted sky blue #DCE8F7 as a support tone; apply {컬러팔레트} consistently across panels, icons, dividers, and CTA elements.
- Graphic details: use thin gold dividers, rounded rectangular information cards, subtle road-line patterns, inspection checklist marks, small phone/chat/location icons, and a soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for the hero or CTA panel.
- Copy layout should feel like a real Korean local service advertisement: clear price/benefit hierarchy, visible reservation cues, practical branch information, and a balanced mix of photo, headline, and information blocks.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial advertising look, shot like a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 for the hero subject or a 35mm f/2 for wider service context, depending on whether the composition emphasizes a car portrait or inspection site.
- Lighting: controlled studio daylight feel with soft key light from upper-left at roughly 45°, gentle fill from the right, and a subtle rim highlight to separate the vehicle, inspector, consultant, documents, and CTA panel from the background.
- Color grade: corporate premium grade with deep blue shadows, restrained gold accents, neutral whites, realistic vehicle paint reflections, legible printed documents, and slightly desaturated blacks; keep contrast crisp but not harsh.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean financial-service and automotive maintenance ad — trustworthy, practical, local-business friendly, and polished like a top-tier insurance campaign combined with a dealership service poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표기할 문자열 — {서비스명}, {헤드라인}, {서브카피}, {주요혜택}, {예약문구}, {상담전화}, {카카오채널}, {지점주소}, {영업시간}, {프로모션기간}, {QR라벨}, {고지문구}.
- Render realistic Korean ad microcopy where appropriate: “무료 상담”, “오늘 예약 가능”, “정기검사 사전예약”, “카카오 채널 1:1 견적”, “보험료 비교상담”, “방문 전 전화 확인”.
- If using a car, wheels, mirrors, hands, inspector, consultant, tablet, clipboard, insurance contract, or handshake, keep anatomy and object geometry realistic; no warped vehicles, no extra fingers, no malformed documents.
- The poster must read as an actual service advertisement: headline readable from a distance, CTA clear at the bottom, branch/contact information visible, benefit chips legible, and fine print present without overpowering the design.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or identity-distorting human faces
- Unrealistic hands, warped vehicles, or malformed documents

args.name: 히어로장면
args.default: 딥블루 세단과 상담원이 태블릿 견적서를 보여주며 악수하는 장면

args.name: 헤드라인

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean bicycle advertisement key visual, landscape 3:2 banner for product promo, local bike shop campaign, and outdoor cycling event announcement.
High-impact cycling brand ad with a premium hero bicycle, real riding context, performance specs, promotion details, and a clear call-to-action.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero composition: a single {자전거 종류·브랜드} bicycle dominates the left 55% of the frame in a sharp side-profile commercial product pose, slightly angled to reveal frame depth, drivetrain texture, tire tread, brake rotors, cable routing, bottle cage, saddle detail, and realistic reflections.
- Background treatment: layered outdoor cycling context using {배경 코스}, including road markings, riverside railing or trail edge, distant riders, trees, asphalt texture, sunlit dust, and atmospheric depth while keeping the bicycle visually dominant.
- Text hierarchy: {캠페인 헤드라인} at upper-right, {서브카피} beneath it, specs block and promotion badge in the middle-right, then CTA/store information anchored lower-right with a practical retail-ad structure.
- Brand treatment: use {컬러 팔레트} as the identity system across headline accents, thin rules, CTA buttons, model badge, small icons, and dealership information cards.
- Advertising details: include a small campaign label, event date, shop address/contact, web or social handle, QR-style reservation box, and fine-print retail note so the banner feels like a real Korean bicycle store promotion.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (left 55%): place the {자전거 종류·브랜드} as a polished editorial product shot with realistic metal/carbon texture, chain, cassette, crank, spokes, brake calipers, tire sidewall lettering, and a believable contact shadow on the ground; add a helmet, water bottle, repair pouch, or folded route map as small supporting cycling accessories near the lower-left without competing with the main product.
2. Headline block (upper-right 20%): set {캠페인 헤드라인} in large bold Korean type with a compact English campaign kicker such as “RIDE READY WEEK”, using a strong two-line layout and tight line spacing for premium sports-ad impact.
3. Copy and specs panel (mid-right 22%): show {서브카피} and {스펙·특징} as a neat bullet-style cluster with icon-like separators for frame material, drivetrain, weight, wheel size, brake type, and recommended riding style.
4. Promotion and CTA zone (lower-right 18%): place {가격·프로모션}, {CTA·매장}, {행사 일정}, and {매장 정보} inside layered rounded rectangles or ticket-stub style panels; include {QR 안내} as a small QR-like square and {SNS·웹주소} as a micro footer line.
5. Decorative graphics: add subtle speed lines, route-map contour lines, small distance markers, kilometer-pin icons, thin divider rules, and a “NEW SEASON” or {배지 문구} badge to create a finished retail campaign layout.
6. Color balance: apply {컬러 팔레트} across headline accents, sponsor/dealer tags, thin rules, and CTA highlights while preserving natural outdoor tones, asphalt grain, and realistic daylight contrast.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: bold Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline, Pretendard Medium for specs, and a clean condensed English companion style for small campaign labels; headline size should feel poster-scale, specs and store details smaller but fully legible.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with planned contrast—dark charcoal text, vivid brand accent blocks, light neutral cards, and natural green/blue outdoor tones so the bicycle remains the strongest visual anchor.
- Layout system: use a premium sports retail grid with layered information cards, model badge, promo coupon strip, QR box, route-marker icons, micro captions, and realistic printed-ad spacing.
- Border/shadow: add soft realistic drop shadows under the bicycle and text cards, about 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use thin separator lines, rounded panels, and small tag shapes for hierarchy.
- Detail realism: show correct bicycle proportions, aligned wheels, accurate drivetrain placement, believable handlebar geometry, clear saddle/post angle, and realistic tire-ground contact.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: professional commercial photography look, shot like a Canon EOS R5 with a 70-200mm f/2.8 at around 135mm, f/4 for crisp product separation and controlled background compression.
- Lighting: bright outdoor studio-style daylight with soft key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from front-right, subtle rim highlight on the frame edges, and small specular highlights on rims, spokes, chain, and brake components.
- Color grade: clean premium cycling promo grade with crisp blues, greens, and charcoal neutrals, moderate contrast, slightly cool daylight balance, and restrained saturation.
- Texture: retain visible asphalt grain, rubber tire texture, carbon or aluminum frame finish, metal drivetrain detail, handlebar tape texture, subtle dust, and realistic outdoor reflections.

[6. MOOD]
Premium sports-brand campaign aesthetic — like a Rapha / Trek / Giant catalog spread combined with a realistic Korean bike-shop event banner, energetic, polished, performance-focused, and ready for weekend riding.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문자열: "오늘은 페달을 밟는 날."
- Korean rendered text must include: "시승 예약", "무이자 12개월", "한강 라이딩 위크", "2026.05.18–05.31", "가까운 매장에서 만나요".
- Korean text accuracy: {자전거 종류·브랜드}, {스펙·특징}, {가격·프로모션}, {CTA·매장}, {매장 정보}, {행사 일정}에 들어가는 한글과 숫자는 끊김 없이 자연스럽고 오타 없이 렌더링.
- Layout invariant: bicycle must remain the single primary hero object; supporting accessories and distant riders are secondary and smaller.
- Layout invariant: all headline, specs, event date, price, CTA, store information, QR 안내, and SNS text must be fully legible, with no warped letters, no partial cropping, and no broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likenesses
- Fake government safety marks or fabricated public-agency endorsements

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean motorcycle/scooter advertisement key visual, wide landscape ad layout for social media, dealer banner, and launch promo. Showcase a single flagship bike with strong motion energy, realistic dealership-campaign details, and premium automotive-commercial finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main vehicle placement: {차량·브랜드} positioned slightly off-center in a dynamic side hero angle, occupying about 55–65% of the frame width, with the front wheel angled toward the viewer for depth and a convincing tire contact patch on the road.
- Background treatment: {hero 이미지} placed on a layered urban road or open-road backdrop with lane markings, asphalt texture, guardrails, distant signage, street lights, light road spray, and atmospheric perspective; keep the environment believable while keeping the bike instantly readable.
- Text flow: headline at upper-left or upper-center with strong visual hierarchy; add a launch/date ribbon near the headline, a spec strip under the hero, a small dealer/contact information line, and CTA anchored at lower-right as a clear action zone.
- Campaign details: include realistic ad elements such as a small QR reservation box, promotion tag, financing microcopy, short legal disclaimer, tiny model credit text, and a compact sponsor/dealer strip along the bottom edge.
- Canvas structure: use {비율} as the final canvas structure with a cinematic road-ad composition and strong foreground-to-background depth.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 60%): cut out or sharply render {차량·브랜드} as the primary subject, with realistic metallic highlights, visible tire tread, brake disc detail, suspension detail, handlebar silhouette, crisp fairing contours, and a subtle ground shadow to anchor it.
2. Motion environment (background 25–30%): build {hero 이미지} with wet asphalt reflections, road spray, faint speed lines, city/neon blur or open-highway sunset haze depending on model tone, plus believable roadside details like lane arrows, barriers, crosswalk paint, and distant headlights.
3. Headline block (top 15–20%): place {헤드라인} in bold, high-contrast Korean typography with a strong wordmark feel; include a small campaign kicker such as “2026 NEW RIDE” and “5월 런칭 프로모션” above or beside it.
4. Specs block (lower-left or mid-lower): list {스펙·특징} in neatly aligned short rows with icon-like separators, small mechanical pictograms, and a dark translucent panel; add supporting micro labels like “연비”, “출력”, “ABS”, “스마트키” only if they fit the given spec content.
5. CTA block (lower-right): set {CTA·매장} inside a button-like visual container or slim banner strip, clearly separated from the specs; add small supporting copy such as “시승 예약 QR”, “오늘 상담 가능”, and “전국 매장 문의”.
6. Brand/color integration: apply {컬러 팔레트} across accent strips, speed slashes, tiny UI icons, panel outlines, reflected highlights on wet pavement, and small dealer/sponsor bars without overpowering the vehicle finish.
7. Bottom information band: add a thin realistic ad footer with “MODEL CREDIT: {차량·브랜드}”, “PROMO PERIOD 2026.05.01–05.31”, “월 ₩89,000부터”, “상세 조건 매장 문의”, page-code text like “AD-920-KR”, and a barcode/QR-style reservation area.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the headline, Pretendard Medium for specs, and Pretendard SemiBold for CTA; headline around 72–110 px equivalent, specs around 24–34 px equivalent, microcopy around 12–18 px equivalent.
- Color palette: derive from {컬러 팔레트}; use saturated brand red, deep blue, matte black, orange accent, and brushed metal silver on a dark neutral base, with small high-visibility accents for price/promo tags.
- Border/shadow: add a soft cinematic drop shadow under the vehicle (4–8 px y-offset, 18–24 px blur, 18% opacity), thin hairline separators for specs in muted gray, translucent glass panels for information blocks, and subtle metallic bevel highlights on CTA elements.
- Real ad details: add small but legible dealership footer text, QR/barcode placeholder graphics, date label, campaign tag, and fine-print disclaimer so the image feels like a finished Korean automotive launch advertisement.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: automotive-commercial look shot on a full-frame camera with a 70–200mm f/2.8 at roughly 120mm for compressed, premium subject isolation; alternate model-friendly version can feel like an 85mm f/1.8 portrait-style product frame.
- Lighting: studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a subtle rim light from rear-right, plus low-intensity fill to define chrome, fairings, tire sidewalls, brake hardware, mirrors, and helmet edges if present; reflections should look controlled, glossy, and physically grounded.
- Color grade: high-contrast commercial grade with deep blacks, metallic highlights, and brand-specific accent saturation; preserve clean asphalt grays, realistic road reflections, and controlled neon/city glow when the model theme suggests city-night energy.
- Detail realism: include fine mechanical texture, subtle dust or water beads on tires, realistic reflections on body panels, readable dashboard hints, and believable road scale cues such as lane lines and curb height.

[6. MOOD]
Premium motorcycle launch campaign — Top Gear / Ducati commercial poster energy with polished showroom realism, Korean dealer-promo credibility, and a fast, confident road-advertising feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "바람을 가르는 자유." / {헤드라인} / {차량·브랜드} / {스펙·특징} / {CTA·매장}
- Additional Korean ad text should be sharp and plausible: "5월 런칭 프로모션", "시승 예약 QR", "전국 매장 상담 가능", "월 ₩89,000부터", "상세 조건 매장 문의".
- Layout invariants: maintain a single main motorcycle hero, strong ad hierarchy, premium road-ad composition, readable promo/spec/CTA zones, and no duplicate conflicting headlines.
- Text rendering: all Korean characters must be sharp, properly spaced, and fully legible; do not distort the brand/model name, price text, QR label, or dealer CTA.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Futuristic electric vehicle advertisement banner for automotive marketing, horizontal hero composition for web ads, showroom displays, and premium social campaigns.
Create a real commercial scene that feels like a photographed launch campaign: the vehicle, environment, charging lifestyle details, performance information, and purchase CTA should all feel integrated into a believable high-end EV ad.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main vehicle placement: {차량·브랜드} in a dominant side-profile hero occupying 52–60% of the frame, angled slightly toward the viewer to emphasize body lines, wheels, headlamp signature, charging-port details, tire tread, glass reflections, and metallic paint finish.
- Background treatment: cinematic city night skyline, smart highway, or coastal nature horizon rendered with real depth, wet asphalt reflections, distant apartment lights, EV charging pylons, subtle traffic light trails, atmospheric haze, and a controlled neon glow gradient.
- Text hierarchy: headline zone in the upper-left or upper-center 20–25% of the canvas, spec zone aligned beneath it, CTA block anchored lower-right, and a thin dealership/footer information strip along the bottom edge for realistic ad context.
- Use {비율} as the final frame ratio, with readable spacing, premium alignment, and natural ad-scale placement so text does not feel cramped.
- Add realistic automotive-ad details: small campaign label “2026 EV 프리뷰”, compact date badge “2026.05”, QR-style reservation tile, charging-map pin icon, tiny legal/finance note line, and subtle illuminated road markings that guide the eye toward the car.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (center 55%): {hero 이미지} presented as a polished commercial render integrated into the scene, with crisp silhouette edges, realistic reflections from buildings and road surface, visible wheel detail, believable glass transparency, and a grounded shadow plus restrained electric underglow.
- Headline area (top 18%): {헤드라인} set large and bold, paired with a short campaign kicker such as “EV FUTURE DRIVE 2026” and “전기로 달리는 새 시대.” for a launch-ad feel.
- Spec strip (mid-lower 15%): {스펙·특징} arranged as concise performance callouts separated by dots, vertical dividers, or small battery/speed/charging icons; include “주행거리 524km”, “0~100 5.2초”, “초고속 충전 18분” with premium infographic styling.
- CTA zone (bottom-right 12–15%): {CTA·매장} placed inside a compact call-to-action module with button-like emphasis, including “시승 예약”, “가까운 매장 검색”, “보조금 신청”, a small QR-style square, and a dealership location line such as “서울 강남 EV 스튜디오”.
- Brand context layer: {차량·브랜드} integrated naturally as the product focus, with a tasteful emblem/wordmark placement, small model-name credit line, and launch badge such as “NEW ELECTRIC LINE-UP”.
- Supporting information layer: add a slim lower footer with realistic microcopy, example financing note “월 납입 예시 및 보조금은 지역별 상이”, reservation date text, web-style URL placeholder text, and tiny icon labels, all sharply typeset and secondary to the hero.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline, Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR SemiBold for specs and CTA, sizes roughly 54–72px headline / 22–28px supporting text on a 1536x1024 canvas; microcopy around 11–15px but still legible.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} applied with deep charcoal #111318, electric blue #2F6BFF, cool white #F5F8FF, and neon accent glow in cyan or yellow depending on the brand match.
- UI and graphic accents: translucent glassmorphism spec cards, thin electric circuit-line motifs, battery percentage graphic, charging pulse line, small map-pin marker, and road-lane light streaks that reinforce the EV theme.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow 0px x-offset, 10px y-offset, 24px blur, 18% opacity for text panels; vehicle edge glow kept restrained and realistic, with reflections and shadows responding to the environment.
- Layout richness: include enough real-world advertising details—date badge, dealer footer, QR-style CTA, finance/legal microcopy, small icons, and environmental reflections—to feel like a finished automotive campaign rather than a mockup.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm or 50mm automotive commercial lens look, equivalent to a Phase One IQ4 with 80mm at f/5.6 for crisp product realism and controlled perspective.
- Lighting: studio-style key from upper-left at 45° combined with cool rim light from the rear-right, plus faint city/neon bounce, charging-station glow, and wet-road reflection highlights to define the silhouette and metallic surfaces.
- Color grade: high-contrast midnight graphite base with electric blue highlights, cool silver reflections, and clean white typographic accents; slight teal-magenta sci-fi bias without oversaturation.
- Rendering detail: photoreal automotive paint, accurate headlamp bloom, realistic tire contact patch, detailed alloy wheels, subtle windshield reflections, believable road texture, and fine atmospheric particles in the light beams.

[6. MOOD]
Premium future-tech automotive launch ad — Apple keynote product reveal meets BMW i-series commercial polish, with the cinematic realism of a late-night test-drive campaign and the urgency of a limited pre-order event.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “전기로 달리는 새 시대.”, “주행거리 524km”, “0~100 5.2초”, “초고속 충전 18분”, “시승 예약”, “가까운 매장 검색”, “보조금 신청”.
- Additional intended Korean/label text may include: “2026 EV 프리뷰”, “사전계약 혜택”, “서울 강남 EV 스튜디오”, “NEW ELECTRIC LINE-UP”, “월 납입 예시 및 보조금은 지역별 상이”.
- All typography must remain sharp, legible, and professionally aligned; no broken Korean characters, no warped letters, no accidental gibberish copy.
- Composition invariants: one main vehicle hero, one headline block, one spec block, one CTA block; supporting footer, QR-style tile, icons, and environmental details must enhance the ad hierarchy without overtaking the vehicle.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Single-subject bakery product close-up for editorial menu use, designed as a square still-life image that spotlights one bread item with premium texture detail.
Create a realistic bakery magazine / café menu photograph where one hero bread feels freshly baked, tactile, and purchasable, with small real-world shop details such as a price label, tray textures, crumbs, linen, and café table atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: one {빵 종류} occupies the center 55–65% of the frame, with the strongest crust, crumb, butter sheen, flake, or baked edge detail facing the camera.
- Surface and background: arrange {상차림} on a warm beige tabletop, wooden board, matte ceramic plate, or bakery tray; include visible linen weave, ceramic speckles, wood grain, pastry crumbs, and small flour dust for a lived-in café editorial feeling.
- Framing and spacing: use {각도} as a close food-photography composition, letting the bread feel generous and dimensional while surrounding props create scale, story, and appetite.
- Prop balance: style {촬영소품} around the lower third and side areas with believable café objects such as a butter knife, jam spoon, torn parchment, folded linen, herb sprig, coffee cup, tiny flower, and a small printed product label.
- Menu detail: include a small tabletop card or parchment tag with {베이커리명}, {상품명}, {가격}, and {매장정보} printed in clean Korean, positioned naturally beside the bread as part of the scene rather than as a digital overlay.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero bread area: present {빵 종류} as the only primary subject, sharply detailed with visible crust, crumb, glaze, seeds, scoring marks, layered folds, or toasted edges depending on the bread type.
2. Supporting setup: place {상차림} as a refined still-life base, with butter, jam, herbs, coffee, and serving ware acting as appetite cues and scale references.
3. Surface accents: integrate {촬영소품} with natural bakery messiness—linen folds, fine flour dust, a few crumbs, a small knife, parchment, a single flower, or handwritten-style tag—so the photograph feels prepared for an actual café menu shoot.
4. Camera angle: follow {각도} so the bread volume, cut surface, flaky layers, or crust bubbles remain readable, with shallow depth separating the hero from the tabletop and background objects.
5. Color balance: apply {컬러} as the dominant palette across bread crust, props, shadows, typography, and tabletop materials, maintaining warm baked tones with refined contrast.
6. Light behavior: shape the bread with {조명} so shadows are soft-edged, highlights stay gentle, and texture remains crisp without greasy glare or plastic smoothness.
7. Editorial realism: let the scene include subtle café context—cup rim, jam glint, butter smear, ceramic texture, parchment crease, tray edge, and small crumbs—while keeping the bread visually dominant.
8. Text readiness: the product label should be legible and integrated into the still life; the overall image may also work as a menu thumbnail, product card, or bakery social post.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Photographic texture: shallow depth of field, crisp micro-detail on the hero bite area, slight lens falloff at the corners, real reflections on glazed bowls, and natural grain in the table surface.

[6. MOOD]

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: no large visible Korean typography is required; if tiny prop text appears, render it cleanly as Korean, for example “오늘의 한상”, “따뜻할 때 드세요”, “국산 김치”, or “₩12,000”.
- Anatomy/layout invariants when relevant: steam should look natural and physically plausible; food should remain anatomically correct in shape and portioning, with no melted chopsticks, duplicated utensils, floating bowls, or impossible ingredient geometry.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Full-page vertical layout with the hero still life centered in the lower-mid 55% of the frame, while the upper 22% carries the headline, brand cue, and campaign date in a magazine-ad hierarchy.
- {주류 종류} is the visual subject, presented as a single-category advertisement with one dominant bottle/serving setup, not a mixed drinks collage.

- Headline sits near the upper third with premium spacing; nearby microcopy includes {서브카피}, {캠페인태그}, and a small issue-style line such as seasonal release date or tasting note.
- Use {hero 정물} as the main object grouping, with believable spacing between bottle, glass, garnish, label, coaster, side dish, and serving tools.
- Color treatment follows {컬러}, with highlights appearing on label foil, glass rim, liquid reflection, garnish, and shadow tint.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (upper 18%): place {브랜드명} as a small premium brand mark at the top, then place {헤드라인} in a strong Korean serif treatment, centered or slightly left-aligned depending on balance, with a short supporting line {서브카피} beneath it.
2. Campaign detail strip: add realistic ad details such as {행사정보}, {가격정보}, and {캠페인태그} in small but legible Korean sans-serif type, like a retail magazine insert or tasting event poster.
3. Hero still life zone (middle 50%): stage {hero 정물} as the focal point, with the bottle or main vessel largest, the glass secondary, and garnish/side dish smaller and slightly offset for realism; include readable label fragments, condensation, liquid meniscus, and table-contact shadows.
4. Table layer (lower mid 20%): build {상차림} as a believable serving scene, with the board, plate, cup, chopsticks, coaster, napkin, dried flower, fruit slice, cheese, jeon, skewer, or small ceramic dish anchoring the product and creating depth through subtle overlap.
5. Brand/type detail zone: add {타이포} as a compact premium label area, using small caps for English brand text and a restrained Korean subtitle beneath it; place {매장정보} along the bottom like a real printed ad footer.
6. Legal footer: include {법적문구} in tiny clear Korean text at the lower edge, separated by a thin divider line, so the poster feels like a real alcoholic beverage advertisement.
7. Color accent pass: apply {컬러} through label highlights, garnish reflections, small dividers, date badges, tasting-note icons, and shadow tint.
8. Final polish: maintain exact Korean readability, crisp edges on bottle and glass, realistic reflections, a premium print finish, and a single elegant hero grouping.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the headline in bold 700–800 weight, with 52–72px visual scale; use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for smaller supporting text in 400–500 weight, 18–28px scale; {타이포} should feel like a vintage premium label with a modern retail footer.
- Color palette: derive from {컬러}; for wine use burgundy #5A1E2D, oxblood #3E0F1C, champagne gold #C8A96A; for traditional liquor use warm white #F5F1E8, rice-cream #E8DDC8, muted jade #7A9B8B; for soju use crystal clear tones, cool gray #D7DCE1, teal accent #3D6E73, gold #B89A5A.

- Finish: clean editorial print look, slightly textured paper feel, subtle contrast, controlled reflections, crisp label detail, and sharp Korean text edges.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

[1. PURPOSE]
Single dessert close-up photo for a menu, social post, or cafe product showcase. Focus on one plated {디저트} with tactile texture, appetizing detail, and polished editorial cafe styling that feels ready for a real dessert menu.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: one {디저트} occupies the central 55–65% of the square frame, with a tight, appetizing crop that keeps the dessert as the undeniable hero.
- Background treatment: real cafe tabletop with subtle matte ceramic, stone, wood grain, linen, or paper menu texture; softly blurred surrounding details should add atmosphere without stealing attention.
- Framing direction: close-up 45° or macro-front composition based on {각도}, showing height, layers, glaze, cream, fruit, crumbs, sauce, or baked edges with realistic depth.
- Table setting: {상차림} arranged around the hero as a believable cafe scene: dessert fork or spoon, folded linen napkin, small ingredient accent, sauce smear, crumbs, coffee cup edge, tiny menu tag, or receipt-style label as appropriate.
- Ratio control: compose for {비율} while keeping the plated dessert prominent and readable in a 1024x1024 product image.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero dessert zone: place {디저트} in the center, sharply focused, with visible surface detail such as crumbs, glaze shine, cream layers, powdered sugar, fruit moisture, chocolate dust, toasted edges, or baked texture rendered clearly.
2. Plating layer: build the base with {상차림}, using one primary plate, bowl, tart stand, or dessert tray plus believable cafe accents like a spoon, linen fold, tiny garnish pieces, cocoa powder specks, sauce drops, or a small menu card.
3. Cafe detail layer: include a small printed dessert label or table card near the plate with short Korean copy such as '오늘의 디저트', '시즌 한정', '₩7,500', and '부드러운 크림과 제철 과일'; keep it secondary but legible.
4. Light-and-shadow layer: apply {조명} so the dessert’s contours, edges, toppings, and plate rim read clearly, with natural soft shadows, gentle highlights, and realistic reflection on glaze or ceramic.
5. Angle and texture layer: render from {각도} to emphasize depth, layering, and surface finish without distortion; foreground crumbs and plate edge may fall softly out of focus.
6. Color coordination layer: use {컬러} so the dessert remains the focal point while the full tabletop palette feels cohesive, warm, and menu-ready.
7. Styling layer: include {스타일링} with refined magazine-like still life balance, allowing natural cafe details, garnish fragments, napkin texture, and tableware character to make the image feel lived-in and premium.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if a small menu label, receipt, or table card appears, use Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Medium, 18–24px equivalent, clean Korean lettering; suggested text: '오늘의 디저트', '시즌 한정', '₩7,500', 'CAFE DESSERT No.12'.
- Color palette: match {컬러}; favor cream #F6F1E8, warm beige #D9CBB7, cocoa brown #6B4E3D, soft pastel accents, berry or citrus highlights when relevant, and muted gold reflections on cutlery or glaze.
- Surface and shadow: use believable contact shadows under the plate, spoon, napkin, crumbs, and menu card; soft drop shadow feel around 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under the plate or stand.
- Food realism: frosting, glaze, fruit, pastry, cream, or sauce should show tiny imperfections, knife marks, air bubbles, crumb structure, condensation, and natural handmade variation.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame macro or close-up setup, 90mm macro lens at f/2.8 or 100mm macro at f/4, crisp subject separation with shallow depth of field.
- Lighting: {조명} with directional side light from left or right at about 45°, gentle fill from the opposite side, realistic soft-shadow falloff, appetizing highlights on glossy or creamy surfaces.
- Color grade: warm editorial food photography grade with creamy whites, caramel highlights, cocoa shadows, and controlled contrast; keep dessert colors appetizing and natural rather than oversaturated.

[6. MOOD]
Premium dessert editorial still life — Kinfolk x Mijitoor-style cafe menu photography with tactile tabletop details, cozy afternoon cafe atmosphere, and a polished product-photo finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 한글 정확
- Render any visible Korean text exactly and legibly, such as '오늘의 디저트', '시즌 한정', '₩7,500', '부드러운 크림과 제철 과일'.
- Preserve a single-dessert hero composition with close-up texture emphasis, realistic plating, and cafe-ready styling.
- Keep the image realistic, polished, appetizing, and suitable for a premium dessert menu or social post.

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]

Flat lay / 45-degree hybrid composition that feels like a real curated café magazine spread, combining appetizing food photography with a visible café menu/pricelist layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main plating zone: {대표 메뉴} arranged as the clear hero subject, occupying about 55–60% of the frame, with realistic café table context around it: plates, cutlery, napkin folds, drink glasses, crumbs, sauce streaks, and small garnish details that make the meal feel freshly served.
- Surface and setting: white tabletop with visible wood grain texture, paired with a natural wood tray, white ceramic plates, stainless cutlery, linen napkin, and a small printed menu card; show tactile materials such as ceramic glaze, condensation on glass, toasted bread texture, egg gloss, fruit skins, and coffee crema.
- Side props: include small coffee and juice accents near the lower-right or upper-left edge, plus jam dish, butter knife, syrup cup, receipt slip, subtle flower stem, folded café newspaper, or book corner as part of {스타일링}, arranged naturally like a real brunch table.
- Menu/pricelist element: place a small refined café menu card or standing paper menu partially visible beside the hero dish, with store name, address/contact line, decorative dividers, and multiple Korean menu items with prices, e.g. "브런치 카페 메뉴", "아보카도 에그 토스트 ₩13,500", "프렌치 토스트 ₩12,000", "그릴드 샌드위치 ₩11,500", "아메리카노 ₩5,000", "오렌지 주스 ₩6,500".
- Framing and spacing: keep the food centered or slightly off-center depending on {각도}, with lively but organized café-table layering so the composition feels authentic, dimensional, and ready for a real menu/social post.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero dish area: showcase {대표 메뉴} as the most visually dominant plate arrangement, with crisp food definition, fresh garnish, appetizing layering, visible sauce sheen, toasted edges, soft egg or cream texture, fruit highlights, and small edible details that communicate freshness.
2. Table styling layer: place {상차림} beneath and around the hero dish, ensuring the wood tray, ceramic plate, napkin, side drinks, cutlery, and menu card read clearly while overlapping naturally like a real café table setting.
3. Light and shadow layer: apply {조명} so shadows remain soft and natural, with gentle contrast that preserves texture on eggs, toast, cream, fruit, sauce, coffee crema, glass condensation, paper grain, and wood tabletop.
4. Color balance layer: keep {컬러} across food, props, and tabletop materials, with warm ivory whites, natural green accents, muted yellow highlights, fresh fruit tones, light wood brown, and dark charcoal anchoring details.
5. Camera angle layer: render from {각도}, maintaining clean geometry, visible plating structure, readable menu/pricelist details, and an editorial tabletop perspective suitable for a square social media brunch post.
6. Styling details: incorporate {스타일링} through realistic edge details such as a folded newspaper section, small flowers, handwritten order slip, spoon reflection, linen wrinkles, café stamp graphic on paper, and a few natural crumbs or herbs near the plate.
7. Format fit: preserve the square {비율} framing with a polished brunch-cafe menu aesthetic, ensuring all key food items stay fully visible and the supporting menu/pricelist elements remain legible enough to enrich the image.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: include small café-menu typography on the printed menu card using Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium; make the Korean text neat and readable, with clear item names, prices, address/contact line, and simple decorative dividers.
- Korean text on menu card may include: "브런치 카페 메뉴", "오늘의 브런치", "평일 10:00–15:00", "서울 성동구 카페거리 24", "예약 02-1234-5678", plus several short item/price lines that match the brunch theme.
- Color palette: use ivory, natural green, warm yellow, charcoal, off-white, light wood brown, muted cream, and small accents from fruit or jam; align with {컬러} and keep saturation moderate.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with natural contact shadows under plates, glasses, tray edges, paper menu, and cutlery.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 50mm lens for a tabletop editorial look, shot at f/4 for crisp food detail and gentle depth separation.
- Lighting: bright window light from the left at about 45°, diffused through sheer white curtains, with a faint fill from the opposite side to keep shadows soft while allowing realistic highlights on ceramic, glass, coffee, fruit, and sauce.
- Color grade: warm cream + sage green + soft butter yellow + charcoal-neutral balance, with a clean café editorial finish and realistic food-photography texture.

[6. MOOD]
Modern brunch editorial — a warm, lived-in Kinfolk-style café spread with the polished clarity of a lifestyle magazine food shoot and the practical detail of a real brunch menu/pricelist.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "브런치 카페 메뉴" must appear correctly on the visible menu card if any text is rendered in the image.
- Render Korean menu text cleanly, such as "오늘의 브런치", "아보카도 에그 토스트 ₩13,500", "프렌치 토스트 ₩12,000", "아메리카노 ₩5,000", and "서울 성동구 카페거리 24" without broken characters.
- Preserve the exact square composition feel, with the food presentation reading as a brunch café menu photo rather than a lifestyle portrait.
- Keep hands, people, and faces out of frame unless absolutely necessary; if any human element appears, it must remain natural and unobtrusive, such as a partial hand placing a cup at the edge.

studio:prompts3:ours-910.content:
[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean kids camp, experiential learning, and museum tour advertisement poster for parents and guardians. Vertical A4-style promotional layout with a large hero scene, clear schedule, inclusion details, and booking price block.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: {hero 이미지} occupies the upper 48–52% of the frame as the main visual, with energetic but clean spacing so the poster still reads like a premium education ad.
- Header zone: {헤드라인} placed in a bold top banner area, spanning about 80% of the width, with strong hierarchy and enough margin for legibility.
- Information zones: {일정·기간} and {포함 내용} arranged in stacked rounded cards or boxed modules in the middle-lower section, with clear separation and consistent alignment.
- Booking zone: {가격·예약} placed near the bottom as the primary call-to-action block, visually heavier than the schedule card but smaller than the headline.
- Program label: {캠프·프로그램} used as a concise category line near the headline or subheader area.
- Maintain generous outer margins, clean grid alignment, and a balanced left-right rhythm suitable for a parent-facing brochure poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (top 50%): {hero 이미지} shown as the dominant scene with lively outdoor activity or hands-on learning energy, cleanly framed without clutter, with subtle depth and crisp detail.
2. Headline strip: {헤드라인} set over the hero or in a dedicated top block, using strong contrast so the Korean text reads instantly from a distance.
3. Program label line: {캠프·프로그램} positioned directly under the headline as a short descriptor, sized smaller but still prominent enough to define the offering.
4. Schedule card: {일정·기간} placed in a neat informational panel, using icons or small separators only if they do not reduce readability.
5. Inclusion card: {포함 내용} presented as a compact benefit list block, with text broken into short readable segments and aligned for quick scanning.
6. Price / reservation block: {가격·예약} in the lowest emphasis-heavy panel, visually distinct with a colored background, bold price weight, and reservation urgency.
7. Footer safety spacing: leave enough breathing room at the bottom so the composition feels like a finished print ad rather than a crowded flyer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for labels, Pretendard Regular for detail text; headline around 56–72px, body around 24–30px, with tight but readable line spacing.
- Color palette: bright sky blue, sunshine yellow, coral orange, fresh grass green, white, and deep navy accents; use saturated but controlled educational-camp colors.
- Border/shadow: rounded cards with soft drop shadow 0px 8px 18px at 14% opacity, thin white separators, and gentle outline contrast for clean poster readability.
- Text treatment: Korean text must be crisp, high-contrast, and evenly kerned; avoid decorative distortion that could damage readability.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary-style 35mm lens look for the hero scene, f/2.8, natural perspective with lively environmental context; infographic poster compositing for the text areas.
- Lighting: bright daytime soft sunlight, slightly diffused from upper-left, with clean fill on faces and objects; no harsh shadows, no dim indoor mood.
- Color grade: vibrant primary-school campaign grade with crisp whites, cyan-blue sky tones, warm skin tones, and fresh green/yellow accents.

[6. MOOD]

[1. PURPOSE]
Child-focused martial arts academy advertisement poster in vertical A4 layout, designed for print flyer distribution, apartment elevator notice boards, school/community bulletin boards, and local SNS reposting.
High-impact taekwondo/kendo academy marketing poster with a strong central hero image, bold Korean headline, realistic academy details, class benefits, trial-class callout, contact strip, and energetic youth sports atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Tall vertical poster with a headline band at the top, a dominant hero zone occupying the mid-frame, and layered information blocks in the lower section like a real local academy flyer.
- Background treatment: deep black martial-arts base with red diagonal energy bands, brushed texture, faint dobok fabric grain, subtle dojo floor lines, crisp white information panels, and metallic gold separators; surface should feel like premium martial arts branding with realistic printed-poster depth.
- Composition should feel disciplined and promotional: strong left-right symmetry in the main layout, but enriched with practical poster elements such as a trial-class badge, contact line, QR placeholder box, sponsor/support strip, and small academy notice labels.
- Include realistic local-ad details around the core content: short Korean benefit tags, date/time/venue information, ticket-style trial lesson info, parent consultation notice, small footer credits, and decorative martial-arts graphic accents.
- Use {학원명·관장}, {헤드라인}, {수업 종류}, {대상·일정}, {hero 이미지}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} as editable placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: place {학원명·관장} as the academy identity, with a small label above such as "2026 신학기 수련생 모집" or "우리 동네 무도 교육"; set {헤드라인} directly below in the largest type with sharp black/red contrast and a thin metallic gold divider line.
- Add 2-3 short supporting headline blurbs near the top or beside the headline: "예절부터 자신감까지", "첫 달 무료 체험 상담", "형제·자매 동반 등록 문의". Keep them short and readable.
- Hero area: feature {hero 이미지} as the main visual anchor, framed like an energetic academy promo photo. If it is a child action shot, keep the pose dynamic, uniform crisp, belt detail visible, and show natural motion cues such as a soft kick arc, kendo shinai angle, light floor shadow, or drifting chalk/dust particles.
- Surround the hero with realistic poster graphics: red slash shapes, gold rank-line dividers, subtle halftone dots, faint Korean brush-stroke texture, and small martial-arts icons such as belt stripes, target pads, shinai silhouettes, or dojo floor markings.
- Info block 1: list {수업 종류} in concise bullet-style lines with small square separators, plus a label such as "수업 프로그램" and a small note line like "기초반 · 성장반 · 승급반 운영".
- Info block 2: present {대상·일정} as a schedule/eligibility panel with compact line breaks, making age range, weekday hours, class frequency, and rank progression easy to scan; include a small calendar-like label such as "상담 가능 시간 14:00~21:00".
- Trial/event module: add a ticket-style coupon panel or rounded promo tag reading "무료 체험 1회권", "선착순 체험 예약", "운동복 지참 · 보호자 상담 가능" without implying an official certification.
- Bottom band: apply {컬러 팔레트} across accent rules, section dividers, class chips, and footer graphics; include contact-style poster details such as "문의 02-123-4567", "카카오톡 @kids_mudo", "주소 서울시 ○○구 무도관로 25", and a small QR placeholder labeled "체험 예약 QR".
- Sponsor/support strip: include a small realistic local partner area with neutral labels such as "지역 체육 활동 후원", "학부모 안내 데스크", "안전 수련 체크리스트 제공"; keep it visually secondary and not official-looking.
- Footer strip: reserve {비율} as the format-consistency cue within the layout logic, but do not visibly print any technical metadata unless it is part of the designed poster. Add tiny production credit text such as "Design for community notice / 2026 Spring" if it fits the poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the headline, Noto Sans KR Bold for section labels, and Pretendard Medium for details; headline size should dominate, while class information, date/time, venue, contact, and small captions remain sharply legible.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트} with deep black #0B0B0D, strong red #C1121F, clean white #F7F7F7, and metallic gold #C8A24A; use red for impact and urgency, white for information clarity, and gold for premium dividers, belt-rank accents, and small highlight rules.
- Border/shadow: apply sharp rectangular panels with thin gold lines, red corner tabs, subtle paper-print texture, and a drop shadow of 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 14% opacity to lift the hero and text blocks from the background.
- Use realistic print flyer finishing: slight ink density variation, fine paper grain, crisp vector-like Korean typography, small barcode/QR-style reservation box, and layered poster hierarchy that feels like a real academy advertisement.
- Decorative elements should support the martial-arts theme: belt stripe motifs, dojo linework, action arrows, small calendar icons, class-level tags, and photo-caption bars.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial sports portrait look, shot on a Sony A7R IV with an 85mm f/1.4 lens for a crisp subject emphasis and shallow separation.
- Lighting: controlled studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a soft fill from front-right and a faint rim light from behind to define the uniform edges and the subject silhouette.
- Color grade: high-contrast black, red, white, and gold martial-arts palette with clean whites and deep blacks, slightly warm gold highlights, natural skin tones, and vivid uniform texture.
- Realism details: dobok fabric weave, belt knots, training pad scuffs, polished gym-floor reflection, slight motion blur on fast limbs or shinai movement, and natural child-athlete expression appropriate for an academy promo.

[6. MOOD]
Premium martial arts academy promotional poster — energetic, trustworthy, parent-friendly, and aspirational, combining the disciplined impact of a sports magazine spread with the practical density of a real local academy recruitment flyer.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보일 문자열: "몸과 마음을 함께 키우는 무도.", "품새·겨루기·체력·기본기·예절·집중력", "6~14세 / 평일 16:00~20:00 / 주 3~5일 / 띠별 진급 시스템"
- Additional Korean poster text may include: "2026 신학기 수련생 모집", "무료 체험 1회권", "예절부터 자신감까지", "상담 가능 시간 14:00~21:00", "체험 예약 QR", "문의 02-123-4567", "주소 서울시 ○○구 무도관로 25".
- Layout invariant: hero image must remain the dominant central visual, with the headline clearly separated above and the class/schedule information organized into two strong lower blocks plus a practical footer contact strip.
- Keep all Korean characters sharp and correctly rendered; do not distort the academy name, headline, schedule text, contact labels, or trial-class copy.
- Poster must read as a finished Korean martial arts academy advertisement, not as a blank template: include realistic promotional modules, class details, contact cues, decorative martial-arts graphics, and print-flyer texture.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

- Program info zone (lower-middle 16–20%): {악기 종류}, {대상·수업}, and {강사진문구} arranged as structured lesson cards with tiny gold icons, note symbols, and dividers.
