[1. PURPOSE]
Korean golf lesson and field-rounding promotion poster, A4 vertical layout for academy, club, or screen-golf shop advertising.
Premium commercial flyer that highlights lesson options, field-rounding packages, booking details, and a realistic hero golf scene with the atmosphere of an upscale clubhouse notice board.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical A4 poster with a strong top-to-bottom reading path: branded header and date label occupy the upper 16%, headline occupies the next 18%, hero visual fills the center 38%, service list, package pricing, and reservation details stack in the lower 28%.
- Center the main visual so {hero 이미지} feels like the focal promotional scene, while the service information remains organized in readable editorial blocks.
- Background treatment: deep forest-green matte field or softly blurred fairway texture with visible grass grain, tee-box markers, faint cart-path bokeh, and warm clubhouse light accents, paired with crisp white or ivory content panels for legibility.
- Use {비율} as the overall canvas proportion cue, with a refined poster-grid structure suitable for printing and social sharing.
- {골프장·아카데미} should appear as the brand/location anchor near the top, balanced with a compact event label and small contact-style details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header band: place {골프장·아카데미} in a compact masthead zone against the dark green background. Add small realistic poster metadata: “SPRING GOLF PROGRAM”, “2026.05”, and a tiny right-aligned reservation note “사전 예약 필수”.
- Headline block: render {헤드라인} as the dominant typographic element in bold Korean sans-serif, slightly condensed, centered or left-aligned depending on balance with the hero image. Add a short supporting line beneath it: “레슨부터 필드 동반 라운딩까지 한 번에”.
- Hero area (mid 38–40%): show {hero 이미지} as a refined editorial-style visual — a golfer preparing a swing on a lush fairway, a golf ball and tee in sharp foreground, glove, club head, scorecard edge, and morning dew on grass. Include realistic depth, lens compression, natural shadows, and premium golf-course atmosphere.
- Service list block: present {서비스 종류} as a clear multi-item list or two-column row with separators. Add small category tags such as “1:1 레슨”, “숏게임 클리닉”, “필드 동반”, “스윙 분석” when visually appropriate, keeping the provided {서비스 종류} as the primary text.
- Pricing block: display {가격·패키지} in a boxed or banded section with the strongest numeric emphasis, using gold accent lines, small price labels, and a membership-style package card look.
- Event detail strip: include practical poster details in Korean: “일시 2026.05.18 SAT 09:00”, “장소 클럽하우스 1F / 연습그린”, “예약 02-000-0000”, “선착순 마감”.
- Sponsor / partner footer: add a small sponsor area with understated text such as “PARTNER · PRO SHOP · FITTING LAB · CADDIE SERVICE”, plus tiny icon-like marks for phone, map pin, calendar, and QR reservation box. Keep all added details subordinate to {골프장·아카데미}, {헤드라인}, {서비스 종류}, and {가격·패키지}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the headline and body, with bold 700–900 weight for the headline, medium 500–600 for supporting text, and a size hierarchy that clearly separates title, services, pricing, and reservation details.
- Color palette: use deep green, gold, white, ivory, and charcoal from {컬러 팔레트}; recommended tones include #0F3B2E, #C8A24A, #FFFFFF, #F6F1E7, and #2B2B2B.
- Border/shadow: thin gold rules, fine ivory dividers, subtle panel shadows at 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, and a few premium certificate-style corner lines around the pricing area.
- Add realistic printed-poster details: small footer credit text, light paper texture, tiny QR-code placeholder block, sponsor line, and refined golf-themed divider icons such as tee, flag, ball, or scorecard marks.
- Keep the layout editorial and premium, with crisp alignment, restrained luxury accents, and polished commercial hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 portrait-style framing for a golfer silhouette or product-focused 50mm f/1.4 editorial shot; if the hero is equipment-based, use a clean flat-lay feel with an 85mm equivalent compression.
- Lighting: soft overcast daylight or studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, with a gentle rim light from the right to separate the club, ball, and golfer from the background.
- Color grade: deep pine green + warm gold highlights + neutral white text, with slightly desaturated shadows and controlled contrast for a polished golf-club brochure look.
- Material realism: show tactile paper grain, realistic grass texture, brushed metal club reflections, leather glove texture, subtle dew highlights, and natural fairway bokeh.

[6. MOOD]
Premium golf club brochure — like a high-end lesson and field-rounding poster displayed in a luxury resort pro shop, combining refined athletic energy, trustworthy booking information, and polished service-poster clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문구: {골프장·아카데미}, {헤드라인}, {서비스 종류}, {가격·패키지}.
- Additional Korean poster text may include: “레슨부터 필드 동반 라운딩까지 한 번에”, “사전 예약 필수”, “일시 2026.05.18 SAT 09:00”, “장소 클럽하우스 1F / 연습그린”, “예약 02-000-0000”, “선착순 마감”.
- All Korean text must remain clean, correctly spelled, and properly spaced; no broken Hangul or garbled characters.
- The poster must preserve a disciplined golf-ad layout with a premium hierarchy, realistic golf-course atmosphere, and clear readable typography.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean water park seasonal advertisement poster, tall A4-style promotional layout for summer campaign, ticket sales, and family leisure promotion.
Designed for social ads, in-store posters, resort lobby signage, subway lightbox-style prints, and outdoor seasonal banners with a vivid splash aesthetic.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical poster composition with a festive resort-ad layout: headline campaign band across the top 18%, hero splash zone occupying the middle 50%, and layered ticket / event / sponsor information across the lower 32%.
- Use {워터파크시설명} as the main facility anchor, visible as a signboard, entrance arch, towel tag, or poolside banner within the hero scene, supported by water slides, wave pool, tube splash, lifeguard tower, palm-style shade umbrellas, and summer crowd atmosphere.
- Top area should feel like a real seasonal campaign poster: large {헤드라인문구}, smaller {서브카피}, a compact season badge, and decorative splash graphics that frame the typography.
- Lower section uses stacked information panels for {운영정보}, {티켓가격}, {할인이벤트}, {행사일정}, and {장소정보}, with icon dividers for calendar, clock, ticket, map pin, and phone.
- Add realistic poster details: ticket reservation CTA, QR-code placeholder block, small sponsor strip, safety notice line, social handle, and a bright promotional sticker-style badge.
- Background should feel like bright summer water spray over aqua-blue skies, with foam, droplets, slide shadows, towel colors, pool reflections, signage, and small resort details that make the advertisement believable.
- Keep framing frontal and slightly elevated, like a premium promo poster photographed for a resort seasonal campaign.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header area: Place {헤드라인문구} centered and oversized, with dynamic splash-shaped accents behind the text; add {서브카피} underneath in a smaller bold line and a round badge reading {시즌배지} near the upper-right.
- Hero area (mid frame): Showcase {히어로이미지} as the dominant visual, with energetic water spray, tube curves, slides, wave-pool foam, smiling family/friends silhouettes, and facility signage integrated naturally into the resort environment.
- Facility label integration: Weave {워터파크시설명} into the composition as a prominent but believable branded caption, entrance sign, poolside flag, or hero descriptor.
- Mid-lower ticket block: Present {운영정보} and {티켓가격} in a scan-friendly layout using translucent aqua panels, rounded cards, small pictogram icons, and a bold ticket button reading {예매CTA}.
- Lower event block: Present {할인이벤트} and {행사일정} as bright yellow and teal sticker badges, separated by wave-shaped dividers and small dotted coupon edges.
- Venue / contact row: Include {장소정보}, {문의정보}, and {SNS핸들} in the final row with map-pin, phone, and share-style micro icons.
- Sponsor and notice area: Add a small sponsor strip reading {스폰서문구} plus a tiny safety notice line {안내문구}; include a decorative QR reservation box labeled {QR라벨}.
- Final polish: Use splash highlights, water reflections, realistic pool tiles, wristbands, floating tubes, towel texture, umbrella shadows, and crisp print-poster edge control so the result feels like a real commercial summer campaign.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for {헤드라인문구}; Pretendard SemiBold for {서브카피}, {시즌배지}, and CTA; Pretendard Medium for info blocks; size hierarchy should be very strong, with headline roughly 3x the info text.
- Color palette: Build from {컬러팔레트} with vivid ocean blue, clean white, sunny yellow, and teal accents; support with deep navy for text, coral-orange sale stickers, and pale aqua highlights for splash glow.
- Panel and shadow treatment: Use soft drop shadows at 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for floating panels; thin white dividers, coupon-style dashed lines, glossy badge highlights, and rounded card corners at 18px radius.
- Decorative graphics: Use wave ribbons, water-drop bullets, sunburst mini icons, inflatable tube curves, ticket perforation motifs, and small sparkle highlights around price and discount areas.
- Text treatment: Keep Korean text sharp, well-kerned, and high contrast; avoid decorative distortion that reduces legibility.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: High-resolution advertising photograph look, shot on a Phase One IQ4 with 80mm lens at f/5.6 for the hero, with crisp detail and controlled depth separation.
- Lighting: Bright summer daylight, simulated as hard but diffused sunlight from upper-left with soft fill from right, plus subtle specular highlights on water spray, wet tile, and floating tubes.
- Color grade: Saturated summer aqua, clean cobalt blue, warm yellow highlights, coral event accents, and bright white foam; overall commercial resort-promo grading with fresh contrast.
- Print finish: Glossy laminated poster feel, rich ink density, crisp vector-like text overlays, realistic photo-composite depth, and high-end Korean leisure advertising polish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium summer resort campaign — akin to a glossy travel magazine ad spread and subway lightbox poster for a major Korean water park, energetic, refreshing, family-friendly, and immediately ticket-purchase oriented.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 주요 문구: "여름의 절정, 오늘 시작", "올여름 가장 시원한 하루를 예약하세요", "SUMMER SPLASH 2026", "운영 6/15 ~ 9/15 · 09:00~21:00", "자유이용권 65,000원 · 시즌권 199,000원", "얼리버드 30% · 4인 가족 패키지 · 리조트 숙박 결합", "7월 매주 토요일 19:30 나이트 풀파티", "지금 예매하기".
- Layout invariants: vertical A4-style poster, clear top headline, central hero splash, lower ticket/event/venue blocks, QR reservation box, sponsor strip, and all Korean text aligned cleanly and readable.
- The waterpark/facility identity must remain family-friendly and promotional, with realistic swimmers, natural anatomy, appropriate swimwear styling, and believable resort signage.
- Prices, dates, hours, ticket CTA, venue, contact line, and discount badges must feel like a coherent seasonal advertisement rather than random decorative text.

K리그·해외축구 매치데이 포스터, 세로형 경기 홍보 비주얼, 소셜 미디어와 전광판 공용.
강한 스포츠 에너지, 실제 경기장 분위기, 경기 정보 가독성을 동시에 살린 editorial poster layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main hero sits in the upper-middle 52% of the frame, with {hero 이미지} as the dominant focal point and {헤드라인} stacked above or partially overlaying the hero edge.
- {리그·구단} is the main content anchor; keep a strong vertical hierarchy from headline to player action, match identity, schedule, tactical preview, and ticket CTA.
- Background is a dark stadium-night scene with visible floodlight haze, rain mist or grass particles, faint pitch texture, blurred stands, digital scoreboard glow, and crowd-light bokeh for a realistic matchday atmosphere.
- {일정·장소} and {전술·맞대결} should be placed in strong broadcast-style info bands in the lower third, using icons for calendar, clock, stadium pin, and tactical board notes.
- Add realistic poster metadata and event details: small top label “MATCHDAY POSTER”, round label “ROUND 17”, date stamp “2026.05.24”, small ticket cue “티켓 예매 OPEN”, venue cue “입장 90분 전”, and a compact footer line “OFFICIAL MATCH PREVIEW / KICKOFF GUIDE”.
- Include a sponsor / partner area near the bottom with small rectangular logo placeholders, broadcaster tag, QR-ticket box, and tiny terms line, styled as believable event-poster production details without overpowering the match identity.
- Use {컬러 팔레트} consistently across headline accents, scoreline dividers, club tags, info highlights, digital UI marks, and atmospheric light streaks, while preserving a charcoal-dominant sports poster base.
- Respect {비율} as a vertical poster composition suitable for 1024x1536 export.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (15%): place {헤드라인} in a bold stacked composition, with the Korean line larger than the English line, centered and tightly tracked for a broadcast-poster feel. Add small supporting labels around it: “MATCHDAY”, “LIVE TONIGHT”, “ROUND 17”, and a tiny issue-style code “MD-2026-05”.
2. Hero zone (upper 52%): render {hero 이미지} as a dramatic football action centerpiece, with a stadium-light rim, flying turf, ball motion cue, sweat/rain highlights, and layered electronic scoreboard glow behind it. Add subtle team-color light trails and translucent tactical arrows around the player.
3. Match identity strip: integrate {리그·구단} as a bold club / league label across the midline or just below the hero, including a small “HOME vs AWAY” marker, crest-like graphic placeholders, and a thin animated-scoreboard divider.
4. Match info zone (lower-mid 18%): place {일정·장소} in a compact, high-contrast strip using crisp separators, calendar/clock/location icons, and ticket microcopy such as “현장 수령 가능” and “온라인 예매”. Keep the date/time readable at a glance.
5. Tactical sub-copy zone (lower 10%): set {전술·맞대결} as a smaller support line, styled like a match preview note with a tiny tactical board diagram, player-position dots, and side labels “KEY MATCHUP” / “PRESSING LINE”.
6. Footer production zone: add a sponsor area, small broadcaster tag “LIVE”, QR-ticket box, page code “POSTER 01”, and micro credit text “Photo by Club Media / Designed for Matchday”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main headline; Pretendard SemiBold for info text; optional condensed English in Inter Tight Bold; headline size should dominate the top third.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} plus charcoal #111111, stadium black #0B0D10, electric accent red #E1062C or cyan #2ED8FF depending on team identity, and off-white #F4F6F8 for readable text.
- Border/shadow: thin divider rules in 1.5px, subtle glow on accent text, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 18% opacity on hero silhouette and info blocks.
- Graphic elements: include scoreboard bars, tactical arrows, halftone speed textures, pitch-line geometry, small broadcast bugs, sponsor rectangles, QR-ticket box, and realistic microtext labels.
- Poster realism: add paper-like grain, slight print texture, stadium vapor, motion blur on the ball, and layered light flares that feel like a real match promotion asset.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.4 sports portrait look for the hero silhouette, or a 70-200mm telephoto stadium shot compressed for dramatic depth; crisp broadcast-poster sharpness.
- Lighting: stadium floodlights from upper-left and upper-right with a slight rim light behind the player, faint scoreboard glow from the rear, dark ambient fill to preserve silhouette definition.
- Color grade: charcoal base with team-specific accent saturation, cool steel blues in the shadows, controlled red highlights, and high-contrast broadcast-grade finishing.
- Render quality: realistic player fabric texture, boot studs, grass spray, illuminated rain mist, blurred crowd seating, and high-resolution editorial sports compositing.

[6. MOOD]
Premium sports editorial poster — ESPN match promo mixed with UEFA broadcast key art energy and a Nike football campaign finish. The final image should feel like a real club matchday announcement posted on Instagram, stadium LED screens, and ticketing pages.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must appear exactly as rendered for the chosen match details in {리그·구단}, {헤드라인}, {일정·장소}, and {전술·맞대결}.
- Additional Korean poster text should be short and readable: “티켓 예매 OPEN”, “입장 90분 전”, “오늘의 빅매치”, “전술 포인트”, “현장 수령 가능”.
- Maintain a clear vertical hierarchy: headline at top, hero in the upper-middle, match identity and schedule in the lower third, sponsor / ticket / QR details at the bottom.
- The hero must read as a football match visual, with no human anatomy distortion, no extra limbs, and no broken typography.
- Keep all added labels secondary to the main match information so {리그·구단}, {헤드라인}, {일정·장소}, and {전술·맞대결} remain the most important readable text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean audiobook cover design for a square digital thumbnail and platform library tile. Premium, editorial, instantly readable cover that communicates listening, narration, chapter-based long-form content, and a believable audiobook product listing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {표지 일러} centered as the hero element, occupying about 55–60% of the frame, with the title lockup layered above and the metadata system below.
- Background treatment: deep purple-to-charcoal gradient backdrop with subtle paper grain, soft luminous haze, faint radial waveform rings, and small editorial graphic marks that support the listening theme.
- Framing: square {비율} platform-tile composition with strong center alignment, readable title scale, and enough edge breathing room for app cropping while still including natural cover details.
- Text placement: {오디오북 제목·저자} as the largest lockup, {짧은 카피} as a compact subtitle ribbon, {내레이터} as a refined secondary credit, and {재생 시간·챕터} as a metadata line near the lower third.
- Additional realistic cover elements: add {에디션 라벨} near the top, {출시일·카테고리} as a small catalogue label, {출판사·스튜디오} near the lower edge, {플랫폼 메타} beside a small play-button/progress motif, and {카탈로그 번호} as tiny production metadata.
- Typography and symbol treatment: {타이포} integrated with headphone pictogram, play icon, waveform progress bar, chapter ticks, and small gold divider rules within one cohesive audiobook-cover system.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer — build a rich deep violet base with charcoal edge falloff, then add soft studio haze behind the center, fine matte grain, faint concentric sound-wave lines, and a few tiny star-like audio particles in gold and lavender.
2. Edition and catalogue layer — place {에디션 라벨} at the upper-left or upper-center in small caps styling; add {출시일·카테고리} and {카탈로그 번호} as tiny but legible production details, similar to a real publisher’s digital release tile.
3. Hero illustration layer — render {표지 일러} as a polished audiobook emblem: book spine, headphones, waveform, play symbol, and simplified human silhouette combined into a single icon-like composition with warm gold edge highlights and soft shadow depth.
4. Title lockup — place {오디오북 제목·저자} in large, bold type across the upper or middle zone, with the main Korean title emphasized more strongly than the author name and English subtitle; maintain crisp Korean rendering and strong legibility at thumbnail size.
5. Subtitle and narrator credit — set {짧은 카피} in a narrow ribbon, caption strip, or small highlighted line beneath the title; position {내레이터} as a smaller credit beneath or to the lower-right, clearly reading as narration information.
6. Duration/chapter metadata — add {재생 시간·챕터} in a compact rounded pill, fine divider line, or stacked label near the bottom; include chapter tick marks, a small play button, and a subtle waveform progress bar.
7. Publisher/platform details — place {출판사·스튜디오} along the lower edge as a realistic imprint credit, with {플랫폼 메타} as small library-style metadata such as preview time and saves; keep all microcopy aligned to the cover grid.
8. Accent system — use headphone pictogram, waveform arcs, small gold rules, chapter dots, and soft illuminated edges to create a modern audiobook-market feel without overpowering the main title.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a bold Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main title, with Pretendard Medium/Regular for credits, metadata, and catalogue copy; include clean English set in a simple geometric sans-serif if present.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} interpreted as deep purple #3B1B63, metallic gold #D7B35A, white #F7F7F5, soft lavender #B99CFF, and charcoal #1E1E24; use gold for premium accents, divider rules, waveform glints, and key icons.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft shadow under title blocks, 4px downward offset, 12px blur, 18% opacity; thin gold divider lines at 1–2px for title, narrator, and metadata separation.
- Surface finish: matte premium digital-cover finish with light paper grain, slight ink texture, crisp vector-like typography, and softly dimensional illustrated objects.
- Layout realism: include small production details, catalogue numbering, preview/play metadata, and publisher credit like a real audiobook store cover while preserving a clear square cover hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing graphic poster composition, equivalent to Canon EOS R5 with 50mm normal-lens product-poster framing, minimal perspective distortion, square crop.
- Lighting: studio-style softbox glow from upper-left with a gentle secondary rim from upper-right, creating a faint halo around the central illustration and clear text contrast.
- Color grade: luxury editorial purple + gold + white with charcoal depth, inspired by premium streaming-app audiobook artwork and polished modern publisher covers.

[6. MOOD]
Premium audiobook marketplace cover — sleek editorial design with the polished clarity of a high-end streaming-app library thumbnail, enriched by believable publisher metadata, chapter cues, and listening-interface details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as provided by the arguments and render correctly without broken characters: {오디오북 제목·저자}, {짧은 카피}, {내레이터}, {재생 시간·챕터}, {에디션 라벨}, {출시일·카테고리}, {출판사·스튜디오}, {플랫폼 메타}, {카탈로그 번호}.
- Keep the composition square at {비율}, centered, and highly legible at small thumbnail sizes.
- Maintain exact typography hierarchy: title largest, subtitle/copy secondary, narrator credit smaller, duration and catalogue metadata clearly supporting.
- Preserve the audiobook identity cues: book + headphones + sound-wave + play/progress motif must be recognizable.
- Render all visible Korean text as intentional cover typography, not placeholder gibberish.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, government marks, or certification badges
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable required text
- Celebrity composites or recognizable real-person faces unless explicitly requested

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean radio program SNS banner for website header and social media promotion, designed like a classic FM station promo card with realistic broadcast information.
The banner should feel like an actual radio show announcement: program title, DJ credit, station frequency, broadcast date, episode number, listener participation cue, SNS handle, hashtags, and small social interaction icons arranged in a polished editorial layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Landscape banner composition with a strong horizontal flow: information stack on the left 42%, hero illustration on the right 46%, and a practical safe-padding area for SNS cropping.
- Use {채널명} and {주파수·시간대} as the compact top broadcast line, {프로그램명} and {DJ명} as the main title block, and {코너소개} as the supporting description.
- Add a visible date-and-episode label using {방송일자} and {에피소드번호}, styled like a small FM schedule tag.
- Background treatment: deep navy matte surface with subtle paper grain, faint analog waveform texture, small frequency tick marks, and warm yellow signal-line graphics.
- Keep the left text area high-contrast and readable, while the right-side visual is larger and more illustrative to anchor the banner.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top label row: place a warm yellow capsule reading 온에어 {방송일자}, followed by 채널 {채널명} {주파수·시간대}; add a tiny red live-dot or antenna icon beside it.
- Main title block: set 프로그램 {프로그램명} as the largest 2-line headline if needed, with 진행 {DJ명} beneath it in a handwritten Korean accent or signature-style label.
- Episode and corner row: add 회차 {에피소드번호} and 코너 {코너소개} as two compact tags under the title, separated by a thin off-white divider line.
- Listener CTA area: place {청취자CTA} and 문자참여 {문자참여번호} in a small rounded box, like a realistic radio request-message prompt.
- Hero area: compose {히어로일러} as a layered central illustration with a vintage radio, studio microphone, LP record, headphones, music-note stickers, waveform arcs, and a stylized DJ silhouette.
- Bottom social strip: include {SNS핸들}, {해시태그}, small save/share/comment micro icons, and 협찬 {협찬문구} as tiny footer details aligned along the lower band.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main title, Noto Sans KR Medium for supporting copy, and a hand-drawn Korean accent style for DJ flavor; title size should dominate the layout with strong hierarchy.
- Color palette: use {컬러팔레트}; emphasize deep navy #0B1630, warm yellow #F4C542, white #FFFFFF, and soft cream #F7F1E3.
- Graphic details: add thin off-white divider lines, small rounded broadcast labels, frequency scale marks, soundwave curves, tiny sparkle dots around the microphone, and a soft shadow under the hero illustration, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity.
- SNS realism: bottom micro icons should resemble generic save, share, comment, and heart symbols, sized subtly so the main radio title remains dominant.
- Text placement should feel like a real Korean FM promotional asset, with balanced hierarchy between the station data, title, DJ name, listener participation, and social footer.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: design as a flat editorial poster with a 50mm studio-poster look and crisp vector-like illustration clarity.
- Lighting: simulated studio lighting with a soft top-left glow and faint right-side fill, creating mild contrast on the radio objects and text blocks.
- Color grade: deep navy + warm yellow + white, with a slightly analog FM broadcast tone, warm night-air atmosphere, and restrained saturation.

[6. MOOD]
Classic Korean FM station promo graphic — warm, trustworthy, slightly nostalgic, and inviting, like a late-night radio booth mixed with a modern SNS announcement card.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following text must appear exactly and without broken characters:
  - 온에어 {방송일자}
  - 채널 {채널명} {주파수·시간대}
  - 프로그램 {프로그램명}

  - 회차 {에피소드번호}
  - 코너 {코너소개}
  - {청취자CTA}
  - 문자참여 {문자참여번호}
  - {SNS핸들} · {해시태그}
  - 협찬 {협찬문구}
- Maintain a clear landscape banner framing with left-information / right-hero separation and legible Korean typography.
- If the DJ silhouette is shown, keep it stylized and non-photorealistic, with natural proportions.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Unlicensed celebrity or real-person composites

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Podcast cover design for streaming platforms, square 1:1 format with bold editorial readability and thumbnail-level impact.
Create a recognizable show identity that feels like a real podcast program cover, with broadcast metadata, episode cues, and strong app-grid visibility.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Compose a square 1024x1024 podcast cover for {채널 이름}, using a strong centered hierarchy and a polished editorial streaming-platform look.
- Place the main title block in the upper-middle 35–40% of the frame; set {영문 부제} as a compact secondary line directly below or beside the Korean title.
- Put {대표 일러·아이콘} in the central area as the visual hero: a microphone, headphones, speech bubble, waveform, bookshelf, host silhouette, or category-specific emblem with bold graphic presence.
- Anchor {호스트·게스트} and {청취 안내} in the lower third as real podcast metadata, with {에피소드 번호}, {공개일}, and {시즌 정보} displayed as small but legible broadcast labels.
- Add 2 short editorial teaser lines, {핵심 문구 1} and {핵심 문구 2}, as feature-style callouts around the central icon or lower title area.
- Include a small category badge for {주제 카테고리}, a channel handle {채널 핸들}, and subtle decorative audio elements such as waveform ticks, play-button marks, dotted rhythm lines, or caption stickers.
- Use {타이포} and {컬러 팔레트} as the primary brand system, with saturated contrast and clear typographic hierarchy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title zone: Render {채널 이름} as the dominant headline, large, centered, and instantly readable. If the name contains both Korean and English, keep Korean primary and {영문 부제} secondary.
- Episode identity zone: Display {에피소드 번호} and {공개일} in a capsule, sticker, or small broadcast label near the top corner or directly under the title, like “EP.128 · 2026.05.01”.
- Illustration zone: Render {대표 일러·아이콘} as a bold central graphic with layered shapes, slight offset shadow, clean outlines, and podcast-relevant symbolism.
- Metadata zone: Set {호스트·게스트}, {시즌 정보}, and {청취 안내} in the lower third using compact rows, dividers, or pill-shaped labels.
- Teaser zone: Add {핵심 문구 1} and {핵심 문구 2} as short, punchy Korean cover lines; they should feel like real episode hooks rather than generic decoration.
- Category and handle zone: Place {주제 카테고리} and {채널 핸들} as micro-branding elements, styled like a streaming app tag, social handle, or corner label.
- Texture and detail: Add subtle paper grain, halftone dots, waveform strokes, tiny equalizer bars, or flat-vector texture that supports the podcast identity while keeping the title clear.
- Format control: Keep a strict square composition optimized for streaming app thumbnails, with all major text inside a balanced central reading area.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main title, with Noto Sans KR Medium, Inter SemiBold, or a condensed sans for metadata. Title size should feel like 14–18% of canvas height; metadata and teaser text should remain readable at thumbnail scale.
- Color palette: Use the tone family from {컬러 팔레트}, anchored by one saturated dominant color and one or two accent colors for title blocks, capsules, waveform graphics, and icon outlines.
- Graphic detailing: Use layered flat-vector shapes, clean outlines, rounded capsules, broadcast stickers, audio waveform marks, play icons, and small divider rules to make the cover feel like a real published podcast asset.
- Border/shadow: A thin outline, offset drop shadow, or sticker-style edge is allowed for separation; keep shadows soft and controlled, around 2–4px offset, 10–15px blur, and 12–18% opacity.
- Text hierarchy: Main title first, episode title second, host and metadata third, category/handle fourth. Avoid letting decorative audio graphics compete with the title.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Clean flat graphic design, no camera realism; if any object styling is used, treat it like a studio poster mockup with a 50mm product-photo perspective and orthographic-like front presentation.
- Lighting: Even, controlled studio-style illumination with soft poster-like shading on icon layers and sticker elements.
- Color grade: Bold digital poster grade with vivid primary accents, strong contrast, sharp vector edges, and mobile-app readability.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean podcast brand identity — energetic, editorial, smart, and broadcast-ready, like a polished streaming cover mixed with a magazine masthead and audio-app UI details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: {채널 이름}, {영문 부제}, {호스트·게스트}, {주제 카테고리}, {에피소드 번호}, {공개일}, {에피소드 제목}, {핵심 문구 1}, {핵심 문구 2}, {채널 핸들}, {청취 안내}.
- 실제 표지에 들어갈 추천 텍스트 예시: “EP.128”, “2026.05.01 공개”, “이번 주의 질문”, “퇴근길 45분 오디오 매거진”, “매주 금요일 업데이트”.
- Layout invariants: 1:1 square cover, centered hierarchy, title as the visual anchor, sharp Korean typography, and podcast-related iconography that reads instantly.
- The design should look like a finished, upload-ready podcast cover, not a blank logo tile.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites
- Illegible, warped, or randomly invented Korean text

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Magazine special supplement / mook cover for editorial distribution, designed as a premium A4-vertical cover with rich bookstore-shelf realism, print-ready typography, and authentic editorial cover details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header zone (15–18%): {잡지·무크 제목} set as the primary masthead, centered or slightly top-aligned depending on the cover style, with strong visual dominance and refined editorial authority.
- Secondary info band (8–10%): {호수·시즌} placed near the masthead in smaller editorial type, combined with realistic issue metadata such as "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "SPECIAL EDITION", and a small date label.
- Main visual field (55–60%): {대표 컷} occupies the central hero area with real magazine-cover framing, natural editorial context, tactile materials, believable shadows, and space for layered text overlays.
- Headline zone (12–15%): {헤드라인 카피} placed across the lower-middle or lower-third area in bold, highly legible Korean sans-serif, supported by 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs such as "지금 가장 필요한 취향", "새로운 일상 가이드", "편집장이 고른 장면".
- Feature keyword strip: {피처 키워드} arranged as a compact English/Korean feature list on the left side, right edge, or lower margin, paired with small separator rules, page references, and editorial microcopy.
- Cover realism details: add a small barcode area near the lower-left or lower-right corner, price text such as "₩7,500", small spine/credit text, model or photo credit such as "Cover Model: 김서윤" or "Photo: Studio Archive", and a short publisher line.
- Background treatment: premium editorial paper surface, subtle ink grain, printed halftone texture, seasonal paper tint, and {컬러 팔레트} applied as the cover’s signature palette.
- Framing direction: strict A4 vertical cover layout, print-editorial proportions, layered cover lines, realistic magazine finishing, and a polished physical-cover presence.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Masthead area: {잡지·무크 제목} large and crisp at the top, with magazine cover authority, controlled letter spacing, and a refined editorial display-font impression.
2) Issue line: {호수·시즌} immediately under or near the masthead in smaller type, readable but secondary, styled like a special issue identifier with additional microcopy: "VOL.247 · 2026 MAY · 별책부록".
3) Hero content: {대표 컷} presented as the main cover image, either as a single strong visual, a cityscape, a people collage, an interior scene, or an illustration still-life treatment with editorial polish and believable printed depth.
4) Main headline: {헤드라인 카피} placed prominently across the hero or lower third, using bold hierarchy to anchor the cover and interact naturally with the main image.
5) Feature blurbs: include 2–3 short Korean cover lines around the hero image, for example "나다운 선택이 가장 좋은 답", "작은 습관으로 바뀌는 계절", "로컬에서 발견한 새로운 장면", with page-number style details such as "p.034" or "p.112".
6) Feature keywords: {피처 키워드} set as small editorial text on the left side, in a neat column or compact stack, reinforcing magazine structure with items like "Editor's Pick", "Travel", "People", "Culture" when suitable.
7) Editorial metadata: add a barcode block, price "₩7,500", ISSN-like placeholder text "ISSN 2765-0526", a tiny credit line, and a slim spine-style vertical text strip along one side for bookstore realism.
8) Color application: {컬러 팔레트} used consistently across masthead accents, rules, badges, caption boxes, barcode label, and background balance to create a cohesive issue identity.
9) Format finishing: {비율} respected exactly with professional cover alignment, sharp typography, realistic printed-paper texture, and final cover readiness.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for {헤드라인 카피}, Pretendard SemiBold for {호수·시즌}, and a clean condensed sans-serif feel for {피처 키워드}; masthead should feel like a refined editorial display font with strong weight and tight control.
- Color palette: apply {컬러 팔레트} as the dominant issue identity, with black/white/gold or season-specific accent tones depending on the chosen palette; maintain high contrast for legibility while allowing subtle accent panels, divider lines, and label blocks.
- Magazine details: include realistic cover furniture such as issue number, date label, barcode area, price, page references, small captions, photo/model credit, and a publisher or editorial department line.
- Border/shadow: subtle print-like shadowing only if needed, such as a soft 3px–6px y-offset shadow at 10%–15% opacity; avoid heavy 3D effects.
- Text treatment: crisp vector-like edges, accurate Korean glyphs, balanced kerning, natural editorial hierarchy, and readable small text wherever it is intended to be legible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial cover photography feel captured on Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens for people covers, or Canon EOS R5 with a 50mm f/1.4 standard lens for mixed editorial layouts; if the cover is a collage or illustration-led issue, emulate professional magazine art direction and printed production quality rather than a casual snapshot.
- Lighting: studio editorial lighting with controlled softbox illumination from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, and clean contrast that preserves text readability while allowing natural highlights, paper texture, and tactile shadows.
- Color grade: premium magazine grade with restrained blacks, clean whites, and accent tones from {컬러 팔레트}; if seasonal, use a polished spring/fall editorial palette with refined saturation and realistic print warmth.

[6. MOOD]
High-end magazine supplement — Kinfolk / Monocle editorial cover energy with a polished bookstore-shelf presence, rich editorial detail, collectible mook quality, and believable Korean publishing design.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: {잡지·무크 제목}, {호수·시즌}, {대표 컷}, and {헤드라인 카피} must appear exactly as provided in the final image text where applicable.
- Add realistic Korean cover text strings where appropriate, such as "2026년 5월호", "별책부록", "나다운 선택이 가장 좋은 답", "편집장이 고른 장면", "새로운 일상 가이드", "₩7,500", and "Cover Model: 김서윤".
- English text accuracy: "Editor's Pick", "Travel", "People", "Culture", "SPECIAL EDITION", and "VOL.247" must appear cleanly and correctly if used.
- Layout invariants: maintain a strict vertical magazine-cover hierarchy with masthead, issue line, hero visual, headline, feature blurbs, barcode/price area, credit line, and feature keywords all clearly organized.
- All typography must remain sharp, correctly spaced, and fully legible in Korean.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized real-person likeness

- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean poetry / essay book cover, vertical editorial cover layout for print and online bookstore thumbnail.
Soft literary packaging with a quiet emotional tone, suitable for B6-sized cover presentation, including realistic publisher details, series labeling, a small obi-band copy area, and print-ready colophon microtext.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title block occupies the upper 30% of the frame, centered slightly above the visual midpoint; {도서제목} is the primary focal point with {도서유형라벨} placed above it as a small genre label.
- A thin left-edge spine-preview strip carries {시리즈라벨} and a tiny {출판사명} mark, giving the cover the feeling of an actual printed book photographed for a catalog.
- Illustration field fills the central 45% with a delicate handcrafted cover illustration based on {표지일러}; include paper fibers, faint watercolor blooms, pressed-petal marks, graphite guide traces, and subtle ink pooling at the edges.
- Subtitle / quote appears as a small accent line near the lower-middle area using {서브카피}, aligned to the title’s visual axis.
- A translucent paper obi band or belly-band crosses the lower 18–24% of the cover, containing {띠지문구} and {추천문구} in readable Korean micro editorial type.
- Author / publisher line sits in the lower 12% as supporting information: {저자명} · {출판사명}, with {출간일} and {가격ISBN} set as small colophon-like details near the bottom-right, plus a tiny ISBN barcode-style block.
- Background is a tactile paper surface with warm off-white texture, muted pastel tint from {컬러팔레트}, visible deckle-like grain, and a soft print-paper shadow.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Series and genre zone: Place {시리즈라벨} on the left-edge spine strip and {도서유형라벨} above the title in small letterspaced Korean type.
2) Top title zone: Place {도서제목} as the largest text element, crisp and legible, with the title spanning 1–3 lines depending on length.
3) Illustration zone: Render {표지일러} as a soft watercolor or hand-drawn natural still-life composition, with visible paper grain, layered pigment, delicate edges, and small realistic stationery details such as a folded note, dried stem shadow, or translucent tape tab.
4) Subtitle zone: Add {서브카피} in a smaller quote style beneath or beside the illustration, using a calm literary rhythm and careful Korean spacing.
5) Obi-band zone: Add a semi-transparent paper band with {띠지문구} as a bold small headline and {추천문구} as a secondary review quote; use faint fold lines and paper overlap shadows.
6) Author/publisher zone: Set {저자명} and {출판사명} near the bottom in restrained small type, allowing the main title to remain dominant while still feeling like a complete retail-ready book cover.
7) Print detail zone: Include {출간일}, {가격ISBN}, a tiny barcode-style ISBN graphic, and a small publisher imprint mark as authentic book-cover production details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: follow {타이포}; use a mix of handwritten script + Noto Serif KR / Nanum Myeongjo for the main title, with Pretendard or a small serif sans for supporting text; title weight medium to bold, subtitle light, author line regular; main title size should feel like 58–92 px equivalent, subtitle 18–28 px, author line 14–20 px, colophon and barcode text 8–12 px equivalent.
- Color palette: use the exact mood family from {컬러팔레트}; prefer ivory #F5F0E6, dusty pink #D9A7A5, sage green #B7C3A5, charcoal #3A3A3A, warm beige #D8C7AE, and pale ink-gray accents.
- Cover finish: use matte uncoated paper, slight cotton-paper tooth, natural ink absorption, faint pressed-flower stains, and a soft paper-cast shadow around the obi band and spine strip.
- Decorative details: add refined literary production marks such as small section dots, a tiny leaf icon, understated rule lines, publisher imprint symbol, and ISBN barcode micro block, all integrated into the printed-cover design.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat editorial cover composition, as if photographed on a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.4 for the title feel, or a top-down 50mm equivalent for the illustration card look; keep perspective natural and print-like.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, low-glare matte paper response, like a calm overcast daylight setup on textured paper.
- Color grade: muted ivory + dusty pink + sage green + charcoal, with low saturation and slightly warm paper tone; preserve fine paper texture, watercolor granulation, and crisp ink edges.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet literary editorial cover — a Kinfolk-meets-modern Korean poetry anthology aesthetic, with restrained elegance, handwritten warmth, tactile paper realism, and the intimacy of a small independent bookstore display.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly and cleanly rendered: {도서제목}, {도서유형라벨}, {저자명}, {출판사명}, {서브카피}, {추천문구}, {띠지문구}, {시리즈라벨}, {출간일}, {가격ISBN}.
- Ensure all Korean characters are crisp, properly spaced, and readable at thumbnail scale; preserve punctuation such as 『 』, ·, ₩, and ISBN hyphens.
- Cover must remain a single vertical B6 composition with title, illustration, subtitle, obi-band copy, author line, and print detail zone clearly separated by hierarchy.
- Render the barcode-style block as a small realistic graphic element while keeping the provided ISBN text legible nearby.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul
- Celebrity composites or real-person likeness claims
- Warped or illegible typography that changes the provided Korean text

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean literary novel book cover, B6 vertical format, restrained contemporary publishing design for print and online mockup.
Editorial cover art that feels like a serious literary paperback in a Korean bookstore, with tactile paper texture, believable jacket details, a calm but memorable focal image, and elegant typography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the main title block in the upper third so the cover immediately reads as a bookstore-ready Korean novel jacket.
- Place the {표지 hero} as the primary visual anchor across the middle 45–55% of the page, integrated with subtle paper grain, delicate shadow, or atmospheric illustration detail so it feels printed on a real matte cover.
- Keep the {소설 제목·저자} lockup clear and legible, with the title larger than the author name and aligned to a refined Korean publishing hierarchy.
- Position the {출판사·시리즈} mark small in a lower corner, like a real literary imprint mark, accompanied by believable micro-details such as a series number, edition line, and small price/ISBN-style text.
- Place the {서브 카피} as a small quoted literary line near the hero or below the title, never overpowering the main title.
- Use {비율} as a strict vertical paperback proportion, with practical trim-safe spacing, a subtle spine-wrap indication near one edge, and print-ready top-to-bottom rhythm.
- Background should feel like premium printed stock using {컬러 팔레트}: matte paper, fine fibers, slight ink density variation, and a subdued accent area that supports the story atmosphere.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone: render {소설 제목·저자} as the dominant cover title, with the title in a crisp Korean serif and the author name smaller beneath it; include a small genre label such as “장편소설” or “한국문학” above or near the title.
- Hero zone (mid-frame): place {표지 hero} as a symbolic literary cover illustration or editorial photograph, with layered realistic details such as soft shadows, faint printed texture, paper grain, or a quiet environmental hint that supports the novel’s mood.
- Quote zone: place {서브 카피} in a smaller, lighter-weight line near the hero or just below the title, set like a real jacket endorsement or excerpt line with Korean quotation marks.
- Series and edition zone: add small supporting Korean cover text such as “문학선 042”, “개정판 1쇄”, “2026 봄”, or “독자들이 오래 기억한 문장들” in tiny editorial type, aligned with the title grid.
- Publisher mark zone: set {출판사·시리즈} tiny at the lower left or lower right with precise alignment; include a realistic small imprint line, ISBN-style number, and price text such as “ISBN 979-11-0000-884-0” and “정가 15,800원” as micro typography.
- Typography zone: use {타이포} to create contrast between the main Korean title and smaller supporting text; include carefully spaced vertical or horizontal microtext along one edge, like a real Korean paperback cover.
- Color zone: apply {컬러 팔레트} as a literary palette with one muted accent and subtle tonal layering, ensuring the cover feels premium, serious, and physically printed rather than like a sterile template.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the main Korean title, Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the author name, imprint, edition, ISBN, price, and small series text; title weight bold or semibold, author weight regular, size hierarchy clearly visible.
- Color palette: build from {컬러 팔레트}, translated into specific tones such as ivory #F4F0E6, charcoal #2B2B2B, and one subdued accent like muted orange #C56B3D, slate blue #4E6F91, moss green #6D8465, or dried rose #A86F68.
- Print finish: matte Korean paperback texture with fine paper fibers, tiny ink spread, slight off-register warmth, delicate grain, and realistic edge softness; add a subtle soft shadow 2–4px y-offset, 8–12px blur, 10–15% opacity if showing the book as a physical cover.
- Decorative publishing details may include a fine rule line, small series badge, understated vertical spine text preview, faint chapter-like numerals, or a narrow colored band, all restrained and integrated into the literary design.
- Keep the cover free of glossy effects, neon gradients, stock-poster loudness, or oversized commercial typography; the overall finish should be matte, tactile, and print-authentic.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: if the hero is photographic, use a 50mm or 85mm lens look with f/2.8–f/4 clarity, book-cover editorial framing, or a flat-lay/portrait setup that feels like an art-book cover.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle shadow falloff and natural paper surface visibility; if studio-based, use a large softbox plus subtle fill for even tonal control.
- Color grade: muted ivory and charcoal base with one restrained accent, slightly desaturated, low-contrast, print-friendly grading reminiscent of Korean literary publishing and independent bookstore cover design.
- Surface realism: show believable printed-paper behavior, including very fine halftone-like texture, subtle scuffs near the trim edge, tiny ink-density variation in dark type, and a gentle tactile shadow where visual elements overlap.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet literary editorial — like a modern Korean bookstore novel jacket with the restrained seriousness of a New York Review Books cover and the emotional understatement of a Jeon Gyeong-rin-style paperback design. The image should feel like a real book someone could pick up from an independent bookstore display, intimate, mature, and thoughtfully produced.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - {소설 제목·저자}
  - {출판사·시리즈}
  - {서브 카피}
  - {타이포}
  - {컬러 팔레트}
  - {비율}
- Add realistic small Korean publishing details where appropriate: “장편소설”, “한국문학”, “문학선 042”, “2026 봄”, “개정판 1쇄”, “정가 15,800원”, “ISBN 979-11-0000-884-0”.
- Composition invariants: maintain a vertical B6 paperback cover layout with clear title hierarchy, a single restrained hero image, small publisher imprint placement, and realistic printed-book surface details.
- Typography must look like real Korean book-cover type, with clean spacing and no broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-883.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
도서관 낭독회·작가 사인회 안내 포스터, A4 세로형 이벤트 홍보물, 도서관/서점 현장 게시와 SNS 공유용.
책 정물, 작가 실루엣, 서가 배경을 활용한 문학 행사 포스터 느낌으로, 행사명·일시·장소·신청 정보를 한눈에 전달하는 편집형 레이아웃.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster is a vertical A4 layout with a strong top-to-bottom reading flow; title block occupies the top 18%, hero illustration/photo area takes about 38–42%, and event details, ticket/application info, sponsor strip fill the lower section.
- Main subject stays slightly above center; {hero 이미지} is framed as the central visual anchor with warm paper texture, library shelf depth, reading lamp glow, bookmark, pencil note, open book pages, and small decorative literary motifs.
- Background treatment: warm library interior tone with subtle paper grain, ivory base, soft shelf texture, visible book spines, a table edge, gentle shadows, and print-friendly matte finish.
- Use {행사번호}, {포스터 카피}, {행사 종류}, {초청 작가·작품}, {일시}, {장소}, {진행 시간}, {참여 방법}, {참가비}, {신청 링크 문구}, {문의처}, {주최·후원}, {티켓 안내}, {hero 이미지}, {장식 모티프}, {컬러 팔레트} as editable content anchors.
- Lower third contains a realistic event information panel: date/time/venue line, participation method, ticket or reservation note, inquiry contact, and a sponsor/organizer area separated by thin editorial rules.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header band: place {행사번호} as a small catalog-like label near the top edge, then set {행사 종류} as the primary headline, large and bold, with {포스터 카피} as a short sub-copy below it; add a thin separator rule and small decorative book/page marks.
2. Hero zone: show {hero 이미지} as the visual focal point, either a warm book still life, a soft author silhouette near shelves, or a quiet library desk scene; include tactile details such as page texture, bookmark ribbon, pencil annotation, reading glasses, library checkout card, and warm shelf lighting.
3. Event title block: place {초청 작가·작품} directly below or overlapping the lower edge of the hero zone in stacked lines for author name and book title; use a refined editorial emphasis so it reads as the featured program.
4. Information block: arrange {일시}, {장소}, {진행 시간} in a clearly divided section with date/time emphasized; use small pictogram-style labels such as DATE, PLACE, TIME rendered as simple typographic tags.
5. Participation / ticket block: place {참여 방법}, {참가비}, {티켓 안내}, and {신청 링크 문구} in a practical lower-panel layout; include a small QR-style application box, reservation number tab, or perforated ticket-like shape to make the poster feel real.
6. Footer area: add {주최·후원} and {문의처} as a sponsor/organizer strip with small logo placeholders, library branch line, contact phone/email text, and page-like divider decoration using {장식 모티프}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main body, weight 700–800 for headlines, 400–500 for details; title 42–58 px, program title 30–42 px, details 18–24 px, footer 13–16 px; use comfortable line spacing for Korean readability.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with ivory #F5F0E6 as base, warm brown #8A6446, indigo #2F3E5C, charcoal #2B2B2B, and a muted burgundy accent for ticket tags or bookmarks.
- Editorial decoration: thin charcoal rules, book-page dividers, small quotation marks, bookmark ribbon, date stamp texture, library checkout-card grid, and a modest sponsor strip at the bottom.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; matte poster print feel with natural paper grain and realistic ink density.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial still-life look shot on a full-frame camera with 50mm lens at f/4 for balanced depth and clean product-style framing; if using a library interior feel, emulate a 35mm documentary composition.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with a faint fill from the right to keep book edges and silhouette contours readable; warm practical lamp glow may appear near the hero desk area.
- Color grade: warm cream + brown + muted indigo + charcoal, with slightly desaturated shadows, paper-like highlights, realistic printed ink texture, and a calm cultural-event poster finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium literary event editorial — think Kinfolk magazine spread meets a quiet Korean public library poster, with a warm, trustworthy, well-organized cultural-announcement tone.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구:
  - {행사번호}
  - {포스터 카피}
  - {행사 종류}
  - {초청 작가·작품}
  - {일시}
  - {장소}
  - {진행 시간}
  - {참여 방법}
  - {참가비}
  - {티켓 안내}
  - {신청 링크 문구}
  - {주최·후원}
  - {문의처}
- 포스터 하단에는 실제 행사물처럼 “신청”, “문의”, “주최/후원” 정보가 구분되어 보여야 하며, QR-style 박스나 티켓 탭은 장식이 아니라 신청 안내 요소처럼 배치한다.
- All Hangul characters must render cleanly with no broken syllables, no substitution glyphs, and no accidental English replacements in the Korean text zones.
- Keep the composition poster-like and readable, with all event information legible at A4 viewing distance.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or misleading real-person likeness
- Illegible event details caused by text distortion

[1. PURPOSE]
Museum family activity guide card for a children's museum program, designed as a social-media-ready square information graphic.
Clear promotional layout that explains program name, activity types, schedule, reservation details, location, and call-to-action at a glance, with the credibility of a cultural institution and the warmth of a family weekend outing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square card with a centered editorial info layout: the {hero 이미지} occupies the upper 42% as the main focal point, while the text block fills the lower 58% in a structured mobile-friendly grid.
- Background treatment: warm beige paper-like surface with subtle fiber texture, museum brochure print grain, child-friendly color touches from {컬러 팔레트}, and small educational graphics such as pottery shard lines, fossil marks, magnifying-glass icons, ticket-stub corners, and simple floor-map dots.
- Use {박물관·프로그램}, {체험 종류}, {대상·일정}, {참가비·예약}, {행사 기간}, {장소}, {문의}, {기관 핸들}, and {해시태그} as the main information anchors.
- Arrange the information like a real museum Instagram announcement: hero photo, headline, activity chips, schedule ticket box, reservation CTA, page indicator, and contact footer all clearly separated by thin dividers and label badges.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (top 42%): {hero 이미지} shown as a clean editorial museum activity photo or cutout-style visual, with soft depth and crisp focus, placed slightly above center for strong first glance impact. Add a small photo caption label on the hero image: "오늘의 체험 현장".
- Header block: title line reading "박물관 가족 체험" in bold Korean display style, followed by {박물관·프로그램} as the program line and a smaller subtitle "주말마다 만나는 어린이박물관 탐험".
- Info row 1: {체험 종류} presented as four rounded activity chips with small icons: pottery, archaeology brush, fossil, traditional play. Add a small label "체험 4종".
- Info row 2: {대상·일정} set as a schedule line with age range, guardian attendance, and weekly time slots in a neat ticket-info style. Include {행사 기간} and a small calendar icon.
- Info row 3: {참가비·예약} placed in a reservation box with fee, free guardian note, booking method, and team limit emphasized through hierarchy. Add a bold CTA button reading {접수 CTA}.
- Location/contact row: show {장소}, {주소}, and {문의} with map-pin and phone icons, designed like a museum visitor-information strip.
- Social/card-news footer: include {기관 핸들}, {해시태그}, save/share micro icons, and page indicator {슬라이드 번호}. Add a small footer badge {하단 배지} and a short caption "아이와 함께 배우는 주말 문화생활".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body text, Pretendard SemiBold/Bold for headlines, size hints 44–56px for title, 22–28px for details, 18–22px for footer/contact text, with clean line spacing and strong legibility.
- Color palette: warm beige, ivory, charcoal, muted yellow, muted blue, and restrained red accents drawn from {컬러 팔레트}; use children colors as section labels, activity chips, and small icon accents while retaining a museum-like editorial tone.
- Border/shadow: thin charcoal divider lines, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on the hero panel and info boxes, with rounded corners kept subtle.
- Graphic details: add realistic printed-card details such as small registration number style text, thin rule lines, map-pin symbol, calendar label, ticket perforation dots, and subtle museum-floor pattern motifs.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial lifestyle photo look, 50mm lens at f/2.8 for the hero image, with shallow but not extreme depth and natural subject separation.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, no harsh flash, no strong specular glare on printed surfaces.
- Color grade: warm cream + muted cyan + soft red accent, lightly desaturated with museum-brochure neutrality and clean contrast.
- Material feel: premium cultural-center printed card, matte paper texture, softly photographed hero panel, crisp vector-like Korean typography, and tactile ticket/card-news interface elements.

[6. MOOD]
Museum family program brochure — calm educational editorial feel like a high-end cultural institution 안내 카드, with friendly weekend energy for parents and children.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구: "박물관 가족 체험", "{박물관·프로그램}", "{체험 종류}", "{대상·일정}", "{참가비·예약}", "{접수 CTA}".
- 추가로 보이면 좋은 실제 카드 문구: "오늘의 체험 현장", "체험 4종", "주말마다 만나는 어린이박물관 탐험", "아이와 함께 배우는 주말 문화생활", "{기관 핸들}", "{해시태그}", "{슬라이드 번호}".
- Layout invariant: the hero image stays in the upper section, and the program title, activity list, schedule, reservation, location/contact, and footer CTA remain clearly separated and easy to scan.
- Keep all Korean text crisp, correctly spelled, and evenly spaced; no broken characters, no warped letters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or identity alteration of any real person

[1. PURPOSE]
Museum special exhibition poster, elegant vertical B2-style promotional print for a contemporary art museum showcase. Designed to feel like a real public exhibition announcement with refined hierarchy, artwork reproduction, museum information, ticket guidance, and sponsor footer details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster layout: a tall vertical composition with the hero artwork occupying the central 50–56% of the frame, title block anchored in the upper 16%, exhibition details and ticket information arranged in the lower 24%, and a narrow sponsor/contact footer at the bottom.
- Background treatment: warm ivory archival paper texture with subtle grain, faint registration speckles, and lightly printed geometric accent shapes derived from {컬러 팔레트} so the poster feels physically printed rather than empty.
- Framing direction: center-weighted, museum-catalog clarity, with {전시 제목} and {영문 제목} as the main focal anchor and {대표 작품} presented as the visual centerpiece in a precise reproduction frame.
- Text hierarchy: place {작가·시기} beneath the title in a smaller secondary line, then separate {전시 기간}, {전시 장소}, {관람 정보}, {큐레이터 프로그램}, and {티켓 안내} into structured informational rows.
- Realistic poster additions: include a small “SPECIAL EXHIBITION” label, issue-style exhibition code “EXH-2026-06”, a museum website/QR-ticket placeholder, sponsor row using {후원·협찬}, and a compact contact/address line using {문의·주소}.
- Color application: use {컬러 팔레트} through title emphasis, separators, small corner glyphs, caption tags, and printed shape overlays that echo the hero artwork.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone (upper 16%): set “SPECIAL EXHIBITION” as a small museum label, then render {전시 제목} in a strong exhibition-title treatment with {영문 제목} directly below it in crisp Roman lettering.
2) Secondary metadata line: place {작가·시기} under the title with wider tracking, followed by a short editorial phrase {포스터 문구} as a curatorial subtitle.
3) Hero artwork zone (middle 50–56%): display {대표 작품} as a central reproduced canvas or artwork plate, with visible brush texture, mat-board-like paper edge, a small artwork caption, and a subtle printed shadow for depth.
4) Information block zone (lower 24%): create clearly separated rows for {전시 기간}, {전시 장소}, {관람 정보}, {큐레이터 프로그램}, and {티켓 안내}; use thin rules, small labels such as “DATE”, “VENUE”, “TICKET”, and compact Korean descriptions.
5) Footer and sponsor area: add {후원·협찬} as a realistic sponsor/partner strip, include {문의·주소}, a small QR-ticket square, website-style text, and a tiny exhibition code “EXH-2026-06” aligned near the bottom edge.
6) Color system: apply {컬러 팔레트} through title accents, divider lines, small museum-wayfinding icons, and decorative geometric fragments; maintain ivory base and charcoal typography for an upscale gallery mood.
7) Final print check: ensure all Korean and English text remains sharp, correctly spaced, and aligned as a premium vertical poster suitable for physical museum display.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for informational text, with a refined serif pairing such as Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo for the exhibition title; title weight bold 700–800, body weight 400–500, labels in small caps, body size compact but highly legible.
- Color palette: ivory #F5F0E6, charcoal #2B2B2B, and the accent tones from {컬러 팔레트}; saturation should feel archival and gallery-grade, with muted pigment-like accents rather than neon color.
- Poster graphics: include fine 1px separators, small label boxes, artwork caption text, delicate overprint shapes, and a sponsor/footer band that feels like a real museum-produced poster.
- Border/shadow: use ultra-soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12–15% opacity only if needed to separate the hero artwork; thin separators may appear in charcoal or accent color at low opacity.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: museum-poster editorial look, shot as a polished product-art reproduction on a high-resolution medium-format setup such as Phase One IQ4 with an 80mm lens at f/8 for crisp surface detail and even reproduction.
- Lighting: studio diffused softbox from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from front-right, designed to preserve the artwork’s texture and minimize glare; no harsh specular highlights.
- Color grade: restrained ivory, charcoal, and muted accent palette with archival-print neutrality; slight warm paper tone, no cinematic teal-orange push.

[6. MOOD]
Premium museum exhibition poster — closer to a MoMA / Tate Modern special exhibition announcement with Korean public-museum realism, precise ticket details, curated typography, and a tactile printed-paper finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the rendered image: {전시 제목}, {작가·시기}, {전시 기간}, {전시 장소}, {관람 정보}, {큐레이터 프로그램}, {티켓 안내}, {후원·협찬}, {문의·주소}.
- Render these additional visible Korean/English poster details clearly: “SPECIAL EXHIBITION”, “EXH-2026-06”, “온라인 예매 가능”, “큐레이터 토크”, “오디오가이드”.
- Keep the composition balanced and print-ready: all text must be fully legible, with no broken Korean characters, warped glyphs, or overlapping lines.
- Preserve the upright B2-style poster framing and museum-poster hierarchy; the hero artwork must remain the dominant visual element while the lower information block reads like a real exhibition notice.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Warped or illegible exhibition information
- Celebrity face composites or unauthorized lookalike portraits

[1. PURPOSE]
Classic opera performance poster for premium theater marketing, vertical B2 format.
Elegant concert announcement with a formal editorial feel, suitable for print-ready lobby display, outdoor poster boards, and social sharing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the title block in the upper-middle 28% of the frame, with the hero visual occupying the central 38–45% and the event details anchored in a refined lower information band.
- Background treatment: deep navy matte field with subtle charcoal-to-navy vignette, faint archival paper grain, light ink texture, and barely visible orchestral score fragments woven into the shadows.
- Build a realistic premium concert-poster layout with theatrical depth: small venue-program details, decorative gold rules, corner flourishes, sponsor strip, booking note, and ticket information that feels printed rather than sterile.
- Use {공연 제목}, {연주자·지휘자}, {공연장·일시}, {티켓 가격}, {hero 이미지}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} as editable content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top area (first 18%): place {공연 제목} as the primary masthead, large and centered, with compact line breaks if needed; add a smaller bilingual subtitle treatment beneath it for a classical concert-poster feel, such as KOREA OPERA GALA CONCERT and SEASON PROGRAM VOL. 42.
- Add a small top metadata row above the title: 기획공연 2026, OPERA NIGHT SERIES, 주최: 라온아트홀, 후원: 클래식저널, using tiny ivory and muted-gold text.
- Mid area (middle 40%): feature {hero 이미지} as the focal artwork, either as a dramatic orchestra silhouette, an opera singer under stage light, or a luxurious close-up of violin/cello details, with gold rim light and clear silhouette separation.
- Enrich the hero zone with subtle stage-curtain shadows, faint sheet-music overlays, warm dust in the spotlight, and engraved ornamental accents around the image so it reads as a real printed opera poster.
- Lower mid area (next 22%): set {연주자·지휘자} in a structured information block, aligned centrally or slightly left-balanced, using thin divider rules to organize ensemble, conductor, soloist, chorus, and program lines.
- Include short program-copy lines in Korean beneath the performer block, for example 베르디 · 푸치니 · 모차르트 명곡 하이라이트 and 1부 아리아 셀렉션 / 2부 오케스트라 갈라.
- Event details band (lower 12%): place {공연장·일시} in a highly legible block with precise spacing, and make the date/time line visually prioritized over venue copy.
- Add practical poster details near the event band: 공연문의 02-742-2026, 예매처 인터파크 티켓 · 공연장 홈페이지, 관람연령 만 7세 이상, 러닝타임 110분 인터미션 포함.
- Ticket area (bottom 8%): show {티켓 가격} in a compact row or stacked list, separated by subtle rules; make prices easy to scan without overpowering the title.
- Add a realistic bottom sponsor/credit strip with small logo-like text marks and labels: 제작 라온스테이지, 디자인 STUDIO ARIA, 협찬 아트앤컬처, media partner CLASSIC RADIO, plus a small QR-ticket placeholder box.
- Preserve the classic poster cadence: title first, hero image second, event information third, ticket pricing last.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a refined serif display face such as Cormorant Garamond or Noto Serif KR for the title, bold 72–96px; use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for supporting text, medium 26–34px; use 12–18px microtype for sponsor, booking, and credit text; maintain crisp Korean glyph rendering.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with deep navy #0B1430, gold #C8A24A, white #F6F2EA, charcoal #1D1D22; gold accents should feel premium, with clean ink-like edges and subtle foil warmth.
- Border/shadow: use thin hairline rules in muted gold, delicate corner ornaments, small typographic dividers, and a soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity beneath the hero image only.
- Add realistic print finishing cues: slight paper tooth, gentle ink absorption, tiny registration texture, and subtle wear at the darkest edges while keeping all text sharp.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: if photographic, use a Phase One IQ4 look with 110mm macro at f/4 for instrument close-ups, or a 85mm f/1.4 portrait-style compression for silhouette drama.
- Lighting: soft spotlight from upper-left at 45° with a subtle right-side rim light, creating elegant gold edge separation against the dark background.
- Color grade: deep navy, antique gold, warm ivory highlights, charcoal shadows, restrained contrast, cinematic concert-poster tonality.
- Rendering quality: realistic premium print poster, editorial theater campaign design, crisp typography, tactile matte paper, refined classical ornamentation, and believable event-promotion details.

[6. MOOD]
Premium classical concert editorial — feel of a New York Philharmonic season poster with the restrained elegance of a Vogue cultural spread, enhanced by the atmosphere of an opera house lobby poster with warm stage light, formal program details, and collectible season-campaign polish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구:
  - {공연 제목}
  - {연주자·지휘자}
  - {공연장·일시}
  - {티켓 가격}
- Additional Korean poster text must also be clean and readable when used: 기획공연 2026, 베르디 · 푸치니 · 모차르트 명곡 하이라이트, 예매처 인터파크 티켓, 관람연령 만 7세 이상, 러닝타임 110분.
- Preserve exact Korean glyph clarity, spacing, punctuation, and line breaks; no broken syllables or merged characters.
- Layout invariants: title, hero image, and information blocks must remain in the described vertical hierarchy; keep all text readable and evenly spaced.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean small-theater play poster, vertical B2-style editorial poster for drama publicity, campus-street distribution, theater lobby display, and ticket sales.
Indie theatrical key art with typography-first layout, emotional monochrome portrait, concrete performance information, ticketing details, and a believable sponsor / production footer.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title area occupies the top 18% of the canvas, centered with strong hierarchy using {연극 제목}, supported by a small subtitle line {부제} and compact production credit above or beside it.
- The hero portrait of {주연 인물} sits in the middle 42% of the frame, slightly off-center for dramatic tension, interacting with faint stage haze, torn rehearsal-paper textures, and one expressive accent graphic from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Background is a deep matte black stage-like field with subtle paper grain, rehearsal-room wall scratches, dim spotlight falloff, and red or teal typographic marks that feel printed onto the poster rather than floating.
- Performance details, venue, date, time, running time, age rating, ticket price, reservation channel, and inquiry number are stacked in a disciplined left-aligned grid in the lower third.
- Add a believable poster footer: production company, cast / staff credit line, sponsor area, small QR-style ticket box, and barcode-like ticket strip, all integrated as real printed ephemera for a 대학로 소극장 poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header zone (top 18%): Render {연극 제목} as the dominant title in large Korean display typography, with {부제} below it and a small line such as “{주최제작} 제작” or “DAEHANGNO BLACKBOX SERIES” above the title.
- Central hero zone (mid 42%): Place {주연 인물} as a high-contrast black-and-white close-up or silhouette treatment, with realistic edge contrast, slight motion softness around hair or coat edges, and a subtle stage shadow that anchors the figure to the dark background.
- Accent graphics layer: Include 2–3 restrained theatrical graphics such as a thin red circle, rehearsal tape mark, small seat-number stamp, torn-paper edge, or teal underline, matching {컬러 팔레트} and never overpowering the actor.
- Quote zone (upper-lower overlap): Set {인용구} as a critic-like pull quote with thin rules, wide tracking, or bracket marks, positioned near the portrait so it feels emotionally connected to the performance.
- Information block (lower 22%): Arrange “{극장명}”, “{공연 기간}”, “{공연 시간}”, “{러닝타임}”, “{관람등급}” in compact schedule format, followed by “{티켓 가격}”, “{예매처}”, and “{문의전화}” in a separated ticketing row.
- Footer production strip (bottom 8%): Add “주최·제작 {주최제작}”, “후원 {후원사}”, a small sponsor/logo placeholder area, QR-style reservation square, page-like ticket number, and a narrow spine credit line along one vertical edge reading “{연극 제목} / {극장명} / {공연 기간}”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold / Bold for information blocks, Noto Sans KR or Sandoll Gothic-style condensed display feel for the title, small mono-style numerals for dates and prices, and a light handwritten accent only for the quote if it enhances the theatrical mood.
- Color palette: deep black #0B0B0D, white #F5F2EC, blood red #C61F2B or muted teal #1D8C8C as accent tones from {컬러 팔레트}; allow tiny warm beige paper texture in printed areas.
- Layout detail: information must feel typeset by a real 공연기획사, with aligned columns, thin hairline rules, small sponsor marks, ticket reservation blocks, and readable hierarchy between title, dates, venue, and prices.
- Print finish: matte ink, visible paper fiber, subtle screen-print density variation, slight ink spread on large black areas, and realistic poster surface texture.
- Border/shadow: thin hairline rules in off-white, soft realistic drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity under the hero figure, no glossy effects.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8 for the hero face, or Canon EOS R5 with 50mm at f/2.0 if the silhouette is broader; crisp editorial portrait compression, not illustration-like softness.
- Lighting: low-key studio lighting with a single softbox from upper-left at 45°, controlled fill from front-right, and a faint rim light to separate the subject from the black background.
- Color grade: high-contrast monochrome with selective red or teal accent treatment, slightly desaturated highlights, deep crushed blacks, and subtle film grain.
- Print realism: the final image should read as a professionally photographed and printed 대학로 theater poster, including tactile matte paper, tiny registration imperfections, and legible Korean typography.

[6. MOOD]
Indie off-Broadway-style drama poster — restrained, literary, tense, and intimate, with the editorial seriousness of a blackbox theater one-sheet and the lived-in texture of a real 대학로 street poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- 반드시 선명한 한글로 렌더링: “{연극 제목}”, “{부제}”, “{극장명}”, “{공연 기간}”, “{공연 시간}”, “{티켓 가격}”, “{예매처}”, “{문의전화}”.
- 포스터 안에 실제 홍보 정보처럼 보이는 문구 포함: “주최·제작 {주최제작}”, “후원 {후원사}”, “{관람등급}”, “{러닝타임}”, “예매 오픈”, “현장 수령 가능”.
- 예시 표기 유지 가능: “대학로 바람소극장”, “2026.05.10 - 06.20”, “화·수·목 19:30 / 금·토 16:00·19:30”, “R석 35,000원 / S석 28,000원 / 학생할인 20%”.
- Maintain a realistic poster layout with a single dominant hero image, legible typography hierarchy, one coherent composition, and believable printed production details.
- If the hero is a face, keep anatomy natural and avoid distorted proportions; if silhouette, keep the outline human and grounded.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable typography
- Celebrity composites unless explicitly requested
- Distorted human anatomy or plastic-looking faces

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the main hero treatment to occupy about 45–55% of the frame, with the title block dominating the upper third and the performance details anchored in the lower third.

- Background should be a stylized stage-like environment matching {작품 톤}, using dramatic scenery, stage curtains, haze, marquee glow, scenic set fragments, spotlight beams, orchestra-pit shadows, or genre-specific decorative motifs depending on the tone.

Layer scenic depth around the hero while preserving readable title and information zones.
4. Information block: Place {공연 정보} in a legitimate theater billing band in the lower third, aligned in compact lines like a real poster. 5. Ticket CTA zone: Add {티켓 CTA} as a visible booking strip or boxed footer element. Include ticket-oriented details such as “티켓 오픈 2026.05.20 WED 14:00”, “R석 150,000원 / S석 120,000원 / A석 90,000원”, “예매처 인터파크·멜론티켓”, and a small “문의 1588-0000” line. Treat this area like a practical sales footer rather than generic ad copy.
6. Sponsor and credit area: Add a compact sponsor/partner row near the bottom edge with small neutral logo boxes or text labels such as “제작”, “주최”, “후원”, “협찬”, “공식 예매처”, plus a fine-print credit line like “Licensed by Original Broadway Production / Korean Production 2026”.
