7. Palette integration: Apply {컬러 팔레트} consistently across title accents, hero rim light, stage haze, decorative dividers, spotlight color, CTA box, and footer details so the entire poster feels unified and production-specific.
8. Format and readability: Maintain a true vertical poster layout in {비율}, with strong contrast, print-ready hierarchy, crisp typography, and a balanced composition that supports both large-format print and mobile ticket-page viewing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use a premium theatrical mix such as Bebas Neue, Trajan-style serif, Didot, Oswald, or condensed marquee lettering for the English/main title, paired with Pretendard Bold, Noto Sans KR Bold, or Sandoll-style Korean gothic for Korean subheads, schedule, and billing text; title around 110–160 px feel, subtitle around 42–60 px, info text around 26–34 px, fine-print billing around 13–18 px.
- Korean poster text: Add short, realistic Korean lines where appropriate, such as “단 하나의 무대, 다시 시작되는 전설”, “오리지널 감동 그대로”, “2026년 7월 대개막”, “티켓 오픈”, “공연장”, “예매 문의”, and “라이선스 뮤지컬”. These should look intentionally typeset, not random filler.
- Color palette: Translate {컬러 팔레트} into specific poster-safe tones such as deep black #0B0B0F, antique gold #C8A24A, crimson #B11226, savanna amber #D89B2B, ocean white #F5F1E8, cobalt blue #2A5C9B, velvet burgundy #4B0F1E, smoky charcoal #17171C, or warm spotlight ivory #F2D58A depending on the musical tone.
- Graphic detailing: Use theatrical drop shadows with 4–8 px y-offset, 14–20 px blur, and 18–28% opacity; add thin gold or ivory rule dividers, subtle marquee bulbs, curtain seams, ticket-stub shapes, music staff lines, art-deco corner flourishes, stage dust, or spotlight cones where they support the production identity.
- Text hierarchy: Main title must dominate; tagline and licensing line should be secondary; {공연 정보} and {티켓 CTA} must be readable as practical information; sponsor and billing details should feel authentic and compact.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Cinematic poster photography look, shot like an Arri Alexa 65 / 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8 for the hero, or a 50mm lens for a more graphic stage-poster feel, with crisp subject isolation and controlled depth.
- Lighting: Use stage-inspired directional lighting such as a warm spotlight from upper-left, a faint rim light from right, footlight glow from below, and controlled front fill to preserve facial or silhouette readability; if the tone is jazz or noir, push to low-key side lighting with sharper contrast and smoky backlight.
- Color grade: Match the chosen musical tone precisely—Lion King-like savanna gold and sunset amber, Chicago-like black/gold/crimson, Phantom-like candlelit black and ivory, or Mamma Mia-like white/blue Mediterranean brightness—with polished cinematic saturation and poster-friendly contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Broadway one-sheet — feels like a large-scale commercial theater campaign poster with the polish of a West End marquee, the informational density of a real Seoul theater advertisement, and the cinematic finish of an award-season musical teaser.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: Render all supplied values from {작품 톤}, {타이틀 타이포}, {주연 hero}, {공연 정보}, {티켓 CTA}, {컬러 팔레트}, and {비율} cleanly if they appear as text or influence the poster design.
- Additional Korean strings must be sharp and correct if used: “라이선스 뮤지컬”, “티켓 오픈”, “공연기간”, “공연장”, “예매 문의”, “R석”, “S석”, “A석”, “러닝타임”, “8세 이상 관람가”.

- Typography must remain sharp, legible, and theatrical; preserve exact Korean characters without distortion or broken glyphs.

[1. PURPOSE]
Public emergency medical information card for quick lifesaving reference, designed as a square social-media infographic.
Korean public-safety poster style, 1-page emergency card layout, realistic municipal leaflet details, clear readability at thumbnail size.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the headline strip in the upper 16% of the frame, stack the main instruction blocks vertically in a strong grid, and use the lower band for emergency contact information and quick-action references.
- Use a bright white card base with strong red alert accents, charcoal text blocks, warning yellow highlight tags, pale blue medical cues, and subtle printed-paper texture for a realistic public-information board feeling.
- Add practical information-card details: top-left mini label “응급안전 카드 VOL.119”, top-right date label “2026.05 개정”, small slide indicator “01/05”, QR-style search box labeled “응급실 찾기”, and a footer credit line “배포용 안내 카드 · 의료상담은 1339”.
- Include compact iconography for phone, CPR hands, AED, burn cooling, location pin, magnifier, and checklist marks; use clear dividers, section labels, and realistic laminated-card shadows.
- Use {주제·상황}, {단계별 가이드}, {헤드라인}, {체크포인트}, {비상 연락처}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} as content placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 16%): set {헤드라인} in a bold Korean sans-serif masthead, centered, with a red emphasis wordmark treatment and tight vertical spacing; place a thin alert bar above and below for urgency. Add small support text: “3분이 생명을 살립니다.” and a top metadata row with “VOL.119”, “응급 · 심폐소생 · 화상”, and “2026년 5월 업데이트”.
- Main guide area (middle 44%): present {단계별 가이드} as a 4-step vertical sequence with pictogram-style icons and numbered circles, each step in its own rounded rectangle, aligned for fast scanning. Suggested step labels may include “1 안전 확인”, “2 119 신고”, “3 가슴압박”, “4 AED 사용 / 구급대 인계”, with short Korean microcopy under each line.
- Safety checkpoint area (middle-lower 16%): show {체크포인트} inside a compact boxed panel with a yellow accent strip, checklist ticks, small caution triangle icons, and concise line breaks for easy reading. Include realistic checkpoint snippets such as “압박 깊이 5cm”, “분당 100~120회”, “화상은 흐르는 물 20분”, “절대 멈추지 말 것”.
- Emergency contact area (lower 16%): display {비상 연락처} in a clearly separated footer block with bold contact numbers, emergency-style spacing, and a small icon row for phone/location/search cues. Add three quick tiles: “119 응급신고”, “1339 의료상담”, “가까운 응급실 검색”. Include a small QR-style square and tiny caption “스캔 후 위치 기반 검색”.
- Context label area (small side or top tag): place {주제·상황} as a compact descriptor label that frames the card’s topic without competing with the headline. Add small card-news UI details such as “저장해두세요”, “공유 권장”, and a bottom page marker “1 / 5”.
- Overall layout note: treat {컬러 팔레트} and {비율} as the governing presentation cues, keeping every section aligned to a rigid infographic grid while allowing useful safety icons, micro-labels, divider rules, paper grain, and realistic print-registration details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR in heavy 800 weight for the headline, 600–700 weight for body labels, and smaller 500 weight for auxiliary notes; keep size hierarchy strong and legible.
- Color palette: follow a public-safety scheme based on white #FFFFFF, emergency red #E53935, charcoal #263238, warning yellow #FBC02D, pale medical blue #E3F2FD, and light gray dividers #E0E0E0.
- Border/shadow: use thin red outline rules, soft card shadows with 0px x-offset, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12% opacity, rounded corners on internal boxes, and subtle offset shadows under labels to make the card feel printed and handled.
- Graphic details: add small icon badges, arrow connectors between steps, tiny dotted divider lines, barcode-like reference strip, QR-style search box, and realistic microtext such as “응급처치 참고용 · 상황별로 119 안내를 따르세요”.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing graphic poster composition, equivalent to a flat 50mm documentary layout with no perspective distortion, perfectly orthographic and centered.
- Lighting: even studio-like diffuse illumination, high-key presentation with clean contrast, gentle paper-surface shading, and controlled laminated-card sheen.
- Color grade: crisp white base with saturated safety red and restrained charcoal, matching municipal emergency pamphlet printing, with slight ink texture, soft gray paper fibers, and realistic printed infographic edges.

[6. MOOD]
Korean municipal emergency safety flyer — practical public-health infographic like a hospital triage notice, civil defense poster, and saved social-media card for urgent first-aid reference.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “3분이 생명을 살립니다.”, “119”, “1339”, “응급”, “의료상담”, “가까운 응급실 검색”, “압박 깊이 5cm”, “분당 100~120회”, “절대 멈추지 말 것”, “화상은 흐르는 물 20분”, “저장해두세요”.
- Keep the layout as a square 1024x1024 card with clear boxed sections, readable hierarchy, realistic emergency-card metadata, and no missing or garbled Korean characters.
- All step blocks must remain separate and visually distinct so the sequence is easy to follow at a glance.
- Render all Korean text cleanly in a professional public-safety style; the placeholders {주제·상황}, {단계별 가이드}, {헤드라인}, {체크포인트}, {비상 연락처}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} must remain available as the primary content drivers.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean hospital recruitment poster, A4 vertical hiring announcement for doctors and nurses, suitable for print, hospital lobby posting, and social sharing.
Create a realistic modern healthcare recruitment poster with institutional trust, rich hiring details, and a professional hospital-brand campaign look.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top section: {헤드라인} centered in the upper 18% of the poster, with {병원·기관명} placed directly below as a smaller institutional subtitle; add a small top-right label such as “2026 상반기 공개채용” and “채용공고 No. 2026-05”.
- Middle section: {채용 직군} presented as the main content block in structured role cards or separated line groups, occupying the central 35% of the frame; include small medical icon cues such as a stethoscope, cross, clipboard, heart pulse, and nurse cap line icons.
- Add a realistic poster background layer: softly blurred hospital corridor, nurse station, or cropped healthcare team photo in white coats and blue scrubs, lightly screened behind the text so the recruitment information remains crisp.
- Lower section: {근무 조건} and {지원 방법} arranged in two clearly separated information bands; include deadline, contact phone, email route, website line, and a realistic QR-code style application box labeled “지원 QR”.
- Footer details: include “접수기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “근무지: 서울시 ○○구 의료로 12”, “인사팀 문의 02-1234-5678”, and small credit text “사진 제공: 홍보팀 / 디자인: 인사채용팀”.
- Background treatment: bright white or very light cool gray matte paper surface with subtle medical-blue gradients, faint grid marks, thin dividers, soft rounded cards, and small clinical graphic accents.
- Framing: strict vertical alignment, balanced spacing between sections, clear hierarchy for fast reading at a distance and up-close print inspection.
- Use {병원·기관명}, {채용 직군}, {헤드라인}, {근무 조건}, {지원 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders throughout the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 20%): set {헤드라인} as the primary attention point in bold Korean sans-serif, with strong contrast and confident spacing; place {병원·기관명} beneath it as a smaller line for identity, plus a bilingual-style subtitle such as “Healthcare Recruitment Notice”.
- Add recruitment metadata near the header: “채용공고 No. 2026-05”, “정규직·계약직 모집”, and “서류접수 D-14” in small pill labels.
- Information block 1 (mid-upper 25%): introduce {채용 직군} as compact role cards with check marks, department labels, and separators; example supporting labels: “진료부”, “간호부”, “재활치료실”, “원무행정팀”.
- Information block 2 (mid-lower 25%): display {근무 조건} as a clear callout band with small icons for salary, insurance, schedule, night duty, meals, and commute support.
- Information block 3 (lower 18%): place {지원 방법} in a distinct footer box or highlighted strip, including “이메일 접수”, “채용 플랫폼 지원”, “마감일 엄수”, and “면접 일정 개별 안내”.
- Bottom utility strip: include a QR-code style square, application email line, phone number, address line, website placeholder, and small page-style marker “RECRUIT POSTER 01”.
- Visual accents: use thin divider lines, soft medical-blue wave shapes, ECG line motif, subtle plus symbols, translucent rounded rectangles, and a faint cropped hospital environment photo.
- Overall balance: create an official hospital recruitment notice that feels actually printed and posted, with realistic informational density and polished Korean institutional branding.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {헤드라인}, Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for section text, Noto Sans KR Regular for detail lines; headline size very large, supporting text medium-small, micro labels small but readable.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} translated into a white base with healthcare blue, teal, and charcoal accents; use hex guidance such as #FFFFFF, #2F80ED, #1FB6B2, #2E3440, plus pale sky tint #EAF5FF for card backgrounds.
- Border/shadow: thin 1–2px divider lines, subtle soft shadow around cards, about 8px blur and 10% opacity; use restrained depth suitable for a printed institutional poster.
- Layout styling: crisp print-poster grid with role cards, deadline badges, application QR area, contact footer, small department labels, and professional hospital identity marks.
- Graphic details: include small monochrome icons, soft gradient ribbons, rounded information panels, and a realistic matte paper feel with slight ink texture.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing graphic poster composition, equivalent to an 85mm clean editorial framing with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: bright even studio-style illumination, flat and readable; if a photographic background element is used, keep it softly lit from upper-left with gentle clinical highlights.
- Color grade: cool clinical whites with medical blue and teal highlights, charcoal text, pale gray dividers, and restrained saturation.
- Material feel: printed A4 recruitment poster on matte paper, sharp Korean typography, crisp vector accents, slight paper grain, realistic ink density, and clean digital-to-print finish.

[6. MOOD]
Professional hospital recruitment notice — editorial healthcare poster with the clean clarity of an NHS public announcement, modern Korean institutional branding, and the practical richness of a real HR hiring campaign displayed in a hospital lobby.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “환자 곁에서 함께할 분을 찾습니다.”, “○○ 종합병원 또는 ○○ 요양병원 — 한글 + 영문 부제”, “내과 전문의·임상간호사·물리치료사·방사선사·의료행정”, “연봉 협의 / 4대보험 / 주 5일 / 야간·당직 별도 / 식대·교통비”, “이력서·자기소개서 → 이메일 hr@○○.co.kr 또는 사람인 / 마감일”, “화이트 + 의료 블루 + 청록 + 차콜 — 신뢰 결”, “A4 세로 1024x1536”.
- Add realistic Korean poster details: “2026 상반기 공개채용”, “채용공고 No. 2026-05”, “접수기간 2026.05.01–05.31”, “지원 QR”, “인사팀 문의 02-1234-5678”, “근무지: 서울시 ○○구 의료로 12”, “면접 일정 개별 안내”, “RECRUIT POSTER 01”.
- Maintain exact poster hierarchy: headline first, institution name second, recruitment roles clearly visible, conditions and application method separated.
- Keep {병원·기관명}, {채용 직군}, {헤드라인}, {근무 조건}, {지원 방법}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} exactly as placeholders while using them as the main visible content.
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and correctly rendered, with no layout collisions or broken spacing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Professional Korean hospital information card for clinic hours, reservation, address, and patient guidance, designed as a square SNS/shareable notice board for a clinic website, Kakao channel post, Naver place image, or in-clinic digital signage.
The card should feel like a real reception-desk 안내문: clear administrative information, practical contact actions, appointment guidance, and small trust-building details such as update date and QR reservation label.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main square notice card fills about 90% of the frame with comfortable internal padding, arranged as a polished clinic information board on a soft medical-white background.
- Top header area holds {병원명·로고} as the brand anchor, plus {업데이트 날짜} in a small rounded label on the right for realistic notice-card detail.
- Organize the body into four clear stacked information zones: 진료시간, 예약 안내, 위치·교통, 내원 전 안내. Use thin dividers, pale tinted panels, and small icon chips to separate content naturally.
- Include a compact CTA strip near the lower area with {예약 버튼 문구}, {예약 QR 라벨}, and a small QR-code-like square graphic placeholder, making the card look like an actual digital reservation guide.
- Use {진료시간 표}, {예약 정보}, {주소·교통}, {내원 안내}, {진료과목 태그}, {아이콘 톤}, {컬러 팔레트}, and {푸터 안내문} as visible customizable content in the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 16–18%): Place {병원명·로고} on the left in a clean clinic brand treatment with logo mark, Korean name, and optional English subline. On the right, add a small capsule label containing {업데이트 날짜}. Under the clinic name, place {진료과목 태그} as 3–5 small rounded medical-category chips.
2. Hours block (upper-middle 24–26%): Show section title “진료시간” with a clock icon from {아이콘 톤}. Present {진료시간 표} in a table-style layout with weekday, Saturday, lunch, and closed-day rows; use pale blue/mint row backgrounds and stronger text for the most important time ranges.
3. Reservation block (middle 19–21%): Use section title “예약 안내” with phone/chat/calendar icons from {아이콘 톤}. Display {예약 정보} as 2–3 practical contact lines, plus a prominent rounded button containing {예약 버튼 문구}. Add a small QR-like square labeled {예약 QR 라벨} beside the button.
4. Address & transport block (lower-middle 20–22%): Use section title “오시는 길” with map-pin and parking icons from {아이콘 톤}. Display {주소·교통} in short lines, accompanied by a simple abstract mini-map strip with a station dot, walking path, building marker, and parking P icon.
5. Patient notice & footer strip (bottom 12–14%): Add a light notice panel titled “내원 전 확인” containing {내원 안내}. Finish with a thin accent band using {컬러 팔레트}, small reception-hours microcopy, and {푸터 안내문} aligned neatly along the bottom.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; clinic name in Bold 700–800 at about 34–44 px, main section titles in SemiBold 600–700 at about 22–26 px, table labels in Medium 500–600 at about 17–21 px, body text in Regular/Medium 400–500 at about 15–19 px, with clean line spacing for mobile readability.
- Color palette: Use {컬러 팔레트} precisely, with white #FFFFFF or very pale mint as the base, medical blue/mint accents such as #3C7DD9 or #4CB7A5, soft panel fills #F3F8FA / #EEF7F5, and charcoal #2B2F33 for primary text.
- Layout details: Use rounded rectangles, icon chips, subtle dividers, table row tinting, small status labels, and a realistic QR-code placeholder; maintain a calm hospital-administration look while allowing enough practical details to feel like a real clinic notice.
- Border/shadow: Add a soft card shadow around the main board, 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 10–14% opacity, or a thin 1px pale blue-gray outline for a crisp professional finish.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat graphic poster composition, as if designed on an iPad in a 1:1 layout; no photographic subject, no depth-heavy perspective, no lens distortion.
- Lighting: Even studio-like diffuse illumination with all typography and icons uniformly legible, suitable for SNS upload and printed clinic counter display.
- Color grade: Cool clinical white balanced with medical blue or mint accents, charcoal typography, soft pastel panels, and polished digital signage clarity.

[6. MOOD]
Trustworthy modern Korean clinic reception notice — calm, practical, friendly, and easy to scan, like a polished hospital lobby information card with real appointment and access details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보이도록 유지: {병원명·로고}, {진료시간 표}, {예약 정보}, {주소·교통}, {내원 안내}, {예약 버튼 문구}, {예약 QR 라벨}, {업데이트 날짜}, {푸터 안내문}.
- Include realistic visible labels such as “진료시간”, “예약 안내”, “오시는 길”, “내원 전 확인”, “대표전화”, “카카오 채널”, “네이버 예약”, “주차 안내”.
- Keep all Korean text sharp, correctly spaced, and free of broken characters or accidental English substitutions.
- Maintain a square notice-card composition with clear hierarchy: clinic header first, then hours, reservation actions, access information, and patient notice/footer.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Misleading government or emergency-service authority marks
- Celebrity composites

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean health checkup package guide card, square card-news style medical infographic for social media sharing and clinic reservation promotion.
Designed to present a hospital screening center package overview with practical pricing, reservation information, clinic contact details, and a trust-building healthcare editorial tone.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered square card-news composition with {병원·검진센터} as the main brand/location anchor near the top, {슬라이드번호} as a small page indicator in the upper-right, and {소셜핸들} as a subtle social source label.
- Headline zone across the upper third: show {헤드라인} in the largest type, supported by a small date chip for {프로모션기간} and a thin cyan accent ribbon.
- Main information zone: place {패키지 종류} as a category strip, then organize {검진 항목 카드} into a 2x2 grid with package name, key tests, estimated duration, and price clearly visible.
- Bottom reservation band: include {상담전화}, {운영시간}, {주소}, {예약CTA}, {해시태그}, and {하단안내문구}; add small save/share micro icons and a QR-style reservation block for realistic social-card detail.
- Trust visual: integrate {의료진 신뢰 컷} in the lower-right or as a rounded photo inset, with natural clinic props such as a tablet chart, stethoscope, appointment card, sample tubes, or screening equipment to make the healthcare setting believable.
- Use {컬러 팔레트} as the design system while allowing rounded cards, dividers, small icon badges, date labels, medical cross motifs, and light geometric accents that support readability.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone (about 18% height): place {병원·검진센터} in a compact institutional title style, add {소셜핸들} beneath or beside it, and set {슬라이드번호} as “01/05” style card-news pagination.
- Hero message zone (about 18% height): set {헤드라인} centered and bold, with a small label reading “2026 건강검진 패키지” and a pill-shaped period tag using {프로모션기간}.
- Package grid zone (about 38% height): place {패키지 종류} as a short category line, then arrange {검진 항목 카드} into four consistent modules; each module should include a tiny medical icon, package title, core examination list, time estimate, and price in a prominent blue or teal number style.
- Trust and clinic detail zone (about 16% height): insert {의료진 신뢰 컷} as a credibility photo inset alongside practical details: “상담 {상담전화}”, {운영시간}, and {주소}. Use a small QR-like block labeled “예약 바로가기” for realistic clinic advertising texture.
- Footer CTA zone (about 10% height): show {예약CTA} as the strongest bottom call-to-action, followed by {해시태그}, save/share micro icons, and {하단안내문구} in smaller legible Korean text.
- Preserve the relationship between headline, package cards, reservation details, and trust image so the composition reads as a professional healthcare card-news slide rather than a generic poster.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard and Noto Sans KR, with bold 700–800 weight for the headline, medium 500–600 for labels and prices, and 400–500 for supporting text; maintain crisp Korean readability at 1024x1024.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} should resolve into white #FFFFFF, medical blue #2F80ED, cyan-teal #2DB7C9, charcoal #2E3440, and very pale blue-gray #F3F8FC for card panels.
- Graphic system: use rounded 14px package modules, 1px pale blue-gray dividers, soft shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12% opacity, cyan check icons, small calendar/phone/location pictograms, and a modest medical cross pattern at low opacity.
- Information density should feel like a real clinic social post: include prices, times, date, phone number, address, and CTA without overwhelming the four-card package grid.
- Decorative graphics may include subtle waveform lines, checklist ticks, circular badge labels, and small document tabs, all aligned to the healthcare brochure grid.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean editorial healthcare product-photo feel, shot like a 50mm lens at f/5.6 for crisp clarity and minimal distortion; if using the trust cut, frame it like a controlled commercial still rather than a candid snapshot.
- Lighting: bright diffused studio light from upper-left at roughly 45°, with gentle fill from the right and no harsh shadows; keep highlights soft and surfaces evenly exposed.
- Color grade: cool white with medical blue, soft cyan, and restrained charcoal, echoing a modern hospital brochure and corporate wellness branding.
- Photo inset realism: medical staff should look professional and approachable, with real fabric texture on lab coats, natural skin detail, clean clinic counter surfaces, and believable equipment scale.

[6. MOOD]
Premium clinical brochure design — similar to a modern hospital campaign card with a trust-forward healthcare editorial finish, practical reservation information, and polished Korean card-news readability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 한국어 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함.
  - "내 몸이 보내는 신호, 미리 잡으세요."
  - "종합검진 / 암 정밀 / 뇌혈관 / 심장 / 여성·남성 맞춤"
  - "○○ 건강검진센터 또는 ○○ 종합병원 검진실"
  - "상담 02-1234-5678"
  - "2026.05.01–2026.06.30"
- Keep all Korean characters sharp and unbroken; do not blur, distort, or reflow the headline, prices, phone number, date, address, or package names so they become unreadable.
- Card grid must remain four items, evenly sized and visually consistent, with package title, 핵심 검사, 소요 시간, and 가격 all present.
- Trust visual must stay modest and credible; no exaggerated facial features, no unnatural anatomy, no aggressive medical dramatization.
- Include realistic social-card details: {슬라이드번호}, {소셜핸들}, {해시태그}, save/share micro icons, and bottom CTA.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or identity swaps

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical pharmacy product advertisement poster for medicines and nutritional supplements, designed like a realistic Korean retail promotional flyer for social media and in-store display.
Commercial health-product layout with a clear headline, product hero lineup, discount badge, campaign period, item prices, store contact details, and pharmacy-counter atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header zone (about 16%): {약국명·로고} placed centered or slightly upper-left depending on logo width, with {상단 캠페인 라벨} and a tidy pharmacy signboard feel.
- Main headline zone (about 15%): {헤드라인} set prominently below the logo in a bold Korean sans-serif, supported by {서브카피} in a smaller charcoal weight.
- Product hero zone (about 39%): {주력 상품} and {제품 hero} arranged as 6–8 boxed or bottled supplement packs in a believable retail lineup, with realistic shadows, label details, foil caps, paper box texture, and a light pharmacy counter surface.
- Price and benefit zone (about 12%): place {할인 배지} near the hero cluster, then add {대표 가격표} as short item-price strips or small shelf tags so the poster feels like an actual pharmacy promotion.
- Event information zone (about 10%): show {행사 기간}, {행사 장소}, {상담 안내} and {쿠폰 안내} in compact information blocks with pharmacy-green dividers and small icon markers.
- Footer zone (about 8%): include {주소·연락처}, {운영시간}, {협력 문구}, a small QR-style reservation box, and fine-print safety guidance using {컬러 팔레트}.
- Keep the composition poster-like, front-facing, and highly legible, with Korean text occupying clearly separated zones and natural pharmacy details supporting the products.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header band: place {약국명·로고} at the top on a white and pale-green field, using a concise pharmacy-brand look with a small cross symbol, receipt-like date tag, and {상단 캠페인 라벨}.
2. Headline band: render {헤드라인} directly beneath the logo in large, bold Korean type, with {서브카피} below it for practical purchase motivation without medical exaggeration.
3. Product staging: arrange {주력 상품} as a set of supplement boxes, bottles, blister-pack cartons, and pouches in a straight or gently staggered retail lineup; the display should feel like a pharmacy counter still life with shelf tags and small product category labels.
4. Hero treatment: show {제품 hero} with crisp packaging edges, subtle natural shadow, realistic material finish, printed Korean product labels, capsule icons, and a light countertop texture rather than glossy plastic staging.
5. Accent badge: add {할인 배지} as one rounded red sticker-style badge near the product grouping, visually secondary to the main products.
6. Price and promotion details: add {대표 가격표} as 3–4 readable price chips, plus {멤버십 혜택} in a small yellow highlight strip.
7. Event and store information: include {행사 기간}, {행사 장소}, {상담 안내}, {쿠폰 안내}, {주소·연락처}, and {운영시간}; add a small QR-style square labeled for reservation or coupon access.
8. Color blocking: apply {컬러 팔레트} across header accents, badge, separators, shelf tags, and footer information; use pharmacy green and yellow to guide the eye through the poster.
9. Layout discipline: maintain consistent margins, aligned baselines, readable hierarchy, and no overlapping text; the poster should feel like a polished Korean pharmacy circular with real in-store details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR ExtraBold for the headline, Pretendard Medium for secondary text, and Pretendard Regular for fine print; headline size should be large and compact, with clean Korean letterforms.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}, using white as the primary background, pharmacy green for brand cues, yellow as a highlight tone, red for the discount badge, and charcoal for readable text.
- Graphic elements: add small pharmacy cross icons, capsule/pill line icons, price-tag shapes, shelf-label strips, dotted coupon edge detail, and a small QR-style reservation box.
- Border/shadow: very subtle soft drop shadow, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; thin separators in muted gray or pale green where helpful.
- Fine print: include short safety guidance and stock notice in small readable Korean, avoiding official-certification seals or medical-cure claims.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, full-frame 85mm lens at f/5.6 for crisp packaging detail and controlled perspective.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left with gentle fill from right, similar to a clean retail catalog shoot; slight rim highlight on bottle edges.
- Color grade: clean white base with pharmacy green, warm yellow accents, and neutral charcoal; natural product-label colors may appear on packaging for realism.
- Surface and environment: pale stone or laminate pharmacy counter, faint shelf reflection, soft background suggestion of a pharmacy aisle, printed price tags, and realistic paper/poster texture.

[6. MOOD]
Professional Korean pharmacy promotional poster — trustworthy neighborhood pharmacy atmosphere, organized retail catalog energy, practical family-health shopping tone, and modern health-brand clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "하루 한 알, 가족 건강 챙기세요.", "가족 패키지 30% OFF"
